title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
PTD Cleantech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (PTD-CS) is an international design and engineering company, catering its services to high-tech and life science industries. PTD-CS has expertise in providing technical and engineering solutions for cleanroom technology, controlled environments, and building engineering.

PTD-CS is a fully owned subsidiary of CRC Engineering, Belgium.

This job role offers to make the most of your dynamic abilities of engineering knowhow, project management, problem solving, risk forecast and troubleshooting.

What PTD-CS Offers

* Exposure to cutting-edge Semiconductor Projects
* Hands-on experience in Cleanroom Technology
* Opportunity to create World-Class Engineering Designs
* Healthy Work-Life Balance
* Comprehensive Medical Health Insurance
* Fair and competitive compensation aligned with market standards
* A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment

Join PTD-CS and become part of a team that is shaping the future of high-tech and life science facilities through innovation, excellence, and engineering expertise. Please refer to the Job Description below for more details.

•Quantity Surveying:

* Prepare detailed BOQs (Bill of Quantities) for projects based on designs and specifications.
* Conduct quantity take-offs and validate measurements for all construction works.
* Regularly update project cost estimates and budgets to ensure alignment with actuals.

•Billing Management:

* Prepare and submit contractor and client bills (RA Bills, final bills, etc.) as per contract terms.
* Reconcile project costs and ensure timely billing to clients and vendors.
* Verify contractor claims, certifications, and invoices against actual progress and deliverables.

•Cost Control & Monitoring:

* Monitor project costs and provide variance analysis reports to management.
* Assist in identifying potential cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.

•Contract Management:

* Review and interpret contract documents, including tender documents, scope of work, and payment terms.
* Coordinate with project teams to ensure adherence to contract terms and conditions.

•Documentation & Reporting:

* Maintain accurate records of quantities, billing documents, and payment schedules.
* Generate MIS reports, cost analyses, and cash flow statements for internal review.

•Site Coordination:

* Collaborate with site engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure seamless execution of work.
* Conduct site visits to verify progress and ensure adherence to planned quantities and quality standards.

**Desire Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering or Quantity Surveying.
* PGDM in QS from NICMAR candidate will be preferred
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in quantity surveying and billing, preferably in construction projects.
* Ready to travel daily to Site Location at Sanand Gujrat India
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Office (Excel, Word), and billing software like SAP, Tally, or ERP systems.
* Strong understanding of construction practices, methods, and materials.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines effectively.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with teams and clients.
* Strong knowledge in rate analysis.
* Strong knowledge of local government and Delhi Scheduled of Rate schedule of rates
* Strong knowledge of IS code provisions.

**Skills**

* Cost Estimation
* Budget Management
* Billing and Invoicing
* Negotiation
* AutoCAD
* MS office
* Excel
* Project Management
* Analytical Skills
* Regulatory Compliance

title: Project Manager Civil
description:
**Job Description: Project Manager – Civil (PRW, High-Rise Residential) | Banga Construction**

**Banga Construction**
is hiring a site-based
**Project Manager – Civil to run its PRW (piece-rate, labour-only)**
packages on multistorey residential towers in Gurugram. The role owns progress, labour, safety, billing and package margin.

**Position**
- Project Manager – Civil (PRW, High-Rise Residential Projects)

**Company**
- Banga Construction

**Location**
- Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana – site-based

**Reports**
to - Managing Partner

**Scope of work**
- Labor-only PRW packages under Tier-1 EPC contractors and developers: RCC structure (formwork, reinforcement, concreting), masonry, plaster and finishing

**Experience**
- 12–18 years in high-rise residential construction, including 5+ years leading a project or tower package

**Qualification**
- B.E./B.Tech (Civil); Diploma (Civil) with 18+ years considered

**Employment type**
- Full-time, permanent

**Site team**
· reporting lines

Execution runs down one line from site engineers to trade gangs; billing, safety, compliance, stores and camp staff report straight to the Project Manager.

**About Banga Construction**

Banga Construction is a partnership firm engaged in high-rise building construction, plotted colony development and solar installation works. It is taking up labor-only PRW packages on multistorey residential projects in Delhi NCR, for reputed developers and Tier-1 EPC contractors. The Project Manager will lead this business at site level from Gurugram.

**Key responsibilities**
1. Mobilisation and planning

•        Study the work order before mobilisation: scope matrix, rates, measurement rules, payment terms, retention, recoveries and penalties. Flag commercial risks to the Managing Partner.

•        Prepare the mobilization plan: trade-wise labour histogram against the client's schedule, core staff, tools and tackles, site office and labour camp.

•        Run 3-week look-ahead and weekly plans by tower and floor. Confirm fronts, GFC drawings, crane and hoist time, and concrete supply with the client daily.

2. Labour mobilization, deployment and retention

•        Mobilise and hold the committed strength by trade: shuttering carpenters, aluminum formwork fitters, bar benders, masons, concrete gangs and helpers.

•        Build a dependable network of gang leaders and labour sources across states. Settle gang-leader advances and payments transparently.

•        Plan for attrition around Holi, Chhath, Diwali and harvest seasons, with replacement pipelines and retention incentives.

•        Run the labour camp to the client's audit standard: drinking water, sanitation, kitchens, electrical and fire safety, first aid.

3. Execution, productivity and cycle time

•        Deliver the committed floor cycle. Clear constraints before they idle a gang.

•        Track daily output per man-day by trade against the rate-analysis assumptions; correct shortfalls the same day.

•        Ensure pre-pour checks, pour cards, curing and de-shuttering times as per specification.

4. Quality

•        Execute to GFC drawings, specifications, the client's method statements and inspection test plans (ITPs), and relevant IS codes.

•        Get stage inspections right the first time; rework is at PRW cost.

•        Close NCRs and snag lists within agreed timelines; keep checklists and quality records current.

5. Health, safety and environment

•        Enforce the client's HSE plan: PPE, work-at-height permits, full-body harnesses with lifelines, edge protection and safety nets. Ensure scaffold tagging, lifting and hot-work permits, and ELCB-protected power.

•        Induct every new worker, hold daily toolbox talks, deploy safety stewards as per client norms, and report near-misses.

•        Manage summer heat stress (work-rest cycles, water, shade) and medical fitness for height work.

•        Follow CAQM/GRAP dust-control norms for NCR. Plan work and retain labor through GRAP restrictions on construction.

•        Target zero incidents and zero safety penalties; back-charges for violations come straight out of margin.

6. Measurement, billing and commercial control

•        Take joint measurements with client engineers as per the contract's measurement rules (IS 1200 where applicable). Submit RA bills on schedule and follow through to certification and payment.

•        Track work done, billed, certified and received; keep unbilled work to a minimum.

•        Document and claim extra items, rate revisions and hindrance or idle-labor claims, backed by the hindrance register and written client instructions.

•        Reconcile every bill's deduction: retention, advance recovery, material recovery and penalties. Contest unjustified back-charges.

•        Track labor cost against billing per tower and review package margin weekly with the Managing Partner.

7. Free-issue material, formwork and tools

•        Reconcile client-supplied materials (reinforcement steel, binding wire, cement, cover blocks) monthly against theoretical consumption. Keep wastage within contractual limits to avoid recoveries.

•        Take custody of client formwork, aluminum or conventional: inventory, cleaning, oiling, and loss and damage control.

8. Statutory labour compliance and welfare

•        Keep every registration current: contractor license under the applicable labour law, BOCW registration of workers, PF and ESIC.

•        Pay wages on time by bank transfer, at or above Haryana minimum wages. Maintain biometric attendance, wage and overtime records.

•        Complete worker documentation: KYC, police verification, ID cards, medical fitness and insurance. Report accidents within statutory timelines.

9. Client and stakeholder management

•        Be Banga's single point of contact with the client's project, planning, QA/QC and HSE teams; attend weekly review meetings.

•        Coordinate interfaces with other agencies on site: MEP, waterproofing, façade and lifts.

•        Liaise with the labour department, BOCW board, police (worker verification) and local vendors.

10. Team leadership

•        Recruit, deploy and develop the site team; run a daily planning meeting and assign an owner to every front.

•        Enforce integrity: true attendance, honest measurement, no ghost labour and no cash leakage.

11. Reporting to the Managing Partner

•        Daily: labour strength by trade, work done, productivity, safety observations and constraints.

•        Weekly: progress against plan, 3-week look-ahead, billing status, wage-cash requirement, margin and risks.

•        Monthly: package P&L, material reconciliation, compliance status, receivables and labour forecast.

12. Business growth

•        Build rate analyses for new PRW enquiries and additional towers from actual site productivity data.

•        Support vendor registration and pre-qualification with Tier-1 contractors and developers in NCR.

Qualifications and experience

The deciding requirement is proven PRW leadership on high-rise residential towers.

Essential

•        B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering; Diploma in Civil Engineering with 18+ years of relevant experience will be considered.

•        12–18 years in multistorey residential construction (typically G+20 and above), with 5+ years leading a project or tower package.

•        Direct PRW experience: running packages for a PRW contractor, or managing PRW contractors for a Tier-1 contractor or developer.

•        Hands-on high-rise execution with aluminum formwork (Mivan or equivalent) and/or conventional formwork.

•        Has managed 300+ workers at a single site, including mobilization from source states.

•        Strong in measurement, rate analysis, RA billing and material reconciliation.

•        Fluent Hindi; working English for client meetings and reports.

Preferred

•        Background with Tier-1 contractors such as L&T, Tata Projects, Shapoorji Pallonji or Ahluwalia Contracts.

•        Projects in Delhi NCR, with knowledge of the local labour market, Haryana labour procedures and CAQM/GRAP norms.

•        An existing network of gang leaders across formwork, reinforcement and masonry trades.

•        Exposure to finishing packages (blockwork, plaster, tiling, painting).

•        Safety training such as NEBOSH IGC or IOSH Managing Safely.

Skills and competenciesTechnical

•        RCC execution to IS 456, ductile detailing to IS 13920 and bar bending schedules to IS 2502; measurement to IS 1200.

•        Aluminum formwork cycle planning, de-shuttering and back-propping sequence, and panel inventory; conventional shuttering for podiums, cores and special elements.

•        Planning: labour histograms, look-ahead plans, trade-wise productivity norms and constraint logs.

•        Commercial: labour-only rate analysis, cost-to-complete, wage cash-flow and claims documentation.

•        Compliance: the Labour Codes, BOCW, PF/ESIC, minimum wages and contract-labour records for construction sites.

•        Safety: work-at-height systems, permit-to-work, scaffolding to IS 3696, and lifting operations.

Behavioral

•        
**Ownership:**
present on site and accountable for outcomes, not effort.

•        
**People leadership:**
firm, fair handling of a large migrant workforce; settles disputes before they stop work.

•        
**Integrity:**
clean attendance, measurement and payments, every time.

•        
**Client handling:**
negotiates claims and deductions without damaging the relationship.

•        
**Data discipline:**
decides from daily numbers, not impressions.

•        
**Composure:**
steady through critical pours, audits and shutdowns.

Working conditions and compensation

•        Site-based at Gurugram, six days a week, with extended hours during critical pours and audits.

•        Travel to labour-source states for mobilization when required.

•        Performance-linked incentive tied to floor cycle, billing realization, safety record and package margin.

How to apply

Send your CV to email-
**hr@greenworldsolarwares.com**

/ WhatsApp number -
**9981444738**
with the subject "Project Manager Civil – PRW – Gurugram". Include:

•        Current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

title: Search Engine Optimization Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**
HO Digital is a performance marketing agency that partners with founders to build end-to-end customer acquisition and lifecycle frameworks that turn marketing channels into profitable revenue engines. we focuses on measurable results, optimizing campaigns for scalable growth. Core services include Paid Ads, search engine optimization, content & creative strategies.

HO Digital helps brands scale acquisition, capture organic market share, and drive repeat revenue through integrated strategy, rapid experimentation, and disciplined execution. More information is available at hodigital.com.

**Role Description**
The Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Project Manager is a full-time hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements.

This role oversees end-to-end SEO projects, coordinating technical optimization, content initiatives, and link-building campaigns to improve organic visibility and drive qualified traffic.

The SEO Project Manager collaborates with internal teams and clients to define objectives, plan roadmaps, allocate resources, and manage timelines while monitoring performance in web analytics tools.

Daily responsibilities include conducting keyword research, reviewing on-page and technical SEO recommendations, tracking deliverables, preparing performance reports, and communicating progress and insights to stakeholders. The role also involves identifying opportunities to enhance organic demand capture across AI search, commercial keywords, and landing page experiences.

**Qualifications**

* **4+ years of hands-on SEO experience**
  managing end-to-end technical, on-page, and off-page initiatives.
* Candidates should possess strong Project Management skills to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple AI SEO initiatives on time and within scope.
* Person should possess advanced Keyword Research and Search Engine Optimization skills to identify opportunities, prioritize pages, and guide content and technical strategies.
* Candidates should possess Link Building and outreach skills to develop high-quality, sustainable off-page SEO campaigns that improve authority and rankings.
* Candidates should possess Web Analytics skills (e.g., Google Analytics, Search Console, tag management) to track performance, analyze trends, and derive actionable insights.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for clear client interactions, cross-functional collaboration, documentation, and reporting.
* Relevant experience in performance marketing, eCommerce, or digital agencies, with a proven track record in managing SEO projects and delivering measurable growth.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page optimization, AI search developments, and best practices for mobile-first and user-centric experiences.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize effectively, and maintain attention to detail across multiple projects.

title: Manager – Gender Equality Project
description:
**Job Description:**
Manager – Gender Project

**Location:**
Gurgaon, with field travel | Experience: 3–5 years | Employment Type: Full-time

About Karma Healthcare TrustKarma Healthcare Trust is a mission-driven organization committed to making quality primary healthcare affordable and accessible for underserved communities across India. Through strategic partnerships, technology-enabled healthcare delivery, and community-focused interventions, we strive to bridge healthcare inequities and improve health outcomes at scale.

Website: https://www.karmahealthcaretrust.org/

At Karma Healthcare Trust, you will be part of a passionate, mission-driven team working to make quality healthcare accessible to underserved communities. As a nimble organization with a culture of ownership, collaboration, and accountability, we empower our people to take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment. If you are driven by purpose and want your work to create lasting social impact, Karma Healthcare Trust is the place for you.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager – Gender Equality Project to support the day-to-day coordination and implementation of the Gender Equality Initiative. Working closely with the Program Lead and the broader project team, the Manager will help drive on-ground execution across the four intervention areas, maintain project documentation and trackers, and support monitoring, reporting, and donor compliance requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project Coordination:**
  Support planning and day-to-day execution of activities under Safe Abortion, Nutrition, Mental Health, and Women’s Leadership interventions across telemedicine centres.
* **Field & Centre Liaison:**
  Coordinate with telemedicine centre staff, paramedics, and doctors (gynaecologist, nutritionist, mental health counsellor) to ensure smooth service delivery and timely data flow.
* **Monitoring & Reporting:**
  Maintain activity trackers, collate outputs (counselling sessions, trainings, awareness reach) and support the Centre for Healthcare at IIM Udaipur with data for M&E.
* **Documentation & Compliance:**
  Assist in preparing donor reports, utilization updates, and program documentation in line with Donor requirements and internal governance.
* **Awareness & Training Support:**
  Help coordinate awareness campaigns, staff training sessions, and the women’s leadership development program, including logistics for the 15 selected women staff.
* **Stakeholder Support:**
  Provide logistical and documentation support for public sector engagement meetings and partnership-building activities.
* **Process Ownership:**
  Flag implementation gaps or delays proactively and support course correction in coordination with the Program Manager.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in social work, Public Health, Gender Studies, Development Studies, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in program coordination within health, gender, or development-sector projects.
* Prior exposure to reproductive health, nutrition, mental health, or women’s empowerment programs is preferred.

**Technical Skills:**

* Comfortable with MS Excel, MS Office, and basic data/reporting trackers.
* Familiarity with donor reporting formats and program monitoring tools is an advantage.
* Good understanding of the relevant regulatory and policy frameworks, such as national health program guidelines and the MTP Act is preferred.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Good coordination and stakeholder communication skills across field, clinical, and leadership teams.
* Willingness to travel in rural India to our telemedicine centers is required.
* Proficiency in Hindi is required.

What We Offer

* The chance to lead a flagship women's health program that improves access to care for rural women across India.
* Direct exposure to the leadership team, donors, government stakeholders and a leading academic evaluation partner.
* Competitive compensation.
* Hybrid work model (3 days' work from office).
* Continuous learning, professional development and meaningful career growth.

How to Apply: Share the following details at humanresources@karmahealthcaretrust.org

* Resume
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC
* Notice Period / Earliest Joining
* Current Location
* Comfortable with Gurgaon base + field travel (Yes/No)

Selection Proces

* Aptitude Assessment
* Managerial Skill Assessment
* Leadership Panel Interviews (2-3 Rounds)

*Note:*

*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted*
Join us in building a future where quality healthcare is accessible to everyone!

title: Project Manager- MEPF, Bhubaneswar
description:
**Who is Turner & Townsend?**

All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**

The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:**
We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:**
We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:**
We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice

**Job Description**

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced
**MEPF Manager**
with 10–12 years of expertise in managing Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Fighting systems for large-scale building and infrastructure projects. The incumbent will be responsible for planning, design coordination, execution, testing & commissioning, quality control, and timely delivery of all MEPF activities while ensuring compliance with project standards, safety regulations, and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities

title: Project Head - Carbon Capture, Bio Industrial Solutions and Circular Materials
description:
**Project Head - Carbon Capture, Bio Industrial Solutions and Circular Materials**

CarbonWeave Ventures Private Limited is part of Sindhu Trade Links Limited, the flagship holding company of the diversified Sindhu Group. The company is establishing a new climate-tech and circular-materials business spanning carbon capture, biochar, algae, biotechnology and fly-ash utilisation.

The initiative is currently at the concept stage and has direct Promoter sponsorship. An identified land parcel, project funding and initial resources are available. The Project Head will convert this foundation into an executable, controlled and commercially viable business platform and build the organisation from the ground up.

**Role informationRole : Project Head - Carbon Capture, Bio-Industrial Solutions and Circular Materials**

**Company :**
CarbonWeave Ventures Private Limited

**Group : Sindhu Trade Links Limited and the diversified Sindhu Group**

**Business stage :**
Greenfield concept-to-commercial build

**Employment : Full-time and exclusive**

**Base location :**
Raipur, Chhattisgarh - approximately three weeks per month

**Corporate travel : Gurgaon headquarters -**
approximately one week per month, plus project-related travel

**Reporting :**
Directly to the Promoter

**Role Overview**

CarbonWeave is seeking a senior techno-commercial Project Head to build and lead an integrated carbon capture and circular-materials platform. The role covers CCUS, biochar, algae-based CO2 capture, biotechnology and bio-industrial solutions, and value-added fly-ash utilisation.

This is not a narrow plant-management, research or sustainability-reporting role. It requires a business builder who can combine technology evaluation, industrial project execution, commercialisation, carbon integrity, regulatory discipline, safety and P&L thinking. The successful candidate is not expected to be the deepest specialist in every technical stream; they must bring credible depth in relevant areas and be able to assemble and lead specialist teams across the wider platform.

**Strategic Mandate**

· Create a commercially viable independent business vertical with its own revenue and P&L roadmap.

· Support the Sindhu Group's decarbonisation objectives, develop credible carbon assets and create new products and business opportunities.

· Build a portfolio of projects across CCUS, biochar, algae, biotechnology and fly-ash utilisation. Multiple initiatives are expected to progress concurrently, supported by specialist teams.

· Translate the current concept into board-ready business plans, detailed project reports, pilot programmes, operating systems and commercial-scale execution.

· Establish disciplined governance so that technology, capex, safety, regulatory and carbon-related decisions are supported by evidence and clear accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and Business Model**

· Prepare and execute a three-year and five-year roadmap for the carbon and circular bio-industrial platform.

· Evaluate opportunities based on carbon impact, technical feasibility, regulatory risk, capex, margins, scalability and offtake certainty.

· Develop detailed project reports, capex and opex estimates, unit-economics models, risk notes, pilot budgets and implementation plans for approval.

· Recommend the appropriate operating model for each opportunity, including an internal division, project-specific partnership, SPV, JV, technology-licensing or other structure.

**Project Development and Technology**

· Identify and assess CO2 sources, biomass and other feedstocks, algae cultivation routes, fly-ash supply chains, industrial partners and customer markets.

· Lead technology scouting, technical due diligence, vendor evaluation, process selection and techno-commercial comparisons across the project portfolio.

· Direct site planning, pilot design, equipment selection, utilities, procurement, commissioning, trial operations and scale-up to commercial implementation.

· Establish project controls covering budget, schedule, quality, contractor performance, procurement, commissioning and handover.

· Ensure pilot programmes generate reliable and scalable operating data rather than remaining demonstration-only initiatives.

**Operating Model and Team Build**

· Build the core multidisciplinary team from the ground up, including process engineering, plant operations, biotechnology and R&D, materials, MRV, EHS, quality, project management and commercial capabilities.

· Create SOPs, production controls, quality systems, maintenance practices, data dashboards and escalation mechanisms for laboratory, pilot and commercial operations.

· Set performance measures for project delivery, operating reliability, yield, energy use, product quality, carbon impact, safety, compliance and commercial outcomes.

· Develop a practical culture of ownership, evidence-based decision-making and cross-functional collaboration among scientists, engineers, operators, contractors and commercial teams.

**Carbon Integrity Compliance and Safety**

· Build robust Measurement, Reporting and Verification systems for carbon reduction, utilisation and removal claims, including baselines, monitoring plans, sampling, chain of custody and audit-ready evidence.

· Ensure that environmental and carbon claims are supported by reliable data, third-party testing and appropriate validation and verification.

· Coordinate environmental permits, regulatory requirements and product approvals with internal and external specialists and government agencies.

· Establish rigorous EHS controls for CO2, pressure systems, high-temperature processes, dust and ash handling, chemicals, wastewater and biological contamination risks.

**Commercialisation and Partnerships**

· Develop commercially viable products and solutions across biochar, algae biomass and derivatives, biotechnology products, fly-ash-based materials and CO2-utilisation applications.

· Build partnerships with industrial emitters, power and cement companies, technology providers, EPC partners, laboratories, research institutions, universities, carbon registries and other ecosystem participants.

· Develop customer trials, specifications, pricing logic, commercial proposals and offtake arrangements before committing to scale-up.

· Create revenue opportunities through product sales, industrial projects, carbon assets, technology licensing, partnerships and other viable downstream opportunities.

**Leadership and Governance**

· Work closely and directly with the Promoter to shape the strategy and establish the business and governance structure.

· Coordinate with finance, legal, HR, EHS, commercial and other Group functions, as well as consultants, vendors, auditors and external partners.

· Present clear progress, budget, risk, compliance and commercial updates to the Promoter and senior management, together with decisions and support required.

· Operate with appropriate commercial discipline and protect the company from uncontrolled capex, weak technical assumptions, regulatory breaches, safety incidents and unsupported sustainability claims.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

· Approximately 5-25 years of relevant experience across industrial projects, process engineering, environmental engineering, carbon projects, biotechnology or bioprocess scale-up, plant operations, circular materials or related sectors.

· At least five years of leadership responsibility covering teams, vendors, budgets, schedules and project execution.

· Demonstrated success in building a new plant, pilot, laboratory, technology platform, project portfolio or business vertical from the ground up.

· Experience taking technologies or industrial projects from concept and feasibility through pilot, commissioning, operation and commercial scale-up.

· Strong exposure to commercial evaluation, unit economics, capex and opex, contracts, customer development, partnerships and offtake.

**Education**

A B.Tech, M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Chemical, Environmental, Biotechnology, Bioprocess, Materials, Mechanical, Civil or Industrial Engineering, or a closely related applied science discipline. An MBA or PGDM, PhD, or relevant certification in carbon accounting, EHS, project management or quality systems would be advantageous when supported by strong industrial execution experience.

**Relevant Technical Exposure**

Candidates should bring meaningful depth in one or more of the following areas and the ability to integrate specialist teams across the broader platform:

· Carbon Capture Utilisation and Storage, CO2 capture or CO2 utilisation

· Biochar, biomass conversion, pyrolysis or gasification

· Algae cultivation, photobioreactors or biological CO2 capture

· Biotechnology, fermentation or bioprocess scale-up

· Carbon mineralisation, fly-ash utilisation, geopolymers, cementitious materials or concrete additives

· Environmental and industrial process systems

· Carbon accounting, MRV, carbon-credit methodologies or verified carbon projects

**Leadership Attributes**

· Broad-based techno-commercial and entrepreneurial orientation

· Hands-on, site-focused leadership style with strong execution discipline

· Ability to make pragmatic decisions under uncertainty and build capability around technical gaps

· High standards of safety, compliance, data integrity and documentation

· Commercial pragmatism and willingness to challenge weak business cases or unsupported claims

· Credibility with technical specialists, industrial partners, regulators, customers, financiers and senior leadership

**Why Consider This Opportunity**

* This is a greenfield leadership opportunity to create a new climate-tech and circular-materials platform within an established diversified Group. The Project Head will have direct access to the Promoter, substantial influence over the business and technical roadmap, and the opportunity to build the team, operating model, partnerships and commercial portfolio from inception.

A Senior Audit Project Lead, leads and manages multiple complex audit projects, overseeing the entire audit process from planning to reporting and ensuring the quality and timely completion of the project in conformance with Internal Audit policies and procedures. The Senior Audit Project Lead may be supervising or consulting on some of these projects while performing planning, fieldwork or reporting on others.
  
  
This senior-level role requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of audit methodologies, risk management, and relevant frameworks like COSO, SOX/ ICFR and other IT or cybersecurity frameworks. Key responsibilities include developing audit plans, leading and mentoring audit teams, managing project risks, and ensuring objectives are met while maintaining professional judgment and delivering high-quality results.
  
  
The Senior Audit Project Lead is also expected to anticipate and smoothly handle unusual situations and challenges with minimal guidance and support from VGO Internal Audit management. This role will also be responsible for ensuring appropriate and timely follow-up on management action plans from published audit reports. The Senior Audit Project lead will directly oversee the audit projects, the Senior/ Staff Auditor(s) and/or Intern(s) assigned to the project, and the client relationship. This position will also help assist junior team members in carrying out their daily responsibilities. The Senior Audit Project Lead reports to the Senior Manager, Internal Audit.
  
  
**How You Make An Impact (Job Accountabilities)**
Primary responsibilities are related to the full scope of audit project execution and a high level of proficiency, efficiency, and effectiveness, and include the following:
  
  
**Audit Project Management**

* Provides significant project leadership for the Internal Audit process and oversees the associated testing of controls
* Serves as the primary interface with process owners, external audit management and Corporate
* Accounting personnel to communicate design assessment conclusions and testing results
* Develops subject matter expertise within select audit and business process areas (and / or
* technologies), and frequently advises VGO management on risk and control issues, follow-up audits, and management requests in those areas
* Participates in annual risk assessment interviews with VGO management, and provides Internal
* Audit management feedback on design of annual Audit Plan
* Acquires and demonstrates an understanding of the business process / legal entity under review and identify potential risks
* Prepares the Engagement Program, Audit Objectives Memo, Draft Audit Report and various other audit and project management related documents (as prescribed by VGO Internal Audit’s policies and procedures) by coordinating input / feedback from the audit team and client
* Designs and executes an effective strategic testing approach
* Reviews workpapers to evaluate fieldwork and testing results to verify that appropriate conclusions are reached about the adequacy of controls and the efficiency and effectiveness of business processes
* Provides constructive and timely workpaper review notes and guidance to audit team members
* Applies VGO Internal Audit processes and project management procedures in completing all aspects of the audit / assignment
* Anticipates project management roadblocks and implements measures to mitigate such circumstances
* Presents audit results to VGO management both verbally and through the audit reporting process, and obtains appropriate, timely management action plans and target dates

**Client Relationship Management**

* Manages VGO Internal Audit and client expectations regarding deliverables, timing, and how the audit process works
* Delivers audit services in a timely manner with minimal disruptions to client workflow
* Leads the Internal Planning, Senior Management Opening, Management Risk Assessment, Status Update and Client Closing meetings
* Maintains an open dialogue with client management about the project, and is responsive and professional when potential conflict situations arise
* Works with client management to develop practical action plans that are appropriately designed to be successful, cost-effective solutions to mitigate the underlying risks

**People Management**

* Assists in staff recruiting and hiring as requested
* Assists in the preparation and delivery of internal training for select new or revised audit processes and at select internal training sessions and VGO Internal Audit Department Training Summits
* Serves as an audit subject matter expert (SME) and sounding board for less experienced auditors
* Assists in the oversight of the VGO Internal Audit intern program, and serves as a mentor to interns and staff auditors as requested
* Delegates appropriate work to Senior and staff auditors and oversees timely, accurate completion of work
* Provides ad-hoc guidance as needed to assist audit staff in the completion of their assigned work
* Coaches team members on learning and applying technical and soft skills that contribute to the individual’s professional development and to successful project completion
* Provides frequent ad hoc guidance and feedback regarding audit staff performance, and completes their final Internal Audit Project Evaluation form and discusses with the audit staff to help improve their performance on future engagements and further their professional development

**Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP) Support**

* Provides thought leadership and design / implementation support on designated audit process improvement initiatives
* Provides quality assurance support and review of audit process compliance for select audit engagements
* Leads Internal Audit focus groups in soliciting input and feedback for internal audit process changes and continuous improvement initiatives

**What You Bring to the Role (Job Qualifications / Education / Skills / Requirements / Capabilities)**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Technology or comparable major required.

+ Master of Business Administration in Finance or Chartered Accountant or Certified Public Accountant is required
+ Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification is required
+ Additional qualification of CIA, CISSP, CISM or CFE is preferred
+ Minimum 8 years of post-qualification experience in Internal Auditing across Financial, Operational and Information Technology domains

**Competencies Desired**
Senior Audit Project Lead's are expected to possess and further develop the following skills and personal characteristics:

* Proficient in Understanding and Analyzing the Interrelationship between Risk and Control
* Project Management

+ Scheduling Planning
+ Budgeting / Tracking
+ Prioritization of Audit Work

title: Program Manager, DiscoveryOne, India
description:
**Company Description**
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
  
  
The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
  
  
In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 950 laboratories in 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
  
  
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.9 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Program Manager supports the successful execution of integrated drug discovery programs by providing project planning, coordination, governance, and operational leadership. Working closely with Scientific Project Leaders and cross-functional scientific teams, the Program Manager ensures that program activities remain aligned to agreed timelines, budgets, milestones, and client expectations.
  
  
The role is responsible for maintaining integrated project plans, facilitating communication across teams and sites, monitoring risks and dependencies, tracking budgets and deliverables, and supporting effective decision-making through clear reporting and governance. The Program Manager serves as a key operational partner to Scientific Project Leaders, enabling efficient program execution and a high-quality client experience.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, and action trackers.
* Coordinate program activities across multidisciplinary scientific teams.
* Facilitate project meetings and document decisions, actions, risks, and dependencies.
* Monitor program performance against scope, timelines, budget, and deliverables.
* Support financial tracking, forecasting, and change management activities.
* Prepare program reports and dashboards for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with Scientific Project Leaders to align operational plans with scientific priorities.
* Identify and escalate risks, issues, and schedule impacts.
* Support proposal development, project start-up, and program expansion activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of program management processes and tools.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline. A Master's degree is preferred.
* Typically 1-3 years of project or program management experience in a CRO, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related drug discovery environment.
* Experience supporting or managing cross-functional programs involving multiple studies, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and interdependent deliverables.
* Working knowledge of integrated drug discovery and the relationship between chemistry, biology, ADME/DMPK, pharmacology, safety, and toxicology activities.
* Program management certification or formal project-management training; experience supporting global, multi-site drug discovery programs.
* Strong program planning and execution skills, including work breakdown, critical-path management, milestone tracking, prioritization, and delivery recovery.
* Ability to lead cross-functional, matrixed teams through influence, establish clear accountability, and drive timely decisions.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, revenue and margin awareness, invoicing visibility, and scope control.
* Working knowledge of risk and issue management, dependency management, change control, governance, and escalation practices.
* Strong client-facing communication, facilitation, negotiation, stakeholder-management, and presentation skills.
* Sound analytical judgment and structured problem-solving, with the ability to challenge assumptions, work through ambiguity, and recommend practical options.
* Ability to communicate complex operational, and financial information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, follow-through, attention to detail, and commitment to quality and on-time delivery.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across functions, sites, cultures, and time zones.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project-management, collaboration, reporting, and data-visualization tools; experience with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, CRM, or ERP/AX is desirable.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project/program management certification is desirable.
* Flexible working hours and occasional travel may be required to support global programs, client meetings, and internal collaboration.

* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.

* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

title: Senior DPDPA GRC Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

* We are looking for an experienced Senior DPDPA GRC Consultant to support the execution and oversight of a large-scale Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) compliance program.
* The candidate will work closely with the Program Lead, Head of DPDPA, internal business teams, and external consulting partners to ensure successful gap assessment, remediation, and implementation.
* This role requires someone with practical DPDP experience, strong GRC fundamentals, and the ability to independently manage multiple compliance workstreams.
* The person must be able to understand assessment findings, identify missing areas, review implementation progress, guide stakeholders, and ensure deliverables are completed on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee day-to-day activities across multiple DPDPA workstreams.
* Review DPDP gap assessment findings, recommendations, and implementation deliverables prepared by external consulting partners.
* Validate department-wise data inventories, data flows, personal data processing activities, and assessment coverage.
* Identify missed requirements, incomplete assessments, compliance gaps, and implementation risks.
* Review remediation plans and track implementation progress against agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with IT, Legal, HR, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and other business functions.
* Work closely with external consulting partners to ensure delivery aligns with business priorities and DPDP requirements.
* Review activities related to consent management, privacy notices, Data Principal rights, grievance handling, data retention, vendor risk, and breach response.
* Track deliverables, action owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, and closure evidence.
* Validate compliance evidence and follow up on incomplete or ineffective remediation.
* Guide internal teams on required actions and help resolve implementation blockers.
* Prepare management updates, compliance status reports, risk summaries, and escalation notes.
* Escalate critical risks, delays, and dependencies to the Head of DPDPA promptly.
* Support governance reviews, audit readiness, and overall program execution.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Minimum 6 years of professional experience in GRC, information security compliance, risk management, privacy, or IT audit.
* Hands-on DPDP / DPDPA gap assessment, readiness assessment, or implementation experience is mandatory.
* Must have directly participated in at least one DPDP assessment or implementation engagement.
* Strong practical understanding of the DPDP Act, applicable rules, and compliance requirements.
* Experience reviewing data inventories, data flows, consent processes, privacy notices, vendor data handling, and remediation activities.
* Experience coordinating compliance projects involving multiple business departments.
* Ability to review consultant deliverables, identify gaps, and challenge findings where necessary.
* Experience managing compliance trackers, risks, dependencies, deadlines, and evidence collection.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently with senior management and external partners.
* Must be based in Delhi NCR and available to work from the Delhi office.
* Must be available to join immediately or within 15 days.

**Good to Have**

* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27701, or other privacy and information security compliance experience.
* Experience working with Big 4 consulting firms or large enterprise compliance programs.
* Experience in privacy impact assessments, vendor risk management, or IT security control reviews.
* Relevant GRC, privacy, or information security certifications.

**Important: Please Read Before Applying**

This position requires actual DPDP project experience, not just theoretical knowledge or certification.

Candidates with only general ISO 27001, SOC 2, audit documentation, or project coordination experience without practical DPDP exposure will not be considered.

**Please apply only if you meet all three conditions:**

1. Minimum 6 years of relevant GRC experience with hands-on DPDP assessment or implementation exposure.
2. Based in Delhi NCR and comfortable working full-time from the Delhi office.
3. Available to join immediately or within 15 days.

Shortlisted candidates will be expected to explain their actual DPDP project responsibilities, assessment activities, identified gaps, and implementation involvement during the interview.

B.E./B. Tech in Mechanical
  
  
Strong experience in manufacturing and plant operations.
  
  
**Good to Have**
MBA / PGDM in Operations / Manufacturing / Supply Chain Management.
  
  
Advanced qualification in Operations or Manufacturing Management.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
The Head – Plant Operations will be responsible for end-to-end plant operations and greenfield manufacturing project execution, including plant setup, commissioning, production readiness, ramp-up, operational stabilization and achievement of manufacturing KPIs.
  
  
The role will lead cross-functional teams and work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, HR and R&D to establish and operate a high-performance manufacturing facility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Greenfield Plant Setup & Commissioning**
Lead end-to-end greenfield plant setup and commissioning from project planning through production readiness.
  
  
Drive plant layout, infrastructure, utilities, machinery, production lines and equipment readiness.
  
  
Manage installation, commissioning, trial production and operational handover.
  
  
Establish project milestones, timelines, budgets, governance and risk-mitigation mechanisms.
  
  
Coordinate with engineering teams, contractors, equipment suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Plant Operations & Production**
Own end-to-end plant manufacturing and production operations.
  
  
Drive production, capacity utilization, OEE, productivity, throughput and delivery targets.
  
  
Ensure effective manpower planning, line balancing and takt-time adherence.
  
  
Establish standardized operating processes and shop-floor governance.
  
  
Lead production ramp-up from pilot/SOP stage to stable volume production.
  
  
**Manufacturing Excellence**
Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen, 5S and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
Improve OEE and reduce downtime, rejection, rework and manufacturing losses.
  
  
Establish plant-level operational dashboards and performance reviews.
  
  
Drive automation, digitization and MES-enabled shop-floor operations.
  
  
**Quality & Process Excellence**
Ensure adherence to defined product and process quality standards.
  
  
Drive First-Time-Right, rejection reduction, defect prevention and root-cause analysis.
  
  
Establish robust process controls across manufacturing operations.
  
  
Partner with Quality teams for process validation and continuous improvement.
  
  
Support prototype, pilot and new-product manufacturing activities.
  
  
**New Product Introduction & SOP**
Drive manufacturing readiness for new products and variants.
  
  
Coordinate prototype, pilot and pre-SOP builds.
  
  
Ensure readiness of manpower, machinery, process, material, tooling and quality systems.
  
  
Lead production ramp-up while maintaining quality, cost and delivery targets.
  
  
**Supply Chain & Supplier Readiness**
Work closely with Procurement, SCM and suppliers to ensure uninterrupted material availability. Drive supplier readiness for new product launches and production ramp-up.
  
  
Resolve material, supplier and production bottlenecks.
  
  
Optimize material flow from incoming material through WIP to finished products.
  
  
**CapEx & Cost Management**
Own manufacturing CapEx planning and execution.
  
  
Ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines and budgets.
  
  
Drive manufacturing cost reduction, productivity improvement and manpower optimization.
  
  
Monitor conversion cost and plant operational expenses.
  
  
**EHS & Compliance**
Establish a strong Safety, Health and Environmental culture across the plant.
  
  
Ensure compliance with statutory, environmental and manufacturing requirements.
  
  
Conduct safety audits, risk assessments and corrective-action reviews.
  
  
Drive safe and sustainable manufacturing practices.
  
  
**People Leadership**
Build and lead a high-performing plant organization.
  
  
Develop plant leadership, engineering, production and shop-floor talent.
  
  
Drive manpower planning, capability building and technical training.
  
  
Establish a culture of accountability, safety, quality and operational excellence.
  
  
**Senior Stakeholder Management**
Work closely with senior leadership on plant strategy, capacity, investment and operational performance.
  
  
Partner with Engineering, R&D, Quality, SCM, Procurement, Finance and HR.
  
  
Present plant performance, risks, CapEx, productivity and operational improvement plans to senior management.
  
  
**Other Specific Remarks**
Greenfield plant setup and commissioning experience is mandatory.
  
  
Candidates with only steady-state plant operations experience and no plant setup/project execution exposure should not be considered.
  
  
Strong preference for candidates from Automotive / EV / Commercial Vehicle / Auto Component manufacturing.
  
  
Candidate should have demonstrated experience in production ramp-up and SOP stabilization.
  
  
**Experience Managing Significant CapEx And Manufacturing Investments Is Preferred.**
Strong exposure to Lean, TPM, OEE and manufacturing excellence is expected.
  
  
Role requires regular presence at the manufacturing plant.
  
  
Candidate should be comfortable working in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
  
  
Experience in setting up a new production line/facility and subsequently taking ownership of operations should be clearly demonstrated in the CV.

title: Operations & Brand Partnerships Executive (Health | Wellness | K-Beauty | Retail | E-Commerce)
description:
**Company:**
Ivy & Prime

**Location:**
Civil Lines, Delhi NCR

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | In-Office + Field Operations

**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Entrepreneurial and Startup Experience Preferred)

**Compensation:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month + Performance-Linked Incentives

**About Ivy & Prime**

**Ivy & Prime is a next-generation venture studio and global ecosystem built to engineer the future of health and wellness.**
As a hands-on venture studio, we bring together a powerhouse network of global partners, deep operational expertise, and strategic capital to transform early-stage concepts into market-defining health solutions. By pairing visionary founders with unfair advantages in capital, distribution, and clinical insights, we don’t just back the next big health innovation-we build it from the ground up. We actively co-build alongside our portfolio companies, delivering day-one operational support and built-in commercial distribution to accelerate innovations from inception to enterprise scale.

We have an integrated network of:

**Retailers | Clinics | Distributors | Brand Partners | Founders**

We are creating a platform where brands, professionals, operators, and consumers connect to create sustainable commercial opportunities.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive and
**Entrepreneurial Operations & Brand Partnerships Executive**
to work closely with Ivy & Prime's founding team.

This is a hands-on role combining business operations, international brand onboarding, vendor management, strategic partnerships, retail execution, and business development.

The selected candidate will help coordinate and execute Ivy & Prime's expanding business verticals, particularly K-Beauty retail stores, clinical skincare, wellness partnerships, and e-commerce operations.

You will work with Korean and international brands, distributors, sourcing partners, airport stakeholders, clinic operators, doctors, service providers, and internal teams to convert business opportunities into functioning operations.

This is not a conventional sales, marketing, or administrative position. It requires someone who can manage relationships, coordinate stakeholders, organize operational workflows, solve problems, and take ownership of execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Commercial Execution**

* Identify business opportunities across retail, e-commerce, clinics, distribution, and founder networks.
* Generate qualified leads, conduct outreach, arrange meetings, and prepare partnership proposals.
* Support commercial negotiations, partnership structures, onboarding agreements, and revenue opportunities.
* Develop business presentations, partner decks, research summaries, and commercial comparisons.

**2. Operations & Retail Store Management**

* Support the setup, launch, and daily management of K-Beauty, skincare, wellness, and specialty retail stores, including airport retail locations.
* Coordinate store infrastructure, vendors, fixtures, merchandising, inventory, staffing, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate with store managers, beauty advisors, suppliers, and external service providers.
* Monitor stock availability, replenishment, product displays, customer feedback, and store performance.

**3. Brand Onboarding & International Partnerships**

* Identify, approach, and onboard Korean, Asian, and international beauty, skincare, health, and wellness brands.
* Manage brand onboarding requirements, including product catalogs, commercial terms, documentation, product information, pricing, and marketing assets.
* Support discussions regarding product selection, inventory arrangements, distribution opportunities, consignment models, and promotional commitments.

**4. Vendor, Sourcing & Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop relationships with relevant vendors, distributors, logistics providers, retail operators, agencies, and business partners.
* Coordinate vendor quotations, commercial proposals, negotiations, agreements, and execution timelines.
* Support sourcing of products, retail fixtures, displays, testers, promotional materials, and operational services.
* Build partnerships with airport operators, specialty retailers, clinics, salons, spas, wellness centers, and professional networks.

**5. Clinic, Healthcare & Wellness Partnerships**

* Identify and coordinate partnerships with dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, cosmetologists, clinics, pharmacies, salons, spas, and wellness professionals.
* Assist with the development of clinic, beauty, and wellness service concepts and pilot locations.
* Coordinate clinical partners, service providers, brands, and operating teams.

**6. E-Commerce, Community & Marketing Coordination**

* Support product listings, marketplace coordination, online brand activation, and e-commerce operational workflows.
* Assist with product launches, sampling programs, brand showcases, community events, and B2B networking activities.
* Maintain engagement with distributors, creators, buyers, professionals, and business communities.
* Coordinate social media and promotional deliverables without making content creation the primary responsibility of the role.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an execution-oriented professional who enjoys building new business opportunities and can manage multiple stakeholders in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Experience & Professional Background**

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in operations, brand partnerships, business development, retail, e-commerce, vendor management, or startups.
* Prior experience in a Founder’s Office, entrepreneurial venture, or early-stage business is advantageous.
* Ability to communicate with international partners across different time zones.
* Willingness to attend field meetings, visit retail locations, and coordinate with vendors independently.

**Preferred Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline. Preferred backgrounds include:

* B.Tech / B.E.
* B.Pharm / Pharmacy
* BBA / MBA
* Healthcare, Life Sciences, Beauty, Retail, or related disciplines
* MBBS / BDS candidates interested in business and operations roles may also apply.

Relevant professional experience and demonstrated execution ability will be considered alongside formal qualifications.

**Compensation & Growth Opportunities**

**Fixed Salary:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and capabilities.

**Incentives:**
Performance-linked incentives based on brand onboarding, partnership conversions, revenue contribution, and operational milestones.

**Career Growth:**
Opportunity to progress into Brand Partnerships Manager, Retail Operations Manager, Business Operations Manager, or a broader Founder’s Office leadership role as Ivy & Prime expands.

**We are looking for someone who can connect the right partners, coordinate the right resources, and turn business opportunities into operational results.**

**Location:**
Civil Lines, Delhi

**Job Type:**
Full-Time, In-Office

**Salary:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month + Incentives

title: Head - SAP Services -
description:
******JOB PURPOSE******
Head – SAP Services will lead the SAP ecosystem across GMR and its entities. The role covers strategy, architecture, delivery, operations and compliance. It ensures robust ERP performance, a clean-core and scalable S/4HANA landscape, audit readiness, and tight integration with airport operations, commercial and corporate functions. As strategic owner of SAP application services, the role is accountable for governance, innovation (including SAP BTP, analytics and AI), vendor and licence management, and business value from SAP investments.
  
  
****ORGANISATION CHART****
CIO - Enterprise IT --> Head SAP Services
  
  
****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
******SAP Strategy, Architecture & Governance******

* Define and own the multi-year SAP roadmap aligned with GAL's digital transformation goals, including the S/4HANA path (version upgrades or RISE with SAP decisions) and a clean-core approach.
* Lead planning and business cases for large SAP transformation programmes.
* Govern SAP architecture, data models, custom code, and dependencies across modules (FI-CO, MM, SD, HCM, PS, PM, RE-FX as applicable) and across airport entities.
* Standardise master data, taxonomy and reporting hierarchies across business units and joint ventures, so regulator (AERA) and concession reporting works across entities.
* Drive adoption of SAP BTP, process automation, workflow digitisation, embedded analytics (SAC/Datasphere) and AI use cases with the Data & AI CoE.
* Run an SAP Architecture/Design Authority and a governance forum with business process owners.
* Adherence to roadmap milestones (on time and on budget)
* Realised ROI and benefits on SAP investments, against the business case
* % reduction in custom code, or clean-core compliance score
* Master data quality
* ROI on SAP investments

******Program & Operations Management******

* Oversee day-to-day operations across SAP modules for uptime, SLA compliance and fast incident resolution.
* Stabilise new SAP projects after go-live (new modules, rollouts to new etntities, integrations).
* Govern the full ticket lifecycle (incidents, service requests, change requests, problems), including root-cause analysis to reduce repeat issues.
* Lead integration across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors and Ariba, and with third-party and systems (billing, e-invoicing/IRP, GST, banking host-to-host, and other systems)
* Coordinate month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing with Finance.
* Make statutory configuration changes on time (GST, TDS, labour codes, Ind AS updates).
* Own SAP disaster recovery, backup and business continuity, including periodic DR drills.
* % SAP availability/uptime
* % tickets resolved within SLA, split by incident, service request and change
* % reduction in repeat P1/P2 incidents
* Number of successful system integrations
* Closing calendar adherence (financial close days)
* DR drill success and RPO/RTO compliance (recovery point and time objectives)

******Enhancements & Change Management******

* Lead identification, prioritization, and execution of system enhancement initiatives across modules.
* Validate business cases for enhancements and ensure ROI justification, budgeting, and vendor coordination.
* Govern the customization lifecycle: review functional specs, interface designs, development timelines, test plans, and UAT outcomes.
* Approve release schedules for new functionalities, patches, upgrades, and version migrations.
* Institutionalize structured change management and communication plans for major releases and system rollouts.
* Number of process enhancements completed annually
* Business satisfaction scores

****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Additional Details****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
******Vendor, Licence & Contract Management******

* Drive partner selection, scope, SLAs, commercial negotiations and renewals with Procurement and Legal.
* Manage SAP, AMS and implementation partners on roadmap alignment and delivery milestones (configuration, enhancements, upgrades, patches).
* Track vendor performance against contract KPIs (resolution SLAs, deployment success rate, defect leakage, audit support) and hold quarterly business reviews.
* Run escalation mechanisms for cross-vendor dependencies and delivery risks in multi-partner setups.
* Own SAP licence management: user licence optimisation, annual licence audit (LAW), indirect/digital access compliance, and SAP support contract value (Enterprise Support or RISE).
* % vendor adherence to SLA
* Turnaround time for service requests
* SAP licence cost optimisation (% savings or avoided cost)
* licence audit

******Compliance, Audit & Risk Management******

* Own audit readiness of SAP landscape â ensure compliance with internal controls, access governance, segregation of duties, and audit trails.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors to provide data extracts, system walkthroughs, and evidential logs.
* Collaborate with IT security team for secure integrations, data access protocols, and 3rd party approvals.
* Ensure compliance with the DPDP Act 2023 for personal data in SAP, especially HR and SuccessFactors.
* Run periodic user access reviews and remediate SoD conflicts.
* % critical audit issues closed on time
* Number of repeat audit observations (target: zero)
* % SoD conflicts remediated or mitigated
* % critical SAP security notes applied within SLA
* % of critical audit issues resolved within defined timelines

**Team Development and Management**

* Implement structured mentorship and leadership development initiatives.
* Address team concerns, provide guidance, and create opportunities for professional growth.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Encourage participation in team-building activities and employee engagement initiatives.
* Attrition rates
* Employee Engagement scores
* % Participation in training and upskilling programs

****EXTERNAL INTERACTIONS****

* SAP SE (account team, Enterprise Support/MaxAttention, RISE)
* SAP implementation and AMS partners
* Third-party software and integration vendors
* Hyperscaler or hosting partner
* Statutory auditors
* Banks and payment partners (host-to-host integration)
* Government portals: GSTN, IRP/e-invoicing, TRACES

****INTERNAL INTERACTIONS****

* Group CIO / Head IT
* Group CFO and Business Finance Heads
* Group CHRO and Business HR Heads
* Head Procurement / Commercial
* Internal Audit and IT Security Team

****FINANCIAL DIMENSIONS****
******OTHER DIMENSIONS******
****EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS****

title: Construction Project Manager [AI & Automation]
description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)
  
  
Engagement type: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: INR 2,38,250 - INR 2,85,900 per month (based on experience and interview process)
  
  
**About Sanctuary**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Construction Project Manager who builds with AI. You understand how construction projects run - schedules, budgets, contractors, and site realities - and you use AI and automation tools to run them faster and smarter. Internally, we call this role a "Construction VibeKid": someone who can vibe code the tools a project needs instead of waiting for someone else to build them.
  
  
You don't need to be a traditional site engineer, and you don't need to be a software developer. You need to sit in the middle: someone who knows construction project management well enough to spot what's slowing a project down, and is hands-on enough with AI tools to build the fix - a scheduling tracker, an automated report, a contractor dashboard, or a workflow that saves the team hours every week.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed toolset. We are looking for someone curious, resourceful, and quick to experiment - who can take a messy process, figure out what's missing, and ship a working solution.
  
  
****What you'll do****
*Construction project management*

* Plan and track construction schedules, milestones, and budgets across our projects
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to keep work on time and on budget
* Track progress, flag risks and delays early, and drive issues to resolution
* Work closely with our architecture, procurement, and construction teams in India and the U.S.

*AI and automation*

* Use AI and automation tools to streamline scheduling, budgeting, reporting, and contractor coordination
* Build internal tools, dashboards, and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate repetitive tasks such as progress reports, cost tracking, RFIs, and status updates
* Stay on top of new AI tools for construction and test what could work for us

*Reporting and communication*

* Produce clear, regular project reports for leadership - ideally automated
* Keep schedules, budgets, and project data accurate and in one place
* Explain technical tools and project status simply to both construction and non-technical teammates

****What you bring****

* 3-7 years of experience in construction project management, project controls, or planning
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field preferred
* Solid understanding of construction processes, scheduling, budgeting, and contractor coordination
* Hands-on experience building tools or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)
* Examples of tools, dashboards, or automations you've built - please share them when you apply
* Strong Google Sheets skills; familiarity with project management tools (e.g. ClickUp, Procore, MS Project, Primavera) is a plus
* Experience on U.S. residential construction projects is a must
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural environment

****Hiring process****

* Stage 1: Intro interview Role alignment, experience overview, a walkthrough of tools you've built, and culture fit
* Stage 2: Test task A short practical assignment: use AI tools to solve a real construction project problem
* Stage 3: Final interview Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth
