title: Director Program Management, 2 Hour Learning (Remote) - $200,000/year USD
description:
You've built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren't the one making the calls.
  
  
2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job as Director of Program Management is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.
  
  
You will own the operating outputs behind those decisions: portfolio dashboards that expose slippage before it becomes a surprise, vendor scorecards tied to real contractual commitments, competitive bid packages that make trade-offs clear, and contract controls that prevent unsupported spend. AI will be part of your daily workflow, helping you standardize updates, detect anomalies, compare bids, analyze vendor performance, and validate invoices.
  
  
This is not a PMO role built around meetings, process compliance, or polished status decks. It is for an operator who wants their work to have consequences. When a vendor underperforms, your evidence should make that obvious. When spend drifts from the contract, your controls should catch it. When executives need to make a $5M decision, your outputs should give them the confidence to make it fast. If that sounds like the level of ownership you have been looking for, apply.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own portfolio-level dashboards across 10+ concurrent initiatives, using AI to standardize updates, detect slippage, expose blockers, and maintain a trusted executive view of delivery, budget, and risk
* Run recurring vendor performance reviews and maintain rubric-based scorecards that combine delivery, quality, cost, contractual commitments, and qualitative performance signals
* Lead competitive technology-vendor procurement, including structured bid packages, normalized comparisons, scoring rubrics, SOW development, and evidence-backed recommendations
* Govern contracts and invoices by tracking fee caps, milestones, acceptance criteria, and amendments, then validating invoices against signed terms before spend is approved
* Use AI daily to analyze portfolio data, detect anomalies, surface underperformance, draft decision-ready outputs, and reduce manual PMO administration

**What You Won’t Be Doing**

* Producing status reports that executives read but never use to make decisions
* Running a meeting-heavy PMO where coordination matters more than measurable execution
* Treating vendor management as relationship maintenance while missed commitments go unchallenged
* Passing contracts, SOWs, invoices, or procurement decisions to someone else because they look too commercial or technical
* Using AI as an occasional productivity trick instead of a core part of how you operate

**Director Program Management Key Responsibilities**
Produce reliable, AI-powered dashboards, scorecards, procurement packages, and contract controls that give executives the clarity and leverage to hold vendors accountable, control costs, and accelerate delivery across a $50M EdTech portfolio.
  
  
**Basic Requirements**

* Directly owned a portfolio of 10+ concurrent initiatives with at least $5M in budget responsibility, including authority over budget allocation, vendor selection, or initiative prioritization
* Managed 5+ external technology vendors at the same time, such as SaaS providers, AI/ML platforms, marketing agencies, or engineering firms
* Built and maintained portfolio-level dashboards covering metrics such as delivery health, budget burn versus forecast, milestone completion, and major risks or blockers
* Can point to a case where C-suite leaders used your portfolio data to make a go/no-go decision on a vendor renewal, budget reallocation, or initiative deprioritization
* Directly led competitive technology procurement, including structured bid evaluation, vendor scoring, negotiation, and selection
* Authored or co-authored SOWs with measurable deliverables, milestone payments, SLAs, acceptance criteria, or other performance-based terms
* Negotiated commercial terms such as pricing, penalties, fee caps, or exit clauses and enforced those terms through invoice validation or corrective action
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial and operational data into concise recommendations executives can act on
* Able to analyze financial and vendor-performance data quickly enough to recommend optimization, reallocation, or vendor elimination
* Able to work US business hours

**Nice-to-have Requirements**

* Experience using AI-enabled dashboards, anomaly detection, predictive alerts, or natural-language analysis in portfolio management
* Experience in EdTech, technology, consulting, or another environment managing complex portfolios of external technology partners
* Fluency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Linear, Jira, or similar systems

**About 2 Hour Learning**
Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
  
  
**With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
  
  
**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
  
  
**Working with us**
This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. title: CEO’s Office – Strategy & Business Operations
description:
Job Description: CEO’s Office – Strategy & Business Operations

Company: Pocketful

Location: Delhi NCR

Reporting to: CEO

Experience: min 5 years

About Pocketful

Pocketful is a technology-driven fintech and stockbroking platform building an integrated financial services ecosystem across broking, wealth management, investment products, and AI-powered trading solutions.

We are looking for a high-calibre professional to join the CEO’s Office and work directly with the CEO on business strategy, growth initiatives, performance management, and execution of key organisational priorities.

Role Overview

The CEO’s Office plays a central role in shaping business priorities and ensuring their execution across the organisation. This role offers exposure to strategic decision-making, business performance, new initiatives, and cross-functional leadership.

The ideal candidate will combine analytical thinking with strong execution capabilities, be comfortable working with senior stakeholders, and take end-to-end ownership of important business initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Corporate Strategy & Business Planning

\* Work with the CEO on business strategy, annual operating plans, growth priorities, and long-term business objectives.

\* Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and industry analysis to identify growth opportunities.

\* Evaluate new business lines, products, partnerships, and distribution opportunities.

\* Prepare business cases, financial analyses, strategic recommendations, and management presentations.

\* Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

2. Strategic Initiatives & Special Projects

\* Own and drive high-priority projects identified by the CEO, from problem definition through execution.

\* Coordinate the launch of new products, business verticals, and strategic initiatives.

\* Identify operational bottlenecks and develop solutions to improve efficiency, growth, and profitability.

\* Work across functions to resolve dependencies and ensure timely delivery of critical initiatives.

\* Independently research and solve ambiguous business problems, presenting clear recommendations to the CEO.

3. Business Performance & Analytics

\* Monitor business KPIs across revenue, customer acquisition, onboarding, engagement, product adoption, and profitability.

\* Develop management dashboards, business review reports, and performance trackers.

\* Analyse business trends, identify performance gaps, and recommend corrective actions.

\* Support periodic business reviews with functional heads and track progress against targets.

\* Evaluate unit economics, channel performance, cost structures, and growth opportunities.

4. Cross-Functional Execution

\* Work closely with Product, Technology, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and HR teams.

\* Ensure alignment between departmental priorities and the company’s strategic objectives.

\* Track commitments, milestones, and deliverables across teams and drive accountability.

\* Facilitate leadership reviews, document key decisions, and monitor closure of action items.

\* Act as an execution partner to the CEO on initiatives requiring coordination across multiple functions.

5. CEO’s Office & Management Support

\* Prepare decision memos, presentations, research notes, and briefing documents for the CEO.

\* Structure complex business information into concise insights and recommendations.

\* Help prioritise strategic initiatives and ensure management attention is directed towards the most important business outcomes.

\* Support board-level presentations, investor materials, and strategic planning exercises as required.

\* Maintain discretion while handling confidential business information.

6. Process Improvement & AI Enablement

\* Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline workflows, and improve organisational productivity.

\* Leverage AI tools and data analysis to accelerate research, decision-making, and execution.

\* Develop repeatable processes and management systems to support Pocketful’s growth and scale.

Candidate Profile

\* 2–5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, a startup CEO’s office, or a similar role.

\* Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.

\* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

\* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.

\* Ability to interpret business data, understand financial metrics, and develop actionable recommendations.

\* Strong project management, stakeholder coordination, and execution skills.

\* High ownership, attention to detail, initiative, and comfort with ambiguity.

\* Ability to work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred: Experience in fintech, financial services, stockbroking, wealth management, or technology-led businesses. Familiarity with SQL, BI tools, and AI-based productivity tools is an advantage.

Key Success Metrics

\* Timely execution of CEO-led strategic initiatives.

\* Improved visibility into business performance through effective KPI reporting.

\* Better accountability and coordination across functions.

\* Quality and speed of strategic analysis and decision support.

\* Measurable improvements in business efficiency, growth, and profitability.

\* Successful execution of new business initiatives and process improvements.

\* Direct exposure to the CEO and senior leadership.

\* Ownership of high-impact strategic projects.

\* Broad exposure to strategy, finance, technology, product, and business operations.

\* An opportunity to influence the growth trajectory of a fast-evolving fintech company.

\* A strong career path towards leadership roles in strategy, business operations, or general management.

The ideal candidate is someone who can think strategically, analyse rigorously, communicate clearly, and drive execution relentlessly.

title: Editorial Services Manager
description:
Informa is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge, and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

Taylor & Francis is one of the world’s largest publishers of high-quality, peer reviewed scholarly journals, books, e-books and reference works. We empower learners, thinkers and doers with trusted knowledge that advances research and enriches lives. We bring together diverse people, ideas and opinions to validate and publish the experts, theories and truths that matter. And we’ve been doing this in an unbroken arc since 1798.

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Description**

Reporting to the Editorial Services Director, the Editorial Services Manager leads the day-to-day delivery of centralised editorial services through the Editorial Services Co-ordinator teams. The role is accountable for operational performance, quality and the flow of work across the function, ensuring that agreed service levels and customer outcomes are achieved consistently.

Using data and continuous improvement methods, the role holder tracks and manages key performance indicators (KPIs), performance against service-level agreements (SLAs), backlog health and throughput; identifies bottlenecks and capacity risks; and takes timely corrective action. The role translates strategic direction into clear operational priorities, develops team capability and provides the Director with accurate insight, escalation and recommendations.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Lead the day-to-day operation of Editorial Services, setting clear priorities and ensuring work is allocated and delivered in line with agreed standards, deadlines and customer requirements.
* Own operational performance across the Co-ordinator teams, including quality, workflow, service stability and the consistent application of standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Monitor service performance and customer outcomes against agreed service levels and expectations, using performance data and stakeholder feedback to identify emerging issues and opportunities to improve service quality and customer experience.
* Establish and maintain effective performance routines to track KPIs, SLAs, backlog health, ageing, work in progress, throughput, productivity, quality trends and customer satisfaction.
* Use Kanban and other visual management tools to maintain a clear view of demand, capacity, dependencies and flow; identify bottlenecks, emerging risks and constraints before they affect service.
* Take relevant corrective action when performance is off track, including reprioritising work, rebalancing capacity, removing blockers, agreeing recovery plans and escalating material risks to the Editorial Services Director.
* Translate functional objectives into practical team plans, daily and weekly operating rhythms, measurable expectations and clear ownership.
* Lead, coach and performance-manage the Editorial Services Co-ordinator teams, building accountability, engagement, cross-team collaboration and a culture of service excellence.
* Ensure appropriate resource and capacity planning, using demand and performance data to highlight current and future capability or resourcing risks and recommend solutions.
* Maintain effective quality controls, root-cause analysis and feedback loops; ensure recurring errors and service failures result in sustainable countermeasures rather than short-term fixes.
* Drive continuous improvement using Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen and Agile principles to remove waste, improve flow, standardise processes and increase customer value.
* Maintain accurate process documentation, operating controls and governance records, ensuring changes are embedded, understood and sustained.
* Provide concise, data-led operational reporting to the Editorial Services Director, including performance commentary, risks, recovery actions, improvement opportunities and decisions required.
* Build effective relationships with Editors, Societies, internal stakeholders and partner teams; manage operational expectations and resolve issues constructively.

**Qualifications**

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Demonstrated experience leading and performance-managing operational or process delivery teams, preferably within academic publishing or a comparable service environment.
* Strong experience managing workflow performance through KPIs, SLAs, backlog analysis, throughput measures, quality data and capacity planning.
* Practical knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methods; Green Belt qualification, or equivalent applied experience, is desirable.
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies, Kanban systems, Kaizen and visual management.
* Experience of diagnosing operational problems, completing root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Experience managing change while maintaining stable day-to-day service delivery.
* Strong Excel and data analysis capability, with experience producing clear operational reporting and visualisation; familiarity with project and workflow management software.
* Knowledge of Journals editorial processes and the needs of Editors and Societies is desirable.
* Experience working with global teams and stakeholders in a matrix environment.

**Skills and Behaviours Required**

* Visible, inclusive leadership with strong coaching, team-building and performance-management skills.
* Strong operational judgement, able to balance customer need, service risk, capacity and continuous improvement priorities.
* Highly data literate; able to interpret trends, challenge assumptions and convert insight into timely action.
* Structured problem-solving skills and the resilience to remove obstacles, manage conflict and sustain recovery plans.
* Excellent organisation and planning, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain focus on flow and outcomes.
* Clear and confident communication, including the ability to explain performance, risks and recommendations to a range of stakeholders.
* Collaborative and customer-focused, able to build trust across teams and influence without relying solely on authority.
* Adaptable and pragmatic, responding quickly to changing demand while maintaining standards and controls.
* Drive for continuous improvement, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to measurable results.
* Comfortable using Kanban boards, project management software and operational dashboards.

**Additional Information**

**Closing Date: Friday 6th November 2026.**

This role is based in India and you must have the right to live and work in India to be considered.
  
  
  
  
The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our offices to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office locations to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a minimum of 3 days per week in-person time, with those 3 days a week spent in our office in New Delhi, India.

**What we offer in return:**

* 30 days annual leave
* 4 volunteering days annually
* Day off for your birthday
* Pension contributions
* Medical insurance for self and dependents; life cover and personal accident cover for self
* Seasonal social and charitable events
* Training and development

If you’re excited about working with Taylor & Francis to foster human progress through knowledge, we invite you to apply even if your existing skills and experience don’t fit every item listed above. At Taylor & Francis, we are at our best and most successful when colleagues can be themselves and make a contribution regardless of their identity or background. As a colleague, you will have the opportunity to further innovate and develop in areas that you are passionate about. Our goal is to empower you with the resources, incentives, and flexibility you need to enjoy success at work and to live a healthy, balanced life.

Taylor & Francis is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe in and value diversity of people and thought, fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where all colleagues can learn and succeed as their true selves. Taylor & Francis recruits, develops, and retains colleagues without regard to any protected personal characteristics or other non-merit based factor.

title: Senior Manager - Business Planning & Commercials - Category Footwear
description:
The role will have end-to-end responsibility for footwear business planning, production planning, commercial governance, factory capacity planning, vendor management, merchandising coordination, tooling planning, and delivery performance across the India business.
  
  
The footwear business is increasingly dependent on an optimal combination of imports and local manufacturing to meet changing business, compliance, quality, cost, and availability requirements. In this environment, the role will be responsible for developing a clear understanding of current and future production capacity, identifying potential supply constraints, and proactively aligning production plans with business requirements.
  
  
The position will work closely with Category, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Finance, Supply Chain, Quality, Product Development, Operations, and manufacturing partners to ensure that the business has the right product, at the right cost, in the right quantity and at the right time.
  
  
The ideal candidate should bring strong footwear industry experience, commercial acumen, analytical capability and a strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, vendor management, and business planning.
  
  
**Designation:**
Senior Manager
  
  
**Department:**
Category – Footwear
  
  
**Function:**
Business Planning & Commercials
  
  
**Location:**
Delhi
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director – Category (Footwear)
  
  
**Experience:**
12+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
FDDI / NIFT preferred; Post-Graduation in Footwear, Business Planning, Supply Chain, Production Planning, Merchandising or a related discipline preferred
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Planning & Commercial Governance
* Drive the overall business planning for the Footwear Category across India, ensuring alignment with business strategy, channel requirements, and financial objectives.
* Develop and maintain the annual, seasonal, and monthly footwear business plans in alignment with category and channel requirements.
* Understand the business dynamics and commercial requirements across Retail, MBO, Distribution, E-commerce, and other relevant channels.
* Translate sales plans and business requirements into actionable buying, production, and supply plans.
* Drive OTB planning and governance, ensuring that all buying decisions are aligned with approved budgets, business plans, and commercial objectives.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained before commitments or buys are placed.
* Define and govern the Annual Footwear Buy Plan, including import and local production requirements.
* Monitor business performance against planned buys, sales, inventory, margin, and cost objectives.
* Partner with Finance and Category teams to ensure alignment between business plans and financial targets.
* Identify commercial risks and opportunities and provide timely recommendations to the leadership team.
* Margin, COGS & Commercial Management
* Drive governance of agreed Gross Margin (GM%) deliverables for the Footwear business.
* Plan and monitor COGS as a percentage of MRP for each season and across relevant product/channel segments.
* Analyze cost structures and identify opportunities for improving product economics and overall business profitability.
* Work closely with sourcing, merchandising, and manufacturing teams to identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality, product standards or delivery timelines.
* Monitor cost movements arising from local manufacturing, imports, production efficiencies, tooling, and other commercial factors.
* Evaluate the financial impact of production and supply decisions and provide recommendations to the Category leadership.
* Track commercial deviations against approved plans and ensure timely corrective action.
* Support scenario planning for changes in demand, production capacity, cost, lead times, and business requirements.
* Production Planning & Factory Capacity Management
* Own the production planning framework for locally manufactured footwear.
* Develop a clear view of current and future factory capacity, production output, and available manufacturing capability.
* Align factory capacity with seasonal business requirements, sales orders, and agreed production plans.
* Monitor factory production output against the agreed plan and proactively identify capacity constraints.
* Work closely with factories to optimize production schedules based on business priorities.
* Manage production planning challenges arising from changing demand, quality requirements, compliance requirements, raw material availability, and factory constraints.
* Develop alternate production scenarios where planned output is at risk.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable, and aligned with required delivery dates.
* Establish regular production planning reviews with manufacturing partners.
* Drive weekly and monthly production planning and dispatch reviews.
* Factory & Vendor Performance Management
* Establish and maintain vendor/factory performance scorecards covering key operational and commercial parameters.
* Track and improve key KPIs including:

+ OTIF – On-Time In-Full delivery
+ On-time production completion
+ Dispatch adherence
+ Production output
+ Capacity utilization
+ Quality performance
+ Production lead time
+ Plan adherence
+ Commercial compliance

* Identify underperforming factories/vendors and develop corrective action plans.
* Work with vendors to resolve production and delivery challenges and escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Conduct regular factory reviews to evaluate production performance, capacity, constraints, and upcoming requirements.
* Undertake visits to production facilities as required to review production planning, manufacturing progress, and dispatch readiness.
* Ensure factories have clear visibility of business requirements and agreed production priorities.
* Drive accountability among vendors for committed timelines and deliverables.
* Merchandising & Product Planning Coordination
* Partner closely with the Footwear Merchandising and Category teams to translate assortment and sales requirements into actionable production and buying plans.
* Ensure production planning is aligned with seasonal assortment requirements and approved sales orders.
* Monitor product-level requirements and identify potential supply gaps.
* Coordinate with merchandising teams on product availability, production status, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure that changes in product requirements, quantities or timelines are communicated to factories in a timely manner.
* Support business decisions related to local production versus imports based on capacity, cost, lead time, quality, and business requirements.
* Provide commercial and operational inputs into seasonal planning and range-building discussions.
* Tooling Planning & Management
* Own the planning and governance of footwear tooling requirements in alignment with sales orders and production plans.
* Ensure tooling requirements are identified and communicated sufficiently in advance to avoid production delays.
* Track tooling development and readiness against agreed production timelines.
* Coordinate with relevant product development, merchandising, sourcing, and factory teams to ensure tooling availability.
* Identify tooling-related risks and escalate potential impact on production or delivery timelines.
* Establish visibility of tooling requirements across seasons and future production plans.
* Imports & Local Manufacturing Planning
* Develop an optimal planning approach for the import and locally manufactured footwear portfolio.
* Evaluate business requirements and recommend the appropriate sourcing/manufacturing mix.
* Consider factors such as:

+ Factory capacity
+ Production lead time
+ Product availability
+ COGS
+ Quality requirements
+ Compliance requirements
+ Tooling requirements
+ Demand and sales plans
+ Delivery commitments

* Proactively identify situations where local production capacity may not be sufficient and recommend alternate supply solutions.
* Support the Category leadership team with data-driven recommendations on production versus import decisions.
* Business Analytics, Reporting & MIS
* Develop and maintain robust business planning and production tracking tools to provide timely visibility to the Category and leadership teams.
* Prepare detailed and actionable analytics covering:

+ Business plan vs. actual
+ Buy plan vs. actual
+ OTB utilization
+ Production plan vs. actual
+ Factory capacity
+ Production output
+ OTIF performance
+ Dispatch status
+ COGS and margin
+ Vendor performance
+ Tooling readiness
+ Supply risks

* Ensure all reports are supported by accurate, timely and reliable data.
* Provide clear insights, risks, and recommended actions, rather than only reporting historical performance.
* Establish weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards that provide forward-looking visibility on production and supply risks.
* Highlight deviations early and ensure ownership and closure of action points.
* Process, SOP & Governance
* Develop and strengthen SOPs, processes and governance mechanisms for business planning, production planning, factory reporting and vendor management.
* Standardize planning and reporting practices across factories and business stakeholders.
* Ensure factories follow agreed reporting formats, timelines, and planning processes.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for production, capacity, quality, and delivery risks.
* Drive process discipline and ensure adherence to agreed procedures.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased planning efficiency.
* Align India factory processes with relevant global Skechers requirements, processes, and best practices.
* Facilitate effective communication between India factories and the global team.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**Work Closely With Internal And External Stakeholders Including**

* Category – Footwear
* Merchandising
* Planning
* Sourcing
* Supply Chain
* Finance
* Quality
* Product Development
* Retail
* E-commerce
* Distribution
* Operations
* Global/Regional Teams
* Local Manufacturing Partners
* Vendors and Factories

Ensure that all stakeholders have timely visibility of business plans, production requirements, risks, changes, and delivery commitments.
  
  

* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4 direct reports.
* Establish clear goals, responsibilities, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build strong analytical, planning, and commercial capabilities within the team.
* Encourage ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving.
* Review team performance through structured business reviews and KPI tracking.
* Develop succession capability and ensure adequate functional coverage.
* Create a culture of urgency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Key Performance Indicators**
The role will be measured against a combination of business, commercial, operational, and planning KPIs, including:
  
  
**Business & Commercial**

* Annual/seasonal business plan adherence
* OTB utilization and governance
* GM% achievement
* COGS% to MRP
* Buy plan adherence
* Commercial savings/optimization initiatives

**Production & Supply**

* Production plan adherence
* Factory capacity utilization
* On-time production completion
* OTIF performance
* On-time dispatch percentage
* Production lead-time adherence
* Reduction in production-related business risks

**Vendor Management**

* Vendor/factory scorecard performance
* Improvement in underperforming vendor performance
* Timely closure of corrective action plans

**Planning & Governance**

* Accuracy and timeliness of business/production plans
* Timely identification of capacity constraints
* Tooling readiness against production requirements
* Compliance with planning SOPs
* Accuracy and timeliness of management reporting

**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate/post-graduate qualification from FDDI, NIFT or another reputed institution preferred.
* Candidates with a strong Footwear Production Planning / Manufacturing / Supply Chain / Merchandising / Business Planning background may also be considered.
* Post-Graduation in Business Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related discipline would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 12+ years of relevant experience, preferably within the footwear industry.
* Strong experience in business planning, production planning, footwear manufacturing, and/or commercial planning.
* Experience working with footwear factories, vendors, and manufacturing partners.
* Strong understanding of footwear production processes, capacity planning, and delivery management.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders and leading a team is essential.
* Exposure to both local manufacturing and import planning would be highly desirable.

**Functional Competencies**
**The Candidate Should Demonstrate Strong Capability In**

* Footwear Business Planning
* Production Planning
* Factory Capacity Planning
* Commercial Planning
* OTB Planning & Governance
* COGS & Margin Management
* Vendor Management
* Factory Performance Management
* Merchandising Coordination
* Tooling Planning
* Supply Planning
* Business Analytics
* MIS & Dashboard Development
* Cost Optimization
* Process & SOP Development
* Risk Identification & Mitigation
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Dynamic and versatile with the ability to operate in a fast-paced business environment.
* Strong analytical and planning orientation.
* High level of commercial acumen and business understanding.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving ability.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong process discipline.
* Strong sense of urgency and ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Team player with the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage stretched timelines when business requirements demand.
* Strong execution focuses with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including data analysis, reporting and business planning.
* Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint for management presentations.
* Working knowledge of MS Word.
* Experience with ERP/Planning/Business Intelligence systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to build and maintain analytical dashboards and production/business tracking tools.

**Key Role Expectations**
**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
**Own the India Footwear business planning agenda**
and ensure alignment between business requirements and supply capability. Maintain strong forward visibility of
**production output, factory capacity, and delivery commitments**
. Ensure the right balance between
**imports and local manufacturing**
. Protect and improve
**commercial outcomes through OTB, COGS and GM governance**
. Ensure factories and vendors deliver against agreed plans and timelines. Identify production, capacity, tooling, and delivery risks
**before they impact the business**
. Provide leadership with accurate, timely and actionable business intelligence. Establish robust planning processes, SOPs, and governance mechanisms. Build a high-performing and commercially oriented planning team. Act as a key link between
**Category, Merchandising, Factories, Vendors, Finance, Supply Chain and Global Stakeholders**
.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
The ideal candidate will be a
**footwear industry professional with strong business planning and commercial expertise**
, who can operate across both strategic planning and day-to-day execution. The person should be equally comfortable analyzing business numbers, reviewing factory capacity, challenging production plans, managing vendors, driving cross-functional alignment and presenting clear recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
The role requires an individual who can
**anticipate business requirements, translate them into executable production and commercial plans, identify risks early and drive stakeholders towards timely closure**
, while maintaining strong process discipline and commercial accountability.
  
  
**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Senior Manager - Customer Service & Logistics India
description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.
  
  
Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns
**25**
plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in
**26**
countries, and employs approximately
**4,700**
people.
  
  
Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Lead end-to-end Customer Service & Logistics for India, ensuring reliable product flow from source to customer, compliant and cost-effective operations, disciplined order-to-cash execution, strong customer experience, and an agile operating model that supports business growth. The role is the senior India coordination point for operational issue resolution and works across Commercial, Finance, Planning, Tax, Legal, Quality, regional Supply Chain teams, external authorities, customers and logistics partners.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Customer Service & Order Management
* Lead customer service and order-to-cash execution, ensuring accurate orders, invoicing, delivery visibility and timely issue resolution.
* Drive service improvement through customer collaboration, missed-sales analysis and corrective actions.
* Logistics, Imports & Distribution
* Govern imports, customs clearance, bonded warehousing, inventory, 3PL operations and outbound distribution.
* Ensure shipment visibility, documentation accuracy, stock integrity and effective management of logistics partners.
* Regulatory & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with customs, excise, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, licensing, label registration and audit requirements.
* Maintain audit-ready records and preventive controls to protect business continuity.
* Planning, Inventory & Cost
* Partner with planning teams to manage availability, inventory health, SLOB, bond expiry and supply risks.
* Own logistics budgets, provisions, cost control, productivity initiatives and vendor governance.
* Systems, Controls & Projects
* Ensure effective SAP execution, KPI reporting, SOPs, controls and audit readiness.
* Lead automation, process improvement and cross-functional supply-chain projects supporting India growth.
* People & Stakeholder Leadership
* Lead and develop the India CS&L team with clear accountability, cross-training and succession coverage.
* Act as the senior India CS&L coordination point across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, authorities and service providers.

**Key Relationships**
Stakeholder Group
  
  
Key Interfaces
  
  
Internal
  
  
India Commercial and Sales, Finance and Controls, Tax, Legal, Quality/Regulatory, Demand and Supply Planning, Procurement, HR, IT/GBS, India leadership, APAC CS&L and regional/global Supply Chain teams.
  
  
External
  
  
Customers, distributors, 3PLs, transporters, customs brokers/CHAs, bonded warehouses, co-packers, consultants, auditors, regulatory authorities and other service providers.
  
  
**Experience, Education & Skills**

* Graduate degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Commerce, Engineering or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Typically 5-7 years of progressive experience in customer service, logistics, import/export, supply-chain operations or a related function, including meaningful team and stakeholder leadership.
* Strong preference for experience in Alcobev, beverages, FMCG or another highly regulated consumer-goods environment.
* Working knowledge of bonded warehousing, customs, excise, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, taxation interfaces and India import/export operations.
* Demonstrated experience with SAP or another ERP, process controls, reporting and systems/process implementation.
* Commercial understanding of logistics contracts, 3PL governance, freight and warehousing costs, budgeting, provisions and vendor payments.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritisation, negotiation and cross-functional stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work with ambiguity, manage urgent escalations and convert operational detail into clear decisions for senior leadership.
* Strong written and spoken English; confident communication with regional/global teams, customers, vendors and authorities.
* Advanced Excel and data-analysis capability; interest in automation, digital tools and continuous improvement.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Customer and business orientation
* Ownership and accountability
* Agility and calm issue resolution
* Strategic thinking with disciplined execution
* Influencing without authority
* Risk and compliance mindset
* People development and succession focus
* Continuous improvement and data-led decision making

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Coordinator CSR (New Delhi, India)
description:
**Job Title: Coordinator CSR**
**Area: The Rotary Foundation**
**Reports to: Team Lead CSR**
**Location: South Asia Office, New Delhi**
**Rotary International Overview**
Rotary unites people from all continents and cultures who take action to deliver real, long-term solutions to pressing issues facing our communities. Each year, Rotary members invest more than $300 million and 16 million volunteer hours to improve lives and create positive change in the world. In exchange for hard work and dedication in support of Rotary’s clubs and humanitarian initiatives, our employees receive competitive salaries, flexible schedules, comprehensive benefits, and job enrichment. To learn more, visit http://www.rotary.org.
  
  
**Rotary International South Asia Office Overview**
Rotary International South Asia Office (RISAO) provides services to more than 9000 Clubs and close to 3 lakh Rotary members spread in 7 countries in South Asia i.e. India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bhutan and Maldives beside assisting Rotary International headquarters located in Chicago, IL, USA by providing guidance/dissemination of Rotary’s policies and procedures to Rotary leaders in South Asia, handles legal & stewardship issues & contributions received from India as well as financial reporting of Fiscal Agents in other countries in South Asia. RI South Asia Office embodies the beliefs, thoughts and practices of Rotary International. Our core values of trust, empowerment and teamwork is a reflection of the same. At RISAO, we believe in:
  
  

* Challenging ourselves to take initiative and be a part of the solution.
* Encouraging our employees to demonstrate accountability and a proactive attitude.
* Being professional in our interaction with customers
* Respecting, recognizing and appreciating individual performance while working in a team.

**Rotary’s Commitment to Diversity**
As a global network that strives to build a world where people unite and take action to create lasting change, Rotary values diversity and celebrates the contributions of people of all backgrounds, regardless of their age, ethnicity, race, color, abilities, religion, socioeconomic status, culture, sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity.
  
  
**General Overview**
Manage the end-to-end approval, documentation, due diligence, and processing of CSR projects, including due diligence of club and project compliance, accurate and sending timely information for booking of corporate contributions, coordination with internal teams, and facilitating disbursement of approved grant payments.
  
  
**You Will Have**

* A qualification in Social Service, CSR or a related field is preferred.
* A minimum of 5 years' experience in Non-Profit Organization or a related field
* Software requirements-MS Office, Oracle, ,
* Soft skills-Adaptability, Communication, Ethics, Flexibility, Empathy, Teamwork, Detail Oriented

* verbal, written and interpersonal communications skills. Fluency in English and an additional Indian language, preferably Hindi.
* Maintaining proper documentation of CSR projects by keeping all project records in place.
* Thinking critically and be a problem solver.
* Being Team-oriented and able to work independently.
* knowledge of computer applications (Word, Excel and other applicable programs).
* Written and oral communication
* Public speaking
* Showing attention to detail
* Good knowledge of managing corporate contracts
* Able to manage the load at peak period

**You Are Open To**

* Travel

**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Review the grant proposal received from the corporate and/or a Rotary club or district through the designated software/platform or pre-approval process. Assess project relevance, beneficiary need, budget reasonableness, measurable outcomes, sustainability and alignment with CSR requirements and RFI policies.
* Maintaining CSR data up to date for data analysis and team reporting

* Whet the agreements between corporate and RFI as also implementing club(s) in case of a tripartite agreement before putting up to Secretary, RFI for signatures on behalf of RFI.
* Work in tandem with the Financial Services (FS) team at SAO for contribution booking and grant payment processing as required.
* Ensure accurate and timely booking of corporate contributions and facilitate the timely processing and disbursement of approved grant payments.
* Ensure that all statutory, financial and program documentation is complete and properly maintained for audit and compliance purposes.
* Respond to CSR grant queries from Rotarians and coordinate all the activities between WHQ staff (if any) and project contacts.
* Works with club/ districts to resolve all outstanding issues for project approval and make sure grants are compliant & complete. Follow through with the clubs/district to expedite the pending documents/information.
* Work closely with grants team on the overdue reports for new application approvals
* Provide timely updates to corporate donors for all grants funded by them.

title: Manager ,Restructuring
description:

Our Restructuring practices’ aim is to provide effective solutions to its clients. We are seeking an Associate Vice President to work with clients to advise them on how they can simplify their group structures. This role will be based in India and will collaborate closely with global teams in UK and Europe region.
  
  
You will be involved throughout all stages of the simplification lifecycle, working as part of a team to advise clients on how to dispose of and reorganise corporate entities, realise assets, resolve outstanding issues such as the settlement of creditor claims and assist in the distribution of the surplus assets to shareholders.
  
  
You will broaden your knowledge as part of a fast-growing global team that has strong relationships and networks across different industry groups and jurisdictions.
  
  
You will develop an impressive range of advisory and technical implementation skills, gaining exposure to company legislation and accounting principles. This will foster a solid legal and financial understanding of different clients and businesses that will offer you both growth and career progression opportunities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Pre-elimination diligence to identify risk areas (both on and off balance sheet) requiring resolution ahead of liquidation. For example, preparation of balance sheet rationalisation steps, underpinned by a solid understanding of accounting principles and an awareness of corporate law and tax implications.

* At least five years’ experience preparing entities for closure and managing a portfolio of MVLs and CVLs.

description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)
  
  
Engagement type: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: INR 2,38,250 - INR 2,85,900 per month (based on experience and interview process)
  
  
**About Sanctuary**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Smart Home Project Manager to bring technology into our homes in a way that supports how people live. You will manage the implementation of smart home systems across our projects - from planning and vendor selection through installation and handover - and use AI tools to prototype integrations, automate workflows, and build internal systems. Internally, we call this role a "Smart Home VibeKid": someone who can vibe code a working prototype instead of waiting for someone else to build it.
  
  
Smart home at Sanctuary looks a little different. Our homes are designed around wellness, so technology has to serve health and comfort - lighting, air and water quality, energy, security - while staying mindful of EMF exposure. You will help decide what goes into our homes, how it all works together, and how residents experience it.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed playbook. We are looking for someone curious and hands-on, who can test ideas quickly, figure out what's missing, and turn a concept into a working system.
  
  
****What you'll do****
*Smart home implementation*

* Plan and manage smart home technology across our projects: lighting, climate, air and water quality monitoring, energy, security, and connectivity
* Evaluate and select smart home platforms, devices, and vendors that fit our wellness and EMF-conscious standards
* Work with architects, MEP consultants, and the construction team to build smart home systems into designs early
* Oversee installation, testing, and handover with vendors and integrators

*AI prototyping and automation*

* Use AI tools to prototype smart home integrations and automations before they go into homes
* Build internal systems and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate project tracking, vendor coordination, and reporting for smart home work
* Keep up with new smart home and AI technology, and test what could work for us

*Project management and coordination*

* Track timelines, budgets, and deliverables for smart home scope on each project
* Coordinate vendors, integrators, and internal teams across India and the U.S.
* Document systems clearly for residents, facility management, and future projects

****What you bring****

* 3-7 years of experience in smart home, home automation, IoT, ELV, or building management systems (BMS) in real estate projects
* Hands-on knowledge of smart home platforms and protocols (e.g. Home Assistant, Control4, Crestron, KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter)
* Experience managing installations with vendors and integrators, from planning to handover
* Hands-on experience building prototypes or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)
* Examples of integrations, tools, or automations you've built - please share them when you apply
* Interest in wellness technology (air and water quality, circadian lighting, low-EMF design) is a strong plus
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural environment
* Clear, proactive communicator in English, both written and spoken

****Hiring process****

* Stage 1: Intro interview - Role alignment, experience overview, a walkthrough of systems or tools you've built, and culture fit
* Stage 2: Test task - A short practical assignment: plan or prototype a smart home solution using AI tools
* Stage 3: Final interview - Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing business and operational projects in India, particularly in areas related to building materials, manufacturing, supply chain, and business development.

The role requires strong project management capabilities, commercial awareness, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, business partners, and regional stakeholders to drive successful project outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Plan, coordinate, and manage projects from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, and performance indicators to monitor project progress.
* Identify potential project risks, develop mitigation plans, and resolve issues to ensure timely and effective execution.
* Monitor project performance and prepare regular progress reports for relevant stakeholders.

**Cross-functional & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with internal teams, business partners, suppliers, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth project implementation.
* Coordinate with local and regional stakeholders, including teams in India and Thailand, to align project objectives, deliverables, and expectations.
* Facilitate effective communication across functions and support timely decision-making to address project challenges.

**Business & Operational Improvement**

* Support projects related to business operations, building materials, manufacturing, supply chain, and process improvement.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, cost effectiveness, quality, and overall project performance.
* Work closely with relevant business functions to implement practical solutions and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Business Development & Strategic Projects**

* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business initiatives, strategic partnerships, and potential business expansion projects in India.
* Conduct project feasibility assessments, including preliminary cost, resource, operational, and risk considerations, as required.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure effective execution of approved business initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in project management, project execution, or business operations, preferably within the building materials, manufacturing, industrial, construction-related, or supply chain sectors.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional projects, including project planning, budgeting, stakeholder coordination, risk management, and performance monitoring.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.
* Good understanding of business operations and the ability to translate business requirements into actionable project plans.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment.
* Proficiency in project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Excel, or other relevant platforms.
* Willingness to travel within India as required by business or project needs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with multinational companies or collaborating with regional or international teams.
* Experience in the building materials, manufacturing, infrastructure, or industrial sectors.
* Exposure to project feasibility studies, business expansion initiatives, joint ventures, or strategic partnerships.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage.

**About SCG**

SCG is a leading business conglomerate headquartered in Thailand, with operations across ASEAN and international markets.

In India, SCG operates through SCG International India Private Limited, with business activities spanning building materials, international sourcing, and supply chain solutions. SCG also participates in a joint venture with BigBloc Construction Limited in the manufacturing of autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) building materials.

SCG is committed to sustainable growth, innovation, and building strong partnerships to support long-term business development.

title: Project Manager (BA)
description:
Digital Minds is an award-winning marketing agency working with some amazing brands including Challenger Group, Servcorp, BigW, FedEx, BridgeClimb and Kennards Storage to name a few. We're growing our team and looking for a Project Manager 'digital mind' who knows how to keep big things moving to join us.

**The Role:**

As our Project Manager (BA), you'll be the main point of contact for one of our key global enterprise clients and the person who makes sure work moves from idea to published without losing momentum.

Day to day, you'll run the account: leading weekly client calls and monthly planning sessions, managing quotes, timelines and budgets and keeping every job moving through the client's workflow. You'll work hand in hand with our Head of SEO & GEO and SEO & GEO Manager, as well as our content partners, to turn strategy into delivery. Our clients value velocity over admin, so we need someone who keeps things simple, structured and moving.

On the BA side, you'll help scope new work, gather requirements and support discovery and business cases when an idea needs more than a brief.

As the role grows, you'll bring the same pragmatic, structured approach to project delivery across the wider SEO team.

**Responsibilities:**

●      Acting as the main point of contact for the client, building trust with stakeholders at every level

●      Running weekly status calls and monthly planning sessions, with clear agendas, actions and follow-ups

●      Building quotes and timelines, and managing budgets, credit tracking and final cost reports

●      Keeping project trackers, content calendars and client workflows (e.g. SharePoint, Teams) up to date

●      Coordinating internal teams, content partners and the client to keep every job on schedule

●      Scoping new work: gathering requirements, flagging complex ideas early and supporting discovery and business cases

●      Tracking and reporting hours and effort against each project

●      Spotting risks, bottlenecks and process gaps, and fixing them before they slow work down

●      Clear, proactive communication with clients, partners and our Australia & India teams across time zones

●      Supporting the SEO team with structured project management across other clients as capacity allows.

**What We’re Looking For:**

●      Minimum 5 years experience in project management, ideally in an agency, consultancy or client-facing role

●      Experience managing enterprise or large corporate clients, with multiple stakeholders and approval layers

●      Excellent written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable; you'll be the voice of the account

●      Confident stakeholder management. You can lead meetings, manage expectations and push work forward while protecting the relationship

●      Commercial awareness across quoting, budget tracking and scoping

●      Business analysis skills: gathering requirements, documenting processes and building simple business cases

●      A watertight approach to process, documentation and follow-up

●      Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Excel) and project tools (e.g. Asana)

●      Comfortable working across time zones, with good overlap with Australian and Asian business hours

●      Exposure to digital marketing, SEO or content production would be looked on favourably

●      Reliable, proactive and comfortable owning the outcome, not just the task

●      Professional, on the ball and hungry for results!

﻿

**Ready to be part of a winning team? Apply Now!**

**Description**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of current operations, identify performance improvement opportunities and quantify potential EBITDA improvement areas across plan, source, make and deliver functions

This role involves working closely with clients to identifytheir operations pain points and design & implement digital solutions across Supply chain planning, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics functions. Individuals should be able to translate business requirements into the right solution and map those with the vendor’sCOTS functionalities along with required customizations for end-to-end digital transformation programs (Design, Build/Configure, Test, Go Live and Hypercare)
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As Manager for Digital supply chain at A&M GCC PI team, you will contribute across the key areas below:
  
  
**Supply Chain Solutions Design & Implementation**

* Evaluate supply chain technologies, platforms, and solution providers and support the development of fit-for-purpose solution architectures and implementation roadmaps
* Define end-to-end digital supply chain strategy, roadmap and target operating model across ERP, planning, procurement, MES, WMS and TMS
* Define and validate data architecture, governance, cloud hosting and API/integration architecture across supply chain platforms
* Conduct “As-is” Assessment for gap analysis to design “To-be” state organization
* Translate business needs into functional & Technical specs and configure processes
* Create Design specifications for planning, procurement, production, Order management, Logistics, distribution
* Support end-to-end ERP implementation life cycle across supply chain modules (e.g., MM, PP, SD, WM, APO/IBP)
* Experience in integration with existing enterprise systems through APIs, middleware, cloud platforms, and cross-functional business process workflows
* Build RICEFW templates as per design specifications to support the solution
* Work with platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, Blue Yonder, SAP IBP, Coupa, SAP Ariba, Tulip, IRIS/MES, SAP EWM/TM etc.

**Testing & Deployment**

* Own the end-to-end implementation lifecycle from requirements through configuration, integration, testing, go-live and post-go-live stabilization
* Design and execute test scenarios: Unit Testing, Integration Testing, UAT
* Assist to validate configurations through business scenarios
* Support data migration, cut-over planning, go-live and hyper-care activities
* Collaborate with IT to troubleshoot and resolve issues post-deployment
* Project Management to track the issues through MS Project and JIRA

**Change Management & Training**

* Prepare SOPs, training materials, and user manuals; drive business-user adoption
* Support role – based user training sessions and drive functional adoption
* Conduct process workshops and knowledge-transfer sessions to build functional capabilities
* Highlight change impacts and ensure user readiness

**Continuous Improvement & Enhancements**

* Identify post-implementation improvements and process automation opportunities
* Support digital supply chain reporting needs (MPS, inventory, OTIF, cycle time etc.)
* Assist in system upgrades and rollouts across new plants or warehouses
* Evaluate emerging technologies like generative AI, Agentic AI and continuously enhance digital solutions through automation and process optimization

**Client Delivery & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead day-to-day project workstreams and contribute to overall project delivery
* Prepare executive-ready presentations, reports, and recommendations
* Facilitate client discussions, workshops, and stakeholder engagements

**Firm & Practice Contribution**

* Develop thought leadership, industry perspectives, benchmarks, and reusable tools / frameworks to strengthen the firm's Digital Supply Chain proposition
* Contribute to proposal development and business development activities
* Support internal knowledge development and training initiatives

**Qualifications**

* 6-11 years of experience in digital supply chain transformation, supply chain planning, logistics, operations excellence, or digital supply chain technology implementation programs
* Previous advisory and consulting experience from a top-tier strategy firm, leading specialist / niche advisory firm, or Big-4 consultancy preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, logistics, supply chain, manufacturing or a related field
* MBA / master’s degree in supply chain & Operations, Logistics, Business Administration, or similar discipline
* Strong functional knowledge across the end-to-end supply chain, including demand & supply planning, manufacturing, procurement, production scheduling, inventory, logistics, distribution, and order fulfilment
* Strong knowledge of supply chain operating models, process re-engineering, business process mapping, and target-state design
* Experience supporting or leading implementation of supply chain planning, logistics, warehouse management (WMS), transportation management (TMS), procurement, or manufacturing execution solutions (MES)
* Familiarity with enterprise data models, cloud platform architectures, data migration lifecycle, API/integration frameworks, and business process integration across supply chain functions
* Hands-on experience with ERP and supply chain platforms such as SAP ECC/S4HANA, SAP IBP, SAP EWM/TM, Oracle SCM Cloud, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, Microsoft Dynamics, o9, WMS / TMS or similar solutions
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills with the ability to drive adoption across business and technology teams
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational and coordination skills in dynamic, operationally complex environments
* Experience in managing cross-functional stakeholders during implementations
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and root-cause problem-solving skills
* Exposure to AI/ML-powered supply chain solutions, generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision intelligence platforms, would be a plus
* Tools knowledge on Alteryx, Power BI, python, Linear programming platforms, etc. would be a plus

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

BMS Projects

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – BMS to manage end-to-end execution of Building Management System projects. The candidate will be responsible for project planning, site execution, resource management, client coordination, vendor management, and timely project delivery.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in BMS installation, integration, testing, and commissioning, along with strong project management and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning and Execution**

* Manage end-to-end execution of BMS projects from project initiation and planning to installation, testing, commissioning, and final handover.

* Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion within the approved scope and budget.
* Coordinate BMS installation activities at commercial buildings, offices, data centres, and other infrastructure projects, as applicable.
* Ensure project activities are aligned with approved drawings, specifications, BOQs, and contractual requirements.

**2. BMS Technical Coordination**

* Oversee installation and integration of BMS field devices, controllers, sensors, actuators, and control panels.
* Coordinate integration of HVAC equipment and other building systems with the BMS platform.
* Monitor testing, commissioning, system functionality, and troubleshooting activities.
* Coordinate with design and engineering teams for shop drawings, control schematics, points lists, and technical submittals.
* Ensure proper integration and communication between BMS controllers, field devices, and supervisory software using protocols such as BACnet and Modbus, wherever applicable.
* Ensure completion of testing reports, commissioning documentation, and system handover.

**3. Client and Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, MEP contractors, electrical contractors, and other project stakeholders.
* Conduct project review meetings and provide regular progress updates.
* Resolve technical and execution-related issues in coordination with engineering teams.
* Manage client expectations, project escalations, approvals, and changes in scope.
* Ensure customer satisfaction throughout project execution and handover.

**4. Team and Vendor Management**

* Lead and coordinate site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and installation teams.
* Allocate resources and monitor productivity at project sites.
* Coordinate with OEMs, suppliers, and vendors for equipment procurement, delivery, and technical support.
* Ensure material availability in line with project schedules.
* Monitor subcontractor performance and ensure adherence to project timelines and quality standards.

**5. Budget and Commercial Management**

* Prepare and monitor project budgets, cost estimates, and resource requirements.
* Track project expenses and control cost overruns.
* Review BOQs, material requirements, and project scope variations.
* Coordinate with commercial and finance teams for billing, payment follow-ups, and variation claims.
* Support preparation of project completion reports and final commercial closure.

**6. Quality, Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure BMS installations comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, and applicable quality standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections and review installation quality.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements and contractor guidelines.
* Identify project risks, delays, and technical issues and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain proper documentation for inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover.

**7. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports.
* Maintain project schedules, material trackers, risk registers, and issue logs.
* Track project milestones, pending approvals, and outstanding work.
* Ensure timely submission of technical documents, testing reports, as-built drawings, and operation and maintenance manuals.
* Coordinate final project handover to the client and operations team.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 5–8 years of experience in BMS project execution and project management.
* Hands-on experience in BMS installation, integration, testing, and commissioning.
* Strong understanding of HVAC controls, field devices, DDC controllers, control panels, and BMS architecture.
* Working knowledge of communication protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.
* Experience in managing site engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, control schematics, BOQs, and project specifications.
* Experience in project scheduling, cost control, material planning, and progress reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and project tracking tools.
* Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of BMS projects against agreed milestones.
* Adherence to project budgets and cost estimates.
* Quality of installation and commissioning with minimal rework.
* Timely resolution of site and technical issues.
* Effective coordination with clients, consultants, and subcontractors.
* Material planning and availability aligned with project schedules.
* Timely completion of documentation and project handover.
