title: Survey Coordinator
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Survey Coordinator**
, you will be the operational engine behind ERM's UK survey programmes — coordinating access, scheduling, logistics, and compliance across a portfolio of capital projects. Working within the Capital Project Delivery (CPD) — Projects Feasibility, Planning & Consents pillar, you will partner with Land Access Managers, Land Access Coordinators, technical survey leads, project managers to ensure surveys are delivered on time, safely, and in line with landowner permissions. This role is critical to de-risking survey programmes, maintaining CDM and H&S compliance, and enabling CPD's UK Land Services and technical teams to grow through reliable, well-run field campaigns.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Survey programmes are delivered on schedule and within budget, with access, resource, and equipment aligned to landowner permissions and site constraints.
* Access windows are actively managed and re-planned in response to weather, ecology seasons, landowner availability, and construction interfaces — protecting critical path.
* Clients and Internal stakeholders receive clear, timely progress updates on survey status, blockers, and completion, supported by accurate trackers and reporting.
* Cross-team coordination, with issues escalated early and resolved collaboratively.
* Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS), permits, and post-survey reinstatement records are complete, auditable, and stored in line with ERM's quality and assurance standards.

**What will you bring?**

* Demonstrable experience (typically 3+ years) coordinating multi-discipline surveys, fieldwork, or site logistics on UK infrastructure, energy, utilities, environmental, or development projects.
* Strong programme and logistics management skills — able to juggle multiple concurrent survey campaigns, teams, and access windows.
* Working knowledge of UK H&S and compliance frameworks relevant to fieldwork.
* Confident communicator with landowners, surveyors, subcontractors, and clients — both written and verbal.
* Strong Microsoft 365 skills (Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint) with the ability to build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and resourcing plans.
* Familiarity with GIS platforms and the ability to interpret land plans, constraint mapping, and access routes.
* Commercial awareness of utilisation, chargeability, and cost control on survey workstreams.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* Background or qualification in ecology, environmental science, geography, land management, or a related discipline.
* Prior experience coordinating surveys.
* Familiarity with resource management and forecasting tools used in consultancy (e.g., Workday, resource trackers).
* Experience supporting DCO, TWAO, planning, or ESIA-driven survey programmes.
* Exposure to global delivery or shared service environments, working alongside offshore/CDH delivery teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the planning, scheduling, and mobilisation of UK survey campaigns across disciplines.
* Work closely with Land Access Managers and Coordinators to align survey programmes with landowner permissions, access windows, and any site-specific conditions or restrictions.
* Maintain the master survey tracker, resource plan, and access matrix — ensuring visibility of status, blockers, and forecast completion across projects.
* Ensure all surveyors and subcontractors have the required competencies, certifications, and inductions before deployment.
* Provide clear, timely progress updates to project managers, technical leads, and clients on survey delivery, and escalate risks or delays early.
* Support the Land Access Manager with post-survey close-out, including reinstatement checks, damage claims, and landowner thank-you communications.
* Contribute to continuous improvement — refining trackers, templates, competency matrices, and process documentation for CPD's UK Land Services and technical teams.
* Uphold ERM's health, safety, quality, and ethics standards on all fieldwork, ensuring the safety and wellbeing of every team member deployed to site.

* Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.
* Be the owner of last-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.
* Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.

**About You**

* 3–6 years of experience in ground operations, last-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride-hailing, e-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).

* Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA-driven operations and comfort working with real-time, on-ground decision-making.

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
* Customer-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.
* Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.
* Willingness to work in shifts, be on-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.

* Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up .
* Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, ground operational excellence, data analysis and vendor management processes.

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.
  
  
If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

results and consultations with Program and RM&E teams to identify capability gaps.Translate needs into a prioritized, role-specific capacity-building plan aligned to program calendars, hiring phases Courses:Lead the design of training modules, facilitator guides, participant materials and job aids for literacy projects, including materials that help teams understand and use program data and run project.Training Impact Analysis with RM&E:Jointly with RM&E, design and carry out evaluations of training impact, with KAP improvement as the central measure.Co-develop KAP baseline, post-training responsibility for training needs analysis and for planning and managing training across multiple cohorts, roles and locations.Experience designing training materials and competency frameworks, with education programs, including work with systems such as SCERT and DIET.Experience with multilingual education, or with digital and AI-supported coaching and learning tools.Experience managing external title: Associate Implementation Manager
description:
**About Global PayEX**

Global PayEX is a leading AI-powered FinTech SaaS company specializing in Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) automation. Our cloud-based platform helps businesses optimize working capital by automating invoice processing, payments, collections, reconciliation, and financial workflows. Leveraging advanced AI and machine learning, we enable organizations to improve cash flow, reduce manual effort, and enhance operational efficiency. Global PayEX serves enterprises, financial institutions, and mid-market businesses worldwide, partnering with leading banks and Fortune 500 companies to deliver intelligent finance automation solutions

**Role Overview**

As an Associate Implementation Manager, you will be at the center of how Global PayEX goes live with major bank and enterprise clients. You will work directly with client teams — CFO offices, treasury teams, and bank implementation leads — to configure, deploy, and onboard our AR/AP automation platform. This is not a coding role. It is a client-facing, problem-solving, project ownership role for someone who understands technology well enough to bridge the gap between engineering and the business. If you are someone who loves working with enterprise clients, can manage a project timeline, and wants to see how technology transforms financial operations at scale — this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Solutioning**

• Run product demos for corporate finance teams, treasury heads, and CFOs.

• Understand each prospect's accounts-receivable process, ERP landscape, and pain points; translate these into a tailored solution narrative.

• Prepare pre-call briefs, solutioning notes, objection-handling material, and follow-up communication for internal stakeholders and clients.

• Support the pipeline by qualifying prospects, contributing to sales collateral and audits, and moving accounts through the funnel.

• Represent the product with credibility in front of senior finance stakeholders.

**Implementation & Delivery**

● Lead end-to-end onboarding of enterprise clients onto the Global PayEX platform, working with bank partners and corporate treasury teams.

● Coordinate between client stakeholders, internal product teams, and technical teams to ensure smooth go-lives.

● Configure and test platform workflows based on client-specific requirements.

● Prepare implementation plans, training materials, and status reports for client and internal stakeholders. ● Identify and resolve implementation blockers quickly, escalating where needed.

● Build trusted relationships with client contacts throughout the implementation lifecycle.

● Support continuous improvement of our implementation playbooks and documentation.

**Operations, Onboarding & Adoption**

• Work with the Operations team on end-user onboarding once a client is live.

• Design and run training programs, adoption campaigns, and refresher sessions for the client's finance users and their downstream users.

• Monitor throughput and adoption metrics for your accounts; identify drop-offs and act on them. • Own the client relationship post go-live for at least the stabilisation period.

**What We're Looking For**

● 1–2 years of full-time work experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or a finance/treasury function within a corporate.

● Educational background in finance, commerce, or business (B.Com, BBA, BMS, MBA-Finance, CA Inter/CA, CFA L1+, or equivalent)

. ● Strong understanding of basic finance concepts — accounts receivable, invoicing, reconciliation, collections, working capital, DSO.

● Comfortable being client-facing: confident in demos, meetings, and presentations with senior finance stakeholders.

● Proactive by default — able to spot what needs doing next and drive it without being asked.

● Strong written and verbal communication in English.

● Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-accountability environment.

● Familiarity with tools like Excel, JIRA, Claude, Confluence, or project management platforms is a plus.

Why Global PayEX

● JPMorgan-backed and JPMorgan channel-distributed — direct exposure to how Tier-1 banks adopt enterprise FinTech.

● Work with Fortune 500 clients from day one.

● Founded and led by a CMU alumnus — you will have direct access to senior leadership

. ● Competitive USD compensation with performance incentives.

● Real ownership from day one — this is not a support role.

**How to Apply Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to hr@globalpayex.com with the subject line: "Associate Implementation Manager | [Your Name]"**

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Technical Project Manager (Healthcare Integrations & AI)
description:
**Company Description**
Esbee Dynamed Pvt. Ltd. is a healthcare technology company that designs and builds advanced surgical devices and operating room (OR) integration systems. Established in 1999, the company has evolved into a trusted partner for hospitals and healthcare institutions, offering ISO 9001-certified production and precision-engineered products. Its portfolio includes media management systems, surgical recording technologies, and customized software tools for digitizing the OR. With a growing focus on digital health solutions, Esbee Dynamed is committed to simplifying institutional workflows and improving clinical outcomes through innovative, high-quality technology.
  
**Role Description**
The Technical Project Manager (Healthcare Integrations & AI) is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring healthcare integration and AI projects, including requirements gathering, timeline management, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication. The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering, product, clinical, and client teams to integrate OR systems, software tools, and AI-based solutions into hospital workflows, ensuring interoperability and robust performance. Day-to-day activities include managing project plans and risks, overseeing testing and validation, coordinating vendor and customer interactions, and preparing clear documentation and status reports. The role also involves driving continuous improvement, aligning projects with regulatory and quality standards, and supporting go-live activities and post-implementation support.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret technical requirements, evaluate data, and solve complex integration and workflow challenges.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams, interact with clinical stakeholders, and present project updates clearly.
* Candidates should possess Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, prioritize, and deliver multiple healthcare integration and AI initiatives on time and within scope.
* Candidates should possess Team Leadership capabilities to guide project teams, coordinate responsibilities, and foster a collaborative, inclusive working environment.
* Relevant experience in healthcare IT, medical devices, OR integration, or digital health solutions, including system integration and interoperability (e.g., HL7, DICOM, FHIR) is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, data workflows, and software development life cycle (SDLC) in regulated environments is an advantage.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, healthcare informatics, or a related field is preferred; advanced degrees or certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are a plus.
* Ability to work on-site in New Delhi, manage stakeholders at different levels, and adapt to evolving clinical and technical requirements.

title: Manager/Senior Manager (Event Operations)
description:
**Job Description: Manager/Senior Manager (Event Operations)**

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana Experience: 5–8 Years Employment Type: Full-Time

About People Matters

People Matters is a leading HR and talent-focused media and community platform serving business leaders across India and Southeast Asia. We partner with CEOs, CHROs, Tech Leaders and senior decision-makers to drive conversations around talent strategy, leadership, and the future of work.

Through high-impact physical conferences, large-scale virtual summits, roundtables, research-led initiatives, and digital properties, People Matters enables meaningful engagement between brands and the HR ecosystem.

We combine community, content, and curated experiences to help organizations strengthen their employer brand and business impact.

Learn more at: www.peoplematters.in

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager/Assistant Manager to lead the planning and execution of People Matters’ conferences and new experiences & Initiatives.

The role will be responsible for managing the end-to-end event operations lifecycle — from planning, budgeting and vendor management to on-ground execution and post-event closure.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in managing B2B events, conferences, corporate events, or large-scale experiences and should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Event Planning & Execution

● Own the end-to-end operational planning and execution of physical, virtual, and hybrid events.

● Develop detailed event plans covering timelines, logistics, production, staffing, vendors, and on-ground requirements.

● Coordinate with internal teams including Sales, Client Servicing, Content, Marketing, and Design to ensure seamless event delivery.

● Ensure all event deliverables are executed as per agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.

● Manage multiple events and projects simultaneously.

2. Vendor & Partner Management

● Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage event vendors and service partners.

● Manage production agencies, AV partners, venues, F&B, fabrication, branding, logistics, travel, and other event suppliers.

● Ensure vendor deliverables meet agreed quality, timelines, and commercial commitments.

● Build a reliable and cost-effective vendor ecosystem.

3. Budget & Cost Management

● Prepare and manage event budgets in line with approved commercial plans.

● Track event expenses, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor payments.

● Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising the attendee or client experience.

● Monitor event profitability and ensure operational decisions are aligned with business objectives.

4. On-Ground Operations & Experience

● Lead on-ground event operations and ensure smooth execution across all touchpoints.

● Manage venue setup, registration, stage and production, branding, seating, F&B, hospitality, transportation, and attendee movement.

● Coordinate with venue teams and vendors to resolve real-time operational challenges.

● Ensure a high-quality experience for speakers, delegates, partners, and other stakeholders.

● Take ownership of troubleshooting and crisis management during events.

5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

● Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand event objectives and translate them into operational plans.

● Coordinate with speakers, delegates, partners, venues, vendors, and external agencies.

● Maintain clear communication and timely updates across stakeholders.

● Anticipate operational risks and proactively develop contingency plans.

6. Post-Event Closure & Reporting

● Ensure timely post-event closure, including vendor reconciliation, documentation, and financial settlements.

● Conduct post-event reviews to identify learnings and improvement areas.

● Track operational KPIs and event performance metrics.

● Maintain event documentation, vendor databases, checklists, and standard operating processes.

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Skills

● 2–6 years of experience in Event Operations, Conference Management, Event Production, Experiential Marketing, or related roles.

● Proven experience managing end-to-end B2B events, conferences, roundtables, or corporate events.

● Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.

● Hands-on experience with event logistics, production, AV, fabrication, venues, F&B, and attendee management.

● Good understanding of event budgeting, cost control, and commercial management.

● Strong project management and execution skills.

● Ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

● Willingness to travel and work on-ground during events as required.

Competencies

● Strong planning and organisational skills.

● High attention to detail and ownership mindset.

● Strong problem-solving and crisis-management abilities.

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

● Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

● Solution-oriented and proactive approach.

● Strong commercial and cost-conscious mindset.

● Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?

● Opportunity to work with top HR and business leaders across India & Southeast Asia.

● Exposure to high-impact leadership conferences and premium brand experiences.

● Opportunity to work across conferences, roundtables, custom events, and exclusive CXO experiences.

● A fast-growing, innovation-driven media organization.

● Collaborative and entrepreneurial work culture.

title: Game Producer: Platform Games
description:
**About Atari**
Founded in 1972, Atari is one of the world’s most iconic consumer brands and a pioneer in the video game industry, recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.
  
  
The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide. Today, Atari Inc. continues to build on its legacy by developing games, hardware, and experiences that honor the past while driving innovation for the future.
  
  
Over the past two years, we've been building Atari India, a growing team that plays a critical role in supporting our global operations. We're proud of the team we've assembled so far, and we’re just getting started. As part of a lean, high-impact organization, the team in India works closely with colleagues in North America and Europe on projects that move the company forward. Whether you're helping launch a new game, keeping our infrastructure secure, or supporting day-to-day operations, your work here matters. Join us as we continue to grow Atari India and build the future of a legendary brand.
  
  
Position: Game Producer : Platform GamesExperience: 3–6 years Location: Remote (requires core overlap with Europe/India time zones)Employment Type: Contractual(3 months)
  
  
**Overview**
We're reimagining Atari's classic arcade catalog as short-session games for Reddit, MSN and emerging channels. We need a Game Producer to own the pipeline end to end, shaping game strategy, turning concepts into shipped live titles, and keeping developers, designers, QA and external studios moving in sync.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own each title across its full lifecycle: strategy, concept, production, testing, launch and live-ops
* Shape game strategy and pitch new concepts and IP for the roster
* Coordinate internal developers/designers and external studios, unblocking the team to hit timelines
* Run agile/scrum planning: sprint schedules, standups and roadmap tracking across multiple titles at once
* Own and keep the game tracker/dashboard current: status, ownership, timelines
* Manage platform partner relationships (Reddit, MSN): format, submission and certification
* Manage external studio and vendor relationships, and drive IP intake and rights clearance with legal/licensing
* Own KPIs (games live, revenue/daily player, engagement) and drive initiatives to improve them; report weekly
* Manage risk across game timelines: flag slippage early and drive mitigation and release management
* Scout new IP and channels (Discord, YouTube Playables, Telegram) for expansion

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 3+ years as a game producer/associate producer (casual, mobile or browser games)
* Shipped games end to end, managing both internal and external/outsourced teams
* Working knowledge of Unity and HTML5 pipelines, and staying current with platform game technology
* Hands-on experience with agile/scrum planning and sprint scheduling in a live production pipeline
* Strong PM and communication skills; comfortable juggling multiple titles at once
* Experience with platform partner launch/certification requirements
* Experience managing external studio/vendor relationships and timeline risk

**Preferred**

* Passion for retro/arcade gaming and the Atari IP library
* Comfort using data (dashboards, revenue-per-player) to make ship/stop calls

Why Join Us?
  
  

* Build in gaming, not just hire for it: real ownership and direct access to leadership
* Hybrid, flexible, trust-driven environment
* Zero-cost comprehensive medical cover
* Ambitious, collaborative, genuinely fun team

EEO Statement
  
  
Atari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We are committed to equal employment regardless of race, religion or lack thereof, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, medical condition, veteran status, ancestry, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

You are a senior, process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes — working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. **Roles & Responsibilities**

* Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.

* Defines and governs the agentic solution design and AI adoption strategy across engagements — agent roles, prompt logic, RAG grounding, multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop.
* Leads AI-led and agentic reinvention pursuits — sets the reinvention agenda, shapes the solution roadmap, and designs AI-enabled operating models that embed AI into how the enterprise runs.
* Leads business development and pre-sales for AI-led reinvention pursuits — shapes proposals and RFP responses that convey the solution and its quantified business impact.

**Must-have Skills**

* Deep, hands-on command of AI-led Reinvention and Agentic Reinvention, with strong ability to shape and lead the reinvention agenda across an enterprise.
* Strong Agentic Architecture capability, spanning multi-agent solution design and the architecture patterns that make agentic solutions production-ready.
* Hands-on experience in Solution Design — defining functional workflow designs alongside the relevant technical components and solution interfaces to form a cohesive, implementation-ready blueprint.
* Strong native AI fluency — NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
* Deep Domain Consulting expertise and the ability to design AI-Enabled Operating Models that embed AI into how the enterprise runs.
* Proven capability in Value Realization and Business Case Development — defining, quantifying, and substantiating the value story that underpins a transformation.
* Able to translate reinvention ambition into a sequenced, executable transformation roadmap that phases workflow re-design, automation, and agentic AI adoption across towers, and aligns them to value realization and the business case, and gives engineering, data, and platform teams a build-ready plan.
* Proven experience leading large-scale Process Transformation and Digital Transformation programs end to end across complex enterprise environments.
* Deep process design and architecture expertise — Business Process Strategy & Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Workflow Analysis & Design, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
* Practical Automation experience, together with a working command of AI / GenAI Governance to enable covering guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and responsible-AI compliance.
* Industry & Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge — including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Multi-agent AI and with RPA / intelligent automation tooling such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Semantic Kernel, Lang Graph, Open AI, Claude etc.
* Product Management experience across discovery, scoping, and delivery.
* Domain Expertise and Process Expertise across one or more industry sectors - and across core end-to-end functional workflows (OTC, RTR, PTP etc.) to ground process re-design in domain-specific operating models and leading practice.

title: Strategy Consultant
description:
**Position:**
Program Manager – Urban Initiative

**Location:**
Delhi

**An initiative supported by The Convergence Foundation**

**About URBAN Project**

India is urbanising rapidly, and its cities are where the country's economic future will be decided. Services already form the largest part of the Indian economy, and well-functioning cities are essential to sustaining services-led growth and creating jobs at scale. Yet urbanisation in India has often been unplanned and under-resourced, leaving cities struggling with weak planning, a difficult business environment, fragmented governance, and chronic under-financing. Getting urbanisation right – rapid yet sustainable – is one of the highest-leverage opportunities for India's economic transformation.

The Urban Initiative is supported by The Convergence Foundation, the Urban Initiative is being established to help India build the policy ecosystem needed to drive economic growth through rapid and sustainable urbanisation. It will work systemically—developing policy perspectives and partnering with the government to advance reform—rather than engaging in on-ground implementation. Its work will be organised around four interconnected pillars:

* **Regional economic and spatial planning:**
  Creating regional economic plans that feed into better, more growth-oriented master plans for cities and their surrounding regions.
* **Ease of doing business:**
  Enabling more sensible development control norms and regulations that make it easier to build, invest and do business in cities.
* **Governance:**
  Strengthening how cities are managed, including the devolution of power to empowered, accountable city governments.
* **Financing:**
  Ensuring cities are adequately funded and well managed – through better allocation of public money, raising local resources, and involving the private sector through PPP and other models.

Across each pillar, the initiative will build a strong policy perspective, drawing on best practices from better-run Indian cities as well as relevant global examples. It will work closely with the central government – including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) – to drive policy change at the national level, and with state and city governments where there is genuine interest and appetite for reform. The initiative will remain a small, high-quality team focused on ideas, influence and partnerships rather than implementation.

**Position Summary**

The Economic growth team works with internal and external stakeholders on cross functional projects. This role sits within the team's Urban Development initiative, which explores emerging issues and whitespaces in the urban development policy ecosystem. The Program Manager (PM) should have strong problem-solving skills, secondary research capabilities and analytical prowess. In addition, as well as excellent oral & written communication skills. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a bias towards action and the ability to work with ambiguous requirements. The PM will have a steep learning curve and would be expected to hit the ground running on live projects with Government institutions.

**Areas of Work:**

The Program Manager will:

* Work with Economic Growth team and leadership to identify and scope priority areas in the urban development policy ecosystem, with a focus on ease of doing business in cities, urban finance, and city planning
* Engage in dipstick secondary research to diagnose binding constraints in issue areas and develop initial hypotheses around opportunities for impact (e.g. which regulatory constraints, if solved for, can improve ease of doing business in a city)
* Develop evidence-based benchmarking frameworks to compare cities on regulatory performance and identify opportunities to streamline approvals, improve governance, and accelerate urban economic growth
* Engage with policymakers, urban practitioners, and other ecosystem stakeholders to validate findings, refine priorities, and build partnerships
* Oversee the creation of knowledge material across priority areas by identifying potential partners, developing terms of reference and managing projects to their completion
* Provide continued program/grant support to organisations, programs or public goods that might stem as a result of the scoping exercise

**Required Qualifications, Skills and Abilities**

* Undergraduate or masters degrees from top tier institutions. While there is no preference for a particular major or specialisation, prior experience in urban development or related sectors will be preferred
* Up to 4 years of work experience in a consulting or challenging/ high growth environment
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Solid planning and organisational skills with high attention to detail, accuracy, protocol and deadline
* Excellent writing ability that is clear, concise and analytic in style
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-facing skills including solid presentation and facilitation skills
* High level of flexibility and responsiveness with the ability to shift priorities quickly and as organisational demands require
* Ability to do research and distil important concepts in a structured, concise, yet comprehensive manner
* Operating style suited to working in a small-organisation setting, where teamwork and resourcefulness are highly valued

**Compensation**

Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend upon the candidate's experience

**Location**

New Delhi, India

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be evaluated on:

title: Founder's Office (Psychologist)
description:
About Antahā

Antahā is a global movement creating micro-communities across major cities to address loneliness at scale. It is built on three core values: Compassion, Connection, Community.

The ambition is large. The method is intimate. Loneliness is not solved by reach alone, by digital tools, or by any system that removes the human from the centre. It is solved by people who actually show up — for one another, for an evening, for a quiet space to belong in.

**About the Work**

Founder, Sitender is a teacher shaped by years of monastic living in the Himalayas. His work spans teaching, hosting signature events and intimate gatherings, and private one-on-one consulting. It is active across UAE, the US, NZ, and scaling fast across cities and continents.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Founder's Office Manager to be the operational spine of everything Sitender does — the bridge between Sitender and the world. You will hold the whole picture, ensure nothing is dropped, and protect the founder's time for the work only he can do: teaching, hosting, and building.

This role calls for a grounding in psychology. Much of the work is human: reading a room, understanding what a participant or private client needs, handling sensitive relationships with care, and shaping experiences that feel safe and meaningful. Your training helps you understand people, not treat them. This is a non-clinical role.

You will run the day-to-day across the founder's speaking and teaching calendar, marketing, and social media assisted by interns — the full surface area of a founder's office. This role suits someone equal parts organised and intuitive: able to manage a tour spreadsheet down to the last detail and to sense what a moment, a room, or a relationship needs. You will work closely with a distributed team across India, Europe, and the US.

What You Will Do

• Own end-to-end event logistics — venues, vendors, travel, run-of-show, and on-ground coordination for events, gatherings, and retreats

• Manage the founder's speaking and teaching calendar — inbound requests, scheduling, preparation, and follow-up

• Bring a psychological lens to participant and client experience — onboarding, follow-up, feedback, and noticing when someone needs more care or a referral

• Help design and refine gatherings and programs with an understanding of group dynamics, belonging, and emotional safety

• Drive marketing execution across channels — campaigns, partner briefs, content scheduling, and asset coordination

• Run social media end-to-end — posting, community engagement, growth, and a consistent voice and aesthetic

• Coordinate across a distributed team and external collaborators in multiple time zones

• Keep the founder's office moving — inbox triage, prioritisation, and making sure projects don't stall

• Anticipate needs before they arise, so the founder can stay present to the work

**Who You Are**

Essential

• A degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Psychology, Counselling, or a closely related field

• 3+ years in operations, executive support, chief-of-staff, or founder's office roles

• An exceptional organiser who thrives across many moving parts without losing the details

• A strong written communicator with a feel for brand voice and visual consistency

• Comfortable delegating social media and marketing execution

• Calm under pressure, discreet, and self-directed — you don't need to be managed

• Drawn to the work of stillness and inner growth, and at ease in a space that values presence over noise

**Preferred**

• Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing figure

• Experience in counselling, organisational psychology, wellbeing programs, or community and group facilitation

• A background in events, hospitality, or a fast-moving operation

• Willing to travel to the UAE, US

• A personal practice in meditation, somatic work, or related modalities

• Multilingual (Italian, Arabic, or others a plus)

**Personal Qualities**

• You hold complexity calmly — many threads at once, nothing dropped

• Quiet confidence and sound judgement; people trust you with what matters

• Discretion, depth, and integrity in all things

• A genuine desire to grow through this work, inwardly as well as professionally

**What You Receive**

• Competitive compensation, with structure and benefits discussed directly based on experience and location

• A rare seat at the centre of a growing body of work — teaching, events, and a movement being planted across cities worldwide

• Direct collaboration with the founder and a depth of perspective few roles offer

• Access to all events and sessions as a participant — your own growth is part of the role

• Room to grow as the work expands across the US, Europe, the Gulf, and beyond

**Education & Background**

A background in psychology is essential. Beyond that, we care less about where you studied and more about who you are: your capability, character, and care. We're looking for someone whose reliability and judgement have shaped the path they've walked, however unconventional that path has been.

Compensation & Onboarding

The role begins with an 8-week probation period, paid at a mutually agreed figure while we find our rhythm and see the work in motion. On successful completion, based on performance and delivery, you'll step into the role permanently with a full CTC upwards of 6 LPA, negotiable for the right profile and growing as the work expands across cities.

To Apply

Send a personal note to hello@antaha.org — not just a CV. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this work, and why this role calls to you. We won't respond to generic applications; we're looking for a specific kind of human being, and we'll know when we find them.

Without the personal note, we will not be responding to your application.

title: Program Manager
description: About the company: Our client is a fast-growing consumer electronics brand driven by innovation, design, and customer delight. They take pride in delivering high-quality products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Their operations, sales, and program teams are the backbone of our ability to scale efficiently and serve millions of customers across India and beyond, through online and offline channels. Role Overview: They are looking for a Program Manager to lead and drive key initiatives across manufacturing, supply chain, offline channel sales, logistics, and D2C growth. The ideal candidate combines operational acumen with strong exposure to offline distribution, retail expansion, and GT/MT/retail partner management. This person must be comfortable managing cross-functional programs in a fast-scaling ecosystem, ensuring execution excellence across both digital and physical sales networks. You will be responsible for driving operational rigor, optimizing processes, enabling offline channel efficiency, and managing a small team to deliver on ambitious business goals. Key Responsibilities: 1. Lead Program Execution - Oversee multiple strategic and operational programs across Manufacturing, SCM, Logistics, Product, D2C, and Offline Sales functions. - Build strong cross-functional alignment to ensure smooth execution of initiatives across online and retail channels. 2. Drive Offline Channel Growth - Partner with the Offline Sales team to enable store launches, distributor onboarding, GT/MT expansion, and retail execution excellence. - Work closely with regional sales leaders to improve supply availability, replenishment cycles, in-store deployment, and channel partner experience. - Identify operational gaps in offline distribution and define interventions to scale smoothly. 3. Drive D2C Growth - Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Operations to improve fulfillment, delivery speed, and customer experience for direct-to-consumer channels. 4. Team Leadership - Manage and mentor a small team of Associate Program Managers and Analysts to ensure seamless execution of initiatives. 5. Operational Excellence - Identify bottlenecks, streamline processes, and ensure alignment across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, Operations, and Marketing. - Build scalable systems to support large-scale offline and online expansion. 6. Data-Driven Decision Making - Analyze performance metrics, operations data, channel sell-through data, and dashboards to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities across offline networks. 7. Stakeholder Management - Partner with internal teams and external stakeholders including vendors, logistics partners, distributors, and retail partners to ensure timely delivery of goals. 8. Program Governance - Define KPIs, build dashboards, and report progress to leadership through structured reviews and presentations. 9. Continuous Improvement - Champion automation, tool adoption, and process innovation across operations, sales operations, and channel management. 10. Special Projects - Lead cross-functional projects aligned with business priorities such as new product launches, offline entry into new regions, retail expansion, or supply chain revamps. Qualifications: - -Education: MBA (Tier-1), If Tier 2 then should have worked in Tier 1 company -Experience: 3 - 8 years in operations, program/project management, supply chain, offline channel sales, manufacturing, or D2C businesses - Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs in a high-growth environment - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; advanced proficiency in Excel and data tools (SQL, Power BI, or similar) - Experience with ERP systems, IT tools, CRM/SFA or automation initiatives is a plus - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills - Demonstrated ability to lead teams, drive accountability, and deliver outcomes under tight timelines Ideal Candidate Profile: - Strategic operator with strong execution discipline - Experience or deep understanding of offline sales operations GT, MT, distributor management, retail operations, or channel expansion - High ownership mindset and ability to work in ambiguity - Adept at using data to drive insights and business decisions - Comfortable managing cross-functional teams and aligning them toward a common goal - Prior experience in consumer electronics, D2C, retail, or tech-driven supply chain is a strong plus - Entrepreneurial, energetic, and obsessed with customer experience

title: IT Program Manager
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Program Manager**
to join our Platform Engineering organization. This role will drive strategic initiatives across
**compute, build infrastructure, and Software Engineering Centers of Excellence (COEs)**
while also supporting
**organizational budget, financial, and asset management**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong technical program management experience with financial acumen and can partner effectively across Engineering, Finance, Procurement, and leadership teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead complex, cross-functional programs across compute, platform engineering, build infrastructure, and software engineering COEs.
* Develop and manage program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, and budgets to ensure delivery on time and within budget.
* Establish program governance, metrics, dashboards, executive reporting, and regular operating rhythms.
* Partner with engineering leaders to identify risks, resolve dependencies, and drive execution across multiple teams.
* Support annual budget planning, forecasting, budget-versus-actual tracking, and financial reporting for the broader organization.
* Provide visibility into spending, financial commitments, variances, and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Support asset and infrastructure financial management, including investment planning, utilization, lifecycle/refresh planning, and CapEx/OpEx management.
* Develop business cases and financial analyses to support investment and prioritization decisions.
* Partner with engineering leaders to establish and scale engineering COEs, best practices, and operational processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering planning, execution, financial governance, and organizational efficiency.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 15+ years of overall industry experience, preferably in technology, engineering, or infrastructure organizations.
* 10+ years of project/program management experience managing complex, cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with compute infrastructure, platform engineering, build infrastructure, developer platforms, or software engineering environments.
* Strong financial acumen with demonstrated experience in budget planning, forecasting, financial tracking, and variance management.
* Experience with organizational budget and/or asset management, including infrastructure investments and CapEx/OpEx.
* Strong proficiency with Jira and project/program management tools, including dashboards and executive reporting.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive alignment across Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and leadership teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, or Developer Productivityorganizations.
* Experience establishing or supporting Software Engineering COEs.
* Experience with portfolio management, capacity planning, and investment prioritization.
* PMP, PgMP, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent certification is a plus.

The successful candidate will bring together execution discipline, technical understanding, and financial rigor to ensure strategic engineering initiatives are delivered predictably while helping leadership effectively manage organizational investments, budgets, and assets.

title: Program Manager – Sales Transformation, India Sales BPR
description:

title: Global GTM & Sales Program Manager
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a strategic programs role at the center of Global Sales HQ. You own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic sales initiatives that turn strategy into repeatable, measurable motions across regions — and you are the connective tissue between Sales and Product, between demand generation and closure, and between global standards and on-the-ground execution.
  
  
In a matrixed organization where regional heads own their reps and delivery, you own the standard, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional programs that make the whole sales engine more effective. It is a builder-strategist role: you design the programs, orchestrate the launches, instrument them, and scale what works.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**SALES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS & STRATEGIC SALES INITIATIVES**

* Own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic initiatives that raise the productivity and consistency of the global sales organization, from skills and plays to new sales motions.
* Translate the annual sales strategy into a sequenced program roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
* Stand up initiatives as time-boxed programs with scale / iterate / kill decision gates, plus the governance rhythm — interlocks, exception desks, QBR cadences — that keeps regions on one standard.

**SALES – PRODUCT INTERLOCK**

* Own the operating interlock between Sales and Product: a structured, two-way loop that turns field signal into roadmap input and turns roadmap into sales readiness.
* Represent the voice of the field in prioritization, packaging, and pricing discussions, and carry product context back into the field.
* Ensure every material product change lands with the sales org through readiness, positioning, and enablement — nothing ships to market unsold internally.

**CAMPAIGNS — DEMAND & CLOSURE ALIGNMENT**

* Orchestrate integrated GTM campaigns that align top-of-funnel demand generation with the sales closure motion, so demand converts to pipeline and pipeline to revenue.
* Partner with Marketing and RevOps to define targeting, messaging, and the handoff and follow-up SLAs that connect demand to closure.
* Instrument campaigns end to end (demand → qualified pipeline → closed revenue) and drive continuous, data-led improvement.

**NEW PRODUCT INTRODUCTION (NPI) INTO MARKETS**

* Own the sales side of new-product introductions: the launch playbook, market-readiness criteria, and sequencing for introducing products into markets, countries, and corridors.
* Coordinate the cross-functional launch (Product, Marketing, Enablement, regional sales) so each introduction has clear ownership, ramp targets, and measurement.
* Define go / no-go gates and post-launch review so the organization scales winners and retires what doesn't land.

**COUNTRY & CORRIDOR SALES STRATEGY**

* Define where-to-play / how-to-win by country and corridor — grounded in market, revenue, and account data.
* Build and maintain the market and corridor tiering and prioritization that focuses sales investment on the highest-value opportunities.
* Partner with regional Sales heads to translate corridor strategy into coverage, targeting, and sequenced motions on the ground.

**What Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months**

* A published, sequenced program roadmap tied to the sales strategy, with governance live and adopted across regions.
* A functioning Sales–Product interlock running on a regular cadence, with measurable roadmap and readiness outcomes.
* Integrated demand-to-closure campaigns live, with clean end-to-end metrics leadership uses to steer.
* A repeatable NPI launch model and an active country / corridor sales strategy directing prioritized investment.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* 8+ years in GTM strategy, sales programs, sales enablement / excellence, or strategic sales initiatives, including running cross-functional programs at scale.
* Proven experience owning a Sales–Product interlock or equivalent alignment between the field and the product roadmap.
* A track record designing and launching go-to-market campaigns that connect demand generation to sales closure.
* Experience leading new-product introductions and / or market and corridor launch strategy.
* Strong analytical foundation — comfortable in the data, building market / corridor prioritization, and instrumenting funnels end to end.
* A record of operating in a matrixed, multi-region organization and driving alignment without direct authority; excellent executive communication.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on fluency with the modern sales stack — Salesforce, Gong, BI / SQL (BigQuery a plus), and campaign tooling.
* Familiarity with corridor-based, multi-currency GTM and with SMB / marketplace / platform segments.
* Experience standing up governance rhythms — interlocks, QBRs, and forecast operating models — across regions.

**Fintech / Payments Experience Strongly Preferred**

* Background in fintech, payments, or cross-border B2B financial services.
* Understanding of how compliance, trust, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees shape GTM in regulated financial services.
* Comfort translating product complexity (multi-currency, FX, working capital, stablecoin rails) into simple, sellable, market-ready motions.

**Who You'll Work With**
Product, Marketing, RevOps, regional sales heads (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), Sales Enablement & Excellence, Customer Retention & Expansion, and Strategic Accounts. You'll be a core member of the Global Sales HQ leadership team, reporting to the VP of Global Sales.
  
  
**Why Join**
You'll own the programs and cross-functional interlocks that a global sales organization runs on — the layer where strategy, product, demand, and execution meet. You'll build, not just maintain, in a company at the frontier of cross-border payments, with the data, tooling, and executive support to make GTM measurably better across three regions.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

title: Materials Sourcing/Production Manager - Linen (India)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
**Material Sourcing / Production Manager - Linen (India)**
****RESPONSIBILITIES:****
Fiber Inventory & Quality Control
  
  

* Oversee linen fiber inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for spinning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality fiber—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the spinning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming fiber before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw linen.

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management
  
  

* Own fiber OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to spinning mills and flagging potential delays.
* Prolinenly manage production schedules to ensure fiber is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Coordinate with planners and production team to align fiber availability with production demand and spinning schedules.
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs.
* Provide input on fiber purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history.
* Escalate production blockers (e.g., fiber shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals.

Spinning & Production Support
  
  

* Partner with spinning mills to ensure fiber lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.
* Monitor fiber consumption during spinning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations.
* Work upstream with suppliers to align fiber bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother mill integration.
* Maintain clear documentation of fiber lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with linen or other luxury fibers.
* Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess fiber quality and enforce standards before spinning.
* Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor fiber usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow.
* Collaboration: Experience working with spinning mills, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with linen fiber grading, testing, or lot management.
* Knowledge of spinning mill operations and fiber-to-yarn conversion.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools.
* Understanding of sustainable fiber sourcing and production practices.

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

**Role Title: VP, IAM End User Operations (L14)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are

For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.
  
  
Specifically,
  
  

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
