title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
**Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Planning Lead**

**Location -**
Gurugram, India

**Experience Level -**
8–10 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced
**Supply Chain Planning Lead with 8–10 years of experience in Oracle Supply Chain**
, including hands-on Oracle Fusion SCM Planning delivery.

The ideal candidate will have led demand, supply, and replenishment planning workstreams on full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations and will be comfortable conducting design workshops directly with business users.

In this role, you will be deployed on an Oracle Fusion engagement for a
**Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) client in the Middle East**
, owning planning process discovery and solution design for a multi-outlet supply chain, from demand signals through to store replenishment.

Delivery will be primarily offshore from Gurugram, with onsite presence in Dubai for key project milestones, including requirement gathering, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), cutover, and go-live.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

A. Process Discovery & Solution Design

* Lead requirement-gathering workshops with business users and translate outcomes into Oracle Fusion solution designs and configuration documents.
* Map as-is and to-be planning processes across demand, supply, and replenishment, identifying gaps and recommending fit-to-standard solutions.
* Define planning data flows across Inventory, Procurement, and, where applicable, central kitchen or manufacturing operations, including planning data collections.
* Advise the client's supply chain team on leading practices for high-velocity, short shelf-life planning.

B. Oracle Fusion SCM Planning – Configuration

* Configure Planning Central, Demand Management, Supply Planning, and Replenishment Planning in Oracle Fusion SCM, as applicable to the project scope.
* Set up planning parameters, forecasting methods, safety stock policies, reorder points, sourcing rules, and assignment sets.
* Configure plan inputs, plan options, measures, and planning tables, and fine-tune plan outputs in collaboration with the business.
* Design exception management and alerts to enable planners to focus on exceptions rather than reviewing every item.

C. Testing, Cutover & Go-Live

* Develop test scenarios, drive System Integration Testing (SIT), and lead UAT with client planners through functional sign-off.
* Support data migration validation for items, organisations, sourcing rules, and historical demand.
* Support cutover planning, go-live, and post-go-live stabilisation through hypercare.

D. Workstream Management & Collaboration

* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and user training materials.
* Maintain workstream status, Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies (RAID) items, and project timelines, reporting progress to engagement leadership.
* Collaborate with technical consultants on integrations, reports, and extensions required to support the planning design.
* Guide and review the work of junior consultants on the workstream, wherever assigned.

**4. Skills & Competencies**

A. Must-Have Skills

* **Oracle Fusion SCM Planning:**
  Hands-on configuration experience with Planning Central, Demand Management, Supply Planning, and/or Replenishment Planning on live implementations.
* **Implementation Lifecycle:**
  At least two full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations in a planning lead or senior planning role.
* **SCM Fundamentals:**
  Working knowledge of Fusion Inventory, item and organisation structures, and the Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) touchpoints with planning.
* **Planning Concepts:**
  Strong understanding of forecasting, safety stock, lead times, sourcing, and replenishment logic.
* **Workshop Leadership:**
  Proven ability to conduct client-facing design workshops and drive decisions with business users.
* **Documentation:**
  Strong skills in preparing functional specifications, configuration documents, process flows, and UAT scripts.

B. Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience in QSR, food service, retail, or FMCG, particularly in perishables, short shelf-life products, and multi-outlet replenishment.
* Experience with Oracle Fusion Sales and Operations Planning or Supply Chain Collaboration.
* Exposure to Oracle EBS ASCP or Demantra, and EBS-to-Fusion migrations.
* Middle East or GCC delivery experience.
* Oracle Fusion SCM or Supply Chain Planning certification.

**5. Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. An MBA in Operations is an advantage.
* **8–10 years of relevant experience**
  in Oracle Supply Chain consulting, with recent hands-on Oracle Fusion SCM Planning delivery.
* Minimum of
  **two full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations**
  , with ownership of the planning workstream.
* Experience working with an Oracle System Integrator (SI)/implementation partner or IT consulting firm is strongly preferred.
* Oracle certifications are an advantage but are not mandatory if hands-on experience can be demonstrated.

**6. Additional Requirements**

* Valid passport and willingness to travel to Dubai, UAE, for critical project milestones, including requirement gathering, UAT, cutover, and go-live.
* Willingness to work hours that overlap with the UAE business day when coordinating with client teams.
* Strong spoken and written English, with the confidence to work directly with client business users.
* Availability to participate in client interviews with the onsite team before deployment.
* Ability to own the planning workstream end-to-end with minimal supervision.

The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.

The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.

* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

title: Principal Manager, Tech (GAITech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for an engineering manager to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, thereby supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, the “Strike” team is a new sub team within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm to both, consult on ideas, and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. Furthermore, you will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional, and clear communication skills. You will manage and lead the team to ensure a productive working environment and clear communication. You will also lead the team on its goals, the focus will be on improving areas including developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption, etc. People and project management is going to be a key part of the job role.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field with 10 to 16 years of relevant industry work experience
* Proficiency in Python with robust coding and debugging abilities

title: Founders’ Office ( IITian Preferred)
description:
**Founder's Office | Growth Valley Community**

Gurugram (in-office) | Full-time | 1-5 years experience | Reports directly to the Founder

**Tier One Education, IIT/IIM Preferred.**

**Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A consistent growth story will be awarded.**

**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.**

**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.**

**About GVC.**

Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

title: Program Associate
description:
**Program Associate, Data Execution**

**Role snapshot**

* **Role:**

  Program Associate – Execution (Data Team)
* **Location:**

  Gurugram on-site, with field travel for some projects
* **Experience:**

  0–2 years (freshers with strong ops exposure welcome)
* **Type:**

  Full-time
* **Languages:**

  Hindi and English required; a regional or foreign language is a plus

**About the role**

We build speech, text and video datasets in Indian and global languages that AI teams use to train and test voice models. As a Program Associate, you make sure the data for each client order gets collected, checked and delivered on time, at the quality the order specifies.

This is an execution job, run at scale. You will not build the app, train models or design the dataset. You will source hundreds of speakers, listen to recordings, chase transcribers, reconcile QC sheets, pay freelancers and report numbers every day. Think of a 100-hour delivery target the way a plant manager thinks about a production line.

**What this job is not:**

a product, research, tech or pure coordination role. If you are mainly looking for those, this role will not be a good fit.

**What you will do**

Every project runs on the same contributor funnel: leads sourced → applied → test passed → hired → in group → working → work accepted. You own that funnel for your languages or regions, end to end.

* **Recruit at scale.**

  Run paid lead-gen and job-platform campaigns with the growth team, screen test recordings, and onboard speakers, transcribers and field workers. Report lead-to-working % weekly and fix the stage that is leaking.
* **Check quality.**

  Listen to recordings and run or supervise audio QC against the client's written spec (format, channels, noise, consent, no personal information). Log a reason for every rejection.
* **Run transcription and annotation.**

  Allocate work on the annotation tool, track output per person per day, audit samples, and block people who do not meet the bar.
* **Know the guideline.**

  Learn each client's recording, transcription and metadata guideline well enough to train a new contributor on it in one sitting, and to spot deviations in the data.
* **Track and report.**

  Update a daily project tracker: funnel, hours recorded / accepted / transcribed / delivered, cost per delivered hour, QC coverage. Send a short weekly status without being asked.
* **Pay people correctly.**

  Reconcile accepted work against payouts before every payment run.
* **Protect data.**

  Keep consent, metadata and storage discipline on every single file.
* **Deliver.**

  Package data in the agreed folder structure with the counts sheet and a delivery note that discloses every assumption affecting price or quality.
* **Escalate early.**

  Flag a target that will be missed the week it becomes likely, not the week it is due.

**Projects you may work on**

You will be assigned to one or two of these workflows based on your languages, location and strengths. The core work above applies to all of them.

* **Two-speaker conversational audio (Indian languages):**

  pair speakers for natural phone conversations, write topic prompts, QC both speakers' audio. Office-based.
* **Speech recognition (ASR) data:**

  recruit against district and demographic quotas, manage transcription teams, track cost per hour. Office-based.
* **Healthcare and domain field recordings:**

  onboard frontline workers to record real conversations, with strict consent and privacy. Field travel.
* **Tribal and low-resource languages:**

  set up in a district, train community contributors on speech, translation and dictionary work. Relocation for ~3 months.
* **Dialect data for institutional projects:**

  turn a tender into a per-dialect plan and hit contractual milestones. Field coordination, north/central India.
* **International accented English:**

  launch new accents country by country and manage local leads and payouts. Remote, across time zones.
* **Global-language conversational audio:**

  launch languages on a calendar, QC two-channel audio, manage outside vendors. Remote, across time zones.
* **Transcription quality:**

  measure transcriber error rates (WER), find systematic errors and improve guidelines. Analytical.
* **Face + voice video data:**

  recruit and coach on-camera speakers, QC audio and video together. New process.
* **Text-to-speech (TTS) data and evaluation:**

  run studio sessions and manage hundreds of native-speaker raters. Studio + remote.

**How you will be measured (KRAs)**

You are measured on delivered hours, not recorded hours, and on what each delivered hour costs.

* **Delivery:**

  delivered hours per language or region each month, at or above plan
* **Yield:**

  accepted vs recorded hours at or above baseline
* **Funnel health:**

  lead-to-working % tracked weekly, with a fix when it drops
* **Cost:**

  cost per delivered hour within budget; every payout reconciled
* **Quality:**

  client audits passed first time; zero batches returned
* **Diversity and spec:**

  gender, age, region and dialect targets met at every submission
* **Compliance:**

  consent and complete metadata on 100% of files; zero privacy incidents
* **Timeliness:**

  milestones met; risks flagged the week they appear
* **Reporting:**

  daily tracker current; weekly status sent without reminders

**Who we are looking for**

**Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline, with 0–2 years of experience.
* Some hands-on operations exposure where you were measured on output or quality: field programmes, campus or community mobilisation, BPO or annotation ops, logistics, QA, or a large college event you ran.
* Fluent Hindi and English, spoken and written.
* Comfort with numbers: funnels, yields, per-hour costs. You read the sheet before forming an opinion.
* Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills (filters, pivots, lookups).
* Stamina for repetitive, high-volume work (listening to 30–50 recordings a day, reconciling sheets, chasing people) over weeks, not days.
* Confidence managing large freelancer groups on WhatsApp or Telegram, including rejecting work and holding payouts.
* Attention to detail at the file level: a wrong sample rate, a missing channel, an unsigned consent.
* Willingness to travel or relocate for field projects, or to work odd hours for international ones.

﻿

**Good to have**

* A regional Indian language (essential for field projects), or a foreign language such as Spanish, French, Arabic or Mandarin.
* Reading knowledge of two or more Indian scripts.
* A good ear for pronunciation, accents and audio quality.
* Basic SQL or familiarity with metrics like WER/CER.
* Experience with paid social ads or job-platform recruitment.

**This role is not for you if**

* You want to move into product, research or engineering soon.
* You are not comfortable with phone-heavy work, daily targets or field travel.
* You prefer coordinating meetings to owning a number.

**Hiring process**

1. Application and short screening call
2. Take-home exercise that mirrors the real work
3. Interview with the Program Manager
4. Final conversation with the Data team lead

title: Manager - Supply Planning
description:
**Overview**
Objective & Purpose:
  
  

* Lead end-to-end Supply Planning & Production Scheduling for Potato Chips Category across the North Region, ensuring optimal service levels, inventory health, network efficiency and cost productivity. Drive capacity planning, network optimization, innovation commercialization, and cross-functional alignment with Agro, Manufacturing, Procurement, Category, and Commercial teams to deliver sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Scope:
  
  

* Own supply planning and Production Scheduling for Potato Chips Category across North Region manufacturing network.
* Responsible for Rough Cut Capacity Planning and Detailed Production Planning (DPP)
* Lead Sourcing and network Optimization decision to balance service, cost and capacity utilization
* Drive successful commercialization of NPDs, promotions, pack transitions, SKU rationalization, and changeovers.
* Deliver critical Supply Chain KPIs including Service Levels, MPS Adherence, Demand Compliance, Production Adherence, Inventory Health, Primary Freight Cost, and Productivity.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the key supply planning interface across Manufacturing, Category, R&D, Procurement, and Agro teams, facilitating timely decision-making and issue resolution. (Being Informed, Provide consultation)
* Facilitate the S&OE process from supply perspective by ensuring alignment and timely course correction to plan and review all demands - NPD, Innovation etc. (Provide consultation)
* Lead development of monthly, weekly, and detailed line-level production schedules to ensure alignment with demand, capacity, and inventory objectives.
* Accountable for executing all innovations, changeovers, NPDs within stipulated timelines support the innovation agenda for PepsiCo (Decide & Execute)
* Responsible for driving the ESP / JDA modules for Supply Planning and Production Scheduling – Tactical Sourcing, DRP, RP, IO and DPP (Decide, Execute)
* Drive continuous improvement in supply planning through network optimization by leveraging technology tools such as LLamasoft /Lyric (Decide, Execute)
* Drive network productivity YoY by ensuring sourcing through most optimum network and by facilitating decisions for capacity augmentations to support network requirement (Decide)
* Facilitate Capacity Planning for AOP and SBP in collaboration with P&P to ensure new capacities come at the right location and at the right brand, pack mix. (Being Informed, Provide consultation)
* Lead the initiative on E2E cost optimization in planning to support profitable growth agenda for India business in collaboration with Finance, Agro, Manufacturing (Decide, Execute)
* Facilitate the S&OE process from supply perspective by ensuring alignment and timely course correction to plan and review all demands - NPD, Innovation etc. (Provide consultation)
* Ensure optimum stock levels to meet sales demand as stipulated demand compliance levels while driving continuous improvement in working capital levels for for India in collaboration with finance (Being Informed, provide consultation, Execute)
* Custodian of FG write off, RM/PM are kept to a minimum and have constant improvement Year on Year through efficient planning and by collaborating with Sales and Plants (Decide, Provide consultation, Execute)
* Optimize between Freight and Service levels in a constantly changing supply scenario through technology intervention, collaborating with field teams to optimize sourcing to support Primary freight delivery (Decide, provide consultation, Execute)

**Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of Supply Chain/ Logistics Operations with preferred FMCG Experience
* Bachelor’s degree with an MBA preferable in Supply Chain/ Operation management from B School
* Proven Experience in Supply chain Planning, Inventory management and related Jobs.
* Good Process automation knowledge of Planning tool – JDA, OMP, SAP and LLamasoft
* Experience in leading a mature S&OP and S&OE enabled Supply Chain team
* Strong analytics Skills with Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques
* Excellent communication, influencing and collaborative skills
* Outward looking with a real understanding of the key customer requirements and developments

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349
description:

title: Associate, Grid, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
  
  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

Our GRID Product Provides Hyperlocal Geospatial Intelligence Solution That Supports Various Industries Like Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, Travel & Logistics In Making Data-backed, Intelligent Decisions. GRID Brings Together Both Functional Expertise And Scalable Tech Stack For
  
  

* Site-level intelligence on asset supply coverage and user experience (for both client and competitors)
* Advanced Analytics platform for scenario modelling and optimization algorithms
* Enhanced real-time visualization and collaboration, distributed across the client org (assets, strategy, marketing etc.)
* Working with cross-functional teams using a ‘single source of truth’ that aligns customer “demand” data and asset “supply” data

**How You Will Contribute**
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate with a proven track record in developing new products & managing product-led consulting delivery, leveraging Geospatial Analytics as part of our GRID team. This role involves overseeing the development, analysis, and application of geospatial data to drive strategic decision-making for our corporate and private equity clients. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in geospatial analytics with strong project management skills to deliver impactful solutions across various domains such as CAPEX Optimization, Go-to-market, Cost to serve, Market Attractiveness, White space opportunity, Competitive intensity etc. across multiple industries with focus on Telecom (Fiber, Tower and Data Centre), Retail, Healthcare, Travel and Hospitality etc.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Building a high performing global centre of excellence for geospatial analytics within Performance Improvement Practice
* Executing the collection, processing, and analysis of geospatial data using advanced GIS tools and methodologies
* Develop and maintain geospatial databases to ensure data integrity and accuracy
* Contribute to the creation of high-quality maps and visualizations that effectively communicate data insights
* Support senior analysts in conducting spatial analyses and modelling
* Assist in implementing spatial analysis techniques such as distance calculations and spatial overlays
* Assist in managing GIS projects across various disciplines, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance technical skills in geospatial technologies
* Position A&M Global Capability Center as a thought partner within the firm for building new solutions and offerings

**Qualifications**

* Comes with 1-5 years of relevant hands-on experience working with a global consulting firm, delivering geospatial driven analytics consulting services delivery for corporate and PE clients
* MBA or Master’s from a top-tier institute
* Have strong knowledge on various spatial models and algorithms to solve complex problems
* Proficiency in solutions around Geo Spatial Analytics (custom solutions, scenario modelling, large volume rendering, foot traffic, shape file formats)
* Proficiency in technical skills
* Python (Geospatial libraries like geopandas), SQL, Alteryx
* Visualization tools (ArcGIS, QGIS, PowerBI, CARTO)
* Statistical Analysis methodologies (Gradient Boost, Random Forest)
* Microsoft Office Suite (must have)
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability
description:
Join us as a "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability" at Barclays, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behavior, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. You will need to take ownership of key initiatives to deliver results through an agile workflow.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
To be successful as an "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Essential Skills And Qualifications**

* Manage change to data platforms.
* Perform incident triage for platform issues.
* Perform root cause analysis on platform performance issues.
* Manage cloud platform usage and costs.
* Educate on the data platforms that are used across the businesses.
* Support users in accessing the platforms and adhering to the required governance.
* Advocate best practice for data platform use to maximize business value delivered.
* Identify common themes in user platform use that is sub optimal and implement training and / or support where needed.
* Championing the features that the business need.
* Translating complex technology into consumable business language. Supporting corporate data modernisation program.
* Design, test and build complex forecast models and simulations to identify causal links between customer behavior and business opportunities and performance.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Communication
* Problem solving
* SQL
* Database query optimization (and understanding of if and when optimization techniques can be used on different platforms)
* Willingness to learn new tools and platforms and then help educate others.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation

title: PMO Analyst
description:
**Position Summary:**
The Analyst - PMO (GCC) is a critical execution-layer role within the Program Management Office, responsible for supporting end-to-end program governance, process documentation, knowledge transfer (KT) coordination, and data management across the GCC delivery lifecycle. The incumbent will act as a custodian of program master data, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and timely updates across all program repositories.
  
  
This role requires a detail-oriented professional who can translate business requirements into structured records, design SOPs and process flows, track KT milestones, and provide advanced Excel-based reporting support across multiple interlinked trackers and stakeholder files. The analyst will interface closely with vendors, project teams, functional leads, and business stakeholders to drive operational accuracy and process compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Master Data & Program Governance:
* Own and maintain program master files and working trackers throughout the program lifecycle.
* Ensure all records remain accurate, structured, and aligned with current business requirements.
* Perform regular data validation and quality checks across all program repositories.
* Support governance reviews and audits through accurate maintenance of program information.
* Maintain version control and change logs for master files to enable traceability.
* Requirement Intake & Management:
* Capture, validate, and enter new business requirements into relevant master files and tracking systems.
* Maintain complete and up-to-date requirement records with status, owner, and resolution details.
* Track requirement lifecycle from intake to closure and flag overdue or unresolved items.
* Support periodic reporting on requirement status for stakeholder reviews.
* Coordinate with business owners to clarify, prioritize, and close requirement backlogs.
* Vendor & Unique ID Governance:
* Allocate vendors and unique identifiers based on approved functional and sub-functional mappings.
* Maintain consistency and accuracy of vendor allocation records across all program trackers.
* Ensure traceability and governance compliance for all vendor-related mapping information.
* Support audit readiness through well-maintained vendor and ID allocation logs.
* Escalate mapping conflicts or anomalies to the PMO Lead for timely resolution.
* SOP Design & Process Documentation:
* Design and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for KT, onboarding, and operational processes.
* Translate business requirements into structured process documentation and workflow diagrams.
* Create swimlane diagrams, process flowcharts, and RACI matrices as required.
* Periodically review and update SOPs to reflect process changes or improvements.
* Maintain a centralized process documentation repository accessible to all stakeholders.
* Knowledge Transfer (KT) Coordination & Tracking:
* Review submitted KT forms and trackers to verify completeness and accuracy.
* Monitor KT schedules and completion status against agreed timelines and milestones.
* Follow up with candidates, vendors, and team leads to ensure timely KT execution.
* Escalate delays, risks, or compliance issues impacting KT progress to the PMO Lead.
* Maintain KT governance records, status dashboards, and exception reports for leadership reviews.
* Advanced Excel & Reporting Support:
* Develop and maintain complex Excel-based trackers: master files, candidate files, and vendor files.
* Troubleshoot issues across interlinked workbooks — including two candidate files and two vendor files linked to master files.
* Build and maintain XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH formulas, pivot tables, dynamic dashboards, and data validation rules.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across all linked reporting files.
* Automate repetitive reporting tasks using advanced Excel features such as Power Query and macros where applicable.
* Stakeholder Reporting & Presentations:
* Prepare management-ready reports and PowerPoint presentations for governance reviews and milestone meetings.
* Convert complex tracker data into executive-level dashboards and visual summaries.
* Support weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting requirements for program leadership.
* Maintain presentation templates and ensure consistency of formatting across all program decks.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related field.
* MBA or Post-Graduate Diploma in Management (preferred).

**Work Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in PMO, Process Excellence, Shared Services, GCC, Reporting, or Program Coordination roles.
* Prior experience in a Global Capability Center (GCC) or Offshore Delivery Center environment preferred.
* Exposure to cross-functional stakeholder management and multi-vendor program environments.
* Experience in Knowledge Transfer (KT) coordination or transition management is a strong advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Data Governance & Master Data Management
* Requirement Management & Lifecycle Tracking
* Knowledge Transfer (KT) Coordination & Tracking
* Vendor Mapping & Unique ID Governance
* SOP Development & Process Documentation
* Program Governance & Compliance Reporting
* Advanced Reporting & Analytics
* Stakeholder Communication & Escalation Management

Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata

title: Senior Manager, Global Coverage/Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
  
  
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager of Global Coverage will work with a technology leader in the market research industry, specialising in online and digital methodologies. This role is responsible for managing a team of Project Managers while developing and growing strong relationships with customers, the sales team, and key internal stakeholders.
  
  
This position plays a critical role within the organisation, serving as the primary line of communication between the Global Coverage team and the Director and leadership team. As part of a global organisation, the Senior Manager is accountable for ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction by enabling their team to successfully deliver on client project goals, supporting client growth strategies, and proactively troubleshooting and resolving client concerns.
  
  
In addition, the role involves coaching and developing team members, leading strategic projects, and collaborating cross-functionally with multiple departments to improve operational efficiency and continue diversifying the coverage portfolio.
  
  
To support our commitment to 24×7 customer coverage, flexibility with shift timings is essential, including participation in rotational shifts. This is a remote position.
  
  
Candidates with high initiative and a hands-on, can-do approach will thrive in this fast-paced environment. Successful individuals will encounter daily opportunities to contribute to the company’s growth in a demanding yet rewarding setting where creativity, ownership, and strong results are recognised and rewarded.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage a team of Project Managers at various skill levels
* Utilize Cint’s proprietary software to create and manage research surveys related to advertising effectiveness or professional services
* Act as the first point of escalation for your team members including (but not limited to) incidents involving platform issues, client's communicated concerns, or impactful changes to project scope
* Develop a robust understanding of the Market Research and Digital Advertising industries, comprehending how Cint can solve challenges using technology
* Support your team to successfully work on a multitude of projects concurrently while ensuring a high level of quality across all studies with little to no supervision
* Compile and extract data from various sources (proprietary software, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Salesforce, Qualtrics, etc.) to present data to internal and external clients
* Coordinate with Sales Directors, Account Management, Product, and Finance to ensure seamless project execution and continued product development
* Ability to work independently and be self-motivated with effective time management
* Develop strong working relationships with external client personnel, anticipating client needs and ensuring high levels of customer service while adhering to client budget
* Work with customers to understand project needs, recommend optimal solutions, and coordinate with internal teams and external partners to successfully deliver projects on time and in budget

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* BA/BS Degree
* Minimum 8 years of customer-facing experience with proven ability to manage multiple complex projects under tight deadlines
* Minimum 5 years of experience managing, growing, and scaling teams.
* Proficient in Google Suite, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Strong work ethic with a self-motivated mindset and drive to achieve goals
* Detail-oriented, self-starter who is eager to learn new skills and concepts
* An innate sense of accountability, ability to provide proactive and thoughtful feedback
* Top quality ability in written and oral communication in English, additional languages are highly beneficial

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the online market research ecosystem
* Knowledge of programmatic sampling
* Survey design experience in Qualtrics, Survey Monkey, etc.
* Market Research coursework or experience
* Microsoft Excel certification
* Statistical knowledge or working knowledge or SPSS, STATA, SAS

**Benefits**
**Additional Information**

* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience
* Comprehensive training and opportunities for professional growth and promotion
* Worldwide exposure to the biggest companies in the market research industry
* Company-provided laptop and other facilities to enable work from home

**Our Values**
**Collaboration is our superpower**

* We uncover rich perspectives across the world
* Success happens together
* We deliver across borders.

**Innovation is in our blood**

* We’re pioneers in our industry
* Our curiosity is insatiable
* We bring the best ideas to life.

**We Do What We Say**

* We’re accountable for our work and actions
* Excellence comes as standard
* We’re open, honest and kind, always.

**We are caring**

* We learn from each other’s experiences
* Stop and listen; every opinion matters
* We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

**More About Cint**
We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
  
  
In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.
  
  
Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)
  
  
Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

title: Senior Programme Manager
description: Role purposeThe Senior Manager – Finance Systems will provide permanent, enterprise-level leadership for the Finance Systems & Transformation portfolio. The role combines programme delivery leadership with hands-on portfolio management, governance and PMO discipline, ensuring that strategic initiatives move from concept and approval through controlled execution, adoption and benefits realisation.The role will maintain an integrated view across Finance transformation initiatives, including finance systems, planning and forecasting, reporting and analytics, controls improvement, process transformation and operating-model change. It will give Finance leadership clear visibility of priorities, delivery status, risks, dependencies, resources, costs and decisions, while holding workstream owners and delivery partners accountable for outcomes.Key responsibilities Programme leadership and execution: Translate the Finance Transformation strategy and roadmap into executable programmes, workstreams, milestones and outcomes. Drive delivery across multiple initiatives and intervene early where progress, ownership or quality is at risk. Integrated portfolio planning: Own the consolidated transformation roadmap, integrated plan, critical path and cross-workstream dependencies. Maintain a clear view of sequencing, capacity, funding and business availability. Governance and decision support: Operate the programme governance rhythm, including Steering Committee preparation, decision papers, status reporting, action tracking and follow-through. Ensure forums focus on decisions, outcomes and value rather than activity reporting. PMO and delivery discipline: Establish and maintain consistent planning, RAID, dependency, decision, change-control, financial tracking and document-management standards across the portfolio. Risk, issue and escalation management: Maintain an enterprise view of delivery risks and issues, ensure mitigations have accountable owners and dates, and escalate material matters with clear options and recommendations. Workstream assurance: Challenge plans, assumptions, RAG status, estimates and recovery actions. Confirm that scope, requirements, testing, readiness, controls, documentation and handover are adequate before stage-gate decisions. Stakeholder alignment: Build strong relationships across Finance, Finance Systems, Technology, Operations, Risk, Internal Audit and regional teams. Translate complex delivery information into concise, decision-ready messages for senior leaders. Supplier and resource coordination: Coordinate internal teams, contractors and delivery partners; monitor commitments, deliverables, costs and knowledge transfer; support mobilisation, onboarding and transition to permanent capability. Change, readiness and adoption: Ensure each initiative has a proportionate change approach covering communications, training, business readiness, operating procedures, ownership and transition into BAU. Benefits and continuous improvement: Define measurable outcomes and benefits, track realisation after implementation and ensure lessons learned are reflected in future delivery standards.Key working relationshipsFinance Transformation sponsors and Steering Committee; Head of Finance Systems; Global and Regional Finance leadership; Finance process owners; Technology and data teams; Risk, Controls, Internal Audit and external audit stakeholders; programme and project managers; business analysts; implementation partners and specialist suppliers.Key deliverables Integrated Finance Systems Transformation roadmap and portfolio plan with milestones, dependencies, resources and critical path. Clear executive reporting, programme dashboards, decision papers and Steering Committee materials. Current RAID, decision, action, dependency, change and benefits registers with accountable ownership. Consistent delivery methodology, templates, stage gates and evidence standards across workstreams. Recovery plans for red or amber initiatives, with measurable actions and dates. Controlled programme financial and resource view covering budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and capacity. Business readiness, transition and BAU handover plans for each material initiative. Portfolio-level benefits tracking and post-implementation review.EssentialSkills and experience Significant experience leading complex, multi-workstream Finance Systems or enterprise transformation programmes. Strong programme and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, governance, RAID, dependencies, change control and benefits realisation. Experience preparing executive and Steering Committee reporting and converting complex information into clear decisions and recommendations. Proven ability to coordinate Finance, Technology, Operations and external delivery partners in a matrix environment. Experience challenging delivery plans, driving recovery activity and holding senior workstream owners accountable. Understanding of Finance processes, systems implementation, controls, testing, readiness and BAU transition. Commercial and financial discipline covering budgets, forecasts, resource plans and supplier commitments. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills. Ability to operate hands-on, manage competing priorities and deliver through ambiguity.Preferred Experience in Financial Services or another regulated, control-focused environment. Experience with Finance ERP, EPM, reporting, data, controls or operating-model transformation. Exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Anaplan, Power BI, Qlik or Azure DevOps. Experience establishing or maturing a transformation office, portfolio office or enterprise PMO. Experience working across global teams and delivery partners, including India-based delivery models. Recognised programme or project management qualification, such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent. Finance, accounting, technology or transformation-related professional qualification.Personal attributes Outcome-oriented, structured and able to combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery. Calm and credible with senior stakeholders, while willing to challenge constructively. Highly organised, analytical and rigorous about ownership, evidence and follow-through. Commercially aware, pragmatic and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information. Collaborative across cultures, functions and locations, with a strong commitment to building internal capability.Success measures Transformation initiatives delivered to agreed outcomes, quality, cost and key milestones. Leadership has a reliable, single view of programme status, decisions, risks, resources and dependencies. Material risks and slippage are identified early, with timely recovery action and escalation. Governance forums result in clear decisions, accountable actions and measurable follow-through. Improved consistency and maturity of programme planning, reporting and delivery controls. Successful business adoption, BAU transition and measurable benefits realisation. Reduced reliance on external programme leadership through sustainable permanent capability in India.Role positioningThis is not a reporting-only PMO role. It is a senior, hands-on programme leadership position accountable for joining up the Finance Transformation portfolio, driving execution and maintaining the governance discipline required to deliver sustainable business outcomes. Individual workstream leads remain accountable for their solutions and deliverables; this role provides the integration, challenge, visibility and leadership that connect them into one controlled programme.About FNZFNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back. We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution. We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

title: Jewellery Brand Operations & Production Manager (Female)
description: Company Description: Kritika Khurana Jewels is an emerging jewellery brand focused on contemporary, fashion-forward designs that blend style with everyday wearability. The brand emphasizes high-quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a curated customer experience across online and offline channels. Based in Gurugram, the team works closely with artisans and suppliers to deliver well-finished, trend-led pieces. Joining Kritika Khurana Jewels offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing label and shape its operational and production standards.Role DescriptionProduct and production trackerMaintain one tracker for every active design and SKU, including:Product name, SKU or temporary product code and collectionDesign owner and design statusVendor and contact personCAD, sample and production statusQuote, approved cost and purchase order statusSample, production and delivery datesQC status and correction notesQuantity ordered, received and sellablePhotography, listing and launch statusCurrent blocker, next action, owner and due dateUse clear statuses such as Not started, In progress, Waiting on vendor, Waiting for approval, Blocked, QC hold, Ready for shoot, Ready for listing and Complete.New product and sampling process1. Receive a design brief from Kritika or the jewellery designer, including the reference, specifications and intended use.2. Create a product code and add the product to the tracker.3. Confirm with the jewellery designer what technical information the vendor needs.4. Request quotes and timelines from vendors.5. Send costs and purchase commitments to Kritika for approval.6. Once approved, confirm the specifications, cost, quantity and timeline in writing with the vendor.7. Follow up on CAD, sample and production milestones and record updates in the tracker.8. Record sample receipt and arrange QC.9. Route technical questions to the jewellery designer and commercial or launch decisions to Kritika.10. Do not mark a product ready for production, photography or launch until the required approvals are recorded.Vendor coordinationOwn routine vendor communication about samples, production status, corrections, quantities and delivery dates.Keep written records of agreed specifications, timelines, costs and changes.Send a written recap after calls where a decision or deadline was agreed.Follow up before due dates if an update is missing and flag overdue items early.Coordinate technical feedback with the jewellery designer so vendors receive one clear design direction.Escalate cost increases, missed deadlines, quality disputes or requests for unapproved payment to Kritika.Do not commit to new costs, quantities, design changes or public delivery dates without approval.Send approved invoices and payment details to Jessica for accountant coordination.Quality controlCheck pieces when samples or production arrive and record the result against the SKU. Check:Finishing, plating or oxidation consistencyStones, pearls and other componentsClasps, hooks, closures and moving partsSizing and fit against the approved specificationColour and material consistency across the batchDesign accuracy against the approved reference or sampleVisible damage, sharp edges, loose components or other defectsIf a piece fails QC, mark it QC hold, keep it separate from sellable stock, photograph and record the issue, and coordinate a correction or replacement. Ask the jewellery designer to review design or technical issues. Recheck corrected pieces and record the outcome before releasing them.Inventory and dispatch coordinationCheck stock with the internal team on agreed days each week.Compare physical stock information with the inventory tracker and Shopify availability.Flag low or inconsistent stock and prepare reorder recommendations.Track incoming stock against the purchase order and record discrepancies.Coordinate which pieces are needed for shoots, PR gifting, stylist requests or campaigns.Keep a product loan and gifting log with item, quantity, recipient, dispatch date, expected return and return condition.Coordinate dispatch priorities with Deepak. Deepak remains responsible for physical stock handling, packing and dispatch.Escalate lost, damaged, missing or returned items that affect sellable stock.Photography and e-commerce readinessPrepare a shoot list with product name, SKU, quantity, styling notes and required angles.Confirm pieces are QC-approved and available before the shoot.Coordinate dates and logistics with the photographer, model, stylist and creative team.Track products photographed, edits pending and final images received.Match final images to the correct SKU and confirm samples are returned to Deepak.Coordinate product listings with the website team, including the correct SKU, approved price, specifications, materials, size information, images and stock availability.Check product pages against approved information before launch. Do not make unsupported material or quality claims.Coordinate sold-out and restock updates with Deepak and the website team.Social, PR and campaign coordinationShare approved product details, pricing, availability and launch timing with the social media team.Make sure pieces requested for campaigns, stylists, celebrities or PR activity are available and logged.Coordinate product dispatches and returns with Deepak.Flag stock shortages or production delays to Kritika, PR and social as early as possible.PR owns outreach and relationship management; social owns the content calendar and publishing. The operations manager ensures products and logistics are ready.Workflow:Daily: Review due and overdue tasks, check expected deliveries and stock issues, update the tracker after confirmations, and flag urgent blockers or approvals to Kritika.Weekly: Share completed work, overdue items, upcoming deadlines, stock risks and decisions needed. Review sampling and production with the jewellery designer, stock and dispatch with internal, and readiness for upcoming shoots and launches.Monthly: Review the product pipeline, propose the next month’s production and shoot calendar, and flag recurring delays or process issues.QualificationsCandidates should possess skills in Jewelry Design and a strong understanding of fashion jewelry trends and aesthetics.Candidates should possess skills in Communication, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.Candidates should possess skills in Polishing and quality inspection to ensure consistent finishing and craftsmanship.Candidates should possess skills in Training, including the ability to guide and coach production staff or artisans on processes and standards.Experience in jewellery production, operations management, or fashion accessories is highly beneficial.Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with proficiency in basic digital tools (spreadsheets, inventory or order-tracking software).Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, collaborate with a small team, and manage multiple orders or projects simultaneously.Relevant education or certification in design, fashion, jewellery, or operations management is an advantage.Work pattern: On-site, Mon-Fri | 10:30 AM to 06:30 PM

title: Associate Project Manager - Quantitative Research
description:
**Inizio Ignite, Research Partnership**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Our Research Partnership healthcare market research team provides research and insights to inform and power healthcare decisions. Serving a variety of clients across the lifecycle, our expertise includes data, research & insights (proprietary syndicated and custom research) and brand tracking (ATU). Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The role of the Project Manager is to cost and oversee the set up and management of fieldwork and data collection to ensure successful completion within best practices. You will also be expected to contribute to company operations processes; providing proactive ideas and plans about improving the efficiency of the project management function and projects. Core, but not exclusive, responsibilities will include:
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Responsibility for sourcing, obtaining and negotiating commercially advantageous costs from external suppliers and panel providers for Research Partnership project proposals
* Updating suppliers on the status of their quotes
* Overseeing the smooth running of fieldwork management
* Successful handover of project deliverables to research team:
* Coordination of Data Processing (DP) work and deliverables, based on specs and templates provided by the project team (Quant-only)
* Own, coordinate and update project timelines with internal research and external client and supplier stakeholders
* Take ownership for coordinating project team meetings,
* Opportunity to develop line management responsibilities for junior members of the team
* Responsibility for Pharmacovigilance and Adverse Event reporting
* Coordination of client and supplier Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Client and supplier invoice management (PO numbers, invoicing and liaison with Finance team)
* You will own specific sub-topics as a member of one of the department’s Pillars (Clients, Suppliers, People, Innovation, Operational Excellence)

**What You'll Need**

* More than 5 years of experience in market research project management (quantitative research)
* Experience managing healthcare market research projects
* Knowledge of the fieldwork agency landscape
* Strong project management skills (adhering to agreed timelines, troubleshooting and communication with internal and external stakeholders)
* Ability to multitask
* Collaboration and working as part of a team
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Excellent numerical skills

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

***Artificial Intelligence***

We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices. Don't meet every requirement? That's okay! We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*
