title: Manager/Senior Manager – Middle Office (Project Management) – Financial Operations
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The D. E. Shaw group seeks a motivated and detail-oriented professional to join its growing Middle Office function in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram, India. This team supports the lifecycle of the firm's global trading strategies and serves as a key link between the front office and operational teams. This project-focused role offers the opportunity to lead middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies, while retaining hands-on operational ownership. This position will initially be an individual contributor role, with the potential to assume people management responsibilities in the future based on business needs and the candidate's interest.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will lead and deliver middle office projects that strengthen the firm's ability to support a growing and increasingly complex book of investment strategies. You will act as a project manager across internal and external teams—scoping requirements, driving solutioning, coordinating testing, and owning sign-off on product roadmaps. You will partner with trading desks, technology, operations, and vendors to convert operational pain points into durable solutions that reduce risk and manual effort. You will manually handle exceptions and edge cases that fall outside automated workflows, resolving them accurately and feeding insights back into process improvements. You will work across the full trade lifecycle and a range of hedge fund asset classes, designing corner cases and defining exception handling for post-automation workflows. You will also build workflows, dashboards, and tooling that give the desk and management clear visibility into trading activity, operational health, and risk.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* A postgraduate degree and 5+ years of relevant experience across the trade lifecycle, including time in or alongside middle office functions
* A robust understanding of trade lifecycle operations—trade capture, P&L, security master, settlements, and corporate actions—and of how various hedge fund asset classes behave across their lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience managing projects end-to-end as a project manager across internal and external teams, including scoping, testing, sign-off, and stakeholder coordination
* A risk-first mindset, with the judgment to anticipate corner cases and design exception handling for post-automation workflows
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to senior management, stakeholders, front office, and vendors
* The ability to design or contribute to dashboards, workflows, and analytics that surface operational insight

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with automation and hands-on familiarity with emerging GenAI and LLM tooling, with the ability to identify and apply these pragmatically within middle office workflows
* Program management–related academic qualifications (e.g., MBA, PMP)

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/MngrMOPMJul2026
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

flawless execution.

* Identify, manage, and mitigate risks, dependencies, and critical project paths.
* Monitor project performance, drive accountability, and ensure timely issue resolution.

* Support portfolio planning, prioritisation, and execution activities.

* A proactive, results-oriented project manager who thrives in dynamic environments.
* Comfortable influencing senior stakeholders and leading cross-functional teams.
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical and decision-making skills.
* Effective communicator and change agent who can navigate ambiguity and drive execution.
* Collaborative, consumer-focused, and motivated by delivering business outcomes.

**In summary:**
This role is a senior project management position focused on protecting and sustaining the Germ Protection business by delivering high-priority programmes through strong planning, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and cross-functional leadership.

description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**
**Global Talent Impact Partner**
**About The Role**
In this role, you will join an agile team of highly skilled HR professionals responsible for shaping and advancing Bayer’s enterprise talent strategy. You will work across a broad and evolving portfolio of talent priorities, partnering with leaders, HR colleagues, and key stakeholders to design and deliver scalable solutions that strengthen organizational capability, leadership effectiveness, and business performance. The role offers the opportunity to build a strong global network, deepen an end-to-end enterprise mindset, and create sustainable impact on Bayer’s talent agenda.
  
  
**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**

* Listen to and identify talent and business needs across the organization, translating them into scalable solutions that drive enterprise outcomes.
* Lead global projects, workstreams, and design teams, ensuring successful delivery of strategic talent initiatives from concept through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted talent expert and consultant across the HR community, providing thought partnership and guidance on talent, leadership, and organizational priorities.
* Build strong partnerships with senior leaders, HR colleagues, and key stakeholders to influence talent decisions, connect perspectives, and align on enterprise priorities.
* Design, pilot, launch, scale, and continuously improve talent management products, processes, and experiences that support Bayer’s talent strategy.
* Contribute to the evolution of enterprise talent frameworks, leadership capabilities, skills-based approaches, and workforce-readiness strategies in response to changing business needs.
* Use talent insights, data, research, external trends, and stakeholder feedback to develop recommendations, assess impact, and improve talent outcomes.
* Lead change, communication, and adoption efforts to enable sustainable implementation of talent solutions across countries, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Build Talent Management and broader HR capability by sharing expertise, coaching and supporting colleagues, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.
* Collaborate across HR and the business to connect talent priorities, manage interdependencies, and deliver integrated solutions that support key business outcomes.
* Apply digital and AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to improve the relevance, scalability, and employee experience of talent solutions.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, adapting focus as enterprise talent priorities evolve.

**Who You Are**
**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Significant experience developing, executing, and driving change for global initiatives, including consulting with and influencing senior business and HR leaders and other stakeholders.
* Demonstrated talent management, organizational development, leadership development, HR consulting, or related expertise, with the ability to connect talent solutions to business needs.
* Proven track record of leading complex projects, programs, or cross-functional teams from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze complex issues, develop hypotheses, synthesize diverse perspectives, and translate insights into practical recommendations.
* Ability to prioritize based on enterprise value, expected impact, feasibility, and return on investment.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, adapt to evolving priorities, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and productive relationships across cultures, functions, and organizational levels.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
* Broad professional experience in Human Resources, Talent Management, organizational development, leadership development, or internal or external consulting.
* Experience managing large-scale, complex, or enterprise-wide initiatives in a global and matrixed organization.
* Experience using talent analytics, digital platforms, or AI-enabled tools to inform or improve talent solutions.
* Experience leading change and adoption across multiple regions, cultures, or stakeholder groups.

**ROLE SCOPE**
**Flexible by design:**
This position is not assigned to one specific project, product, or talent discipline. Priorities and assignments may evolve in line with Bayer’s enterprise talent strategy and business needs. The role holder is expected to contribute across the Talent Impact portfolio and to move between strategic design, consulting, project leadership, capability building, and implementation as required.

title: Program Manager (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Program Manager (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location and Work Authorization: New Delhi, India preferred. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Application Deadline: 10 November 2026, 6 PM IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a Program Manager to lead the delivery and scale-up of PxD's heat initiative in India — bringing AI-based heat forecasts and actionable heat advisories to agriculture and livestock farmers, with a particular focus on government partnerships and coordination across delivery channels.
  
  
You will build and maintain strong relationships with relevant government institutions — including agriculture, animal husbandry, meteorological, dairy cooperatives and disaster management agencies — and coordinate closely with PxD's research, technology, program, and country teams. You will play a central role in moving the heat use case from formative research and pilot to delivery at scale, aligning partners, content, timelines, and channels so that farmers receive timely, consistent heat guidance.
  
  
This is a chance to help farmers protect their crops, animals, and livelihoods from increasingly frequent and severe heatwaves, at a moment when advances in AI forecasting make earlier and more localized heat warnings possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are below.
  
  
Government Relations & Partnerships
  
  

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with central and state government institutions involved in heat early warning, weather and climate services, agriculture extension, and animal husbandry, serving as a key point of contact for PxD's heat initiative
* Coordinate with government stakeholders to secure approvals and support for the implementation, alignment, and scale-up of heat advisory activities, and identify opportunities to integrate heat advisories into government systems such as heat action plans, extension platforms, and existing advisory services
* Engage with forecasting and technical partners to align on the use of AI-based heat forecast products
* Represent PxD in government meetings, technical working groups, workshops, conferences, and other external forums

Use Case, Pilot & Channel Coordination
  
  

* Work with the research team to translate formative research findings into a heat advisory use case for crop and livestock farmers, and support the planning and execution of pilots
* Coordinate across the channels used to deliver heat forecasts and advisories (e.g. voice calls, IVR, SMS, WhatsApp, extension workers), working closely with program, research, technology, and content teams on channel-specific activities and deliverables
* Support the development, testing, and rollout of heat advisory content with agronomists and livestock experts, ensuring advisories are timely, actionable, and suited to local contexts
* Maintain clear implementation plans, timelines, and responsibilities, plan around the seasonal heatwave window, monitor progress, and proactively address challenges and risks

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
  
  

* Coordinate meetings, workshops, trainings, demonstrations, and other stakeholder engagement activities with government and implementation partners
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, updates, and reports for government and external stakeholders, and support knowledge-sharing between the India and global PxD teams
* Work closely with PxD’s senior leadership and relevant colleagues to ensure government engagement aligns with country priorities and organizational objectives

Program Learning, Monitoring & Adaptation
  
  

* Support strategies to increase the reach, use, and effectiveness of heat advisory services, incorporating farmer feedback, evidence, and pilot learning into program improvements
* Track program and channel performance indicators, support teams in using data to inform implementation decisions, and document stakeholder engagement, decisions, and lessons learned

Reporting & Organizational Contribution
  
  

* Contribute to project reports, donor updates, funding proposals, and other documentation
* Support other program activities related to PxD's weather and climate portfolio as required

What You'll Bring
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

* A Master's degree in development studies, economics, agricultural economics, public policy, environmental or climate science, communications, or a related field
* Significant professional experience in program management, government relations, or stakeholder/partnership management, including demonstrated experience working directly with central and/or state government institutions in India
* Strong understanding of government structures, processes, and stakeholder engagement in India; familiarity with heat action plans, disaster management, agriculture extension, or animal husbandry systems is an advantage
* Experience coordinating programs involving multiple stakeholders, partners, and delivery channels; experience in agriculture, livestock, weather, climate, or digital development is an advantage
* Interest in how AI and new forecasting technologies can be applied to climate adaptation for farmers
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to work effectively with government officials and institutional partners
* Strong project coordination skills, including work planning, tracking deliverables, and managing timelines across multiple workstreams
* Ability to communicate complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, in both English and Hindi (fluency in Hindi required; another Indian language is a plus)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary, international teams
* Ability and willingness to travel within India as required, including to project sites during the summer months

How To Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and complete the online application form, including your CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 6 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Urban Transport Specialist - req38813
description: Urban Transport Specialist Job #: req38813Organization: World BankSector: TransportationGrade: GFTerm Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)Recruitment Type: Local RecruitmentLocation: New Delhi,IndiaRequired Language(s): EnglishPreferred Language(s)Closing Date: 11/9/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTCDescriptionAt the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrdSouth Asia Region ContextThe South Asia Region, comprising Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, is at a pivotal stage of development. Rapid economic growth, driven by urbanization and demographic trends, has reduced poverty, but significant disparities persist. The region also faces growing climate risks, environmental pollution, informality, and low female labor force participation.Sustained, private sector-led growth, anchored in investments in infrastructure, logistics, energy, and connectivity, is critical to creating jobs for South Asia’s sizeable youth population. At the same time, continued investment in human capital is needed to equip people for the jobs of the future.The South Asia Infrastructure program supports countries in building sustainable, resilient, and inclusive infrastructure systems through an integrated, cross-sectoral approach to growth, job creation, connectivity, resilience, and service delivery. Infrastructure engagements increasingly combine public and private sector solutions, including collaboration across the World Bank Group, to maximize development impact.India, the largest economy in South Asia, is undergoing a profound urban and economic transformation. Meeting the country’s growing demand for sustainable mobility, efficient logistics systems, and climate-resilient infrastructure will be important for improving access to jobs and services, enhancing competitiveness, supporting decarbonization, and attracting private investment. The World Bank Group’s engagement in India increasingly calls for integrated solutions that combine public and private financing, policy reform, institutional strengthening, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA.Transport And Logistics PracticeThe Transport and Logistics Practice supports efficient, safe, resilient, and low-carbon connectivity across road, rail, urban transport, maritime transport, inland waterways, and aviation. Working with public and private sector partners, it combines investment and policy support to improve access, trade, economic integration, and the performance of transport services and supply chains.In India, the Practice’s urban transport program promotes compact, connected, inclusive, and low-carbon development through better public transport, multimodal integration, transit-oriented development, electric mobility, safer streets, stronger institutions, and sustainable financing. The program brings together lending, analytics, technical assistance, policy dialogue, and partnerships with national, state, and city governments.About The PositionISAT1 seeks to recruit an Urban Transport Specialist (GF), based in New Delhi, to support the preparation and implementation of urban mobility operations and analytical and advisory work in India and, as needed, elsewhere in South Asia. The position requires a strong combination of urban transport expertise, operational capability, client engagement, analytical judgment, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines and institutions.The selected candidate will be expected to contribute materially to the design and delivery of complex programs, including public transport and institutional reform, urban rail and bus systems, integrated mobility, electric mobility, accessibility and inclusion, climate resilience, road safety, digitalization, infrastructure financing, and private sector participation. The Specialist will work closely with government counterparts, World Bank Group teams, development partners, consultants, and other stakeholders, and will report to the Practice Manager for Transport and Logistics in South Asia.Duties And ResponsibilitiesThe Urban Transport Specialist will perform a full range of technical, operational, analytical, and coordination functions, including but not limited to the following: Urban Transport Operations Support and, as appropriate, lead or co-lead the identification, preparation, appraisal, and implementation of lending and non-lending activities in urban transport. Contribute to project design, results frameworks, implementation arrangements, cost and economic analysis, risk assessment, procurement planning, and implementation support. Help resolve implementation bottlenecks and provide practical, timely advice to clients on institutional, technical, contractual, and operational issues. Work with environmental, social, procurement, financial management, legal, and other specialists to ensure integrated and high-quality project delivery. Monitor progress, results, risks, disbursements, and agreed actions, and prepare concise, decision-useful reporting for task teams and management. Technical and Policy Support Provide technical advice on urban mobility planning, public transport networks and operations, urban rail and bus systems, multimodal integration, first- and last-mile connectivity, walking and cycling, transit-oriented development, and demand management. Support reforms related to public transport institutions, governance, service contracting, fare policy, funding and financing, data systems, performance management, and service quality. Contribute to electric mobility programs, including public transport electrification, enabling infrastructure, institutional arrangements, and coordination with energy and private sector stakeholders. Integrate climate mitigation and resilience, road safety, gender, universal accessibility, social inclusion, and environmental considerations into transport strategies and investments. Assess opportunities for private capital mobilization and innovative financing, including PPPs, blended finance, guarantees, land value capture, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA, where appropriate. Analytics, Knowledge, and Innovation Lead or contribute to analytical and advisory work, policy notes, investment frameworks, sector diagnostics, and city-level mobility studies. Collect, assess, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; use evidence to diagnose mobility constraints, compare options, and formulate implementable recommendations. Promote the use of digital tools, geospatial analysis, transport modeling, open data, and other technologies where they improve planning, operations, monitoring, or user outcomes. Prepare clear technical reports, briefing notes, presentations, talking points, and other knowledge products for varied technical and senior audiences. Share lessons across projects, cities, countries, and Global Practice networks, and contribute to knowledge events and professional communities. Client Engagement and Partnerships Build and maintain effective working relationships with national ministries, state governments, urban local bodies, transport authorities, operators, development partners, private sector participants, academia, and civil society. Participate in policy dialogue and technical discussions, providing evidence-based and practical advice that is responsive to client priorities and implementation capacity. Plan and support missions, workshops, consultations, training activities, and high-level visits, including timely documentation and follow-up. Coordinate effectively across World Bank Group practices and institutions to develop integrated solutions relevant to India’s urban transformation. Team Contribution Work collaboratively in diverse, multidisciplinary, and geographically dispersed teams, contributing constructively to shared outcomes. Guide consultants and junior colleagues, review technical outputs, and contribute to quality assurance and capacity development. Support country and regional strategy work and other Transport and Logistics Practice priorities, including assignments outside the immediate urban transport portfolio when required. Undertake other related responsibilities assigned by the Practice Manager.Selection Criteria Master’s degree or higher in transport planning, transport or civil engineering, urban planning, economics, public policy, finance, or a closely related field. At least 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in urban transport, with demonstrated experience in project preparation, implementation, and/or advisory work. Substantial experience in at least three of the following areas: public transport planning and reform; urban rail or bus systems; integrated and multimodal mobility; electric mobility; active mobility and road safety; transport institutions and policy; infrastructure financing or private sector participation. Experience working with national, state, or city governments on complex transport programs. Experience in India or comparable federal and rapidly urbanizing settings is highly desirable.Technical And Operational Capabilities Strong understanding of urban mobility systems, including the interactions among land use, accessibility, public transport, non-motorized transport, road networks, technology, institutions, financing, and user needs. Demonstrated ability to translate technical analysis into practical project design, policy advice, and implementable actions. Experience managing or supporting complex infrastructure or service-delivery projects, including coordination across technical, fiduciary, environmental, social, and institutional dimensions. Familiarity with economic and financial analysis, procurement and contract management, results monitoring, and risk management in infrastructure projects. Experience with World Bank or other MDB operations is desirable. Familiarity with IPF, PforR, or other development finance instruments would be an advantage.Client, Communication, And Team Skills Excellent client orientation and the ability to build trust, work through differing perspectives, and provide candid, evidence-based advice in complex institutional settings. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, including the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely to technical and senior audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines. Strong judgment, initiative, attention to detail, resourcefulness, and results orientation. Ability to mentor colleagues, manage consultants, and contribute to an inclusive and collaborative working environment.Critical Success Factors Sound understanding of India’s urban transport challenges, institutions, and political economy, with the ability to identify feasible pathways for reform and investment. Capacity to connect technical quality with implementation realities, financing constraints, institutional incentives, and user outcomes. Ability to move comfortably between detailed operational work and higher-level strategic and policy dialogue. Credibility with clients and colleagues, combined with humility, collaboration, and a strong focus on results. Commitment to sustainable, safe, resilient, inclusive, and low-carbon urban mobility.WBG and Transport GP CompetenciesThe position requires strong alignment with World Bank Group Core Competencies, including Deliver Results for Clients, Collaborate Within Teams and Across Boundaries, Lead and Innovate, Create, Apply and Share Knowledge, and Make Smart Decisions. Relevant Transport GP competencies include transport policy and institutions, general transport planning, transport systems and technologies, operational project management, project design for impact and sustainability, client orientation, and knowledge and communication.As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.WBG Culture Attributes Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.World Bank Group Core CompetenciesThe World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.Learn more about working at the World Bank and IFC including our values and inspiring stories.

description:
**Executive Assistant | Full-Time | Remote (India)**

**Company:**
The Bhagat Group, powered by eXp Realty

**Company Location:**
Los Angeles, California, USA

**Work Location:**
100% remote, candidate must be based in India

**Working Hours:**
Pacific Time (USA). You must work US Pacific Coast hours, Monday to Friday. This is required for the role.

**About the Role**

The Bhagat Group is a growing real estate team in the South Bay of Los Angeles. We are hiring a full-time Executive Assistant to work directly with the broker and team leader and keep the business running smoothly. You will run team meetings, coach agents, manage transactions and systems, and represent the company every day. This is a high-ownership role. You are expected to follow through without being chased.

**Responsibilities**

* Control contract-to-close in production and coordinate listings and escrow with all parties
* Work with our offshore transaction coordinators and make sure files move on time in Follow Up Boss, SkySlope and Trello
* Run the team sales meeting
* Make Sales Agent 101 calls to coach and support agents
* Track KPIs, run weekly meetings, and hold 1-on-1 calls with team members to keep everyone accountable
* Run agent recruitment, onboarding and offboarding
* Be the face of the company: represent The Bhagat Group professionally with agents, clients and vendors
* Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets reports, trackers and commission calculations
* Manage the broker's inbox and calendar
* Attend leadership meetings and turn every meeting into clear, tracked action items
* Manage GoHighLevel and Follow Up Boss workflows and keep the database clean
* Support branding and marketing: Canva designs, social media calendar, newsletters, branded email templates and marketing budget tracking
* Run our post-closing Client for Life program
* Document processes and keep SOPs current as the business changes

**Requirements (Non-Negotiable)**

* Available to work Pacific Time (USA) hours
* Excellent written and spoken English, with a clear, confident speaking voice. You will lead meetings and speak with US agents, clients and vendors daily
* Comfortable leading a group, making calls and coaching people
* Strong Excel skills: VLOOKUP, pivot tables and formulas, plus solid math for commissions and budgets
* 2+ years supporting an executive, broker or business owner
* Hands-on Follow Up Boss experience
* Ability to pass our English screening, Excel test and live interview



**Preferred**

* GoHighLevel experience
* Strong Google Workspace skills
* Canva and a good eye for branding
* Real estate experience
* Comfort using AI tools

**Tools:**
Follow Up Boss, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, Excel, Trello, SkySlope, Canva, ScreenMonitor.com

title: Lead, User-Led Growth (Referrals & Affiliates)
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**User-Led Growth Lead**
to turn our 1M+ travellers into one of Atlys’s most powerful growth channels.
  
  
You’ll own the referral & affiliate program end to end, from how it is constructed and how it shows up in the product to the data and operations that make it run, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Data.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role for someone who has built something from scratch and can own both the strategy and the execution.
  
  
**The Job**

* Own the referral program construct, the incentives, reward economics and placement in the traveller journey, rebuilt from first principles and extended with new levers like an affiliate program.
* Reimagine the referral experience with Product and Engineering, from discovery and sharing to reward redemption across the app and website, shipping experiments that move the numbers.
* Understand who refers and why, digging into data on non-referrers, new referrers and power referrers and running motivation studies that turn into targeted interventions.
* Build the processes behind the program, from reward fulfilment to reporting, so it runs reliably at scale.
* Run a tight ship on delivery, executing referral and UGC campaigns relentlessly, paying every reward on time and catching fraud before it scales.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 3–4 years of experience in growth, product or strategy roles at a startup.
* Have built something from 0 to 1, ideally a referral, loyalty or user-led growth program, and taken it from idea to scale.
* Are a first-principle thinker who is deeply data-driven and lets numbers, not opinions, guide decisions.
* Have a strong grasp of consumer psychology and product, and understand how incentives, timing and UX shape user behaviour.
* Are execution-heavy with strong ops diligence: you sweat the details, close loops and ship fast.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Software Portfolio Specialist - Delhi NCR (Hybrid)
description:
Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our Professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enables clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

**Job Description**

The Software Portfolio Specialist supports the end-to-end management of the organization’s software application portfolio, from initial business need and sourcing through provisioning, ongoing administration, renewal, optimization, and retirement. This role partners with business stakeholders, Purchasing, Cybersecurity, software vendors, and other IT teams to ensure applications are effectively managed and aligned with business needs.

As a founding member of our new Delhi hub, this individual will play a key role in helping establish and shape the function locally, contributing to process development, operational excellence, and the long-term growth of the team while supporting a global technology environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Software Application Management**

* Support the full lifecycle of software applications, including evaluation, onboarding, administration, optimization, renewal, and retirement.
* Administer software applications as assigned, including user access, license allocation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine configuration.
* Coordinate with other Technology teams on application-related security, identity/access, endpoint, infrastructure, architecture, and support requirements.
* Maintain accurate application records, including licensing information, business ownership, renewal dates, contracts, entitlements, and other portfolio data.
* Execute established policies, procedures, and controls.
* Support software license optimization and reclamation activities.
* Assist with license and user audits to promote compliance with contractual requirements.
* Gather and analyze business requirements for new applications.
* Assess existing applications to determine whether current solutions can meet a business need before introducing additional software.
* Support application integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions.
* Coordinate software demonstrations, solution discussions, and technical/vendor evaluations.
* Support cross-functional evaluation of new software, including applicable Cybersecurity, Compliance, Legal, Purchasing, and technical reviews.
* Use AI, workflow automation, and intelligent agents to modernize software asset management.
* Help develop an increasingly autonomous operating model, where routine activities are proactively identified and automated.
* Maintain application documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and administration guides.

**Procurement and Sourcing**

* Support software sourcing, procurement, contract renewal, and licensing activities.
* Engage software vendors and resellers to obtain pricing, proposals, licensing options, and product information.
* Assist with vendor negotiations and evaluate commercial options to support competitive pricing and appropriate licensing.
* Proactively analyze licensing, usage, and market options to develop innovative recommendations for cost optimization and portfolio consolidation.
* Track software agreements, renewal dates, license quantities, costs, and contractual requirements.
* Review software usage and licensing needs ahead of renewals to identify opportunities for consolidation, right-sizing, or cost avoidance.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with software vendors and internal sourcing partners.

**Incident and Request Management**

* Manage assigned software application incidents, service requests, and tasks
* Review and triage requests, gather missing information, troubleshoot application issues, and coordinate resolution.
* Serve as a liaison between end users, internal technology teams, and vendor support
* Monitor assigned queues and follow up on outstanding approvals, dependencies, and actions.
* Escalate application issues appropriately based on business impact, complexity, or required technical expertise.
* Identify recurring support issues and contribute to knowledge articles, process improvements, and self-service documentation.
* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.
* Support software access requests and new application requests in accordance with established governance processes.

**Qualifications**

* Self-starter who demonstrates initiative, ownership, curiosity, and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
* Ability to develop innovative, practical solutions and confidently challenge established practices when improvement opportunities exist.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities.
* Ability to learn new technologies and platforms quickly
* Experience in software application management, application support, IT operations, and cross-functional enterprise IT environments.
* Understanding of application lifecycle management and software asset management best practices.
* Working knowledge of different types of software and licenses
* Hands on experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management Professional (SAM Pro) and IT Service Management (ITSM), including incident and request management.
* Experience working with software vendors, procurement processes, contracts, licensing, renewals, license optimization, and reclamation.
* Understanding of single sign-on (SSO), software installation and configuration requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting application implementations or technology projects preferred.

**Additional Information**

**Some of the Benefits We Have Include**

J.S. Held understands all our employees are people and sometimes life needs flexibility. We work to always provide an environment that best supports and suits our team’s needs.

* Our flexible work environment allows employees to work remotely, when needed
* Medical, and Vision Insurance

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read the J.S. Held Online Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as required and described therein. California residents can click here to learn more about the personal information we collect and here to learn about additional privacy rights that may be available.

Please explore what we’re all about at www.jsheld.com.

**EEO and Job Accommodations**

*We embrace diversity and our commitment to building a team and environment that fosters professional and personal enrichment is unwavering. We are greater when we are equal!*

*J.S. Held is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to hiring a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**Role purpose**

The Senior Programme Manager – Finance Systems will provide permanent, enterprise-level leadership for the Finance Systems & Transformation portfolio. The role combines programme delivery leadership with hands-on portfolio management, governance and PMO discipline, ensuring that strategic initiatives move from concept and approval through controlled execution, adoption and benefits realisation.

The role will maintain an integrated view across Finance transformation initiatives, including finance systems, planning and forecasting, reporting and analytics, controls improvement, process transformation and operating-model change. It will give Finance leadership clear visibility of priorities, delivery status, risks, dependencies, resources, costs and decisions, while holding workstream owners and delivery partners accountable for outcomes.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Programme leadership and execution:**
  Translate the Finance Transformation strategy and roadmap into executable programmes, workstreams, milestones and outcomes. Drive delivery across multiple initiatives and intervene early where progress, ownership or quality is at risk.
* **Integrated portfolio planning:**
  Own the consolidated transformation roadmap, integrated plan, critical path and cross-workstream dependencies. Maintain a clear view of sequencing, capacity, funding and business availability.
* **Governance and decision support:**
  Operate the programme governance rhythm, including Steering Committee preparation, decision papers, status reporting, action tracking and follow-through. Ensure forums focus on decisions, outcomes and value rather than activity reporting.
* **PMO and delivery discipline:**
  Establish and maintain consistent planning, RAID, dependency, decision, change-control, financial tracking and document-management standards across the portfolio.
* **Risk, issue and escalation management:**
  Maintain an enterprise view of delivery risks and issues, ensure mitigations have accountable owners and dates, and escalate material matters with clear options and recommendations.
* **Workstream assurance:**
  Challenge plans, assumptions, RAG status, estimates and recovery actions. Confirm that scope, requirements, testing, readiness, controls, documentation and handover are adequate before stage-gate decisions.
* **Stakeholder alignment:**
  Build strong relationships across Finance, Finance Systems, Technology, Operations, Risk, Internal Audit and regional teams. Translate complex delivery information into concise, decision-ready messages for senior leaders.
* **Supplier and resource coordination:**
  Coordinate internal teams, contractors and delivery partners; monitor commitments, deliverables, costs and knowledge transfer; support mobilisation, onboarding and transition to permanent capability.
* **Change, readiness and adoption:**
  Ensure each initiative has a proportionate change approach covering communications, training, business readiness, operating procedures, ownership and transition into BAU.
* **Benefits and continuous improvement:**
  Define measurable outcomes and benefits, track realisation after implementation and ensure lessons learned are reflected in future delivery standards.

**Key working relationships**

Finance Transformation sponsors and Steering Committee; Head of Finance Systems; Global and Regional Finance leadership; Finance process owners; Technology and data teams; Risk, Controls, Internal Audit and external audit stakeholders; programme and project managers; business analysts; implementation partners and specialist suppliers.

**Key deliverables**

* Integrated Finance Systems Transformation roadmap and portfolio plan with milestones, dependencies, resources and critical path.
* Clear executive reporting, programme dashboards, decision papers and Steering Committee materials.
* Current RAID, decision, action, dependency, change and benefits registers with accountable ownership.
* Consistent delivery methodology, templates, stage gates and evidence standards across workstreams.
* Recovery plans for red or amber initiatives, with measurable actions and dates.
* Controlled programme financial and resource view covering budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and capacity.
* Business readiness, transition and BAU handover plans for each material initiative.
* Portfolio-level benefits tracking and post-implementation review.

**Skills and experience**

**Essential**

* Significant experience leading complex, multi-workstream Finance Systems or enterprise transformation programmes.
* Strong programme and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, governance, RAID, dependencies, change control and benefits realisation.
* Experience preparing executive and Steering Committee reporting and converting complex information into clear decisions and recommendations.
* Proven ability to coordinate Finance, Technology, Operations and external delivery partners in a matrix environment.
* Experience challenging delivery plans, driving recovery activity and holding senior workstream owners accountable.
* Understanding of Finance processes, systems implementation, controls, testing, readiness and BAU transition.
* Commercial and financial discipline covering budgets, forecasts, resource plans and supplier commitments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate hands-on, manage competing priorities and deliver through ambiguity.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Financial Services or another regulated, control-focused environment.
* Experience with Finance ERP, EPM, reporting, data, controls or operating-model transformation.
* Exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Anaplan, Power BI, Qlik or Azure DevOps.
* Experience establishing or maturing a transformation office, portfolio office or enterprise PMO.
* Experience working across global teams and delivery partners, including India-based delivery models.
* Recognised programme or project management qualification, such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent.
* Finance, accounting, technology or transformation-related professional qualification.

**Personal attributes**

* Outcome-oriented, structured and able to combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery.
* Calm and credible with senior stakeholders, while willing to challenge constructively.
* Highly organised, analytical and rigorous about ownership, evidence and follow-through.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information.
* Collaborative across cultures, functions and locations, with a strong commitment to building internal capability.

**Success measures**

* Transformation initiatives delivered to agreed outcomes, quality, cost and key milestones.
* Leadership has a reliable, single view of programme status, decisions, risks, resources and dependencies.
* Material risks and slippage are identified early, with timely recovery action and escalation.
* Governance forums result in clear decisions, accountable actions and measurable follow-through.
* Improved consistency and maturity of programme planning, reporting and delivery controls.
* Successful business adoption, BAU transition and measurable benefits realisation.
* Reduced reliance on external programme leadership through sustainable permanent capability in India.

**Role positioning**

This is not a reporting-only PMO role. It is a senior, hands-on programme leadership position accountable for joining up the Finance Transformation portfolio, driving execution and maintaining the governance discipline required to deliver sustainable business outcomes. Individual workstream leads remain accountable for their solutions and deliverables; this role provides the integration, challenge, visibility and leadership that connect them into one controlled programme.

title: Program Operations (Senior Associate)
description:
If you like being the person students turn to, and the person who makes sure their program actually works, read on. You’ll own the student experience for Kraftshala’s live programs: answering questions, fixing problems, keeping trainers and mentors in sync, and getting every learner to the finish line.

Delhi, on-site | 0 to 3 years | ₹6 to ₹8 LPA

You’d fit well if you’ve worked in EdTech ops, student success, customer success, or any role with lots of people and lots of deadlines.

**The short version**

**Who we’re looking for:**
Someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving operational problems, communicates clearly under pressure, and genuinely cares about creating exceptional student experiences. If you naturally take ownership, bring structure to chaos, and enjoy making systems work better every day, you’ll fit right in here.

**What this role is about:**
You’ll manage learning programs end-to-end - ensuring students stay on track, stakeholders stay aligned, and execution happens smoothly across multiple moving parts. The role combines program management, operations, stakeholder coordination, student support, and process improvement.

**Why you should apply:**
This is a strong fit for someone with 0-3 years of experience who wants rapid ownership, steep learning, and exposure to real operational complexity early in their career. You’ll work in a fast-moving, high-trust environment where strong execution, responsiveness, initiative, and problem-solving are deeply valued.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The detailed version**

As a Program Operations (Senior Associate) at Kraftshala, you’ll coordinate live sessions, manage stakeholders, improve processes, and ensure our programs run smoothly at scale. You will own operational execution across multiple moving parts. This role requires someone who can combine strong operational thinking with empathy, responsiveness, attention to detail, and excellent execution discipline.

Specific responsibilities will include:

**Program Management & Student Operations**

* Taking charge of the entire learning journey for assigned student cohorts and ensuring smooth end-to-end program delivery.
  *Metric to Measure: % of students achieving key learning milestones; cohort completion metrics*
* Being the first point of contact for students, solving queries promptly, empathetically, and with strong ownership.
  *Metric to Measure: Average response/resolution time; student satisfaction scores*
* Coordinating and executing live sessions, schedules, assessments, and operational workflows seamlessly across batches.
  *Metric to Measure: % of sessions conducted without operational issues or reschedules*
* Managing student escalations effectively and ensuring timely closure while maintaining a strong student experience.
  *Metric to Measure: Escalation turnaround time; escalation satisfaction scores*
* Tracking student engagement, participation, and progress using internal systems and operational dashboards.
  *Metric to Measure: % of students receiving timely nudges/support; engagement metrics*

**Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Liaising with trainers, mentors, evaluators, operations teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure aligned execution.
  *Metric to Measure: Timeliness and quality of stakeholder coordination; stakeholder feedback*
* Managing communication across multiple stakeholders while ensuring clarity, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  *Metric to Measure: Task completion timelines; communication effectiveness*

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identifying inefficiencies in workflows and proactively improving operational systems and processes.
  *Metric to Measure: Number of process improvements implemented; measurable impact on delivery quality*
* Leveraging tools and automation platforms (Notion, Google Sheets, Zapier, etc.) to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort.
  *Metric to Measure: Reduction in manual interventions; automation coverage across workflows*

**Monthly Outcomes**

**Month 1:**
Learn the ropes - understand our program delivery workflows, student journey, systems, tools, communication practices, and operational processes while shadowing ongoing cohorts.

**Month 2-3:**
Take ownership of one or more student cohorts end-to-end, independently manage student communication and operational workflows, and identify at least one meaningful process improvement opportunity.

**Month 4:**
Own multiple cohorts independently, handle stakeholder coordination smoothly, drive operational execution with minimal supervision, and consistently hit key program delivery metrics.

**Top Grading**

* **Ownership & Accountability:**
  An A-Player takes complete ownership of outcomes, follows through consistently, and proactively solves problems before they escalate, whereas a B-Player requires reminders and reacts only after issues surface.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  An A-Player brings structure to complexity, manages multiple moving parts effectively, and executes reliably under pressure, whereas a B-Player struggles with prioritization and consistency.
* **Student Obsession:**
  An A-Player genuinely cares about student experience and looks for ways to improve it proactively, whereas a B-Player focuses only on task completion.
* **Process Thinking:**
  An A-Player continuously improves systems and workflows to make operations more scalable and efficient, whereas a B-Player sticks to existing processes without questioning or optimizing them.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  An A-Player catches small issues early and maintains high execution accuracy, whereas a B-Player misses details that create operational friction or delays.
* **Communication & Coordination:**
  An A-Player communicates clearly, promptly, and with context across stakeholders, whereas a B-Player’s communication is inconsistent, delayed, or incomplete.
* **Learning Agility:**
  An A-Player adapts quickly, absorbs feedback well, and improves continuously, whereas a B-Player struggles with change or repeated feedback.

**Must Haves**

title: Senior Onboarding Specialist
description:
**About the role**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own**

Onboarding Delivery and Governance

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

Cross Functional Partnership

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

Process, Tooling and Reporting

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

Merchant Experience and Retention

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

Team Leadership and Capacity

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

﻿

What we are looking for

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

title: Test Strategy & Operations Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT)
description:
**About Our Program**
S4E is one of the major Business- & IT Transformation Programs within global Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions.The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.
  
  
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As the Test Strategy & Operations Management Specialist for User Acceptance Test (UAT) (f/m/d), you start your day aligning with internal stakeholders and external IT partners to support in the develop the S/4 test factory setup for User Acceptance Testing.
  
  
You oversee the integration of various rollout projects within the S/4 program, ensuring a scalable, efficient, and well-governed operating model. Being part of a global team of IT and Business Transformation experts, you monitor testing activities across rollout projects and ensure transparency regarding progress, risks, and performance.
  
  
You drive stakeholder alignment, analyze key performance metrics, and continuously improve processes through automation and AI-driven solutions. At the end of the day, you consolidate results, prepare performance reports, and propose next steps to strengthen the factory setup
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute to scale the S/4 test factory for the UAT scope, combining internal employees and external IT partners to enable industrialized SAP rollouts.
* Lead and govern defined UAT test-related activities across the global rollout program.
* Manage the Performance Management on UAT testing scope with clear KPIs and continuous improvement mechanisms for various rollout projects.
* Drive automation and AI-enabled testing approaches for UAT across various rollout projects to increase efficiency and quality.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and service levels for UAT scope across various rollout projects to ensure timely and complete delivery.
* Ensure transparency through structured reporting, governance, and stakeholder alignment

**What You Bring**
Proven experience in managing IT environments or transformation programs.
  
  

* Good understanding of enterprise IT systems (software, hardware, databases).
* Experience in rollout initiatives (preferably SAP/S/4HANA).
* Knowledge of IT operations, governance, and service management structures.
* Experience to work with external IT partners and related performance frameworks.
* Experience leading cross-functional, international initiatives.
* Business fluent English; German is an advantage

**About The Team (Vision/Mission Of The UAT Team)**
You are responsible for managing all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Siemens Energy SAP S/4HANA across multiple rollout projects and contribute to the overall setup of the UAT delivery model. You contribute to the UAT strategy development and take the lead on various aspects of its operational execution. In this role you leverage the setup of the S4E Program with assigned team members across all rollout projects as well as our external IT delivery partner. Your work enables us to scale the testing process to an industrialized level including automation and AI technologies that allow efficient and effective UAT test management for 10+ in-parallel rollout projects.
  
  
You manage various stakeholders related to UAT testing from across our solution factory, data migration factory, change factory to contribute towards our rollout projects and its business stakeholders. You steer the performance of the external IT service delivery partner for the UAT scope and ensure in-time, in-quality, audit proof documented testing as part of the rollout projects.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our distributed team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Gain deep insights into the most strategic Business / IT Transformation Program of Siemens Energy
* Get a profound understanding of the global Siemens Energy organization, process landscape and ways of working
* Establish a wide personal network with stakeholders and colleagues from all Businesses, Regions and Functions as well as with internal and external partners
* All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay monthly.

title: Actuarial Program Strategist -UNDP-Milliman Global Actuarial Initiative (GAIN)
description:
**About Milliman**
Independent for 75 years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world's most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
  
  
Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
  
  
**About GAIN**
GAIN is strengthening financial resilience worldwide by building up the actuarial profession and deepening local insurance markets. Launched in 2022 by the UNDP and Milliman, GAIN addresses the urgent need for actuarial expertise to quantify and manage risks, fostering more resilient economies and communities. In many low and middle-income countries, the actuarial profession is emerging, with few qualified national experts. GAIN is driving change in this landscape by delivering targeted capacity-building, mentorship, and policy support. Through collaborative action, driven by local stakeholders, GAIN empowers countries to develop homegrown actuarial talent and implement robust insurance frameworks, laying the foundation for sustainable growth and climate resilience around the world. Greater information on the program can be found on the LinkedIn page.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Actuarial Program Strategist will drive and manage country activities as well as contributing to thought leadership research whilst working closely with volunteers for the UNDP-Milliman Global Actuarial Initiative (GAIN), a joint initiative between Milliman Inc. and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to build the actuarial profession and expertise in low-middle income countries.
  
  
The Actuarial Program Strategist will be responsible for supporting, driving, and overseeing active engagement across 3-4 countries, working closely with ambassadors and volunteers who serve as country leads. This includes managing relationships and continued engagement with stakeholders as well as overseeing the delivery and coordination of key interventions across priority markets. The position will also contribute to and drive the development of ongoing thought leadership initiatives, including papers and insights on topics such as climate, data, capacity building, and regulatory considerations.
  
  
**Key Roles and Responsibilities (expected workload %)**

* Support, drive and oversee 3-4 active country activities and work closely with leading ambassadors and volunteers as country leads (50%)
* Management of ongoing support for GAIN countries and their activities (25%)
* Drive ongoing thought leadership papers (e.g. climate, data, capacity building regulatory) and interventions (25%)

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong interest in the initiative's mission to strengthen the actuarial profession in developing and emerging countries to advance risk management and economic development
* Keen to develop new capacity building tools and training programs and be flexible to make adjustments given local implementation requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Enthusiastic and effective leader who will work with other professionals on specific activities towards the satisfaction of the objectives
* Comfortable working with external stakeholders and managing ongoing relationships
* Highly organized with the ability to effectively manage and track multiple tasks, issues, and projects simultaneously, and adjust priorities to meet changing circumstances
* Works well with a wide variety of professionals with diverse backgrounds, skill levels, and personalities
* Motivated professional who takes initiative to drive projects and diversify the team's skillset
* Confident working in a remote environment and across different time zones

**Skills And Qualifications Required**

* 5-10 years of working experience in the actuarial profession, inclusive of experience working in low- and middle-income countries
* Associate or Fellow (or equivalent) of one of the actuarial professional bodies
* Experience in volunteering with local actuarial society or international actuarial associations
* Experience managing multiple projects and coordinating outsourced or external partners
* Bachelor's Degree or higher
* English fluency is required

**Skills And Qualifications Preferred**

* Work experience in low-middle income countries is a must
* Experience working in an insurance-related environment
* Experience developing thought leadership research
* Degree in a relevant field (actuarial science, economics, business or finance)
* Strong communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a multitude of stakeholders and teams/departments

**Location**

* Position will be placed in Gurgaon, India with the option of hybrid work
* GAIN operational team is centered in APAC time zone. Flexible working with different time zones and willingness to participate in conference calls before or after normal business hours to accommodate business hours in a different country
* Occasional travel may be required for meetings, conferences, or visits to stakeholder locations. Travel expectations will vary based on business needs.

**We focus on our mission**

Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. * You have at least five to seven years of relevant project management work experience, preferably in a fast-paced consulting / professional services environment.
