title: Program Manager, TA Business Operations
description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
  
  
The Program Manager, TA Business Operations serves as the operating backbone of Ciena's global Talent Acquisition function, enabling programmes, projects, and commitments to remain on track across North America, EMEA, APAC, and India. This individual contributor role partners closely with the Senior Director, Talent Acquisition & HRBP, EMEA to establish operating discipline, identify risk early, strengthen accountability, and provide recommendations that support effective decision-making. The role applies business operations, programme management, recruiting data, and technology inputs to improve execution across the global function.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of cross-functional Talent Acquisition initiatives, including process redesign, organisational changes, and systems rollouts, with defined owners, milestones, and risk logs.
* Drive accountability across HR Technology, Learning and Development, HR Data, Compliance, Legal, recruiting managers, and other cross-functional partners by tracking commitments, escalating slippage early, and proposing a course of action.
* Own the global Talent Acquisition operating cadence, including recurring reviews, dashboard readouts, action tracking, follow-through, and a single source of truth for initiatives, owners, and deadlines.
* Partner with the Senior Director as a constructive thought partner by pressure-testing plans, identifying blind spots, preparing briefing materials, talking points, and pre-reads, and representing the Senior Director in select forums.
* Govern the Talent Acquisition reporting framework with stakeholders, ensuring hiring volume, time-to-fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, diversity, and recruiter productivity metrics are consistently defined, reviewed, and applied to business decisions.
* Partner with Compliance and Legal to align recruiting practices with applicable employment policies, right-to-work requirements, and screening obligations across operating geographies.
* Optimise Talent Acquisition operations by monitoring vendor performance and budget spend, recommending renewal, consolidation, and cost actions, resolving process friction, and defining requirements and outcome measures for recruiting technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

**The Must Haves**

* Experience: 8+ years in business operations, programme or project management, or chief-of-staff-type roles; recruiting or HR domain experience is a plus.
* Track record of managing an operating cadence for a senior leader or function, including reviews, reporting, and follow-through without repeated direction.
* Demonstrated management of senior stakeholders across regions and time zones, including driving accountability without formal authority.
* Application of workforce and recruiting data, including dashboards, post-implementation reviews, and funnel metrics, to inform decisions; systems administration experience is not required.
* Written and verbal English communication experience, including preparation of materials for executive or board-level audiences.

**Nice To Haves**

* Certifications: Project or programme management credential, including PMP, PgMP, Six Sigma, or equivalent experience.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
  
  
Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
  
  
If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

  Lead the evaluation and interviewing of contractors. Present formal written recommendations to the Client based on pricing, experience, safety records, and financial stability, wherever possible.
* **Supplier Diversity:**
  Identify and engage diverse-owned suppliers where possible and track spend data accordingly.

  Coordinate the preparation and completion of punch/snag lists.
* **Documentation:**

title: Founder's Office - Fulfillment Lead
description:
Every company knows how to generate pipelines. Very few know how to deliver consistently at scale.

At SalesMonk, we're building AI-native GTM systems that help customers turn events and outbound into predictable revenue. As we grow, the biggest challenge isn't shipping more work- it's building the operating system that ensures every customer engagement is executed consistently, efficiently, and repeatedly.

That's where this role comes in.

**Why This Role Exists**

Today, our delivery works because smart people are solving problems every day.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

We're looking for someone who can build the processes, operating rhythms, and delivery playbooks that allow us to scale without adding operational chaos.

This isn't a project management role, this is a systems-building role.

You'll work directly with the founders to create the delivery engine that supports the next stage of the company.

**What You Will Own**

**Build the Delivery Operating System**

Design how delivery should work- from customer kickoff to successful execution.

Build repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, governance, and playbooks that reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

Own delivery health across all customer engagements.

Identify bottlenecks, eliminate operational friction, and continuously improve execution quality.

Ensure delivery standards remain high as the team scales.

**Cross-functional Execution**

Work closely with Product, GTM Engineers, Customer Success, and the founders to ensure priorities move quickly.

Bring structure, accountability, and visibility across teams.

**Process & Automation**

Identify manual workflows that should be standardized or automated.

Help build scalable systems that improve speed, quality, and consistency.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Define what great delivery looks like.

Build dashboards and operating metrics around delivery quality, turnaround time, customer outcomes, and execution efficiency.

Use data to continuously improve the way we operate.

**What We're Looking For**

* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 3-4 years of post-MBA experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Transformation, or Operations Consulting.
* Experience designing operating models, improving business processes, or leading transformation initiatives.
* Strong structured problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure from scratch.
* High ownership with a bias towards execution.

**Brownie Points**

* Experience in a B2B SaaS or AI startup.
* Exposure to customer delivery, implementation, or GTM operations.
* Experience building operational dashboards and business metrics.
* Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Airtable, or similar tools.
* Experience driving automation using AI or no-code workflows.

**Why This Seat**

You'll build the operating backbone of an AI-native GTM company.

Instead of maintaining existing processes, you'll design them.

You'll work directly with the founders, influence how the company scales, and solve problems that don't have predefined answers.

If you enjoy building systems, simplifying complexity, and creating leverage across teams, you'll have an outsized impact here.

description:
**Company Description**
Chamber for Promotion and Facilitation of Innovative Business (CPFIB) is dedicated to empowering micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and innovative startups to scale globally through trade opportunities, technology exchange, and facilitation of government schemes. The Chamber focuses on increasing awareness of innovative industry practices, support programs, and export incentives offered by relevant government agencies. CPFIB works to promote financial inclusion for innovative MSMEs by encouraging adoption of progressive financial models that reward innovation. The organization also provides mentoring and expert guidance across sectors, and facilitates buyer–seller meets to support sector-wise adoption of innovative practices within MSMEs.

**Role Description**
This is a part-time, hybrid Management role based in Delhi, India, with flexibility for some work from home. The individual in this role will oversee programs and initiatives that support MSMEs and startups, including planning and coordinating trade promotion activities, technology exchange initiatives, and government scheme awareness sessions. Daily responsibilities include stakeholder engagement with entrepreneurs, industry experts, and government bodies, organizing events such as buyer–seller meets, and managing communication and reporting on key projects. The role involves supervising outreach campaigns, ensuring timely delivery of program objectives, and monitoring the impact of CPFIB’s initiatives on member organizations. The manager will also contribute to strategic planning, process improvement, and documentation to strengthen CPFIB’s mission and operations.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in program or project management, including planning, coordination, and monitoring of initiatives supporting MSMEs or startups.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with entrepreneurs, industry partners, and government agencies.
* Background in business development, trade facilitation, or economic development, ideally with exposure to innovative business practices or financial inclusion.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to deliver presentations, conduct workshops, and prepare clear reports and proposals.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a hybrid environment, managing priorities and meeting deadlines in a part-time schedule.
* Understanding of Indian government schemes, export incentives, and support mechanisms for MSMEs and startups is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Management, Economics, Public Policy, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in chambers of commerce, industry associations, incubators, or innovation-focused organizations is an advantage.

**Why this role matters**
Deliver seamless, high-quality customer experiences across APAC region by managing the complete order-to-delivery process for ICEYE’s satellite radar data.
  
  
As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you will ensure customers receive timely and accurate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, balancing technical insight, proactive communication, and operational precision. **Who We Are**
ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world’s largest SAR constellation, acquiring images of Earth at any time — even through clouds or darkness — to help commercial and government partners make data-driven decisions.
  
  
Our satellites and analytics support critical sectors, including maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance. ICEYE’s mission is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.
  
  
Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from offices in five international locations and employs over 600 people from nearly 60 countries, united by our passion for innovation, teamwork, and impact.

**Reporting**

**Requirements**
**Must haves:**

* Proven experience in customer excellence or account management roles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Bachelor's degree or practical experience in geography, remote sensing, or aerospace domains.
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindu/Mandarin/Korean (depending on the location).

**Key Competences**

* Intellectual Firepower: Quickly grasps complex operational and technical information, translating it into clear customer communication.
* Passion & Work Ethic: Demonstrates consistent motivation, reliability, and ownership in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Working at ICEYE**
At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
  
  
**How We Work (Our Values)**
**Make the impossible possible**
: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
  
  

* Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

* Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Math
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mathematics expert to lead a pod of 5–10 trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science.
* You will review trainer-created tasks for mathematical correctness, reproducibility, challenge, and grader reliability. You will also mentor trainers, manage quality and throughput, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mathematical research and computational workflows.
* The role covers numerical and applied mathematics, scientific computing, optimization, statistics, mathematical modeling, computational algebra, and formal verification.

**What you’ll do:**

* Review tasks end to end, including problem statements, datasets, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Verify mathematical correctness, well-posedness, convergence, stability, conditioning, discretization error, and edge-case handling.
* Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step reasoning rather than lookup or a single library call.
* Validate that exact, symbolic, arbitrary-precision, or floating-point computation is used appropriately.
* Check that tolerances are suitable for the problem’s numerical conditioning.
* Design and review graders based on mathematical properties such as residuals, feasibility, optimality certificates, invariants, error bounds, or proof checking.
* Ensure tasks are reproducible through pinned tools, libraries, solver versions, and dependencies.
* Identify and prevent hard-coded solutions, test-file leakage, and other methods of bypassing the intended computation.
* Provide precise, actionable feedback and track trainer revisions through closure.
* Mentor and onboard trainers on mathematical rigor, task design, coding practices, and evaluation standards.
* Allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, and escalate blockers.
* Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.
* Collaborate with the Mathematics Team Lead and other technical stakeholders to improve benchmark quality.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, MATLAB/Octave, or a computer algebra system.
* Strong Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on experience with numerical methods, scientific computing, symbolic computation, optimization, computational statistics, or mathematical modeling.
* Ability to rigorously evaluate mathematical derivations, algorithms, proofs, and computational results.
* Experience reviewing research outputs, code, mathematical work, or scientific workflows.
* Experience mentoring or leading small technical or research teams.
* Strong written communication and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback.
* Ability to assess reproducibility, test reliability, and the scientific validity of computational tasks.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, mpmath, SageMath, PARI/GP, GAP, Macaulay2, or Mathematica-like workflows.
* Experience with FEniCS, Firedrake, DifferentialEquations.jl, PETSc, or similar ODE/PDE tools.
* Experience with CVXPY, JuMP, Pyomo, HiGHS, or other optimization frameworks.
* Familiarity with Lean/mathlib, Coq/Rocq, Isabelle, or other proof assistants.
* Experience with Docker, Git, CI systems, and automated testing.
* Experience designing benchmarks, competition problems, or computational evaluations.
* Experience evaluating AI coding, reasoning, or terminal agents.
* Experience setting or judging mathematics olympiad or competition problems.
* Publications or open-source contributions in computational mathematics, numerical software, or formalized mathematics.
* Prior experience in AI training, data generation, or model evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Associate, Creative Producer
description:
**Who we are:**

Roundglass is a wholistic wellbeing company working to empower healthier lives, stronger communities, and a more sustainable world. That w in wholistic is intentional: We believe true wellbeing spans the whole human experience, from how we care for ourselves to our connections with others and the planet.

This philosophy shapes both what we build and how we work. We’ve created an environment where supporting people’s whole selves fuels their most meaningful work.

Roundglass creates real-world impact through two core pillars:

Roundglass Giving is our nonprofit arm that drives philanthropic work in youth development, women's equity, and environmental sustainability. Our mission is to transform communities by tackling systemic challenges and unlocking human potential through Roundglass Sports, Roundglass Sustain, the Roundglass Foundation, and the Global India Institute (GIC). These efforts have reached millions of people, creating scalable models of community-led change.

Through the Roundglass Living platform, we deliver personalized wellbeing guidance rooted in science. The Roundglass Living app helps people develop habits that last through breathwork, meditation, movement, nutrition, music, and more.

We built Roundglass on the belief that people thrive when they’re supported wholistically, and we apply this philosophy to how we work together as a team. If you're passionate about transforming communities and creating systemic change and want to contribute to a culture that embodies the impact we're creating, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**

Roundglass Creative Studio is looking for a detail-oriented Associate with a strong interest in non-fiction storytelling, a grounding in documentary research and production processes, and the ability to work confidently in fast-paced, real-world environments.

The ideal candidate will work closely with the Creative Lead and support the development and production of films across the Studio. The role involves coordinating with internal teams, programme teams, community members, contributors, and external production crews through every stage of the filmmaking process — from story discovery, research and validation to pre-production, field shoots, post-production, and final delivery.

We are looking for someone who understands that a strong documentary film begins long before the camera starts rolling. It requires curiosity, thorough research, careful validation, an understanding of context, and detailed preparation. It means finding the layers within a story - understanding not only what happened, but why it matters, whose perspective needs to be represented, and what will make the story meaningful to an audience.

The role requires someone who is comfortable going across Punjab, comfortable meeting people and communities, listening closely, and asking the right questions. The candidate should be able to observe and identify the impact of different programmes and help translate that into strong, research-backed pre-production material.

The Associate will help ensure that research, contributors, production requirements, references, footage, feedback, and post-production workflows are organized and followed through carefully.

**What you’ll do:**

**End-to-End Project Coordination | Development to Post-Production**

* Conduct in-depth online and field research to support story discovery, development, and validation.
* Support the Creative Lead in identifying strong case studies and contributors and ensuring that research and narrative choices remain aligned with the film’s creative objective.
* Develop and organise research notes, contributor profiles, beat sheets, step outlines, visual references, and shot breakdowns in line with the creative direction.
* Coordinate with writers on scripts, revisions, feedback, and timely submissions.
* Support pre-production planning and crew coordination, ensuring clarity and alignment on schedules, requirements, deliverables, and expectations across departments.
* Coordinate closely with internal programme teams, contributors, communities, and external production partners to ensure information and production requirements are communicated accurately and on time.
* Across all productions, ensure adherence to Roundglass standards, design guidelines, science and factual accuracy, safety protocols, compliances, and ethical storytelling practices.

**On-Ground Shoot Coordination**

* Act as a key bridge between the creative team, production crew, programme teams, and contributors during shoots.
* Help ensure contributors, locations, scenes, and production requirements are ready and coordinated according to the shooting plan.
* Track shot sequences and coverage requirements, helping the team stay aligned with the creative brief while responding to the realities of the field.
* Maintain detailed shoot logs, contributor notes, coverage records, and production documentation to ensure continuity from production into post-production.
* Manage on-ground flow and troubleshoot coordination challenges as they arise, supporting the crew in making informed decisions within real-time constraints.

**Post-Production Support**

* Work closely with the post-production team to ensure that creative briefs, footage, research, contributor context, and production notes are clearly organised and handed over.
* Provide editorial support through shoot logs, story notes, contributor and character context, transcripts, research material, and visual references.
* Coordinate across different stages of post-production, including editing, graphics, sound, colour, reviews, feedback, and final delivery, as required.
* Track post-production schedules, review rounds, feedback, approval gateways, and deliverables to ensure projects move efficiently through each stage.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between creative, programme, and external teams, ensuring feedback is consolidated, communicated clearly, and followed through.
* Maintain organised project documentation and ensure that final masters, project files, assets, and supporting material are properly managed, handed over and archived.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in documentary or non-fiction filmmaking as Researcher, Assistant Director or in a related role.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling and narrative structures.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills– ability to navigate ground realities and communicate across departments and communities.
* Fluency in English (spoken and written).Conversational Hindi and Punjabi.
* Willingness to travel and work on location in rural and semi-urban areas of Punjab.
* Prior experience in filmmaking, being on the set, scheduling, field research and production management is a must.

**JOB DESCRIPTION: Project Manager – AI**

**Strategic Objective**

  Improved pre- vs. post-implementation quality parameters and verified employee satisfaction indexes.

**AI Strategy & Roadmap Development**

* **High-Impact Strategy:**
  Define and execute a phased, high-impact AI roadmap aligned with overarching business objectives across Finance, HR, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support.

  Assess and prioritize technical initiatives based on operational feasibility, pipeline impact, and financial ROI potential.

  Monitor global technology shifts, benchmark competitor ecosystems, and deliver a quarterly 'State of AI' landscape report to the executive leadership team.

**Workflow Automation & Platform Architecture**

* **System Integration:**
  Design and oversee end-to-end automation workflows that integrate smoothly with existing enterprise applications (CRM, HRMS, Legacy Databases, etc.).

  Demonstrate strong hands-on mastery of modern enterprise workflow tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Microsoft Power Automate.
* **Governance & Compliance:**
  Establish robust AI governance, data privacy parameters, continuous model-monitoring controls, and ethical compliance frameworks from day one.
* **Build vs. Buy Analysis:**
  Evaluate complex commercial build vs. buy solutions with structured technical and financial risk analysis.

**Vibe Coding, Prototyping & Technical Translation**

* **Rapid Prototyping:**
  Utilize 'vibe coding' principles using natural language inside AI development shells (Cursor, Replit AI, GitHub Copilot, v0) to accelerate prototype deployment without engineering bottlenecks.
* **Discovery Engineering:**
  Lead discovery workshops with business heads to translate practical pain points into crisp system requirements, user stories, and precise technical briefs.
* **Quality Assurance Check:**
  Evaluate early low-code/vibe-coded prototypes for production readiness before passing them to core developer lines.

**ROI Analytics & Financial Case Development**

* **Financial Modeling:**
  Build data-grounded financial models projecting cost optimizations, capacity release, and structural quality returns to capture leadership approval.
* **KPI Dashboards:**
  Monitor and distribute detailed monthly dashboards reporting target vs. actual ROI performance benchmarks.

**Vendor, Client & Management Communication**

* **Vendor Optimization:**
  Serve as the master point of contact for external AI software companies, SaaS vendors, and specialized system integrators; negotiate precise SLAs.
* **Executive Advisory:**
  Translate complex, multi-layered algorithmic and machine learning engineering terms into simplified, accessible strategic vocabulary for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Culture Catalyst:**
  Champion a data-driven, AI-first work culture through internal continuous learning series, lunch-and-learn presentations, and proactive change management strategies.

  Partner directly with engineering lines, data scientists, and DevOps specialists to break execution blockers and maintain delivery timeline momentum.
* **Technical Foundation:**
  Maintain a functional, operational literacy in database structures (MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL architectures) and foundational programming frameworks (Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, JSON data maps) to effectively guide core product decisions.

**Team Leadership & Personnel Management**

* **Cross-Functional Operations:**
  Directly coordinate, mentor, and track performance across a cross-functional Agile unit comprising developers, data analysts, system architects, UI/UX engineers, and QA assets.
* **Psychological Safety:**
  Construct a highly collaborative, innovative, and safe team environment that incentivizes experimentation, speed, and learning from failure.
* **Resource Optimization:**
  Control tactical resource allocation patterns to avoid personnel burnout while defending roadmap velocity commitments.

**3. Qualifications & Competencies**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's or Master's university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a heavily analytical engineering field.
* **Professional Background:**
  5–9 years of structural project management experience, with a validated minimum of 3 years strictly dedicated to AI deployment, complex workflow automation, or enterprise-scale digital transformations.
* **Delivery Execution:**
  Proven, end-to-end portfolio tracking product evolution from conceptual design phase through to live enterprise rollout using Agile, Scrum, or hybrid workflow methods.
* **Integration Literacy:**
  Verifiable hands-on track record using cloud workflow orchestration engines (n8n, Make, Zapier, or Power Automate).
* **Commercial Competence:**
  Documented background creating financial case summaries, tracking cost-mitigation parameters, and proving tech investments ROI.

**Core Competency Matrix**

* Executive-Level Communication
* Workflow Automation Platforms
* Team Building & Mentorship
* ROI Modeling & Financial Analysis
* Vendor & Stakeholder Management
* AI Platform Architecture
* Change Management & Empathy
* Vibe Coding & Low-Code Deployment
* Strategic Thinking
* Business Requirements Analysis
* Conflict Resolution
* Database & API Knowledge
* Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
* Data Governance & AI Ethics
* Cross-Functional Collaboration

**4. Work Environment & Corporate Culture**

* **AI-First Mindset:**
  We operate in an aggressive, progressive corporate landscape where internal workflow automation and AI scaling are resourced as primary, non-negotiable competitive business advantages.
* **High Market Impact:**
  This position holds deep strategic authority with real-time, measurable influence over company-wide profit sheets, employee operational capacity, and structural framework maturity.
* **Innovation Incubator:**
  Personnel are consistently encouraged, measured, and expected to proactively test, pilot, and pitch novel AI-augmented infrastructure solutions directly to executive directors.

title: Senior Program Manager
company: Foundation for Advancing Science and Technology - India
description:
**Job Title: SPM – Government Policy and Programs**

**Foundation for Advancing Science and Technology**

**Background**

We live in a world of fast-paced innovation today, driven by exponential progress in science and technology (S&T) and the growth of vibrant ecosystems to commercialize research. India must aspire to be a top 3 S&T Nation, where the first two places are occupied by US and China today. To do so, India needs to be at the forefront of research:
**the creation of new knowledge (research) and its translation to economic and social goods**
. This is imperative for long-term industry differentiation and competitiveness, National security, and self-reliance to attain our socio-economic goals.

The time for India to revive its S&T agenda is now or never. We have the economic size, the talent pool, a large market size and a vibrant startup ecosystem to both invest in research and be able to translate S&T knowledge into economic value. For India to be a global leader, exponential S&T growth needs to go hand-in-hand with economic growth and social progress.

While the West has traditionally dominated global S&T, many Asian countries such as Japan, Korea and Taiwan have made rapid progress in the past, and China has dramatically scaled its S&T prowess to become #2 in the world behind USA. India's Contribution is relatively dwarfed - its high impact research output is ranked 1oth, with US & China being the top 2, no Indian university shows up in top 100 research rankings, with just 1 company in world's top 50 innovative companies.

**Way of Work**

The
**Foundation for Advancing Science and Technology (FAST India)**
is a non-profit institution of excellence dedicated to catalyse India's journey to a top 3 S&T Nation. We identify that the major stakeholders for S&T include the government, the research institutions and the industry. There are systemic challenges with how these actors today work, such as size of ambition, right incentives, resource allocation and efficiency. Our way of working is to identify these challenges, develop and vigorously advocate policy solutions and best practices to address them. We also identify high-leverage projects that can have an outsized impact on the ecosystem, and run programs with stakeholders, where we lend our team of experts, to make sure best practices are used and the program is impactful. At maturity, we see the ecosystem develop the virtuous cycle of research funding, new breakthrough research, translation into economic value, and re-investment. While we build the

ecosystem, we also look forward to build a strong narrative of S&T leadership in India and create political salience around it.

In a short period of time, FAST has started engagements with the
**Office of PSA (Govt of India), Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Capacity Building Commission of India and Banaras Hindu University**
, among others.

Our projects span easing procurement for scientists, re-envisaging government and industry financing of research, fixing institutional grant management process, shaping sectoral missions, simplifying government procurement etc. Our current body of work includes partnerships with
**Niti Ayog**
on driving measures for ease of doing science, initiatives on industry academia collaboration , thought leadership on Research Linked Incentives, and operationalising R&D Hub spoke models to accelerate India's R&D impact.

At
**Department of Science and Technology,**
FAST has co partnered on shaping and operationalising
**Anusandhaan National Research Fund**
and
**Research Development and Innovation Fund**

FAST has conducted a
**state of sector report**
on Industrial R&D benchmarking Indian industry players across six sectors and comparison versus global peers while highlighting opportunities to increase R&D intensity, and patent, publications outcomes.

FAST's current efforts include understanding the
**R&D landscape of the pharmaceutical sector**
in India and highlighting opportunities to accelerate innovation through various policy interventions. FAST is leading efforts to increase industry participation in R&D, and finding pathways to improving the research translational effectiveness at our institutions. We have produced multiple succinct policy briefs for the governmental and institutional sector.

We also run India's largest non-profit science festival in India called the
**India Science Fest**
, which has seen an audience of 50,000 people over the last three years. We also support and co-ordinate a
**Science Book Fellowship**
to spur public science books in India.

**Leadership**

FAST India is founded by Varun Aggarwal, who is a successful entrepreneur and researcher, and Ashish Dhawan, a private equity investor turned philanthropist. Varun built and sold India's largest job assessment company, Aspiring Minds and wrote a book on the science ecosystem of India. Ashish Dhawan is the chairperson of Ashoka University, a leading liberal arts university in India, and Central Square Foundation, and is passionate about promoting science in India.

FAST's advisory board is chaired by Prof.Tarun Khanna, the Jorge Paulo Lemann Professort at the Harvard Business School. The advisory board includes Prof VijayRaghavan ( Ex Principal Scientific Advisor), Ramesh Mangaleswran ( Ex Mckinsey), Saurabh Srivastava ( Ex Chairman Nasscom ), Dr Soumya Swaminathan(ex World Health Organisation), Dr Ramgopal Rao( Group Vice Chancellor BIT Pilani), Thomas Barlow, Shantanu Rastogi( MD General Atlantic Partners India). FAST's advisory council includes Sanjay Sarma, Dr. Swaminathan Sivaram (IISER), Venkatesh Narayanamurti (Harvard

Univ), Kris Gopalakrishnan, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Ajay Mehta, Abhishek Goel, Vijay Chandru (IISc), Samir K. Brahmachari and Gagandeep Kang.

**Pre-reading**

Varun's talk on his book explaining India's S&T ecosystem and the need for change

Keynote Remarks and Panel Discussion at India Science Fest about why India needs to invigorate its S&T ecosystem Policy and best practices briefs by FAST

**Responsibilities**

FAST India is looking for a
**Senior Program Manager**
to support its government policy and program engagements at a pivotal moment in our growth. This role will be central to advancing India's position at the forefront of global innovation by sustaining partnerships with government bodies like Niti Aayog, Department of Science and Technology, ANRF etc and supporting the policy design and implementation efforts of identified policies and programs. Reporting to the CEO- FAST, and working closely with the FAST leadership team, the candidate would drive research work to identify policy interventions to accelerate India's innovation effort and their implementation of agreed actions through PMU resources aligned and deployed with the government bodies. Following are the responsibilities of the candidate:

The key responsibilities of the SPM (Policy Reforms) include, but are not limited to:

**1. Provide analytical depth in policy intervention design and develop their execution plans.**

The Senior Program Manager will collaborate with partners to iteratively design, develop, and frame decision options that resolve challenges in science, technology, and innovation strategy. The SPM will help design operational interventions that can catalyse and accelerate Indian STI ecosystems.

The SPM will support the leadership team with research and insight, recommending an appropriate approach for diverse policy questions.

**2. Build and Sustain Partnerships**

The Senior Program Manager will develop a strong partnership with government organisations.

**3. Government Interface**

He/she would be a key interface with the government organisations like Niti Aayog, ANRF, State Departments or Line Ministries where the PMU has been deployed, and manage the program implementation

**4. Project and Program Management**

The Senior Program Manager would develop a clear roadmap for implementation and execution of agreed deliverables with the government. This would include development of project plan/workplans, and KPI's for the agreed scope of work

**5. Program Monitoring, Reporting and Control**

He/She would develop appropriate metrics, and dashboards and publish periodic reports and updates on the PMU progress, to the FAST and Government team members

**6. Opportunity Identification and feedback to shape priorities**
He/she would identify additional opportunities through the PMU to help further FAST's goals of increasing R&D impact in the country.

**7. Governance and Compliance**

The Senior Program Manager would ensure adherence to government protocols and legal frameworks

**8. Arrange Policy briefs, organise roundtables etc**

The Senior Program Manager would prepare background analytics and policy briefs for policy roundtables, conferences, summits, workshops etc as needed to

Working closely with FAST India's leadership, the Senior Program Manager will help expand the organisation's capabilities and influence, playing a key role in shaping programs, partnerships, and the narrative that positions FAST India as the go-to institution for enhancing R&D in the country.

**Skills and Competencies Required:**

**1. Ability to Provide Analytical depth to shape policy interventions and recommendations**

Should have strong analytical capability and mature thinking to determine appropriate policy recommendations that can accelerate innovation impact

**2. Ability to build partnerships**

Ability to
**forge and manage partnerships**
with government leaders.

**2. Ability to understand policy Strategic Acumen and Analytical skills**

Understand the national Science and Technology policies, government programs Should be able to identify and prioritise the opportunities to support the government efforts in line with the national needs and FAST's vision and plans

**3. Strategic Acumen**

Should be able to identify and prioritise the opportunities to support the government efforts in line with the national needs and FAST's vision and plans

**4. Project Management and Program Execution**

Ability to organize team, establish clear work plans, KPI's and metrics. The candidate must be able to actively manage the overall project and PMU deployed to ensure successful completion of agreed deliverables

**5. Organisational Leadership -Ability to lead team remotely**

Candidate should be able to supervise, and guide remotely deployed PMU's. He/she must be able to develop the team members, and ensure they are well supported through the deployment efforts

**6. Stakeholder Liaisoning & Management**

Candidate must be able to work with government stakeholders and manage the overall relationship while ensuring team delivers on agreed outcomes. Candidate would show maturity and decision making as needed for the same.

**7. Communication**

Clear, persuasive communicator in both written and spoken formats and excellent powerpoint skills

**8. Personal qualities**

Mission-driven, result oriented mindset, with high integrity and resilience in complex stakeholder environments.

**Who you are:**

1. You are a graduate in STEM, Economics, Management or Public Policy and have a clear passion for science and technology.

2. You have excellent analytical, critical thinking, planning and organisational skills with high attention to details.

3. You bring 6+ years' experience in government , academia, corporates or government, preferably working closely with the S&T ecosystem.

4. You're an inspirational leader with strong strategic and operational skills, able to energize teams and deliver results.

5. You are comfortable with collaborating with multiple stakeholders , and driving alignment.

6. You thrive in building credible and trusted relationships.

7. You have high intellectual vitality with desire to engage in variety of topics and willingness to learn.

title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)
description:
**Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)**

**The Short version**

**Who we're looking for:**
A sharp, high-intensity problem solver with 3 to 6 years of experience, who cares deeply about education and is happiest when handed a messy problem with no playbook.

**What the role is about:**
You'll work directly with our CEO on the strategic priorities that will shape Kraftshala's next phase of growth, across admissions, training, placements, tech, partnerships, and scale, and you'll own each one from start to finish.

**Why you should apply:**
You'll work on some of the hardest and most critical problems in the company, alongside people with extraordinary expertise in skilling and training. There's a lot to learn here, and plenty of room to grow.

**About Us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

Our goal is simple: drive placements. That takes stellar admissions, training and placement processes, strong technology and deep partnerships across the ecosystem, and keeping all of it stellar as our programs grow. This role exists to solve the cross-functional problems that get in the way of that, working alongside the founder as priorities shift.

**Responsibilities & Metrics to Measure:**

* Take ambiguous, high-priority problems from the founder, break them down, find root causes using data, and turn them into a clear plan with owners and timelines.
* Spot where our programs risk slipping into mediocrity as they scale, across learner outcomes, placement quality and delivery standards, and fix the gaps at a system level.
* Run small, quick experiments on problem areas as they come up, share what worked and what didn't, and change course when the data or priorities shift.
* Act as the founder's thinking partner through sharp analyses, decision memos and reviews, and turn solved problems into repeatable processes that teams can run on their own.

**Top Grading**

* **Proactiveness:**
  An A-Player spots the next problem before being told and moves on it, whereas a B-Player waits for direction and does well only once the task is clearly defined.
* **Intensity & Focus:**
  An A-Player attacks the most important problem with urgency until it's solved, whereas a B-Player spreads effort thin and lets momentum fade after the first push.
* **Structuring Ambiguity:**
  An A-Player turns a vague, messy problem into a clear problem statement, hypothesis and plan, whereas a B-Player either waits for clarity or jumps into action without a frame.
* **Iterative Learning:**
  An A-Player tests fast, learns from what didn't work and changes course without ego, whereas a B-Player sticks to the original plan even when the data says otherwise.
* **Cross-functional Influence:**
  An A-Player gets teams they don't manage to move by building trust and making a clear case, whereas a B-Player leans on the founder's name to get things done.
* **Adaptability:**
  An A-Player shifts gears calmly when priorities change and carries the learnings forward, whereas a B-Player treats every change as a disruption and loses pace.
* **Passion for Education:**
  An A-Player believes in the cause of education and finds ways to drive change, whether through learner outcomes, access to opportunity, better systems or shifting mindsets, whereas a B-Player sees education as just another sector to work in.

**Ideal Candidate**

You have 3 to 6 years of experience solving real problems end-to-end. You might come from consulting, strategy, a founder's office or business operations, or from any role where you've had to work through varied, unstructured problems with no fixed playbook.

* A clear, genuine interest in education is a must. Prior exposure to the sector, whether through edtech, skilling or teaching, is a strong plus.
* You've taken an ambiguous problem, given it structure, and delivered a measurable result, ideally while working across teams you didn't directly manage.
* You're looking to build deep context and grow with us over the long term, not a short stint.

**Location**

Delhi / Gurugram

Know more about Kraftshala's philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: DE-NCLC-M365 Migration and Modernization Manager-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**DE NCLC Manager – Technology Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Manager with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a client-focused technology leader who can shape and deliver Microsoft 365 transformation engagements. The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large-scale migration or modernization programs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
* Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
* Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
* Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
* Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
* Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
* Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
* Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
* Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
* Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
* Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 9-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
* Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
* Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
* Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
* Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
* Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
* Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
* Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

title: Delivery Lead, Internal Financial Controls
description:
**Delivery Lead – Internal Financial Controls**
Gurugram, Haryana, India
  
  
As a Delivery Lead of Internal Financial Controls, you will be leading the complex IFC framework project workstreams and provide technical and delivery leadership for the design and implementation of sustainable controls across insurance and finance processes.
  
  
The role supports a project to strengthen the design, documentation and sustainability of internal financial control arrangements across insurance and finance processes. The successful candidate will combine risk and controls expertise with sound judgement, credible challenge and clear written communication.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Lead complex IFC projects and workstreams, setting delivery approaches and translating programme objectives into executable plans through implementation readiness and handover.
* Own the translation of IFRS financial statement risks into control design principles.
* Facilitate design workshops with Finance, Operations, Technology and process owners to ensure proposed controls address risks and can operate sustainably.
* Provide expert advice and credible challenge in complex situations, influencing senior process owners and escalating material decisions, dependencies and barriers through programme governance.
* Assess the impact of process, system, data and organisational change on control design and implementation sequencing.
* Maintain oversight of delivery plans, milestones, interdependencies, risks and evidence requirements.
* Ensure deliverables are internally consistent and suitable for review by Group IC, external auditors and senior governance forums.
* Coach team members and business stakeholders on risks, control design, evidence standards and methodology application.
* Support programme leadership through status reporting, decision papers and recommendations.
* Understand end-to-end processes, relevant systems, data flows, hand-offs and financial statement impacts before proposing control changes.
* Assess IFRS financial statement risks and translate them into relevant financial statement assertions and process outcomes.
* Design sustainable controls with clear ownership, frequency, evidence, escalation and retention requirements.
* Apply AXA Group Internal Control methodology pragmatically while maintaining alignment with required standards.
* Distinguish control design or coverage issues from documentation enhancements and evidence limitations.
* Produce complete and consistent documentation capable of withstanding Group IC and external auditor scrutiny.
* Support development of standards, training, action tracking and the embedding of enhanced ways of working.
* Provide expert advice in complex situations and communicate difficult concepts in a way that influences stakeholders to adopt appropriate solutions.

You will report to Senior Risk Governance Manager.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Robust understanding of insurance business processes, including underwriting, claims, reinsurance, technical accounting, finance and reporting.
* Ability to understand IFRS financial statement risks and related financial statement assertions.
* Ability to translate risks into precise, practical and testable control objectives.
* Demonstrated experience designing sustainable controls rather than simply documenting existing activities.
* Working knowledge of SOX, ICFR or comparable internal financial control frameworks and risk-to-control mapping.
* Ability to apply group methodology proportionately and pragmatically while documenting judgement.
* Confidence to challenge process owners and senior stakeholders constructively and credibly.
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to produce concise, evidence-based documentation suitable for governance and assurance review.
* Robust analytical skills, attention to detail and ability to manage dependencies across multiple workstreams.
* Ability to assess financial statement coverage and maintain clear mapping between balances, processes, risks, controls and financial statement assertions.
* Practical understanding of process narratives, walkthroughs, risk and control matrices, design and operating effectiveness testing and quality assurance expectations.
* Awareness of technology dependencies relevant to financial reporting, including critical financial applications, IT general controls, end-user computing and outsourced service providers.
* Ability to maintain consistency across process documentation, testing evidence and risk and control systems with a clear audit trail and disciplined version control.
* Robust change delivery and stakeholder communication skills.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Significant experience in SOX/ICFR consulting, Internal Control, technical accounting, finance transformation or insurance process improvement.
* Experience leading complex internal control, control design or finance change workstreams within a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Insurance industry experience supported by a practical understanding of accounting and reporting processes.
* Experience within a Big Four or specialist consulting firm, Internal Control function, technical accounting or finance transformation environment, or as an insurance process SME.
* Relevant professional qualification or equivalent experience in accounting, audit, risk, controls or finance.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across cultures, functions and levels of seniority.
* Demonstrated accountability for delivery, quality of outputs and stakeholder engagement.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager
description:
**About Sirion**
Sirion is the world’s leading
**AI–native Contract Lifecyle Management (CLM) platform**
, transforming the end-to-end contracting journey for enterprises. With Agentic AI at the core, the platform’s extraction, conversational search, and AI-enhanced negotiation capabilities have revolutionized contracting across Fortune 500 companies like IBM, Coca Cola, Citi and GE. With more than 800 employees across the globe, Sirion comprises a team of AI engineers, legal experts and researchers who are working relentlessly to build reliable and trustworthy CLM for businesses of tomorrow. Recognized by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters as a consistent CLM leader, Sirion sets the innovation benchmark for the category.
  
  
For more information, visit
**www.sirion.ai**
.
  
  
**Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters**
The Partner Success Project Manager (PSPM) is the nerve centre of Sirion's visibility into partner-led implementation health. This role is deliberately not a classical project manager role, instead, the PSPM is a skilled in CLM domain, whose core contribution is ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows between partner project teams, Sirion's internal functions, and regional leadership.
  
  
The PSPM operates across multiple concurrent engagements, maintaining a real-time pulse on each project's status, proactively identifying patterns that signal risk, and escalating issues before they become crises. This role rewards structured thinking, sharp communication instincts, and the ability to synthesize complexity into clear, decision-ready insight.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**
**Project Portfolio Tracking & Metrics Oversight**

* Maintain a real-time, accurate view of all active partner-led implementation projects within the assigned portfolio — covering milestone status, go-live dates, open risks, blockers, and key decisions pending.
* Define and track a standardized set of project health metrics across the portfolio, including milestone adherence rate, risk density, open action item age, and escalation frequency.
* Develop and maintain a project health dashboard that provides the Regional Partner Success Leader and Regional Partner Delivery Lead with an at-a-glance view of portfolio status.
* Conduct weekly portfolio sweeps, reviewing updates from partner project teams and flagging discrepancies between reported status and observed delivery signals.

**Proactive Reporting & Stakeholder Communication**

* Prepare and distribute structured project status reports for each active engagement on a regular cadence (weekly / bi-weekly), tailored to the intended audience — ranging from working-level updates to executive summaries.
* Translate raw project data into clear, concise, and visually effective reports that highlight what matters: what is on track, what is at risk, what decisions are needed, and what is overdue.
* Proactively surface emerging risks and issues to the Regional Partner Delivery Lead and Regional Partner Success Leader before they escalate, with supporting context and recommended escalation paths.
* Maintain a rolling decisions log across each engagement, tracking open decisions, owners, and due dates to prevent stalled progress caused by unresolved choices.
* Prepare briefing materials for governance meetings, including project dashboards, risk summaries, and action item trackers.

**Liaison Between Partner Project Teams and Sirion Internal Teams**

* Serve as the coordination point between partner project teams and Sirion's internal functions — including Product Support, Technical Consultants, Enablement, CS Ops, and Legal/Commercial teams — ensuring requests are routed correctly and responses are tracked.
* Chase open actions from Sirion-side stakeholders, ensuring that partner teams are not left waiting for Sirion inputs that are blocking their delivery progress.
* Attend partner project team meetings (as observer or participant) to maintain firsthand visibility into delivery dynamics, emerging risks, and team sentiment.
* Facilitate information flow between the Regional Partner Delivery Lead and the partner's day-to-day delivery team — translating feedback from design reviews and toolgates into clear action items with owners and timelines.
* Coordinate logistics for governance meetings, design review sessions, and toolgate checkpoints — owning agendas, minute-taking, and action item distribution.

**Escalation Management & Issue Triage**

* Maintain a clear escalation log across the portfolio, tracking the nature of each escalation, the escalation path taken, and the resolution timeline.
* Triage incoming issues from partner teams, assessing urgency, determining the appropriate Sirion owner, and ensuring timely acknowledgement and response.
* Follow up on open escalations with relevant Sirion stakeholders until resolution is confirmed and the partner team is updated.
* Monitor recurrence patterns in issues across projects — identifying systemic problems (e.g., product gaps, knowledge deficiencies, process failures) and flagging them for structural remediation.

**Governance Preparation & Cadence Management**

* Prepare materials for all governance cadences — weekly internal team syncs, monthly partner review meetings, and ad-hoc escalation calls — including status decks, risk registers, and action item logs.
* Distribute meeting agendas in advance, capture minutes and action items during sessions, and circulate post-meeting summaries within 24 hours.
* Track action items from governance meetings to closure, chasing owners proactively when deadlines are approaching or missed.
* Maintain a governance calendar for each active engagement, ensuring all cadences are scheduled, attendees are confirmed, and materials are ready on time.

**Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table**

* 10–15 years of experience in project coordination, delivery operations, PMO, or program management support in an enterprise technology environment.
* Experience in CLM domain is mandate
* Proven ability to track and report on multiple concurrent projects simultaneously without losing accuracy or detail.
* Strong written communication skills — able to produce clear, concise status reports, executive summaries, and risk briefs that non-technical stakeholders can act on immediately.
* High attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and project tracking tools.
* Confident interpersonal skills — able to chase actions and follow up with senior internal and partner stakeholders professionally and persistently.
* Demonstrated ability to identify patterns and signals in project data that indicate emerging risk, before they surface as formal issues.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
Sirion is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are provided as required by law.

title: Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech)
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech) who combines marketing operations expertise, technical depth and a strong understanding of how B2B companies run programs such as Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and demand generation.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, marketing technology and revenue operations. You'll work directly with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other senior stakeholders to understand the business challenges driving their need for technology, translate those challenges into executable game plans, and partner with our technology and delivery teams to bring those solutions to life.
  
  
This isn't a pure consulting or project management role. You'll need to understand how businesses operate, how their marketing and sales programs work, and how the right technology architecture and execution can drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, designing connected technology solutions and working closely with senior stakeholders, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Business Discovery & Consulting: Lead discovery conversations with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other stakeholders to understand business goals, GTM motions, operational challenges and the underlying problems driving technology requirements.
* Solution Strategy & Planning: Translate business challenges into clearly defined problem statements, solution approaches and executable game plans, working with Solution Architects and the technology execution team to define scope, priorities and implementation plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Solutions: Design and implement technology setups across Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience (CX), ensuring systems, workflows and data connect to support business objectives.
* ABM & Demand Generation Enablement: Understand how B2B companies plan and execute ABM and demand generation programs, and translate these requirements into scalable technology solutions, workflows and measurement frameworks.
* Technology Stack & Integration: Work hands-on with marketing and revenue technology platforms, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and ABM and intent platforms such as Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level, to enable integrated GTM execution.
* Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery, Customer Success and other internal teams to translate the agreed game plan into technical requirements, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations and manage expectations throughout solution design and delivery.
* Engagement Governance: Maintain visibility into project scope, timelines, dependencies and risks. Identify gaps early, resolve execution blockers and ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop discovery frameworks, solution playbooks and repeatable approaches that improve consulting quality, implementation efficiency and client outcomes.

****What success looks like****

* Senior stakeholders trust you to understand their business challenges and recommend solutions beyond simply implementing a tool.
* Business problems are translated into clear, technically feasible execution plans.
* Marketing, Sales and CX technology setups work together to support ABM, demand generation and broader revenue objectives.
* Solution Architects and delivery teams have the business context and requirements needed to execute effectively.
* Client engagements remain aligned with business outcomes, with measurable improvements in operational efficiency, GTM execution and revenue performance.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 5–8 years in MarTech, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, solutions consulting or technology implementation, ideally within a B2B SaaS, MarTech or consulting environment.
* Business Consulting: Experience conducting discovery with senior stakeholders, identifying root causes and translating business challenges into actionable solution plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of how B2B Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience teams operate, including their processes, data flows and technology requirements.
* ABM & Demand Generation: Practical understanding of B2B demand generation and ABM programs, including how technology enables targeting, campaign orchestration, engagement and performance measurement.
* Technology Implementation: Demonstrated experience implementing or architecting technology setups for Marketing, Sales and/or CX teams, including workflows, integrations, data structures and process automation.
* Platform Knowledge: Strong hands-on knowledge of HubSpot and familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level. Experience with multiple platforms across the MarTech and ABM ecosystem is a plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Confidence working with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and cross-functional teams, translating between business priorities and technical execution.
* Execution & Ownership: Ability to turn strategy into a practical implementation plan, manage competing priorities and stay accountable for outcomes.
* How you think: Curious about how businesses work, technically sound, commercially aware and comfortable navigating ambiguity without relying on a fixed playbook.

****Why join us****

* Solve real business problems: Work directly with senior leaders to address business challenges through technology and execution.
* Bridge strategy and implementation: Own the journey from discovery and solution planning to implementation alongside experienced technical teams.
* Work across the revenue ecosystem: Gain exposure to leading MarTech, CRM, ABM and AI platforms and complex B2B GTM environments.
* Join a top-tier ecosystem: As a HubSpot Elite Partner, we work with ambitious businesses and a strong technology ecosystem.
* Grow with the business: Be part of a growing team where ownership, problem-solving and impact create opportunities to take on more responsibility.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build and the outcomes you drive.

* **Explore partnerships and new markets:**
