* **Build with AI and automation:**
  Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI-powered platforms to automate workflows, analyse data, prototype solutions, and improve execution speed.
* **Create executive-ready communication:**
  Develop strategy documents, business reviews, presentations, and decision memos that communicate complex problems and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* **Build scalable operating mechanisms:**
  Establish processes, governance frameworks, and performance metrics that improve execution discipline and help new initiatives scale efficiently.

**Who Will Do Well Here**

* **Experience:**
  3–6 years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), corporate strategy, business operations, a high-growth startup, or a founder's/business office role.
* **Strong business acumen:**
  Ability to understand business models, identify growth opportunities, and connect strategic decisions to commercial outcomes.
* **Analytical rigour:**
  Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, financial modelling, market research, and the ability to build and defend assumptions with data.
* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Demonstrated experience taking a project or initiative from problem definition through execution and measurable results, rather than stopping at recommendations.
* **Cross-functional leadership:**
  Ability to influence stakeholders across teams, manage competing priorities, and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.
* **AI-first mindset:**
  Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve productivity, automate work, analyse information, or build functional prototypes.
* **Structured communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex analysis into clear recommendations and actionable plans.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:**
  A proactive, resourceful approach to solving open-ended problems in a fast-moving environment.
* **Commercial orientation:**
  Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical considerations such as revenue potential, cost, feasibility, and time to impact.

**Why This Role?**

* **Build what's next:**
  Work on new business opportunities that can meaningfully shape Spyne's next phase of growth.

* **Work across the business:**

title: Senior Manager - Risk Management (Merchant Operations)
description:
**Job Description**
**You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.**
At American Express, our culture is built on a long history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviours, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. We operate with a strong risk mindset while continuously improving how we serve merchants and manage critical business processes.
  
  
Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together we help define the future of American Express.
  
  
**How Will You Make Impact In This Role.**
Merchant Account Operations & Resilience supports critical merchant-data, operational-risk, remediation, and transformation activities. Accurate merchant data and effective operational processes are essential to pricing, servicing, risk management, reporting, and decision-making.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Risk Management will lead a team focused on
**Merchant Hierarchy process transformation, enterprise remediation, and strategic program delivery**
.
  
  
The role will identify opportunities to simplify and uplift hierarchy review processes using AI, automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and operating-model improvements. It will also lead or support complex remediation and cross-functional programs by bringing strong governance, execution discipline, change management, and leadership visibility.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine operational experience, program leadership, analytical fluency, transformation thinking, stakeholder management and people leadership. The role will partner closely with teams responsible for ongoing Merchant Hierarchy governance and day-to-day hierarchy reviews.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Drive Merchant Hierarchy process transformation**

* Develop and execute a prioritized roadmap to simplify, standardize, automate, and modernize Merchant Hierarchy review processes in partnership with the teams responsible for governance and operational delivery.
* Translate operational pain points into structured improvement opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and data quality, strengthen controls, and create scalable capabilities.
* Coordinate cross-functional partners, dependencies, decisions, operating-model changes, and adoption activities required to deliver sustainable enterprise-wide process uplift.

**Advance AI, automation, and analytics**

* Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI, automation, analytics, workflow tools, external data, and emerging technologies to improve operational processes and outcomes.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Operations teams to evaluate solutions and progress them from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and benefits measurement.
* Ensure new capabilities address clear business needs and are supported by appropriate data, controls, ownership, governance, and performance monitoring.

**Lead remediation and strategic program execution**

* Lead or provide PMO support for complex remediation, operational-risk, control-enhancement, and strategic-change initiatives across functions and markets.
* Establish effective program governance, including clear scope, milestones, ownership, decision rights, dependencies, risks, escalation paths, and success measures.
* Drive change management, operational readiness, and executive reporting while maintaining accountability through implementation, stabilization, and benefits realization.

**Strengthen stakeholder partnerships and team effectiveness**

* Serve as a trusted stakeholder anchor across business, Operations, Servicing, Pricing, Client Management, Product, Technology, Analytics, Risk, Compliance, Policy, and Control Management.
* Demonstrate executive presence and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners without direct authority through structured thinking, sound judgement, constructive challenge, and clear communication.
* Lead and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities across program governance, remediation, operational transformation, analytics, automation, and stakeholder management.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in a global or highly matrixed organization.
* Strong program-governance capability across planning, ownership, dependencies, risk management, escalation, and outcome measurement.
* Experience within operations, servicing, risk, controls, remediation, transformation, or another operationally intensive environment.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and shape process improvements involving AI, automation, analytics, workflow redesign, simplification, or operational efficiencies.
* Strong analytical fluency and the ability to translate complex or ambiguous challenges into structured recommendations and executable plans.
* Strong executive presence, credibility, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence senior partners without direct authority.
* Proven people-leadership experience, including setting direction, coaching talent, and building team capability.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within merchant operations, onboarding, account maintenance, servicing, pricing, payments, or a related function.
* Knowledge of merchant account structures, hierarchy processes, data enrichment, or Know Your Customer processes.
* Experience delivering operational transformation, AI, automation, workflow, analytics, or technology-enabled process improvements.
* Experience supporting operational-risk events, corrective-action plans, remediation, or control-enhancement programs.
* Familiarity with analytical and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms.
* Experience working across multiple markets or global teams.

**Critical Factors To Success**

* Apply strong program governance and execution discipline across transformation and remediation initiatives.
* Convert AI, automation, analytics, and process-improvement opportunities into scalable and sustainable operational capabilities.
* Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality, controls, and operational outcomes.
* Bring structure, transparency, and accountability to complex cross-functional programs.
* Build trusted partnerships and influence decisions without direct authority.

**Leadership Behaviors**
The successful candidate should consistently demonstrate the American Express Leadership Behaviours by:
  
  

* Defining What Winning Looks Like: Establishing clear priorities, outcomes, delivery plans, and success measures.
* Putting Enterprise Thinking First: Balancing business value, merchant and customer outcomes, colleague impact, operational feasibility, and the control environment.
* Making Collaboration Essential: Building trusted partnerships while maintaining clarity on ownership, accountability, and decision rights.
* Seeking and Providing Coaching and Feedback: Strengthening team capability through regular, candid, and actionable development conversations.
* Communicating Frequently, Candidly, and Clearly: Providing transparent information on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, benefits, and required actions.
* Making Decisions Quickly and Effectively: Evaluating alternatives and balancing speed, business value, data, implementation effort, risk, and sustainable outcomes.
* Demonstrating Courageous and Authentic Leadership: Raising concerns proactively, challenging assumptions, and creating an environment where colleagues can speak up.
* Leading with a Digital and Improvement Mindset: Challenging how work is performed and identifying scalable opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational outcomes.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Lead Engineer
description:

* Strong knowledge of GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, FEA, mechanical design, and materials

* Experience with PLM/PDM systems and engineering change processes
* Experience with NPI, design reviews, FMEA, qualification testing, root-cause analysis, and CAPA
* Experience working directly with manufacturing and quality organizations
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with Houston and global engineering teams
* Experience supporting products manufactured within API/ISO-certified organizations is preferred

Thank you for your interest in a career with Varel Energy Solutions.

title: Program Manager, BXT-SE
description:
**Description**
Join Amazon’s Employee Services team and help make a difference for all Amazonians! We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to own and oversee the operations of Amazon's Medical Clinics across 40+ office locations in India. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for ensuring continuous, uninterrupted availability of clinical services — including on-site medicines and qualified nursing staff — at every clinic, at all times. You will manage vendor and staff transitions seamlessly, drive standardization and compliance across sites, and partner with a broad set of stakeholders spanning Procurement, GREF (Global Real Estate & Facilities), clinical teams, local site leaders, and HR partners. This is a role for a self-starter who thrives on operational excellence, ambiguity, and scaling employee health services across a large, geographically distributed footprint.
  
  
Note - This is a contract only role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Clinic Operations Oversight: Own end-to-end operations of medical clinics across 40+ Amazon office locations in India, ensuring consistent service quality, availability, and compliance with applicable regulations and Amazon standards.
  
  
Continuity of Care: Guarantee uninterrupted availability of essential medicines, medical supplies, and nursing/clinical staff at all clinics at all times, including proactive planning for demand, stock-outs, and coverage gaps.
  
  
Transition & Change Management: Plan and manage all staff and vendor transitions (onboarding, offboarding, replacements, contract changes) with zero disruption to clinic availability or employee experience.
  
  
Vendor Management: Partner with Procurement to select, onboard, and govern clinical service and pharmacy vendors; monitor SLAs, service quality, and contractual compliance, and drive corrective action where needed.
  
  
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Procurement, GREF, clinical teams, local site leaders, and HR partners to align on clinic setup, facilities readiness, staffing, and service delivery.
  
  
Standardization & Scale: Develop and implement standardized processes, playbooks, and mechanisms to ensure consistent clinic operations across all locations, and to scale efficiently as the footprint grows.
  
  
Compliance & Risk: Ensure clinics operate in accordance with local statutory, medical, and licensing requirements; identify and mitigate operational and clinical risks.
  
  
Metrics & Reporting: Define, track, and report on key operational metrics (availability, staffing coverage, medicine stock levels, incident response, employee utilization/satisfaction) and drive data-informed improvements.
  
  
Escalation Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for clinic-related operational issues, resolving them promptly and implementing preventive measures.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start your day by reviewing the operational dashboard across all 40+ clinics — checking overnight incidents, medicine stock levels, and any staffing gaps flagged by site teams. You spot that a clinic in Hyderabad has a nurse on unplanned leave; you coordinate with the vendor and HR partner to arrange immediate backup coverage so there's no service interruption.
  
  
Work with Procurement on any contractual needs, a pharmacy vendor and align on SLAs for medicine replenishment timelines. You then sync with GREF on facilities readiness for clinic, ensuring the spaces meet clinical requirements and licensing standards.
  
  
meet with the clinical team to review a new standardized triage protocol, connect with a local site leader across India who have concerns about clinic timings/availability/Medicines. You update your weekly metrics report — tracking availability, staffing coverage, and stock.
  
  
You wrap up by documenting a transition plan for an upcoming vendor change at three sites, ensuring a smooth handover with no disruption to employees relying on the clinics.
  
  
Note - This is a contract only role.
  
  
**About The Team**
Team administers benefits for 58 countries and supports ~1.5MM employees (997K US and 522K non-US). The major service areas include: (1) benefits administrative services, (2) MyBenefits product support, (3) shared quality services; (4) Employee Investment Services (EIS) administration, (5) U.S. regulatory work, (6) benefits reconciliation and (7) US Benefit services
  
  
Note - This is a contract only role.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above
* 4+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in conducting investigative work, including claimant, witness, and target employee interviews, investigative data analysis, and production of investigative documentation
* Experience developing policies and supporting documentation
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards

title: Senior Consultant, India-Europe Projects
description:
Jain-Richter Group connects Indian and European companies with the right partner on the other side. You find those partners, run the projects that bring them together, and sit at the table with the Managing Partner.

**The practical terms first**

* ₹45,000 to ₹60,000 a month depending on experience, on a consultancy agreement
* Plus performance-based pay
* Remote from Delhi NCR, Monday to Saturday, starting by 07:30 IST
* In person with clients in Delhi NCR 10 to 15 days a quarter

**What is on the desk now**

You work across all four services, because the work arrives that way. Every project is confidential, so these are described without names.

**Technology transfer & joint ventures**

* A European biogas technology owner wants Indian EPC contractors to take its licence.
* A German engineering firm builds biogas plants for Indian clients.
* A joint venture is moving from term sheet to company.

**Investment & acquisitions**

* Indian investors are looking at German companies, hotels and real estate.
* A European pharmaceutical site needs a buyer.
* Investors want Indian greentech opportunities.

**Market entry & access**

* German Mittelstand companies are preparing to enter India.
* Indian technology companies want a way into German industry.

**Trade & sourcing**

* Trading houses want agricultural commodities and edible oils.
* New enquiries need qualifying before anyone spends time on them.

**The work**

**Find and qualify the right companies (about 35%)**

* Build the target list for each project: manufacturers, EPC contractors, investors, Mittelstand companies, suppliers and buyers.
* Check what each company claims against sources a client can verify: filings, certification registers, trade fair exhibitor lists, trade data.
* Deliver a ranked shortlist with a short case for each name, and a separate list of what you could not verify.

**Run the projects (about 30%)**

* Own the tracker for four to six live projects, so every thread carries an owner and a dated next step.
* Prepare a one-page brief for every meeting, route NDAs and keep the documents in order.
* Send minutes and follow-ups the same day, and chase every open thread to a yes, a no or a date.

**Work with clients and partners (about 25%)**

* Join client and partner calls and the meetings in Delhi NCR, and present your own research.
* Be the day-to-day contact for information requests.
* Represent the firm at trade fairs and come back with qualified contacts and written notes.

**Improve how the firm works (about 10%)**

* Fix what slows the work down: the project tracker, the CRM, research and handover templates, and the AI research workflows.
* Write down each process you improve, so the next person can run it without asking.
* Propose one improvement a month, agree it with the Managing Partner, and put it in use. Client deadlines always come first.

**How we work together**

**We work across two time zones: the Managing Partner in Singapore, you in India. A few simple habits keep us in step and make sure your work keeps moving without waiting on anyone.**

1. **Progress over perfection.**
   We work on an 80/20 basis. A clear first answer early is worth more than a perfect one late, so share what you have as soon as it is enough to decide the next step.
2. **Raise it early.**
   If something is not working after about two hours, let us know and suggest a way forward. Getting stuck is normal; staying stuck alone is what we want to avoid.
3. **Align before you dive in.**
   For anything that will take longer than a day, send a short note first: how you understand the task, how you plan to approach it, and when you expect to finish.
4. **A short daily update.**
   At the end of your day, by 17:00 IST, a few lines on what you completed, anything that is blocked, and your priorities for tomorrow.
5. **Stay connected in the mornings.**
   A short call each morning, and replies within a couple of hours between 07:30 and 13:00 IST.

"I could not verify this" is always a good answer. We value honesty over a confident guess.

**What this role is not**

* Not an executive assistant role. No calendar management, inbox triage, travel booking or errands.
* Not a sales role. You find and qualify companies. The Managing Partner pitches, prices, negotiates and signs. That boundary is legal, not a judgement about you.
* Not web development or design.

**You**

* Mid to senior level: at least five years in consulting, market research, transaction support, investment promotion, a chamber of commerce or an embassy's commercial section.
* You can name a project you ran from start to finish and what it changed.
* You write English that goes to a German managing director or an Indian promoter family with light edits or none. You speak Hindi well enough to call a company and ask a short set of questions.
* Excel or Sheets to a working standard. You use AI research tools and check every fact against its original source.
* You live in Delhi NCR, meet in person on a few days' notice, and work on your own laptop.
* German is a real advantage, and is paid as one.
* The role is open to anyone, whatever their gender, community or marital status.

**Your first 90 days**

* Day 30: the tracker is live for every open project, nothing sits without a dated next step, and the daily handover runs unasked. One ranked target list delivered.
* Day 60: you run the weekly rhythm of one project on your own, and own the follow-ups from at least two client meetings.
* Day 90: at least one project has moved a full stage, with you as the working contact on our side. One improved process is written down and in use.

**Pay**

The monthly fee is fixed and paid against your invoice. Performance-based pay is at the firm's discretion and scored on four things you control:

* Delivery: milestones met on the agreed date, or moved in writing before they were missed.
* Research quality: sources a client can check, a ranking with reasons, an honest unverified list.
* Project control: every thread with an owner and a next step, and a handover on every working day.
* Client and partner feedback: how the people on the other side describe working with you.

Performance-based pay is never linked to a deal, a commission or a transaction value. That is a legal requirement, and it keeps the incentive on the quality of the work.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. Then email your answers to the two questions below, in no more than 150 words each, to join@jain-richtergroup.com with the subject line "Senior Consultant, your name".

1. Describe one project you ran from start to finish. What was the outcome, and what did you personally do?
2. Tell us about a time you stopped working on something because it was not going anywhere. How long did it take you to notice, and who did you tell?

Applications without the two answers are not read.

Shortlisted candidates have one interview of 45 minutes with the Managing Partner, a two-hour case study, and a paid trial week on real work before any agreement is signed. We reply to everyone within seven days, and if we say no, we say why in a line.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Prism Projects is an end-to-end execution partner that transforms approved designs into customer-ready spaces for brands expanding their physical presence. The company manages the full journey from design approval to opening day, overseeing planning, procurement, manufacturing, on-site execution, quality checks, and final handover with a single accountable team. Prism Projects delivers retail stores, experience centers, corporate offices, custom furniture and fixtures, and complete civil, MEP, and finishing services with pan-India coverage. Its model emphasizes speed through parallel site execution and factory manufacturing, consistent quality through structured checks, and transparent project tracking for scalable rollouts across multiple locations. The founding team has completed over 300 projects for more than 50 brands across India, focusing on reliable, repeatable execution.

**Role Description**
The Site Supervisor role is an on-site position based in Delhi, however site specific travel to PAN India shall be required, supporting project execution from mobilization to handover. The selected individuals will assist in coordinating day-to-day site activities, including monitoring work progress, ensuring adherence to drawings and specifications, and supporting contractors and vendors to meet timelines. The role involves tracking material deliveries, verifying quantities and quality, and escalating issues related to delays, safety, or workmanship to senior project managers. The Site Supervisor intern will help document site status through daily reports, photos, and checklists, contribute to quality inspections, and support compliance with safety standards and company processes. This internship offers hands-on exposure to retail, office, and experiential build-outs, working closely with project managers, designers, and factory teams.

**Qualifications**

* Foundational knowledge of construction or interior fit-out processes, including civil work, MEP, finishing, and installation.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, interior, and technical drawings, with attention to detail and quality standards.
* Strong site coordination skills, including scheduling, task follow-up, vendor/contractor liaison, and basic project tracking.
* Commitment to safety and compliance, with a focus on maintaining clean, organized work areas and following established procedures.
* Effective communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and clearly reporting site issues and progress.
* Proficiency in basic productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, documentation platforms, email) for reporting and record-keeping.
* Relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, interior design, construction management, or a related field (students or recent graduates encouraged to apply).
* Ability to work full-time on-site in Delhi, adapt to fast-paced project environments, and travel to different sites within the city as needed.

title: Teaching Coordinator (Adults)
description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For over 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
  
  
*We work with people in over 150 countries and reach over 700 million people.*
**We connect. We inspire.**
**Pay Band:**
Higher Teacher payband
  
  
**Country/Location:**
Delhi, India
  
  
**Department:**
English Language Services
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Fixed Term Contract, 2 years
  
  
**Closing Date:**
Wednesday, 4th November 2026 - 23:59 Malaysia Time (GMT +8)
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The role is responsible for promoting high-quality English language teaching and effective learning while supporting the British Council’s wider objectives and cultural relations mission. It involves guiding, supporting, and developing teachers in delivering a full range of courses, providing training, coordinating and developing teaching materials, and contributing to the management of teaching quality, academic programme content, and day-to-day operations.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
The role is responsible for delivering high-quality English language teaching in line with British Council Global Teaching Standards, meeting learner needs and supporting the organisation’s global English strategy. Key responsibilities include teaching across various course types, developing teaching and assessment materials, supporting teacher development through training and lesson observations, line-managing teachers, assisting with teacher recruitment and talent retention, and deputising for Senior Teachers when required. The role also involves contributing to teaching centre operations, administrative duties, continuous professional development, and the sharing of best practices, while promoting the British Council’s reputation in English language teaching and ensuring compliance with safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI), and health and safety policies.
  
  
**Essential Requirements**
**Role specific skills, knowledge and experience**
**Qualifications**

* Cambridge DELTA/DipTESOL or Trinity Cert TESOL.
* At least one further specialist qualification, such as YL extension to CELTA, IELTS examiner status, e-moderator certificate.
* Undergraduate degree or equivalent.

Knowledge and Skills
  
  
As appropriate within Global British Council Teaching Standards at a HIGHER level
  
  

* Demonstrate subject knowledge.
* Engage and motivate learners.
* Create a positive and inclusive learning environment.
* Plan and deliver coherent lessons.
* Make use of assessment and feedback.
* Manage teaching and learning resources.
* Uphold professional responsibilities and values.

Evidence of high performance in class (from evaluations, observation reports, feedback)
  
  
Ability, or demonstrable interest in at least some of the following:
  
  

* syllabus design, teacher timetabling, class scheduling, course planning, teacher observations, teacher training, line management and professional development of teachers.

Working with Children and Vulnerable Adults
  
  

* Ability to work in a way that promotes the safety and well-being of children and vulnerable adults.
* Effective communication and engagement with children/protected adults and their families.
* Knowledge and understanding of child development and its impact on learning and behaviour.
* Experience of supporting learners to meet Equality, Diversity and Inclusion principles.

**Experience**
4 years post-certificate i.e. CELTA/Trinity cert TESOL experience including substantial experience in all of the following
  
  

* Young learners aged 800+ hours
* Adults English 1500+ hours, including IELTS
* At least 2 years experience in training and mentoring teachers
* Experience in materials development
* At least 2 years experience in managing quality to formal standards frameworks
* Line management experience, preferably academic/teacher
* At least 2 years experience in managing the classroom/customer services interface for business objectives (for example dealing with complaints, re-registrations, parent/student engagement, contracts, client meetings, school partners)

Desirable Requirements
  
  

* Experience of structured teacher development programmes from initial teacher training to advanced levels.
* IELTS Examiner and training status
* Online teaching qualification and experience Problem based learning
* Masters level qualifications in applied linguistics, ELT, management

**Important Information**

* Language: Strong English proficiency is crucial for this role, requiring fluency in both written and spoken communication to effectively navigate British Council systems and international operations.
* Work schedule: Teaching is conducted throughout the week, with teachers working five days per week, including weekends as required. Flexibility and maximum availability on Saturdays and Sundays are expected, as these are the busiest teaching days. Weekend working days are generally consecutive, although this cannot be guaranteed. Classes may be scheduled in the mornings or evenings, and while split shifts are uncommon, they may occasionally be required to meet operational needs.
* Locally recruited: Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work. Relocation support is not provided for this role.
* Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
* Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and we welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability, and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent and we guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people, and adults who we work with. **science of measurement**

.

,

,
**Pipplet**

**Vericant**

and

**nearly 50 million assessments annually**

In India, ETS plays a growing and strategic role in

****Role Overview****
The
**Assessment Expert**
serves as a
**senior psychometric and educational measurement leader**
, providing technical and strategic direction for
**large-scale education assessment initiatives**
. This role is critical to ensuring that ETS-led and ETS-supported assessments are
**psychometrically sound, policy-relevant, and operationally successful**
for external clients—particularly
**government and public-sector education bodies**
.
  
  
You will lead and oversee
**statistical design, psychometric analysis, research studies, and technical advisory work**
, while representing ETS India as a trusted expert partner. The role includes
**team leadership, mentoring, capacity building**
, and close collaboration with
**ETS global experts and headquarters teams.**
**Location: Delhi**
**Employment Type: Full-time**
****Key Responsibilities****
****Psychometric & Technical Leadership****

* Provide expert guidance in psychometrics, educational measurement, and large-scale assessment design.
* Define and lead the statistical and research components of education assessment programs.
* Frame complex technical and implementation challenges and propose evidence-based solutions.
* Design, conduct, and oversee research and psychometric studies, ensuring technical rigor, validity, and accuracy.
* Review statistical outputs and findings for reasonableness, quality, and policy relevance.

****Client Advisory & Representation****

* Serve as a senior technical advisor to external clients on assessment, measurement, and data-related topics.
* Translate complex psychometric concepts into clear, actionable insights for decision-makers.
* Prepare and deliver technical reports, policy-ready documentation, and executive-level presentations.
* Represent ETS India and ETS globally in client engagements, workshops, and review forums.

****Team Leadership & Capability Building****

* Coordinate and guide the work of Junior Psychometricians and subject matter experts in India.
* Collaborate closely with ETS global research and psychometric teams to ensure alignment to enterprise standards.
* Conduct seminars, workshops, and briefings for ETS staff, clients, test committees, and policy bodies.
* Coach and mentor staff, supporting professional development and technical excellence.
* Participate in interviewing, onboarding, and training of new team members.

****Knowledge Sharing & Professional Contribution****

* Support capacity building for client and ETS India teams on principles of psychometrics and educational measurement.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, and professional forums.
* Represent ETS through engagement with professional bodies and academic communities, as appropriate.

**Qualifications Required**

* Postgraduate degree in Education, Educational Measurement, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
* Formal certification or specialized training in assessment and psychometrics.
* 10+ years of professional experience in assessment development or educational measurement, preferably within large-scale or system-level contexts.
* Demonstrated experience working on government or public-sector education assessment initiatives.
* Proven ability to work effectively in multi-stakeholder environments, including with education boards, ministries, or system-level bodies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing technical reports and presentations.

****Preferred / Desirable****

* Experience developing and delivering training modules on pedagogy, assessment, or data use.
* Familiarity with Indian education institutions and structures, such as SCERTs, DIETs, or state education systems.
* Broad understanding of education and assessment frameworks.

****Why Join ETS in India****

* Contribute to high-impact education and assessment initiatives that shape learning outcomes at scale.
* Be part of a mission-driven, research-led organization with global credibility and public purpose.
* Work at the intersection of policy, research, and large-scale implementation.
* Collaborate with world-class psychometricians and researchers across ETS globally.
* Access professional growth opportunities supported by Business Resource Groups (BRGs) and learning communities.

title: Associate Manager - Drone Ecosystem
description:
**About QCI**

The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030.

**Role Summary**

As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.

The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone-as-a-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.

**Role & Responsibility-**

QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:

* **Scheme Design & Development**
  : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.
* **Research, Analysis & Knowledge Products**
  : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.
* **Report Writing & Deck Preparation:**
  Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.
* **Scheme Operations**
  : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.
* **Business Development & Marketing of the Scheme**
  : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.

**Eligibility Criteria & Requirements-**

**Educational Qualification**
:

* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.
* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.

**Experience-**

* Minimum 3 years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.
* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.
* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.
* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.
* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.
* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.

**Technical Capabilities-**

**Strong Research Skills:**
Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.

**Structured Thinking & Writing:**
Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well-written outputs.

**Data Analysis:**
Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.

**Visualization & Presentation Skills:**
Strong data-visualization skills using MS Office Suite, with Tableau/Power BI proficiency being an added advantage; ability to create well-structured and visually compelling presentations.

**Behavioural Capabilities-**

**High Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in how India’s public policy and governance systems work; naturally follows current affairs and asks “why.”

**Integrity & Accountability:**
Takes ownership of tasks, delivers on commitments, and upholds the highest ethical standards in all work and workplace interactions.

**Meticulous Attention to Detail:**
Able to identify typos, formatting errors, inconsistencies, and mismatched numbers that others may overlook.

**Proactive & “Get-it-Done” Attitude:**
Self-starter who takes complete ownership of tasks, anticipates what needs to be done, and delivers results without waiting for instructions.

title: Independent Consultant, Market Shaping - Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead (Pb) exposure is a silent yet devastating global health crisis, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Research from UNICEF and other partners estimates that 1 in 2 children in LMICs have elevated blood lead levels, contributing neurological damage, reduced cognitive development, and a variety of health impacts.
  
  
Lead exposure in India arises from multiple sources, with leaded decorative paints and used lead-acid batteries (ULABs) representing the two most significant. Despite a regulatory limit of 90 ppm for lead in decorative paints, widespread non-compliance among SME manufacturers means lead chromate pigments continue to enter the paint supply chain. ULABs are the single largest source of secondary lead in India, with approximately 1.1 million metric tonnes generated annually across the automotive, telecom, inverter, and UPS sectors; informal recycling of spent batteries releases lead into surrounding communities, disproportionately affecting children.
  
  
WJCF has launched a new Lead Exposure Program, building on its proven market shaping capabilities and experience partnering with governments to address large-scale and cross-sectoral health challenges. Program priorities include
  
  

* Devising and implementing strategies to support paint SME manufacturers in transitioning from lead inputs to safer and sustainable alternatives (organic pigments)
* Scoping gaps and intervention areas for market-shaping opportunities across the lead exposure program, spanning diagnostics (pXRF), treatment (chelating agents), and source-side mitigation (plastics, other sources)

The incumbent will support across multiple market shaping workstreams as detailed below.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and entrepreneurial individual to support the design, implementation, and monitoring of WJCF’s market shaping interventions. The role involves market assessment, value chain analysis, stakeholder interviews, policy analysis, and financial modelling. It spans government, private sector, and civil society actors, and sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, environmental health, and government engagement.
  
  

* Location New Delhi, with domestic travel to pilot states.
* Duration Up to 6 months, extendable based on performance
* Market Strategies to Transition Paint SMEs to Safer Alternatives

**Transition to Lead-Free Paints**

* Support the scoping and implementation of targeted pilot interventions to enable industry transition to lead-free paints, including addressing SME barriers to transition, supply chain solutions, and related market-shaping measures.

**Pilot Planning & Design**

* Develop detailed pilot blueprints for selected interventions implementation plans, resource requirements, partnerships, budgets, timelines, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.
* The intervention hypotheses under consideration are

+ Aggregate raw material demand Test the feasibility of aggregating demand from medium-sized paint manufacturers to secure lower-cost lead-free inputs and incentivize greater reformulation of paints to lead-free alternatives.
+ Leverage institutional procurement Identify high-volume institutional paint buyers and work with them to adopt lead-free procurement commitments, creating demand-side pressure for manufacturers to reformulate their products.

* Prepare implementation toolkits and support materials for roll-out as needed.

**Exploring Lead-Free Pigment Transitions in Non-Paint Sources**

* Mapping lead and lead-free pigment supply chains, assess switching barriers, and evaluate the feasibility of lead-free alternatives in other sources (plastics, turmeric)
* Identify opportunities and support concept to proposal writing, including defining and prioritizing intervention areas.
* Market Shaping for Portable XRF (pXRF)

**Accelerate access to affordable pXRF for research and routine government environmental testing**

* Conduct a supplier and distribution landscape of pXRF devices
* Assess device availability and pricing across suppliers
* Map demand with stakeholders, including current pXRF use and unmet needs
* Understand procurement pathways and regulatory frameworks
* Assess end-user needs to evaluate product-market fit
* Market shaping for Chelating Agents

**Enable access to affordable oral chelation therapy**

* Expanding access to chelation drugs through improved sourcing and procurement to reduce costs and enable addition in essential drug lists
* Assessing alternative formulations or delivery approaches that could improve affordability and feasibility in low-resource settings
* Cross-cutting

**Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting**

* Support proposal development, including concept notes, funding proposals, and progress reports.
* Support stakeholder management across donor, government, private sector, and civil society partners.
* Maintain programme tracking tools and contribute to milestone monitoring.
* Scope can potentially evolve basis developing understanding of the above lead exposure program areas
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, public policy, or a related field; a postgraduate degree is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with a strong analytical focus, such as market assessment, supply chain analysis, commercial strategy, or policy analysis. Strategy consulting experience is preferred.
* Experience in primary research, such as stakeholder interviews, value chain mapping, or market assessments in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and comfort building unit economics or financial models.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify and pursue high-impact opportunities in complex, uncertain, and changing environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs, and presentations for government, donors, and technical audiences.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, lead workstreams end-to-end, and to propose and carry out new initiatives.

title: Senior Technical Consultant, India Safe Water (EAII Advisors)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here:
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
  
  
(i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water-treatment arrangements; and
  
  
(ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems
  
  
The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
  
  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan)
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution - addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet-based dozers and other chlorination options

The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
  
  
**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**

* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states

**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**

* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non-viable across different rural water-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising

**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**

* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale-up

**Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership

**Position Location**
**This is a 6-month consultancy engagement,**
with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Consultancy Fees:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
**All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

title: Manager- Data Governance and Responsible AI
description:
**Position: Manager – Data Governance and Responsible AI**
**Location: India- Chennai, New Delhi or Bengaluru. Hybrid, with travel to Athena offices, project sites and field partners in India and occasionally abroad**
**Position Type: Full Time**
**Experience: 8–12 years**
**About Athena**
Athena Infonomics is a research, advisory and implementation firm working with governments, multilateral institutions, foundations and companies on development and public-policy problems. We operate across India, the United States, EU, Asia and Africa. The group also includes TolaData, an impact-measurement software platform, and early-stage work in AI and digital public infrastructure.
  
  
Our work runs on data that is often personal, sensitive or confidential: household and beneficiary surveys, qualitative interviews with vulnerable groups, health and social-protection records, government administrative datasets, and proprietary client data. Much of it is collected in the field by our staff, enumerators and partners, then stored, analysed, shared and archived across several countries and tools. Our teams also use AI every day, on that same data.
  
  
Two things make this role necessary now. India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act and its Rules take effect in stages through 2026 and 2027, alongside GDPR and other regimes we already work under. And our use of AI has grown faster than the guardrails around it. We want one organisation-wide way of governing, protecting and using data that is practical for field teams and credible to clients, regulators and investors. This role builds and owns it.
  
  
**The role**
You will own how the Athena group governs, protects and uses data, including how it uses AI on client and participant data. You will design the framework, write the policies and tools, put them into daily use across practices and offices, and keep them current as law, clients and technology change. You will be the person clients, auditors and regulators talk to about our data practices, and the person our project teams call when a hard case comes up in the field.
  
  
This is a build-and-own role, not a compliance desk. You start with an independent diagnostic of where we stand; your job is to turn its findings into a working system and then run it. The measure of success is that a project manager in Chennai, a field coordinator in Nairobi and a product engineer at TolaData each know what they may do with data, do it without asking, and can show it if asked.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build and own the data governance framework
* Take the findings of the independent diagnostic and turn them into a right-sized policy suite: data governance, data protection and privacy, information security, classification and handling, retention and disposal, third-party and field-partner data, breach and incident response, data sharing and publication.
* Set the governance model: who owns which data, who decides, and how the policies are kept current. Run the Data Governance Steering Group's cadence.
* Build the operating toolkit teams actually use: project data management plans (with a light version for low-risk work), consent frameworks for written, verbal, digital and low-literacy settings, DPIA and screening checklists, data sharing and processing agreement templates, field data protocols, project start-up and close-out checklists.
* Maintain the data inventory and record of processing activities across entities.
* Make the group compliant and keep it there
* Own readiness for India's DPDP Act and Rules across their phased deadlines, and for GDPR, UK GDPR, Kenya's Data Protection Act and client-specific requirements in the countries where we work.
* Act as, or stand up, the Data Protection Officer function; be the named contact for clients, data principals and regulators.
* Review data clauses in client contracts, sub-contracts and vendor agreements, working with external counsel where needed.
* Run breach and incident response when it is needed, and the drills before it is.
* Prepare TolaData for the certifications its customers and investors will expect (ISO 27001 and SOC 2 readiness), working with the product and engineering team and specialist consultants.
* Govern how we use AI
* Build and maintain the AI tool register and approval process: which tools, which data classes, under what vendor terms, with what human oversight.
* Write and keep current the Responsible AI policy, covering staff use of generative AI on client and participant data and the AI features in products we build for clients and in TolaData.
* Design AI risk assessment into the project lifecycle so teams can use AI productively with clear guardrails rather than being blocked by default.
* Stay close to how our teams and products actually use AI, and keep the rules practical as the tools change.
* Put it into daily practice
* Train leaders, project managers, data analysts, field coordinators and partner enumerators, using our own cases; build the short modules new staff and partners go through before they handle data.
* Work alongside project teams on live engagements: review data management plans, sit in on field design, resolve hard cases quickly.
* Run a light audit cycle: sample projects each year, trace data from collection to disposal, publish what was found and what changed.
* Track a small set of indicators the Co-Founders review each quarter, and report to clients and auditors when asked.

**How The Role Works**

* Scope. You are employed by Athena Infonomics, but the mandate spans the group. Expect a substantial share of your time on TolaData, which processes client monitoring data as a software platform and is preparing for institutional investment, and some on the group's AI ventures and its US federal work.
* Reporting. You report to the Co-Founder and a small Data Governance Steering Group that meets monthly. Practice heads, IT, the TolaData product lead and legal counsel sit on it. You set its agenda.
* Independence. You are expected to say no, in writing, when a project, product or client request cannot be done safely, and to propose what can. The Co-Founders will back that.
* Proportionate by design. Controls must match the sensitivity of the data and the risk. Low-risk work stays light. A framework field teams cannot follow in a low-connectivity, multi-language setting is a failed framework.
* Specialists on call. You will have a budget for external counsel, penetration testing and certification consultants. You decide when to use them; you do not need to be a lawyer or a security engineer yourself.
* Time zones and travel. The group works across India, East Africa, Europe and the United States. Some early-morning or evening calls are part of the job, as is travel to Athena offices, project sites and field partners.
* Discretion. You will see client data, contracts, incident reports and investor material from day one. Judgement about what to share, with whom, and when is a core requirement.
* Tools. We use AI tools every day for research, drafting and analysis. You should already work this way, and be able to govern it from the inside.

**Who We Are Looking For**
**Must have**

* 8–12 years of experience, with a substantial part spent building or running a data protection, privacy or data governance programme inside an organisation or for clients. You have implemented, not only advised.
* Working command of India's DPDP Act and Rules and of GDPR, and the ability to read a new regime or a client's data requirements and turn them into practice.
* Experience writing policies, procedures and templates that people actually used, and training people to use them.
* Enough information security literacy to run an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 readiness effort and to manage a security consultant well. You do not need to be the engineer.
* Practical understanding of how generative AI tools handle data (training, retention, hosting, account types) and of what responsible use looks like in an organisation.
* Excellent written English. Policies, guidance and client responses that a non-specialist can follow and a specialist cannot fault.
* Judgement and steadiness: comfortable taking a firm position with senior colleagues and clients, and finding the workable answer rather than the safest-sounding one.
* Fluent daily use of AI tools in your own work.

**Strongly Preferred**

* A recognised privacy or AI governance credential: CIPP/E, CIPM, DSCI DCPP or DCPLA, AIGP.
* Experience with research or development-sector data: informed consent, field data collection, enumerator partners, ethics review, vulnerable participants.
* Exposure to a software or SaaS business, including vendor security questionnaires, data processing agreements and certification audits.
* Experience working across several countries and legal regimes, including Kenya or other East African markets.
* Experience with donor and client data requirements from multilateral institutions, foundations and government clients.

**What Success Looks Like**
**Horizon**
**What is visibly true**
First 90 daysYou have absorbed the independent diagnostic, met every practice and office, and the Steering Group has agreed a prioritised plan with owners and dates. The data classification standard and the AI tool register are in use. The DPDP obligations that take effect in November 2026 are covered.By 12 monthsThe policy suite and toolkit are approved, published and in use on every new project. Leaders, project managers and field coordinators have been trained on Athena's own cases. Clients receive a standard answer to data and AI questions within days, not weeks. TolaData has a dated path to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 and the first controls are in place. The remaining DPDP obligations are covered ahead of May 2027.By 24 monthsA sample audit of live projects finds practice matching policy. At least one client or investor diligence has passed on our data and AI practices without remediation. AI is used more widely across the group than today, with fewer incidents and clearer rules. The system runs on its cycle without the Co-Founders in the loop.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**

* Not an IT or security engineering role. You will set requirements and check they are met; IT and TolaData engineering will implement them.
* Not a legal counsel role. You will work with external counsel on contracts and regulatory questions; you will not be the firm's lawyer.
* Not a policy-writing exercise that ends at publication. The job is the practice, not the documents.
* Not a gatekeeper. The brief is to let the group use data and AI more, more safely, not less.

**Where this leads**
This is designed as a two- to three-year build. People who succeed in it grow into a group-wide risk and compliance leadership role, a senior operating role at TolaData as it scales, or a client-facing practice advising governments and development organisations on data governance and responsible AI, an area where Athena already works and intends to do more. You will leave knowing how a multi-country research, software and AI business handles sensitive data, from the village to the investor data room.
  
  
**Athena’s Work Culture**
At Athena, we function in an outcomes-based work environment with flexible hours and a high level of autonomy. Professional development and thought leadership are key elements of our business model: we support our team members' professional growth through on-the-job training, and we encourage the cultivation of our colleagues’ personal brands through participation in panels, events, publications, and other thought-leadership opportunities. We embrace a transparent, open work environment with meaningful leadership pathways for those with inventive ideas and initiatives.

description:

Responsible for an area of output, including editorial control, selection and compilation of material, production, leading teams, planning and implementing effective use of resources.
  
  

**Who We Are**
  
From April 2024, the majority of the BBC’s Indian operations moved to the Collective Newsroom which has been set up by some of the BBC’s most experienced journalists in India. It has more than 250 journalists and operational staff, bringing you distinctive, impartial and world-class content and is the BBC’s sole provider of content for its Indian language websites and social media platforms including English. Based in the BBC’s largest international market, we bring you the best of Indian journalism guided by the world’s biggest and most reputable news organisation. We provide digital, audio and television content in Bangla, Hindi, Tamil, Gujarati, Marathi, Punjabi, Telugu, Urdu as well as English.

Our Vision: “Home to India’s most credible, creative and courageous journalism.”
  
  
Our Mission: “To lead with facts bringing diverse voices through innovative and impactful journalism in the public interest.”
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer, that strongly supports diversity and inclusion at the workplace, and encourages female candidates and persons from other diverse groups such as marginalised, under-privileged communities and differently-abled people, to apply.
  
  
To know more about us, visit our website: https://collectivenewsroom.com/

* Reporting to the Editor, the Senior Producer is responsible for originating and producing original stories from the ground. The role includes ideation, scripting, editing, outputting, filming content across a range of digital output.
