title: Meta Ads Operation Manager
description:
**Job Description: Meta Ads Operations Manager**

**Location:**

Kirti Nagar, New Delhi, India

**Work Mode:**

Work From Office

**Department:**

Ad Operations

**Job Type:**

Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Meta Ads Operations Manager**

to manage and streamline the operational activities related to Meta advertising. The role involves managing ad accounts, Business Managers, access permissions, media buyer allocation, billing, advertiser verification, and account suspension tracking.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager, strong coordination skills, and the ability to troubleshoot operational issues while ensuring compliance with Meta's advertising policies and internal procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Ad Account & Asset Management**

* Coordinate with agencies and partners to request new Meta ad accounts, profiles, Pages, and Business Managers.
* Manage account access, permissions, and asset allocation for media buyers.
* Maintain accurate mapping of ad accounts, Pages, Business Managers, and assigned media buyers.
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of all advertising assets.

**2. Media Buyer Allocation & Coordination**

* Allocate ad accounts to media buyers based on business requirements and approved access.
* Maintain updated records of account assignments, access permissions, and asset ownership.
* Coordinate with media buyers to resolve account-related queries and operational challenges.
* Ensure smooth coordination between media buyers, agencies, and internal teams.

**3. Business Manager Setup & Management**

* Coordinate the setup and configuration of Meta Business Managers.
* Manage approved asset mapping, partner access, and user permissions.
* Monitor account and asset access to ensure appropriate authorization.
* Troubleshoot Business Manager access issues and coordinate resolutions.

**4. Technical Support & Issue Resolution**

* Monitor ad account functionality, ad delivery issues, and website-related technical concerns.
* Investigate operational issues reported by media buyers and coordinate with relevant technical teams.
* Track issues and ensure resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders when required.

**5. Account Suspension & Policy Compliance**

* Monitor and maintain records of suspended or restricted ad accounts and Pages.
* Coordinate legitimate appeals and follow up on account reviews through official Meta channels.
* Track the status of appeals, restrictions, and reinstatement requests.
* Ensure all operational activities comply with Meta advertising policies and applicable platform rules.
* Support the use of alternative eligible advertising assets only where permitted by Meta's policies.

**6. Payment & Advertising Spend Monitoring**

* Coordinate the addition and management of approved payment methods.
* Monitor advertising spend, payment status, billing activity, and account spending limits.
* Identify billing discrepancies, failed payments, and unusual spending patterns.
* Coordinate with the finance team, agencies, and relevant stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues.
* Maintain accurate payment and spend records for reporting and reconciliation.

**7. Advertiser Verification**

* Track advertiser verification and business verification status across relevant accounts.
* Coordinate the collection and submission of required business documents through official channels.
* Follow up on pending verification requests and document-related issues.
* Maintain records of verification progress, approvals, rejections, and pending actions.

**8. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date trackers for ad accounts, Business Managers, Pages, media buyer allocation, suspensions, payments, and verification.
* Prepare regular operational reports covering pending issues, account status, spend, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of escalations, follow-ups, and completed actions.
* Provide timely updates to management regarding operational risks and bottlenecks.

**9. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with agencies, media buyers, finance, technical teams, and management to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Establish consistent tracking and follow-up practices for account provisioning and issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to internal processes, access-control requirements, and Meta policies.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.
* Understanding of Meta ad accounts, Pages, business portfolios, user roles, partner access, and permissions.
* Experience handling ad account restrictions, suspension tracking, appeals, and advertiser verification.
* Understanding of advertising billing, payment methods, spend monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and operational tasks simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a process-oriented approach.
* Understanding of Meta advertising policies and platform compliance requirements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant experience in Meta Ads operations, digital advertising support, Business Manager management, or advertising account operations is preferred.
* Practical experience coordinating with media buyers, agencies, and internal teams will be an advantage.
* Candidates with strong operational knowledge and hands-on experience managing Meta advertising assets are encouraged to apply.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Timely provisioning of ad accounts and allocation to media buyers.
* Compliance with defined SLAs for issue resolution and escalation.
* Accuracy of ad account, Business Manager, Page, and media buyer mapping.
* Effective tracking and follow-up of suspensions, appeals, and verification requests.
* Accuracy of payment, billing, and advertising spend reports.
* Timely maintenance of operational trackers and documentation.
* Efficient coordination with agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Adherence to Meta policies, approved access procedures, and internal compliance standards.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:

This role exercises independent judgment and creative solutioning to ensure customer success. The STAM may coordinate the activities of other team members (team lead) to ensure successful completion of projects and assignments. * Lead complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution efforts for critical customer issues.

* Perform technical reviews & share knowledge to proactively identify & prevent issues

* Perform initial or secondary investigations and respond to online and phone support requests

* Manage customer cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans & keep documentation on customer environments updated
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with each qualified engagement through the complete adoption life cycle of our offerings
* Engage with Red Hat's field teams, customers to ensure a positive platform & cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat platform & cloud solutions and our cloud road-map align to customer use cases
* Capture Red Hat product capabilities and identify gaps as related to customer use cases through a closed-loop process for each step of the engagement life cycle
* Engage with Red Hat's product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns based on customer engagements and personal experience that guide platform adoption
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat’s platform & cloud technologies strategy
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas or process areas
* Travel to visit customers, partners, conferences, and other events as needed

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in science or a technical field; engineering or computer science
* Competent reading and writing skills in English
* Ability to convey information to customers in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to effectively manage and grow existing enterprise customer and partner relationships by delivering best-in-class support
* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a passion for problem solving and investigation
* Upstream involvement in open source projects (patches submitted for upstream) is a plus
* Indian citizenship or authorisation to work in India
* Red Hat OpenStack Platform - RHOSP

+ Fundamental understanding of OpenStack, Container architecture, and administration experience across all working components
+ Deep understanding and troubleshooting skills on OpenStack core components.
+ Deployment and troubleshooting experience of OpenStack clusters on bare metal or non-bare metal environments.
+ Planning, Designing, and implementation of OpenStack products on various hardware.
+ Technical and Deep understanding of Ceph cluster storage and its functionalities.
+ Experience with Linux operating system installation, configuration, upgrade, and maintenance.

* Red Hat OpenShift Platform - RHOCP

+ Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Docker cluster management
+ Understanding of RHOCP Architecture & different types of RHOCP installations Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
+ Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
+ Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
+ Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers

* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)**
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
  
  
Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. title: Procurement & Costing Manager - Interiors & Turnkey Execution
description:
**Location:**

Delhi NCR

**Company:**

Hub and Oak Interiors

**About Hub and Oak Interiors**

Hub and Oak Interiors is an established commercial interior design and turnkey fit-out company based in Delhi NCR. We specialise in designing and delivering offices and commercial workspaces for startups, corporates and established businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Faridabad. 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Procurement & Costing Manager to take end-to-end ownership of BOQs, project estimates and cost planning for office interiors and turnkey projects. The role involves working closely with the Interior Design Head, Business Development Manager and Project Manager to ensure proposals are accurately costed, commercially viable and submitted on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **BOQ Preparation and Quantity Take-Offs:**

   Prepare detailed BOQs by reviewing layouts, working drawings, specifications and site measurements. Identify missing information, scope gaps and discrepancies before finalising estimates.
2. **Project Estimation and Costing:**

   Prepare item-wise estimates covering materials, labour, installation, transport, wastage, site overheads and contingency allowances. Cover all relevant trades, including civil works, partitions, ceilings, flooring, furniture, joinery, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire safety and IT infrastructure.
3. **Vendor Quotations and Rate Analysis:**

   Obtain quotations from vendors and contractors, prepare comparison statements, assess scope completeness and negotiate rates to establish reliable project costs.
4. **Commercial Proposals and Tender Support:**

   Prepare priced BOQs, quotation inputs, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. Coordinate with business development to ensure client proposals reflect the approved scope, costs and margins.
5. **Budget Planning and Value Engineering:**

   Develop execution budgets and recommend alternative materials, specifications or construction methods to meet client budgets while maintaining design intent, functionality and quality.
6. **Design and Execution Coordination:**

   Work with the design and project teams to validate quantities, specifications, site conditions and execution requirements. Hand over approved costing sheets and budgets to the Project Manager before execution.
7. **Variation Costing and Cost Monitoring:**

   Estimate additional work and scope changes, maintain variation records and support approval before execution. Compare actual and committed costs against budgets with the project and accounts teams, highlighting overruns and margin risks.
8. **Cost Database and Documentation:**

   Maintain updated material and labour rates, vendor quotations, standard BOQs and historical project costs. Ensure estimates are version-controlled, traceable and supported by clear calculations and approvals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing or quantity surveying, with hands-on experience in commercial office interiors and turnkey fit-outs.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to read architectural, interior and services drawings and independently prepare quantity take-offs and detailed BOQs.
* Strong understanding of interior materials, construction methods, labour productivity and vendor pricing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD for drawing review and measurement; familiarity with estimation software is an advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple estimates within deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, vendors and the business development team.

**Success in This Role**

Accurate and timely estimates, complete BOQs with minimal scope omissions, reliable execution budgets, prompt costing of variations and clear visibility of expected project margins.

**JOB TITLE:**
**Manager. Material Production - Leather**
RESPONSIBILITIES:
  
  
Leather Inventory & Quality Control
  
  

* Oversee leather inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for tanning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality leather—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the tanning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming leather before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw leather.

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management
  
  

* Own leather OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to tanneries and flagging potential delays.
* Proleatherly manage production schedules to ensure leather is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

Tanning & Production Support
  
  

* Partner with tanneries to ensure leather lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.
* Monitor leather consumption during tanning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations.
* Work upstream with suppliers to align leather bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother tannery integration.
* Maintain clear documentation of leather lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Coordinate with planners and production team to align leather availability with production demand and tanning schedules.
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs.
* Provide input on leather purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history.
* Escalate production blockers (e.g., leather shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with leather or other luxury leathers.
* Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess leather quality and enforce standards before tanning.
* Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor leather usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow.
* Collaboration: Experience working with tanneries, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with leather leather grading, testing, or lot management.
* Knowledge of tannery operations and leather-to-yarn conversion.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools.
* Understanding of sustainable leather sourcing and production practices.

**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Regional Manager – RSP / BDO Operations

Operations

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
At
**Blue Dart**
, we go beyond delivering shipments—we deliver trust, precision, and excellence. As India’s most reliable express logistics provider, we empower commerce by reaching over 56,000+ locations across India and connecting to 220+ countries through our global DHL network. Backed by the strength of DHL Group, we bring together international standards with deep local expertise. Our dedicated Boeing freighter fleet, 12,000+ vehicles, and best-in-class service ensure time-definite delivery that businesses and customers count on every day.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work®**
and recognized as part of the DHL Group’s Top Employer certification across multiple regions. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal—it’s a fundamental part of who we are. We are committed to creating a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and proud to belong.
  
  
If you're looking to join a purpose-led, people-first organization that shapes India’s supply chain with integrity and care—Blue Dart is where you belong.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Regional Manager – RSP / BDO Operations role is accountable for the operational performance, service quality, governance and sustainability of the Regional Service Provider (RSP) and Blue Dart Office (BDO) network across multiple states and non-metro / remote markets.
  
  
The network operates through a combination of franchise / service-partner locations, outsourced manpower and lean Blue Dart-operated offices, typically serving markets where shipment volumes do not require a full-scale Blue Dart facility.
  
  
The role ensures that customers in these markets receive consistent Blue Dart service standards irrespective of whether operations are delivered through a partner, contractor-supported office or lean Blue Dart location.
  
  
Owns regional governance of RSPs and BDOs covering pickup and delivery performance, shipment connectivity, operational compliance, partner capability, manpower productivity, customer experience, cost effectiveness and business continuity.
  
  
Acts as the regional anchor between RSP / BDO locations and Area / Branch Operations, PUD, Hub, CPU, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance and other functions to ensure reliable service delivery across the extended network.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To build and govern a reliable, scalable and cost-efficient RSP / BDO operating network across Tier 2, Tier 3 and remote markets by strengthening partner performance, operational standards, service quality, network connectivity and compliance while ensuring sustainable Blue Dart presence in lower-volume geographies.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Regional RSP / BDO Network Leadership**

* Own and govern operational performance of RSP and BDO locations across the Region.
* Establish consistent operating standards across franchise, outsourced and lean Blue Dart locations.
* Translate regional operational priorities and service standards into location-level execution requirements.
* Establish structured performance-review mechanisms across the RSP / BDO network.
* Identify weak-performing locations and drive time-bound corrective action plans.
* Ensure appropriate escalation and intervention for locations with recurring service, compliance or viability concerns.
* Act as the regional SME for RSP / BDO operating models and remote-market operations.

**Partner & Franchise Operations Governance**

* Monitor operational performance of Regional Service Providers and franchise / channel partners against agreed service standards.
* Ensure partners understand and adhere to Blue Dart operating processes, customer commitments and brand standards.
* Establish partner scorecards covering service, productivity, quality, compliance and customer experience.
* Conduct periodic operating and capability reviews with partners.
* Drive corrective action where partner performance falls below defined standards.
* Provide operational inputs for appointment, continuation, renewal, expansion or rationalisation of partners in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure business continuity during partner transitions or service disruptions.

**BDO & Remote Location Operations**

* Govern performance of Blue Dart Offices operating with lean Blue Dart manpower and predominantly outsourced resources.
* Ensure BDOs maintain adequate operational capability despite lower shipment volumes and geographically dispersed locations.
* Drive consistent pickup, delivery, shipment handling and customer-service standards.
* Monitor location productivity and ensure manpower deployment remains aligned with business volumes.
* Ensure adequate supervisory controls where direct Blue Dart manpower is limited.
* Review operating viability and recommend changes to the service model where appropriate.
* Ensure continuity of service across difficult-to-access and remote locations.

**Service Performance & Customer Experience**

* Drive achievement of pickup, delivery and service-quality commitments across RSP and BDO locations.
* Monitor First Attempt Delivery, pending / ageing shipments, NDR, pickup performance and operational exceptions.
* Identify recurring service failures and ensure structured root-cause resolution.
* Monitor customer complaints arising from RSP / BDO locations and drive preventive actions.
* Ensure service levels in partner-operated locations remain aligned with Blue Dart standards.
* Partner with Area and Branch Operations teams on customer-critical issues requiring intervention.

**Network Connectivity & Shipment Flow**

* Ensure timely shipment movement between RSP / BDO locations and parent Service Centres, Hubs, CPUs and downstream network locations.
* Monitor adherence to pickup, dispatch and network cut-offs.
* Identify connectivity gaps affecting remote-market service performance.
* Work with Surface, Air, PUD and Network teams to optimise connections and operating schedules.
* Ensure appropriate contingency plans for route disruptions, volume spikes or partner resource shortages.
* Minimise shipment delays arising from weak upstream or downstream connectivity.

**Manpower & Productivity Governance**

* Monitor productivity and manpower deployment across outsourced / partner-supported operations.
* Ensure staffing levels are aligned with shipment volumes and service requirements.
* Improve productivity through better workforce deployment, route planning and process discipline.
* Monitor absenteeism, attrition and continuity risks among outsourced resources.
* Ensure partners maintain adequate staffing and backup capability.
* Work with HR / Operations teams on workforce issues requiring regional intervention.

**Cost & Operating Model Optimization**

* Monitor cost-to-serve across RSP and BDO locations.
* Evaluate operational productivity and sustainability of remote-location operating models.
* Identify opportunities to optimise manpower, routes, infrastructure and service-partner costs.
* Balance cost efficiency with network reach and service commitments.
* Recommend alternative operating models where existing arrangements are no longer operationally or financially appropriate.
* Support development of scalable models for low-volume and emerging markets.

**Compliance, Safety & Brand Governance**

* Ensure partner and BDO operations comply with Blue Dart SOPs, security standards, statutory requirements and applicable contractual conditions.
* Conduct periodic operational and compliance reviews across locations.
* Ensure appropriate controls over shipment custody, scanning, cash / documentation processes and Blue Dart assets wherever applicable.
* Drive timely closure of audit findings and compliance gaps.
* Ensure partner-operated locations maintain required workplace, signage and customer-interface standards.
* Escalate serious compliance, ethics, security or customer-risk concerns promptly.

**Capability Building & Standardisation**

* Build operational capability among RSPs, BDO coordinators and outsourced teams.
* Drive structured onboarding and refresher training on Blue Dart operating standards.
* Standardise SOPs, dashboards and governance mechanisms across the regional network.
* Identify and replicate best practices across locations.
* Support digital adoption and use of operational systems by partners and outsourced resources.
* Build stronger local operating capability to reduce dependence on continuous regional intervention.

**Network Expansion & Rationalisation**

* Support evaluation of new RSP / BDO locations based on service reach, business potential and network requirements.
* Provide operational inputs into location feasibility, coverage and resource requirements.
* Review existing locations for service performance, productivity and continued relevance.
* Recommend strengthening, consolidation, relocation or alternate service models where required.
* Ensure new locations achieve operational readiness and defined service standards before stabilisation.
* Support expansion into underserved Tier 2 / Tier 3 and emerging markets in alignment with business requirements.

You act as the FM Category Manager, owning the FM categories end‑to‑end. You oversee maintenance, supplier management, lifecycle planning, energy efficiency, and cross‑functional collaboration to ensure safe, compliant, and reliable facility operations across all sites.

Key Responsibilities include:

* Responsible to monitor and report on site energy consumption, drive energy efficiency reduction initiatives to optimize energy efficiency and mitigate energy cost, in line with the global defined energy targets.

title: Jewellery Brand Operations & Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Kritika Khurana Jewels is an emerging jewellery brand focused on contemporary, fashion-forward designs that blend style with everyday wearability. The brand emphasizes high-quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a curated customer experience across online and offline channels. Based in Gurugram, the team works closely with artisans and suppliers to deliver well-finished, trend-led pieces. Joining Kritika Khurana Jewels offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing label and shape its operational and production standards.

**Role Description**

**Product and production tracker**

Maintain one tracker for every active design and SKU, including:

* Product name, SKU or temporary product code and collection
* Design owner and design status
* Vendor and contact person
* CAD, sample and production status
* Quote, approved cost and purchase order status
* Sample, production and delivery dates
* QC status and correction notes
* Quantity ordered, received and sellable
* Photography, listing and launch status
* Current blocker, next action, owner and due date

Use clear statuses such as Not started, In progress, Waiting on vendor, Waiting for approval, Blocked, QC hold, Ready for shoot, Ready for listing and Complete.

**New product and sampling process**

1. Receive a design brief from Kritika or the jewellery designer, including the reference, specifications and intended use.

2. Create a product code and add the product to the tracker.

3. Confirm with the jewellery designer what technical information the vendor needs.

4. Request quotes and timelines from vendors.

5. Send costs and purchase commitments to Kritika for approval.

6. Once approved, confirm the specifications, cost, quantity and timeline in writing with the vendor.

7. Follow up on CAD, sample and production milestones and record updates in the tracker.

8. Record sample receipt and arrange QC.

9. Route technical questions to the jewellery designer and commercial or launch decisions to Kritika.

10. Do not mark a product ready for production, photography or launch until the required approvals are recorded.

**Vendor coordination**

* Own routine vendor communication about samples, production status, corrections, quantities and delivery dates.
* Keep written records of agreed specifications, timelines, costs and changes.
* Send a written recap after calls where a decision or deadline was agreed.
* Follow up before due dates if an update is missing and flag overdue items early.
* Coordinate technical feedback with the jewellery designer so vendors receive one clear design direction.
* Escalate cost increases, missed deadlines, quality disputes or requests for unapproved payment to Kritika.
* Do not commit to new costs, quantities, design changes or public delivery dates without approval.
* Send approved invoices and payment details to Jessica for accountant coordination.

**Quality control**

Check pieces when samples or production arrive and record the result against the SKU. Check:

* Finishing, plating or oxidation consistency
* Stones, pearls and other components
* Clasps, hooks, closures and moving parts
* Sizing and fit against the approved specification
* Colour and material consistency across the batch
* Design accuracy against the approved reference or sample
* Visible damage, sharp edges, loose components or other defects

If a piece fails QC, mark it QC hold, keep it separate from sellable stock, photograph and record the issue, and coordinate a correction or replacement. Ask the jewellery designer to review design or technical issues. Recheck corrected pieces and record the outcome before releasing them.

**Inventory and dispatch coordination**

* Check stock with the internal team on agreed days each week.
* Compare physical stock information with the inventory tracker and Shopify availability.
* Flag low or inconsistent stock and prepare reorder recommendations.
* Track incoming stock against the purchase order and record discrepancies.
* Coordinate which pieces are needed for shoots, PR gifting, stylist requests or campaigns.
* Keep a product loan and gifting log with item, quantity, recipient, dispatch date, expected return and return condition.
* Coordinate dispatch priorities with Deepak. Deepak remains responsible for physical stock handling, packing and dispatch.
* Escalate lost, damaged, missing or returned items that affect sellable stock.

**Photography and e-commerce readiness**

* Prepare a shoot list with product name, SKU, quantity, styling notes and required angles.
* Confirm pieces are QC-approved and available before the shoot.
* Coordinate dates and logistics with the photographer, model, stylist and creative team.
* Track products photographed, edits pending and final images received.
* Match final images to the correct SKU and confirm samples are returned to Deepak.
* Coordinate product listings with the website team, including the correct SKU, approved price, specifications, materials, size information, images and stock availability.
* Check product pages against approved information before launch. Do not make unsupported material or quality claims.
* Coordinate sold-out and restock updates with Deepak and the website team.

**Social, PR and campaign coordination**

* Share approved product details, pricing, availability and launch timing with the social media team.
* Make sure pieces requested for campaigns, stylists, celebrities or PR activity are available and logged.
* Coordinate product dispatches and returns with Deepak.
* Flag stock shortages or production delays to Kritika, PR and social as early as possible.
* PR owns outreach and relationship management; social owns the content calendar and publishing. The operations manager ensures products and logistics are ready.

**Workflow:**

**Daily:**
Review due and overdue tasks, check expected deliveries and stock issues, update the tracker after confirmations, and flag urgent blockers or approvals to Kritika.

**Weekly:**
Share completed work, overdue items, upcoming deadlines, stock risks and decisions needed. Review sampling and production with the jewellery designer, stock and dispatch with internal, and readiness for upcoming shoots and launches.

**Monthly:**
Review the product pipeline, propose the next month’s production and shoot calendar, and flag recurring delays or process issues.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Jewelry Design and a strong understanding of fashion jewelry trends and aesthetics.
* Candidates should possess skills in Communication, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess skills in Polishing and quality inspection to ensure consistent finishing and craftsmanship.
* Candidates should possess skills in Training, including the ability to guide and coach production staff or artisans on processes and standards.
* Experience in jewellery production, operations management, or fashion accessories is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with proficiency in basic digital tools (spreadsheets, inventory or order-tracking software).
* Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, collaborate with a small team, and manage multiple orders or projects simultaneously.
* Relevant education or certification in design, fashion, jewellery, or operations management is an advantage.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:

While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
  
  
Monks is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the Delhi-based team delivering rapid-turn editorial and marketing content. This senior, client-facing role will oversee day-to-day operations across multiple shifts, ensuring work is properly prioritized, staffed, trafficked, reviewed and delivered.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a process-oriented project manager who can bring structure to a complex, fast-moving environment. You will manage regional capacity and team performance, partner closely with the US-based Monks leadership team and serve as a senior point of contact for client stakeholders.
  
  
An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential. All briefs, client communications and creative deliverables will be in English.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Delhi-based creative team across multiple shifts and workstreams.
* Serve as a senior regional contact for client stakeholders and Monks leadership.
* Oversee intake, prioritization, staffing, production, review, approval and final delivery.
* Translate incoming demand into clear capacity plans, assignments, timelines and escalation paths.
* Manage and support producers or project managers responsible for individual shifts and deliverables.
* Maintain visibility across active work, team capacity, deadlines, risks, dependencies and approvals.
* Establish clear operating standards across shifts, including intake, documentation, QA, handoffs and delivery.
* Ensure cross-shift handoffs include current status, decisions, open questions, source files and next actions.
* Use sound judgment to determine when work should continue within a shift and when a regional handoff will improve speed.
* Partner closely with US-based Monks leadership to align priorities, processes, staffing and client communications.
* Build productive client relationships and provide clear recommendations when priorities, timing or capacity conflict.
* Consolidate feedback, resolve operational ambiguity and escalate only when client direction or approval is genuinely required.
* Maintain senior oversight of producer-level QA, version control, asset packaging and delivery requirements.
* Monitor service levels and operational performance, identifying recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop reporting around volume, turnaround times, capacity, workflow health and team performance.
* Support team onboarding, training and retention of program-specific knowledge.
* Partner with creative, editorial and technical leaders to maintain quality without slowing delivery.
* Work with AI and creative technology specialists to improve workflows, automation and production efficiency.
* Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.

**Experience You Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in creative operations, production, program management or project management within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading large or multi-shift creative production teams.
* Strong client-facing experience and confidence communicating with senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing rapid-turn digital, web, editorial, design and motion deliverables.
* Proven ability to build scalable processes and maintain operational consistency across teams and shifts.
* Strong capacity-planning, resource-management, trafficking and delivery-management skills.
* Experience leading and developing producers, project managers or other operational team members.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong understanding of creative and technical QA.
* Ability to operate autonomously, make informed decisions and navigate ambiguity.
* Experience partnering across regions, time zones and organizational functions.
* Ability to distinguish critical issues from lower-priority feedback and provide practical resolution paths.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required, as all briefs, client communications and creative deliverables will be in English.
* Clear executive communication, documentation and presentation skills.
* Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.
* Ability to support a nontraditional operating model and participate in scheduled weekend and holiday rotations.

**Working Model**
This is a hybrid leadership role supporting a global, shift-based production model. The Operations Director will oversee teams working across early morning, evening, overnight and other nontraditional schedules. The role requires sufficient flexibility to maintain leadership coverage across shifts, support planned weekend and holiday rotations and respond to urgent operational priorities. Schedules and coverage expectations will be established in advance wherever possible.
  
  
**About Monks**
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
  
  
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
**Overview**
**Our Culture and Impact**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution, so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.
  
  
The role blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and give clients a sharper, more consultative experience. This is no longer just a configuration role: it's a role where the best performers use AI as a force multiplier across research, documentation, testing, and client communication.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Implementation / Implementation Lead, you will own mid-to-complex client implementations end-to-end — from discovery and process mapping through configuration, testing, training, and go-live. You'll act as a trusted advisor to clients, a hands-on product expert, and a mentor to junior team members, while leveraging AI tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality at every stage of the project lifecycle.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
**Client Consultation & Strategic Delivery**

* Provide high-level consultation to clients on applying Cvent technology to meet their meetings and events program goals.
* Analyze current-state processes and map future-state workflows to Cvent solutions, identifying opportunities for automation along the way.
* Serve as a product specialist — deeply knowledgeable across Cvent products, able to demonstrate, consult, configure, test, train, and deploy solutions.
* Cultivate strong advisory relationships with key client stakeholders who influence adoption and long-term account health.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Apply structured project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and change control — to manage simple-to-complex implementations, keeping timelines on track and proactively escalating barriers to success.
* Translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-value, process cycle time, cost savings, ROI) rather than relying on subjective or anecdotal measures of progress.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics with clients at project kick-off, and report progress against them throughout the engagement so success is data-driven, not just directional.
* Oversee and/or configure client accounts, including testing, refining, and directing the contributions of other team members.
* Track time and profitability of implementation projects, providing recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign.
* Coordinate and conduct virtual user training sessions for client teams.

**Technical Configuration & Product Expertise**

* Configure, test, and refine Cvent product instances to match documented client requirements.
* Diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Interface with the Product Development team to define and convey client feature requests.

**AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation**
**Role**
*This is where the role has evolved most. AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done, not an optional add-on:*

* Use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to draft, summarize, and refine requirements documents, process maps, and configuration workbooks — cutting documentation time and improving consistency across projects.
* Apply AI-assisted meeting summarization and transcription tools during discovery calls and configuration workshops to speed up note-taking, action-item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* Identify and build lightweight automations or AI-agent workflows for repetitive project tasks — status updates, test-case generation, training material drafts, and client FAQs — freeing up time for higher-value consulting.
* Maintain quality and accuracy as a human-in-the-loop reviewer: validating AI-generated configurations, documentation, and communications before they reach the client.
* Model and mentor AI tool adoption to junior team members and peers, helping the broader team adopt AI-first ways of working.
* Use AI-powered analytics on data such as usage patterns, support tickets, or historical project data to proactively flag risk and improve implementation quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to support sales activities where implementation expertise is a differentiator.
* Ensure client objectives and requirements are clearly conveyed and tracked throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Serve as a mentor to new team members, including on best practices for using AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Present internally as a subject-matter expert on implementation topics, lead conversations in team meetings, and participate in team committees, at times in a leadership capacity.

**Here's What You Need**

* 10 to 14+ years of external work experience in a project or customer management role — preferably in the corporate meetings, software, or broader high-tech industry — or a minimum of 5 years of Cvent experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.
* Experience implementing technology or automation, ideally within an organization responsible for managing meetings or events.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a positive, confident, and outgoing presence; strong presentation skills.
* Highly articulate and detail-oriented, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for clients of varying technical fluency.
* Strong project management skills — able to build and manage project plans, timelines, RAID/risk logs, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer goals into objective, quantifiable outcomes and hold projects accountable to measurable results rather than subjective impressions of progress.
* Ability to comprehend and diagram intermediate process flows, identifying opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in core productivity tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio/Draw.io.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, and for applying general and industry-specific business knowledge in a fast-paced, analytical, team-oriented environment.
* Strong time-management and organizational discipline; ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
* A solutions-first mindset — comfortable proposing fixes rather than simply surfacing problems to management.

**Adaptability & Resilience Under Pressure**

* Ability to pivot quickly on customer situations — reworking scope, timelines, or approach mid-project when client needs, priorities, or constraints shift unexpectedly.
* Comfort operating through significant change management within a project (new stakeholders, revised requirements, shifting priorities) with flexibility rather than resistance to the change.
* Proven ability to multitask and stay effective under pressure — juggling competing deadlines, client escalations, and internal priorities without losing quality or composure.
* Willingness and ability to manage through non-ideal or ambiguous situations — messy data, incomplete requirements, tight timelines — rather than waiting for perfect conditions to make progress.

**AI & Technology Fluency (New)**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate day-to-day work — documentation, research, communications, or analysis.
* Comfort working in a human-in-the-loop capacity: reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they go to clients.
* Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging AI-powered workflow and automation tools, with a willingness to experiment and share learnings with the team.
* Basic understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows can be applied to client onboarding, configuration, or reporting tasks (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Azure, Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Prior exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP) good to have, not required.
* Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) or equivalent process-improvement certification.

description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Manager - Revenue Operations (Strategy and Transformation)

Services Business Unit within Mastercard is focused on driving value beyond payment transactions. We harness the power of our transaction data, deep payments expertise and vast network of merchant and FI partners to offer holistic solutions to our customers. Our solutions comprise consulting; cyber & intelligence; data insights; marketing services; loyalty & analytics platforms; and more. Discover more at www.mastercardservices.com/en.

The Ideal Candidate Will Combine Strategic Thinking, Operational Expertise, And Execution Rigor To Translate Business Priorities Into Actionable Programs That Enhance Productivity, Customer Experience, And Revenue Realization. Key Responsibilities Include:
  
  

* Strategy & Operating Model Evolution

Define and evolve the Revenue Operations strategy and target operating model aligned with business growth priorities
  
  
Identify opportunities to improve sales lifecycle efficiency, revenue realization, and customer experience
  
  
Act as a trusted advisor to RevOps leadership on strategic planning and transformation roadmaps
  
  

* Transformation & Program Leadership

Lead and execute enterprise-wide transformation initiatives across areas such as deal lifecycle management, order-to-cash, and revenue assurance
  
  
Drive cross-functional programs spanning Sales, Finance, Product, Legal, and Technology
  
  
Ensure disciplined program governance, milestone tracking, risk management, and value realization
  
  

* Process Optimization

Identify, design, and implement process simplification and automation opportunities across Revenue Operations
  
  
Leverage data, tools, and technology (e.g., CRM, workflow automation, analytics) to improve efficiency and scalability
  
  
Champion best practices, standardization, and continuous improvement
  
  

* Insights & Performance Management

Establish robust performance metrics and KPIs to track operational health and transformation impact across RevOps workstreams
  
  
Generate actionable insights to support decision-making and prioritize initiatives
  
  
Drive adoption of a data-driven culture within RevOps
  
  

* Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

Partner with RevOps leadership and cross functional stakeholders to align on priorities and support execution
  
  
Lead change management efforts, ensuring stakeholder buy-in, effective communication, and sustained adoption
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**
~6-10 years of experience in Strategy, Transformation, Consulting, or Revenue/Sales Operations
  
  
Proven track record of leading large-scale transformation programs in complex, matrixed organizations
  
  
Strong understanding of end-to-end revenue lifecycle (sales, contracting, order management, billing, revenue assurance)
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment
  
  
Experience with Business Process Engineering and Digital Transformation
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset
  
  
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills
  
  
Experience in B2B Services / SaaS environments
  
  
Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, O2C, Business Process Management, Workflow automation
  
  
Global experience working across multiple regions (e.g., LAC, NAM, EMEA, APAC)
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Position And Key Responsibilities**

title: Assistant Project Manager, Nagpur
description:
**Who is Turner & Townsend?**

All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**

The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:**
We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:**
We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:**
We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice

**Job Description**

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced
**Project Manager**
to lead and deliver large-scale projects from planning through execution, commissioning, and handover. The role will be responsible for driving project performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and stakeholder management while ensuring successful project completion within defined timelines and budgets.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, technical expertise, commercial acumen, and extensive experience managing multidisciplinary teams and complex projects.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

* Lead end-to-end project execution from project initiation to final handover.
* Develop project plans, schedules, resource plans, and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress and ensure milestones are achieved as per approved timelines.
* Drive project performance and ensure delivery within budget and quality parameters.
* Review construction methodologies and implement best practices for project delivery.

Budget & Cost Management

* Prepare and monitor project budgets and forecasts.
* Track project costs and ensure effective cost control measures.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and timelines.
* Review contractor bills, change orders, and project expenditures.

Stakeholder Management

* Manage relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and present progress updates to leadership.
* Address project challenges proactively and ensure timely resolution of issues.

Contract & Commercial Management

* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project specifications.
* Evaluate variations, claims, extensions of time, and commercial risks.
* Coordinate with procurement, contracts, and commercial teams for project requirements.
* Support negotiation and management of project-related contracts.

Team Leadership

* Lead cross-functional teams including engineering, procurement, planning, quality, safety, and construction teams.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Mentor and develop team members to build high-performing project teams.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies.
* Drive Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance across project sites.
* Conduct periodic reviews to ensure adherence to project quality plans and safety standards.
* Ensure timely closure of quality and safety observations.

Risk Management

* Identify and assess project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Maintain project risk registers and monitor critical risk areas.
* Escalate major risks and issues to management with recommended solutions.

Reporting & Governance

* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Monitor project KPIs and report variances.
* Ensure documentation and project records are maintained accurately.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and governance requirements.

**Qualifications**

Education & Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree/MBA in Project Management or Operations preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is an advantage.

Experience Required

* 15-20 years of experience in Project Management.
* Proven experience managing large-scale projects worth ₹100 Cr+ (or equivalent).
* Experience in Construction, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Data Centers, Industrial, Commercial Fit-Out, EPC, or Engineering Projects preferred.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders, contractors, and project teams.

**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

title: Founders’ Office ( Business Builder )
description:
**Founder's Office | Growth Valley Community**

Gurugram (in-office) | Full-time | 1-5 years experience | Reports directly to the Founder

Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred.

Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A
**consistent**
growth story will be awarded.

**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.**

**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.**

**About GVC.**

Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

title: Integrated Logistics Excellence Manager Performance
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
The IL Excellence Manager is responsible for driving operational excellence across the supply chain by managing LSP performance, ensuring compliance with SOPs and KPIs, and advancing digital integration through automation and real-time shipment visibility.
  
  
The role collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external LSPs to support efficient operations, continuous improvement, and successful customer implementations.
