LSP (3PL) Management
  
  

* Manage and oversee Logistics Service Providers (LSPs) to ensure service excellence
* Monitor supplier performance, drive continuous improvement, and manage escalations
* Support LSP onboarding, integration, SOP implementation, EDI, and digital initiatives
* Coordinate with customers, Control Towers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth operations
* Lead LSP training and change management during new implementations

Problem Solving
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to resolve operational issues affecting KPIs and service quality
* Identify process bottlenecks, analyze performance data, and implement corrective actions
* Monitor process deviations and troubleshoot system or data integration issues

Business Continuity & Hypercare
  
  

* Ensure BCP readiness and resolve critical supply chain disruptions during Hypercare

Freight Procurement
  
  

* Support transportation procurement, supplier management, and cost optimization

**What we would like you to bring**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience
* Strong background in 3PL/logistics operations
* Experience in transportation, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry
* Knowledge of reefer containers, GDP/GxP, and logistics data management
* Experience in LSP supplier management, including performance monitoring and escalation handling
* Candidates with an Operations Excellence Manager background may also be considered
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  

* To be responsible for identifying and implementing optimized operational processes to improve productivity and efficiency.
* To interact very closely with other departments of LCC, Implementation, Solution Development, Project Management and Business Management to aid the design of Integrated Logistics (IL) solutions.
* To ensure that all processes are properly documented once optimization is approved and implemented.
* To train all relevant staff in new processes in a timely manner including testing to ensure capability.

**How you create impact**

* To deliver and deploy productivity management tools to ensure consistent measurement and monitoring of productivity at process and team level.
* To constantly review all tasks within scope to identify potential opportunities for process improvements/optimization.
* To prepare supporting documents and presentations to customer for approval of process improvement initiatives.
* To ensure that the process is monitored after improvements implemented and track and record results to demonstrate success and/or enable further adjustments.
* To ensure that accurate training records of all new processes/actions are kept accessible.
* To translate operational process designs into applicable process documentation – process flows, Standard Operating Procedures, Working Instructions, etc and ensure that all such process documentation work is maintained and updated as per requirements.
* To achieve project savings via Productivity Improvement Strategy.
* To participate in designing, executing and documentation User Acceptance Testing.
* To be responsible for internal communication processes and presentations related to key performance metrics, program updates and on-going program information providing tasks.

**What we would like you to bring**

* A bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 7 - 8 years of experience in logistics or supply chain management, preferably within the consultancy industry.
* MUST be a Green Belt Six Sigma Certified or Black Belt Certified.
* Strong automation, analytical, and project management skills, with expertise in process improvement and proficiency in logistics systems and tools.
* Ability to identify issues and implement effective solutions to optimize logistics processes.

**What's in it for you**
At Kuehne+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact—on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
  
  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100+ countries.
* People-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning & Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation & Sustainability: Be part of a future-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards & Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.

**Who we are**
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

**Position Summary**

Professionals in this group collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to solve process challenges, support transformation initiatives, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

title: Founder's Office - Operations
description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**

An urban Indian eats about 90 meals a month. About 80 of them are everyday meals: dal, sabzi, and roti. Food delivery apps serve almost none of these. Most homes still depend on a part-time cook who has about an hour per home, so food gets cooked whenever she has a slot and is eaten cold or reheated.

We make three promises to the people who eat with us:

* Food made fresh and served hot, the way your mother would serve it at home.
* A kitchen you can trust as much as your own.
* The nutrition you need, from your daily meals. Every plate includes calories and macros.

We deliver this through Live Kitchens. Each one is 3,000 to 4,000 sq ft and serves the homes and offices within about 2 km, so food reaches people hot within 10 minutes. Our own software, the Kitchen OS, runs the kitchen: what to cook, how much, and when.

We are well capitalized to build this - we have raised $3.7 million in our angel+seed round from top VCs and founders in India, including founders of Blinkit, Cred, Tata 1mg, Chaayos, TBO.com, CoinSwitch, PocketFM, the ex-CTO of Zomato and Blinkit, and more.

**THE ROLE**

You'll work directly with the founders as their execution partner: you'll turn ideas into plans, plans into work on the ground, and messy problems into systems that run without you. This is a 0→1 role. If you need structure handed to you, this isn't for you. If you enjoy building structure while running, this could be the most important role of your career so far.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

* **Founder's execution arm:**
  Turn founder discussions into clear plans with owners and dates, and follow through until they're done.
* **Pilot operations:**
  Run the day-to-day work of the kitchen launch: vendors, daily sourcing, ingredient testing, hiring support and partners.
* **Systems and numbers:**
  Build the SOPs, dashboards and weekly reviews that show how the pilot is doing: repeat customers, waste, cost per meal and rush-hour performance.
* **On-ground problem solving:**
  Handle what breaks: a vendor who doesn't deliver, a cook who doesn't show up, a dish that runs out at 8 pm. Make decisions with incomplete information.
* **Founder leverage:**
  Take whole projects off the founders' plate so they can focus on strategy, hiring, and fundraising. Push back when you disagree.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Must-haves**

* **Hungry:**
  You want a hard, high-stakes role and you'll put in the hours to win. During launch that can mean a 6 am start in the kitchen, and you'll want to be there.
* **Smart:**
  You think in numbers and structure. You can work out whether ₹20 a ladle covers our costs, or why dinner waste jumped on Tuesday.
* **High ownership:**
  Nobody will hand you a task list. You find what's broken, fix it and own the result, good or bad.
* **Quick on your feet:**
  Two cooks don't turn up at 11 am, and lunch starts at 12:30. You stay calm, decide fast, and sort it out.

**Also**

* 1–3 years of work experience. Startup experience is a strong plus.
* A strong academic record from a top engineering or business school (MBA), or similar.
* Clear, crisp writing and speaking.
* Based in Gurugram or ready to move. This role is on-site.

**PAY AND EQUITY**

We pay competitive salaries along with meaningful equity, so everyone who helps build Annapoorna shares in what it becomes. You grow with the company, and your stake grows with your impact. This role is for someone who values ownership over comfort and wants to grow into a long-term operating leader as the company scales.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then answer two short questions in this
form
. We read every answer. Applications without answers won't be considered.

1. **Your story:**
   Tell us your story. Who are you, and what have you done so far? Walk us through the big decisions you've made (your college and branch, your first job, a switch, a project you dropped) and why you made each one.
2. **Something you fixed:**
   Tell us about something you fixed or built that nobody asked you to. What was broken, what did you do, and what changed? Use numbers.

Write it yourself without using AI. We want to hear your voice, not a polished draft. Short, plain and specific beats long and perfect. We'll talk about your answers in the interview.

**OUR BELIEFS**

* **Nourishment is the point; taste is how it wins.**
  We engineer wellbeing people crave, every single day.
* **Great craft should multiply.**
  We encode expertise into systems, so our best day in the kitchen becomes every customer’s every day.
* **Consistency is a joy, not a chore.**
  The 10,000th meal should taste like the first.
* **Every role is a mandate.**
  You own outcomes, co-create the how, and shape important decisions from week one.
* **Low ego, high conviction.**
  We argue hard, decide boldly, and put the mission above ourselves.
* **The first people here shape the culture.**
  We are deliberately building a company with a soul, and you’ll be part of how it’s formed.

title: Producer
description:
What’s up?
**We’re VaynerMedia**
! We are a contemporary global creative and media agency with an expertise in driving relevance for clients and delivering impactful business results. The independently-owned agency was founded in 2009 and has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Singapore, Australia, Thailand, Japan and Mexico City. VaynerMedia has been recognized for its work at Cannes Lions, the Clio Awards and The Webby Awards. It is part of the VaynerX family of companies.
  
  
**Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it**
. VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time --- PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In APAC, we are proudly +200, servicing a diverse client all around the region.
  
  
**The Pitch**
We believe everyone's got brilliant ideas. But what sets YOU apart from the rest? It's making a beeline for out-of-the-box, killer concepts with the ability to make stuff happen. We've got makers and creators - from illustrators to poets to musicians to 3D artists - who bring brands to life, creating and hijacking at the speed of culture. You’ll help us put our hearts and soul into our client's products. Solving business problems in unorthodox ways. Touching audiences with emotions. Mixing art and passion with logic and numbers. All to make magic happen.
  
  
Our
**Producers**
oversee all aspects of production: estimating, concepting, scheduling, talent, shoot, editing, visual effects, music, and delivery all through a creative execution lens. This position is the hub connecting the Account, Creative, Project Management, Strategy and Business Affairs departments.
  
  
Producers coordinate with the digital, social, and experiential teams to ensure synergy of all assets and content. The ideal candidate supports the creative vision and comes from a culture of yes and winning. This role will be based in India with a reporting line to our Head of Production.
  
  
**Here’s where you come in.**

* Support and execute the creative concept.
* Develop and articulate production rationale and recommendations.
* A resource to the agency for developing production solutions and strategies.
* Procure, review and negotiate production estimates.
* Coordinate and schedule productions.
* Organize and run pre-production meetings.
* Manage production budgets.
* Review and approve all production-related invoices.
* Advise agency stakeholders in all content production-related matters with creative and budgetary solutions for improving quality.
* Be an expert on filmmaking, photography, image capture, digital platforms and formats.
* Manage multiple projects as needed.
* Be client-facing as needed.
* Mentor junior producers.

**Define Vayner Success.**

* Creative problem solver.
* Be one step ahead – anticipate and guide the team around pitfalls throughout the process.
* Be a diplomat – deal with conflicting personalities and agendas and be able to unite divergent viewpoints.
* Demonstrate fiscal responsibility and integrity.
* Be a savvy ad person who is able to understand strategies, platforms, trends and creativity.
* Be imaginative – bring your own ideas to the table.
* Have a strong visual sense.
* Be flexible – production is not an exact science.

**What a “Star” Would Entail Like**

* A minimum of 7 years of ad agency experience. Production experience is a plus.
* Knowledge of all agency disciplines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and proactive problem-solving skills
* Detail-oriented, take-ownership attitude, self-organizing and highly skilled in time management to facilitate involvement in multiple projects
* Able to work independently with limited supervision, and communicate up, down and laterally to project stakeholders within the agency
* Proficient in MAC OS, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Keynote (Adobe Suite & Smartsheet a plus)

**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia**
Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
  
  
Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us.
**We can’t wait to meet you.**

title: Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services
  
  
**Overview:**
Settlement & Currency Services is Mastercard’s center of expertise for global settlement, cross-border payments, currency and foreign exchange services, and value movement across traditional and digital financial networks. The team supports initiatives related to fiat and digital currencies, settlement infrastructure, and emerging payment technologies, working across products, markets, and functions to advance strategic priorities. The team also develops solutions that enable funds movement between Mastercard customers, engages with regulators and manages relationships with commercial and central banks.
  
  
Mastercard is seeking an execution-focused Vice President, Settlement & Currency Services to lead settlement and FX capability development and implementation across AP & EEMEA. This role will prioritize regional initiatives, support regulatory reporting requirements, and help manage responses to regulatory inquiries.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Conducting thorough analysis to assess the financial, operational, regulatory, customer, and system impacts and requirements needed to support settlement/FX initiatives
* Collaborating with the global team on strategic efforts such as introducing new settlement and FX enhancements in AP & EEMEA region
* Partnering with business units to strategize, develop and implement enhancements to settlement service offerings, ensuring alignment with market needs and operational capabilities
* Driving initiatives to ensure liquidity availability for settlement in AP & EEMEA region
* Engaging with regulators, central banks, and other stakeholders in AP & EEMEA region to manage regulatory audits and inquiries related to Settlement and FX and staying abreast of regulatory changes and legal developments
* Overseeing the timely and accurate preparation and submission of regulatory reports related to Settlement activities, ensuring compliance with reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Managing global settlement invoice processing including establishing new vendors, routing invoices for approvals/payment through Oracle, and triaging processing issues
* Ensuring that all project aspects are compliant with Mastercard policies and procedures
* Formulating and presenting strategic recommendations to executive management

**All About You:**

* Educational qualification: MBA or a degree in business or finance
* Proven track record in payment systems product/project management, including the implementation and maintenance of external systems or proprietary technology
* Demonstrated ability in leading high-impact transformation initiatives with strong project management and stakeholder management skills across global and cross-functional teams
* Advanced level of expertise in Treasury settlements / payment operations and banking infrastructure gained through experiences in multinational corporates’ Regional/Global Treasury centers, financial institutions or banks
* Proficient in payment network systems, including authorization, clearing, and settlement, and bank connectivity solutions like Host-to-host and SWIFT
* Significant experience managing regulatory correspondence on Settlement/Payment matters. Experience with payments‑related regulatory compliance requirements across APAC and EEMEA regulators like MAS, HKMA, ASIC, JFSA, RBI, PBOC, SARB is highly valuable while not mandatory
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with the ability to initiate and implement the needed changes to achieve business unit /corporate objectives
* Ability to think creatively and out-of-the box; ability to challenge the status quo; demonstrated ability to innovate
* Strong leadership qualities, including getting work done through others, being organizationally savvy, thought leadership
* Demonstrated ability to manage a diverse team with varying skillsets
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills, and proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, particularly the ability to work and communicate cross-functionally
* Management style that is proactive towards employee development

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Capability Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
The Data Product Capability Manager is a senior, hybrid role that combines the strategic focus of a data product owner with the cross-functional coordination responsibilities of a capability manager. This individual will own the definition, prioritization, and delivery of enterprise data capabilities - establishing the structure for how structured data is identified, governed, and consumed across the organization. Reporting into the Product Management organization, the role serves as the central connective tissue between business stakeholders, data domain owners, IT delivery, and data governance functions, ensuring that data products are developed in alignment with enterprise strategy, quality standards, and business value objectives.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Data Strategy Management & Roadmap Ownership: Define and maintain the enterprise data capability roadmap in alignment with overall business strategy. Identify data investment priorities, manage the capability backlog, and communicate progress and value delivery to senior stakeholders
* Vendor & Internal Data Needs Assessment: Evaluate and document structured data requirements across both vendor-sourced and internally generated datasets. Partner with procurement, legal, and data architecture teams to assess fit, feasibility, and compliance of data supply options
* Business & Domain Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with business and domain owners to identify and validate authoritative data sources (Systems of Truth / SOTs) and key attribute requirements. Facilitate workshops and working sessions to surface data needs, resolve conflicts, and build shared understanding of data definitions
* IT Partnership & Agile Delivery Planning: Collaborate with IT and engineering teams to translate data capability requirements into delivery plans using agile methodologies (e.g., SAFe, Scrum). Participate in sprint planning, PI planning, and backlog grooming to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution
* Data Governance Support & Stewardship: Support and actively contribute to enterprise data governance frameworks, policies, and practices. Work with data stewards and governance councils to ensure data capabilities are developed and maintained in compliance with data standards, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations
* Data Quality Management: Define and enforce data quality standards, metrics, and SLAs for owned data products. Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to implement monitoring, remediation, and continuous improvement processes that ensure fitness-for-purpose data across the enterprise
* Data Product Definition & Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise data products - from ideation and requirements definition through development, launch, and sunset. Ensure data products are well-documented, discoverable, and aligned to measurable business outcomes
* Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation path for data capability delivery across business, IT, and governance functions. Manage stakeholder expectations, facilitate issue resolution, and deliver regular status updates and executive-level reporting
* Data Maturity & Capability Development: Assess the current state of enterprise data capabilities against industry benchmarks and organizational goals. Develop and execute maturity improvement plans that elevate the organization's ability to manage, consume, and derive value from data assets
* Metadata & Data Catalog Stewardship: Champion the adoption and maintenance of enterprise metadata standards and data catalog tools. Ensure critical data attributes, lineage, and ownership are documented and accessible to enable data discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in product management, data management, or a related discipline, with demonstrated accountability for delivering data or technology capabilities in a complex enterprise environment
* Hands-on experience working in agile delivery environments; proficiency with agile frameworks such as Scrum, and familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent
* Experience supporting or leading data governance initiatives, including data quality programs, data stewardship models, or regulatory compliance efforts (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
* Solid understanding of structured data concepts including data modeling, data dictionaries, systems of record/truth, master data management, and enterprise data architecture principles
* Proven ability to elicit, document, and prioritize data requirements from business and domain stakeholders, including the ability to reconcile conflicting priorities and drive alignment
* Proven exceptional cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across business, IT, and executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant certifications such as CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), SAFe Product Owner/Manager, or equivalent data or agile credentials
* Experience with vendor evaluation and management, including RFI/RFP processes for data and technology solutions
* Experience on US Healthcare Domain
* Experience in a capability management, product ownership, or enterprise program management role within a data & analytics, enterprise architecture, or digital transformation context
* Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools such as Alation, Collibra, Informatica, or Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of cloud data platform ecosystems (e.g., Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) and their implications for data product design and delivery

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

Leads and directs programs with the objective to enhance engineering productivity and efficiency.

People leadership & development.

title: Business Strategy Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Premier engineering or management institutes preferred; MBA is an advantage.

**The Role**

**No playbook. No hand-holding. Real problems. Real ownership.**

We're looking for an exceptionally sharp, ambitious, and AI-first problem solver to work directly with the business leadership and co-founders at Zavya.

This is not a conventional business analyst role.

You won't be handed perfectly defined problems, detailed instructions, or established frameworks to follow.

Instead, you'll be expected to identify what needs fixing, question why things work the way they do, develop solutions, and take ownership of getting them implemented.

We're looking for someone who combines
**first-principles thinking, intellectual curiosity, technological fluency, and an exceptional bias for action.**

Someone who can think strategically, move independently, challenge assumptions, and build solutions rather than just recommend them.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Solve Unstructured Business Problems**

* Work directly with leadership to identify business bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities.
* Break down ambiguous problems using first-principles thinking, data, and structured reasoning.
* Move from problem identification to diagnosis, solution design, and execution.

**2. Build an AI-First Business**

* Identify opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies across functions.
* Build practical AI-powered workflows, analytical tools, and automations that improve productivity and business outcomes.
* Experiment with tools, prototype solutions, and implement what works.
* Challenge processes that exist simply because
  *that's how they've always been done.*

**3. Drive High-Impact Strategic Initiatives**

* Own special projects spanning revenue growth, profitability, business operations, and customer experience.
* Work cross-functionally to drive initiatives from concept to measurable results.
* Identify opportunities proactively rather than waiting for projects to be assigned.

**4. Turn Data Into Decisions**

* Analyze business performance, identify patterns, and uncover underlying drivers.
* Translate complex data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Build scalable decision-making frameworks rather than repetitive manual reports.

**Who We're Looking For**

**We care less about how many years you've worked and more about how you think, what you've built, and what you've owned.**

* **Academic foundation:**
  Graduates from leading engineering institutions (IITs, NITs, IIITs, VIT, or equivalent) or premier business schools preferred. MBA is a plus.
* **Experience:**
  1–3 years in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles, or high-ownership startup environments.
* **First-principles thinker:**
  Can challenge assumptions, structure ambiguous problems, and arrive at independent conclusions.
* **AI-native operator:**
  Uses AI extensively to research, analyze, automate, prototype, and execute. Has actually built something useful with AI.
* **High agency:**
  Doesn't wait to be told what to do. Identifies problems, proposes solutions, and drives them forward.
* **Fearless communicator:**
  Comfortable questioning conventional approaches, defending ideas with evidence, and engaging directly with senior leadership.
* **Analytical horsepower:**
  Strong quantitative reasoning, commercial understanding, and comfort working with data.
* **Bias for execution:**
  Values outcomes over presentations, experiments over endless discussions, and progress over perfection.
* **Learning velocity:**
  Can quickly understand unfamiliar industries, tools, and business problems.

**What You'll Get**

* **Direct exposure:**
  Work closely with business leadership and co-founders on consequential business decisions.
* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Take initiatives from problem identification through execution.
* **Freedom to experiment:**
  Challenge traditional processes and build better ways of working.
* **Cross-functional learning:**
  Work across growth, commerce, operations, technology, and strategic initiatives.
* **Accelerated responsibility:**
  Your scope will grow with your ability to deliver, not merely your tenure.

**Before You Apply**

This role is for people who are comfortable being uncomfortable.

You should enjoy solving problems without predefined answers, challenging established thinking, learning new technologies independently, and being accountable for outcomes.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
**Our Culture and Impact**
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Cvent Implementation team configures and deploys Cvent software for new and existing clients. Our mission is to provide expert guidance and hands-on technical execution, so every client successfully launches, adopts, and realizes value from their Cvent products.
  
  
The role blends project management, technical configuration, and client-facing consulting — and increasingly, the smart use of AI tools to move faster, reduce manual work, and give clients a sharper, more consultative experience. This is no longer just a configuration role: it's a role where the best performers use AI as a force multiplier across research, documentation, testing, and client communication.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Implementation / Implementation Lead, you will own mid-to-complex client implementations end-to-end — from discovery and process mapping through configuration, testing, training, and go-live. You'll act as a trusted advisor to clients, a hands-on product expert, and a mentor to junior team members, while leveraging AI tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality at every stage of the project lifecycle.
  
  
**Client Consultation & Strategic Delivery**

* Provide high-level consultation to clients on applying Cvent technology to meet their meetings and events program goals.
* Analyze current-state processes and map future-state workflows to Cvent solutions, identifying opportunities for automation along the way.
* Serve as a product specialist — deeply knowledgeable across Cvent products, able to demonstrate, consult, configure, test, train, and deploy solutions.
* Cultivate strong advisory relationships with key client stakeholders who influence adoption and long-term account health.

**Project & Program Leadership**

* Apply structured project management discipline — scoping, planning, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and change control — to manage simple-to-complex implementations, keeping timelines on track and proactively escalating barriers to success.
* Translate customer goals into objective, measurable success criteria (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-value, process cycle time, cost savings, ROI) rather than relying on subjective or anecdotal measures of progress.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics with clients at project kick-off, and report progress against them throughout the engagement so success is data-driven, not just directional.
* Oversee and/or configure client accounts, including testing, refining, and directing the contributions of other team members.
* Track time and profitability of implementation projects, providing recommendations on streamlining, automation, or process redesign.
* Coordinate and conduct virtual user training sessions for client teams.

**Technical Configuration & Product Expertise**

* Configure, test, and refine Cvent product instances to match documented client requirements.
* Diagram intermediate-to-complex process flows and identify opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Interface with the Product Development team to define and convey client feature requests.

**AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation**
**Role**
*This is where the role has evolved most. AI is now a core part of how implementation work gets done, not an optional add-on:*

* Use generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to draft, summarize, and refine requirements documents, process maps, and configuration workbooks — cutting documentation time and improving consistency across projects.
* Apply AI-assisted meeting summarization and transcription tools during discovery calls and configuration workshops to speed up note-taking, action-item tracking, and follow-up communications.
* Identify and build lightweight automations or AI-agent workflows for repetitive project tasks — status updates, test-case generation, training material drafts, and client FAQs — freeing up time for higher-value consulting.
* Maintain quality and accuracy as a human-in-the-loop reviewer: validating AI-generated configurations, documentation, and communications before they reach the client.
* Model and mentor AI tool adoption to junior team members and peers, helping the broader team adopt AI-first ways of working.
* Use AI-powered analytics on data such as usage patterns, support tickets, or historical project data to proactively flag risk and improve implementation quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to support sales activities where implementation expertise is a differentiator.
* Ensure client objectives and requirements are clearly conveyed and tracked throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Serve as a mentor to new team members, including on best practices for using AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Present internally as a subject-matter expert on implementation topics, lead conversations in team meetings, and participate in team committees, at times in a leadership capacity.
* 10 to 14+ years of external work experience in a project or customer management role — preferably in the corporate meetings, software, or broader high-tech industry — or a minimum of 5 years of Cvent experience.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent applicable experience.
* Experience implementing technology or automation, ideally within an organization responsible for managing meetings or events.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a positive, confident, and outgoing presence; strong presentation skills.
* Highly articulate and detail-oriented, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for clients of varying technical fluency.
* Strong project management skills — able to build and manage project plans, timelines, RAID/risk logs, and status reporting across multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to translate customer goals into objective, quantifiable outcomes and hold projects accountable to measurable results rather than subjective impressions of progress.
* Ability to comprehend and diagram intermediate process flows, identifying opportunities to streamline and improve efficiency.
* Proficiency in core productivity tools: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio/Draw.io.
* Demonstrable aptitude for learning and applying new technologies, and for applying general and industry-specific business knowledge in a fast-paced, analytical, team-oriented environment.
* Strong time-management and organizational discipline; ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
* A solutions-first mindset — comfortable proposing fixes rather than simply surfacing problems to management.

**Adaptability & Resilience Under Pressure**

* Ability to pivot quickly on customer situations — reworking scope, timelines, or approach mid-project when client needs, priorities, or constraints shift unexpectedly.
* Comfort operating through significant change management within a project (new stakeholders, revised requirements, shifting priorities) with flexibility rather than resistance to the change.
* Proven ability to multitask and stay effective under pressure — juggling competing deadlines, client escalations, and internal priorities without losing quality or composure.
* Willingness and ability to manage through non-ideal or ambiguous situations — messy data, incomplete requirements, tight timelines — rather than waiting for perfect conditions to make progress.

**AI & Technology Fluency (New)**

* Hands-on, practical experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to accelerate day-to-day work — documentation, research, communications, or analysis.
* Comfort working in a human-in-the-loop capacity: reviewing, validating, and correcting AI-generated outputs before they go to clients.
* Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging AI-powered workflow and automation tools, with a willingness to experiment and share learnings with the team.
* Basic understanding of how AI agents and automated workflows can be applied to client onboarding, configuration, or reporting tasks (formal AI/ML background not required).

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Experience with AI-assisted meeting transcription/summarization tools (e.g., Azure, Copilot, Glean, Claude).
* Prior exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Power Automate) or agentic workflow builders.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP) good to have, not required.
* Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher) or equivalent process-improvement certification.

KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993. KPMG Advisory professionals provide advice and assistance to enable companies, intermediaries and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance, and create value. stakeholders professionally.Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.A proactive, solution-oriented approach with the ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and resolve execution challenges.Valid driver's license and willingness to travel for regional and interstate site visits as required.Key Performance Expectations:Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and approved budgets.Maintain accurate site measurements and technical requirements to minimize rework and fitment errors.Ensure delays, communicates confidently with clients and vendors, and understands the realities of on-site execution.If you have hands-on experience managing signage, fit-out, or commercial workspace projects and can take responsibility for delivering them from start to finish, we would love to hear from you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for senior professionals who know how to turn complex clinical and operational data into decisions that matter. You'll bring your healthcare BI leadership experience to a team working on some of the most advanced AI projects in the industry.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a business intelligence team in building dashboards, reports, and analytics that support clinical and operational decision-making
* Design, maintain, and optimize BI infrastructure — including data models, SQL queries, and reporting pipelines — ensuring accuracy, reliability, and performance
* Analyze clinical, operational, and performance data to uncover meaningful trends and surface insights that support leadership decisions
* Translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, trusted outputs that drive improvements in care delivery and organizational efficiency
* Apply your domain expertise to evaluate, quality-check, and improve AI-generated outputs related to clinical analytics and healthcare data reasoning

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare or clinical analytics, business intelligence, or data management within regulated environments
* Proven track record designing and managing BI systems — including dashboards, reporting pipelines, and data models
* Comfortable working with clinical, operational, and administrative datasets and understanding their real-world implications
* Strong communicator who can translate technical findings into meaningful narratives for both clinical and operational stakeholders
* Self-directed and reliable — you deliver quality work independently without hand-holding

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with AI tools, LLM outputs, or AI training workflows
* Background in health informatics, population health, or value-based care analytics
* Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar BI platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work alongside world-leading AI research labs on genuinely cutting-edge projects
* Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
* Freelance autonomy with the substance of meaningful, high-impact work
* Gain direct exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated
* Contribute clinical intelligence expertise to AI systems that will shape how healthcare data is understood at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

A career within SAP Consulting services, will provide you with the opportunity to help our clients maximise the value of their SAP investment with offerings that address sales, finance, supply chain, engineering, and human capital. We provide comprehensive consulting, system integration and implementation services across multiple SAP applications, products and technologies. Simply put, we focus on delivering business led, technology enabled change for our clients including industry specific enterprise resource planning and the latest in mobile, analytics and cloud solutions.
  
  
  
To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose-led and values-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Use feedback and reflection to develop self awareness, personal strengths and address development areas.
* Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results.
* Demonstrate critical thinking and the ability to bring order to unstructured problems.
* Use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current industry or sector trends.
* Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance.
* Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and can explain the reasons for this choice.
* Seek and embrace opportunities which give exposure to different situations, environments and perspectives.

title: Hospital Health Data Governance Lead
description:
**Hospital Health Data Governance Lead (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your expertise in hospital data governance could directly shape how AI understands, interprets, and works with healthcare information at scale? We're looking for experienced health data governance leaders to help ensure that the healthcare data used to train cutting-edge AI models is accurate, compliant, and clinically meaningful.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. You'll work at the intersection of healthcare and advanced AI — contributing deep domain knowledge that most people simply don't have.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Evaluate and provide expert guidance on the quality, accuracy, and consistency of hospital health data used in AI model training
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance risks in healthcare datasets and flag them with clear, structured feedback
* Apply your knowledge of healthcare governance frameworks — including HIPAA and clinical data standards — to assess data integrity and regulatory alignment
* Review and critique AI-generated outputs related to health data management, governance policies, and clinical workflows
* Collaborate asynchronously with project teams to define and apply standards that make health data trustworthy and useful
* Complete task-based assignments independently on your own schedule

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in healthcare data governance, clinical data management, or health information operations
* Strong working knowledge of healthcare privacy regulations and compliance frameworks, including HIPAA
* Skilled at working across clinical, technical, and administrative domains — you understand what each stakeholder needs from data
* Detail-oriented and methodical — you catch what others miss and can explain why it matters
* Clear, structured communicator who can document findings and recommendations with precision
* Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without day-to-day oversight

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with data annotation, data quality assurance, or evaluation systems
* Familiarity with EHR systems, clinical coding standards (ICD, SNOMED, HL7/FHIR), or health analytics platforms
* Background in health informatics, clinical operations, compliance, or health IT
* Exposure to AI tools, machine learning workflows, or data labeling platforms

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs and AI teams
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact work
* Apply rare, specialized expertise to one of the most consequential applications of AI — healthcare
* Contribute to AI systems that could ultimately improve how health data supports patient care at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Event Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Aareana Production is an events production house specializing in weddings, corporate events, and social gatherings. The team focuses on creating memorable, well-executed experiences tailored to client needs and visions. By combining creative planning with precise coordination, Aareana Production delivers high-quality events across diverse formats and scales. The company values professionalism, attention to detail, and strong client collaboration, offering event professionals an opportunity to work on a variety of dynamic projects.

**Role Description**
The Event Manager role at Aareana Production is a full-time, on-site position based in Saket. The Event Manager is responsible for end-to-end event planning and execution, including understanding client requirements, developing event concepts, and creating detailed project plans and timelines. Daily tasks include coordinating with vendors, managing budgets, overseeing logistics, and ensuring all technical and creative elements are delivered on time and to specification. The role involves conducting site visits, supervising event setup and teardown, and addressing on-the-spot issues to maintain smooth operations. The Event Manager will also collaborate closely with internal teams, manage client communication, and provide post-event reports and feedback to support continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Strong event planning and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple events and tight timelines.
* Experience coordinating vendors, venue partners, and external service providers for weddings, corporate, and social events.
* Proficiency in budgeting, cost control, and basic contract management for event-related services.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage clients, negotiate with vendors, and lead on-site teams.
* Ability to work on-site during setup, event execution, and teardown, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the capacity to remain calm under pressure in fast-paced environments.
* Familiarity with event production tools, timelines, checklists, and basic understanding of audiovisual and décor elements.
* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Prior experience in an events agency or production house is highly beneficial.

title: Planning Lead
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* We are seeking a Planning Lead to manage the planning team while maintaining a hands-on role in project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and reporting using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project (MSP).
* The successful candidate will provide planning leadership across projects, ensure consistent scheduling standards, and personally develop and maintain schedules for assigned projects. This is a working leadership role that combines team management with practical project delivery.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the planning team, managing workloads and ensuring quality and consistency of schedules and reports.
* Establish planning standards, procedures, and reporting templates; support recruitment, training, and performance reviews.
* Develop, baseline, and maintain integrated project schedules using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project (MSP), including WBS, milestones, dependencies, and resource/cost loading.
* Monitor progress against baselines, analyse critical paths and variances, and develop look-ahead and recovery plans.
* Prepare progress reports, dashboards, S-curves, and performance indicators; communicate schedule status, risks, and corrective actions.
* Assess the impact of changes and delays, support delay analysis and extension-of-time assessments, and maintain schedule records.
* Coordinate with project teams and clients to align schedules, lead progress reviews, and resolve or escalate delivery risks.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Typically 8–12 years of relevant planning and scheduling experience, including experience leading a planning team.
* Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project; experience must extend beyond reviewing schedules prepared by others.
* Experience developing and controlling schedules through the full project lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of critical path methodology, resource planning, progress measurement, and schedule recovery.
* Experience coordinating multiple projects or complex work packages.
* Relevant industry experience in infrastructure projects.
* A relevant planning, scheduling, or project management certification is desirable.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!
  
  
Workplace Type

title: IV Fluids Manufacturing Plant – Technical Project Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Project Engineer / Consultant specializing in Intravenous (IV) Fluids Manufacturing Plants**
to support the planning, designing, establishment, installation, and commissioning of IV fluids manufacturing facilities in India or abroad. The candidate should have practical knowledge of large-volume parenterals (LVP), sterile liquid manufacturing, aseptic processing, filling and sealing systems, terminal sterilization, and pharmaceutical plant utilities.

The role involves providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable pharmaceutical manufacturing standards, revised Schedule M, WHO-GMP requirements, and other relevant regulatory guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and coordinate the establishment of IV fluids manufacturing plants for products such as Normal Saline (0.9% Sodium Chloride), Dextrose Solutions, Ringer’s Lactate, and other intravenous infusion solutions.
* Develop and review plant layouts, manufacturing process flow diagrams, equipment specifications, and production capacity requirements.
* Select and coordinate the procurement of IV fluids manufacturing machinery, including solution preparation tanks, mixing vessels, filtration systems, bottle or bag filling lines, sealing systems, and packaging equipment.
* Supervise machinery installation, erection, commissioning, trial runs, and production line integration.
* Coordinate the setup of sterile manufacturing areas, cleanrooms, HVAC systems, purified water systems, Water for Injection (WFI), and other critical pharmaceutical utilities.
* Provide technical guidance on IV solution preparation, filtration, filling, container closure integrity, terminal sterilization, and applicable in-process controls.
* Coordinate with machinery manufacturers, EPC contractors, architects, utility system suppliers, and pharmaceutical regulatory consultants.
* Support equipment qualification, process validation, cleaning validation, sterilization validation, and preparation of technical documentation, as applicable.
* Assist in establishing quality control and microbiological testing facilities for IV fluids manufacturing.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements, revised Schedule M, WHO-GMP guidelines, and relevant Indian pharmaceutical regulations.
* Troubleshoot technical issues during installation, commissioning, validation, and initial commercial production.
* Support project planning, cost estimation, machinery selection, implementation schedules, and budget control.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Pharmaceutical, or related Engineering, or another relevant pharmaceutical qualification.
* 3–8 years of relevant experience in
  **IV fluids, large-volume parenterals (LVP), sterile injectable manufacturing, or pharmaceutical plant project execution**
  .
* Practical experience in IV fluids manufacturing processes, solution preparation, filling, sealing, sterilization, and packaging.
* Knowledge of cleanroom design, HVAC systems, purified water, WFI systems, and other pharmaceutical utilities.
* Familiarity with revised Schedule M, WHO-GMP, GMP documentation, equipment qualification, and process validation.
* Experience in machinery installation, plant commissioning, production troubleshooting, and technical project coordination.
* Previous involvement in setting up or expanding an IV fluids manufacturing plant will be highly preferred.
* Experience with pharmaceutical EPC projects, plant engineering, or technical consultancy will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in the
**design, installation, commissioning, or operation of an IV fluids manufacturing plant**
, rather than only general pharmaceutical production experience. Candidates who have successfully executed IV fluids or LVP plant projects will receive preference.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates and consultants with relevant IV fluids manufacturing or plant commissioning experience are requested to share their updated resume and contact details.

title: Site Manager - Industrial (Facility)
description:
Location: Remote India, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Title - Industrial Site Manager**
**Industry– Electronics & Avionics Manufacturing**
**Location - Bengaluru & Mysore**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Industrial Site Manager to lead the planning, construction, commissioning, compliance, administration, and operational management of a greenfield manufacturing facility specializing in electronic assemblies, PCBA production, avionics products, and other high-reliability aerospace and electronics components.
  
  
The role requires a seasoned professional with 18–20 years of industrial leadership experience, including successful management of greenfield projects from concept through operational readiness.
  
  
The candidate must possess deep knowledge of Indian statutory regulations, factory compliance requirements, industrial infrastructure development, manufacturing operations, supply chain management, project execution, and workforce leadership.
  
  
The Industrial Site Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the facility is delivered on time, within budget, fully compliant with regulatory requirements, and capable of meeting aerospace-grade quality, safety, and production standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Greenfield Project Development & Site Operations Management
* Lead the end-to-end development of the manufacturing facility from site selection through operational handover.
* Coordinate land development, civil construction, utilities installation, and infrastructure readiness.
* Manage EPC contractors, consultants, architects, and engineering teams.
* Oversee factory layout planning, production flow design, warehousing, utilities, and office infrastructure.
* Develop and monitor project schedules, budgets, milestones, and risk mitigation plans.
* Ensure timely commissioning and operational readiness of all manufacturing areas.
* Establish and manage manufacturing operations for:

+ Electronic assemblies
+ Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) lines
+ SMT and through-hole manufacturing
+ In-Flight Entertainment (IFE) systems
+ Avionics products and subsystems
+ Aerospace-grade electronic equipment

* Develop production strategies to achieve quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement programs.
* Ensure production capacity planning and resource optimization.
* Regulatory Compliance & Governance
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Indian laws, regulations, and statutory requirements, including:

+ Factories Act and related State Factory Rules
+ Industrial Safety Regulations
+ Labour Laws and Employment Regulations
+ Environmental Regulations and Pollution Control Board requirements
+ Fire and Life Safety requirements
+ Electrical Safety Regulations
+ Hazardous Waste Management Rules
+ Building approvals and occupancy certifications
+ ESI, EPF, Professional Tax, and other statutory requirements

* Manage interactions with government authorities and regulatory agencies.
* Maintain all permits, licenses, approvals, and certifications required for factory operations.
* Real Estate Project Management & Execution
* Develop comprehensive project plans and governance structures.
* Manage project budgets, capital expenditures, and resource allocation.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular updates to executive leadership.
* Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Lead cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Site Management, Infrastructure and Maintenance:
* MUST Oversee operation and maintenance of:

+ HVAC systems
+ Cleanroom environments and compliances
+ Compressed air systems
+ Power distribution systems
+ Backup power systems
+ Water treatment facilities
+ Fire protection systems
+ Security and access control systems

* Ensure uninterrupted utilities and facility support for manufacturing operations.
* Manage Facility management company and provide end to end guidance to support local business sites including FM leadership in terms of managing local supplier relationships specific to the local business sites. Must be expert in soft skills including management of site security, physical security, housekeeping, offce boys etc for smooth functioning of complete Thales facility.
* Expertise in security systems including CCTV and access systems, housekeeping and office maintenance including zeal to drive innovation, transformation, change and efficiency strategically within organization.
* Understanding of Building infrastructure & back up source to provide non-stop service to the site in regards of Electrical, Water, power redundancy, Building Genset failures, electrical panel failures, Earthing, Air Conditioning etc.
* Day to Day Office Facilities and Maintenance, Vendor Management & rate contracts.
* Expertise in handling critical infrastructure like critical labs, SFC (frequency convertors) isolation transformers, various powers frequencies, UPS, VRF, VRV, PAC Fire System, WLD, Humidity control and HEPA filters given technical work site etc..and all associated AMC contracts.
* Make sure to take care of security of office employees at site, manage accidents, issues and complaints, and handle medical emergencies for the office through continuous improvements.
* Take initiatives including use of technology to improve site efficiencies, managing KPIs and continuous improvement in administration operations.
* Propose & Implement cost saving measures at site.
* Stakeholder Management
* Ensure all site related compliances are checked and adhered.
* Exemplary behavior in regards with Business Ethics and patience levels.
* Must exercise solid judgment and perform as a team player while executing duties.
* Must possess excellent interpersonal and written communication skills, be detail and results oriented.
* Demonstrated ability to interface with employees at all levels in the organization.
* Problem Solving Approach, highly organized and analytical strong work ethic.
* Possess a collaborative personality and be open to suggestions.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint presentations, excel reporting’s, word, Outlook, software’s like autocad, 3D graphics etc.
* Workplace 5S
* Timely monitoring and ensuring of calibration / servicing for essential equipment
* Inventory Management (e.g. all kind of Inventory management, Storage 5S, Cycle-count, Support Inventory Audit, etc)

+ Maintain accurate records of repair orders, Invoices, inventory, transactions
+ Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement strategies to enhance overall operational efficiency.
+ Oversee the maintenance of tools and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition.
+ Collaborate with the finance team to manage budgetary aspects related to all suppliers, vendors timely payments.
+ Ensure strict HSE and Quality compliances including ESD lab related with safety regulations and industry standards processes.
+ Ensure to adhere the timelines for different tasks.

* Proactive approach to identifying process improvements and cost-saving opportunities
* Support for Aerospace Quality Compliance
* Support implementation and maintenance of:

+ AS9100 Quality Management Systems
+ ISO 9001
+ ISO 14001
+ ISO 45001
+ ESD Control Programs
+ IPC Standards for Electronics Manufacturing
+ Aerospace customer requirements

* Ensure readiness for customer, regulatory, and certification audits.
* Supply Chain & Vendor Management
* Develop strategic relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers.
* Manage procurement activities related to facility setup and operations.
* Evaluate vendor performance and ensure contractual compliance.
* Support localization and supply chain development initiatives.
* Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
* Establish and promote a strong safety culture.
* Implement occupational health and safety programs.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.
* Lead emergency preparedness and business continuity planning.
* Drive incident prevention and risk management initiatives.
* Financial & Administrative Management
* Manage site operating budgets and capital expenditure plans. Need to prepare annual budget, Site CAPEX, Site opex and actuals In conjunction with MYB (Multi Year Budget), the REM shall optimize and propose the real estate budget as a whole (rent payments, charges, investment and conversion work, transfer).
* Drive cost optimization and operational efficiency initiatives.
* Oversee site administration, security, logistics, and support services.
* Ensure effective asset management and inventory control.
* Physical Security & Site Protection
* Design and management of complete industrial security architecture.
* Perimeter security, fencing, gates, and guard force management.
* Security policies, procedures, and risk assessments.
* Visitor, contractor, and employee access management.

**Electronic Security Systems**

* RFID and Smart Card Access Control Systems.
* Biometric Access Control Systems.
* CCTV Surveillance and Video Analytics.
* Security Control Room Operations (24×7).
* Intrusion Detection Systems.
* Alarm Monitoring Systems.
* Security Event Investigation and Incident Management.

**Security Technologies Knowledge**

* PIR (Passive Infrared) Motion Sensors.
* Glass Break Sensors.
* Door and Window Contact Sensors.
* Panic Alarms and Emergency Response Systems.
* License Plate Recognition Systems.
* Visitor Management Systems.
* Integrated Security Management Platforms.
* Asset Protection & Business Continuity
* Protection of high-value inventory and electronic components.
* Intellectual Property (IP) protection.
* Prototype and engineering asset security.
* Crisis Management and Emergency Response.
* Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Planning.
* Theft prevention and loss-control programs.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or related discipline).
* Master's Degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or MBA preferred.

**Experience**

* 18–20 years of progressive industrial manufacturing experience.
* Minimum 10 years in senior plant management, site leadership, or factory management roles.
* Demonstrated experience leading greenfield manufacturing projects from concept through production startup.
* Experience in electronics manufacturing, PCBA operations, aerospace electronics, avionics, or related high-reliability industries.
* Proven track record managing large industrial facilities and multidisciplinary teams.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Bridger
description:
**Department:**
Technology Solutions

**Location:**
Noida

**Description**
This role sits within the AI Agentics team, an independent team, working closely with Technology and functional leaders to support adoption, change management and function-level engagement as we roll out agentic AI across the business.
