title: Associate Fire Engineer
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
  
  
We are an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services. Through our work, we make a positive difference in the world.
  
  
As an Associate Fire Engineer you will be working with a creative, innovative, multi-cultural and self-motivated team of fire safety consultants in India, the wider UKIMEA region and globally. The successful candidate will complement our fire safety consultants by assisting with the implementation of fire engineering solutions and fire strategies across our projects. Due to our geographic location, we are very well positioned to work closely with our fire teams globally. It's an exciting time to be a part of our growth in India.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The successful candidate will form part of the project team on a range of different projects, managing junior engineers, and being supported by the wider team as necessary. The role will involve interactive and collaborative working with our fire engineers and with colleagues throughout the multidisciplinary teams at Arup. The projects will be diverse, exciting and range from conceptual fire strategy and masterplan developments through to detailed design and handing over landmark projects.
  
  
Our Fire Engineering team takes a particularly active role in the development of our people and routinely provide opportunities to attend appropriate training and development courses. Also, because of the developing nature of fire engineering, employees are encouraged to attend annual conferences and CPD events (both internal and external). Once you have demonstrated a suitable skill level in fire engineering and delivery of projects there will be a number of opportunities to advance your career.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is technically excellent and capable of delivering quality fire safety solutions on time and on budget. A proven track record of gaining agreement for prescriptive and performance-based design solutions from approving authorities is also essential.
  
  
As a senior member of the Fire team, you will have strong communication and negotiating skills and experience of leading project teams. You will be a team player capable of imparting knowledge and experience to other members of the team to grow and develop them under your support.
  
  
You should have strong commercial and client facing skills and be able to represent Arup externally with minimal supervision. An existing portfolio of clients / contacts in the industry would be of benefit.
  
  
Experience in the principles of smoke control and means of escape are essential and knowledge of fire safety codes, standards and guidance associated with the industry is also important.
  
  
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
  
  
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
  
  
**Is this role right for you?**
**We Are Looking For Candidates With**

* A minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant degree subject (fire engineering, other types of engineering, or architecture related degree).
* Chartered status with a relevant institution such as the Institution of Fire Engineers or be close to gaining Chartered Engineer status or equivalent (e.g. Professional Engineer in USA).
* 7+ years’ experience in a consultancy or similar environment with at least 3 years in a similar senior position. Extensive experience in delivering fire engineered solutions.
* Awareness of industry challenges and code changes and experience in implementation in projects as well as discussing/presenting to clients and stakeholders on the topic.
* Knowledge of IBC and NFPA codes and standards would be a benefit but not essential.
* Be familiar with RIBA stages of design or other design frameworks and understand the total fire concept: from the client brief through to construction and operation, the fire engineering challenges relevant to different design stages and the level/type of fire engineering input required to progress the design and contribute to completion.
* Experience in managing other engineers in the development and implementation of fire strategies, projects, and research initiatives.
* Experience in managing financial performance on projects.
* Experience in negotiation and agreement of scope, fee, contractual terms and conditions with clients. Understand and manage the scope and relevant programme constraints of projects, experience in project changes management.
* Experience in presenting and discussing design solutions, including fire engineering assessments, to approving authorities and other stakeholders.
* Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting junior engineers in their career development.
* Excellent report writing, presentation and communication skills, be collaborative, be creative and engaging.
* Experience in business development activities and establishing a network of clients / colleagues inside and outside Arup.

**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance
  
  
**Different people, shared values**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.

title: Interior Design Project Manager
description:
Job Summary

Epic Studio is seeking an experienced interior design project manager to plan, manage, and deliver interior projects from initiation through handover. The ideal candidate will oversee project schedules, budgets, site execution, contractor performance, procurement, and quality control while ensuring projects are completed on time and within approved costs.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)1. Project Planning & Scheduling

· Develop project execution plans, timelines, milestones, and resource plans.

· Coordinate design approvals, procurement schedules, and site activities.

· Monitor progress against the project program and resolve delays.

2. Budget & Cost Management

· Prepare and monitor project budgets, estimates, and cost plans.

· Track expenses, variations, purchase orders, and contractor bills.

· Control project costs while maintaining quality standards.

· Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising design intent.

3. Site Execution & Coordination

· Manage day-to-day site execution and coordinate contractors, supervisors, and vendors.

· Coordinate civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry, ceiling, flooring, and finishing works.

· Resolve site issues, drawing conflicts and execution bottlenecks.

· Conduct regular site inspections and progress reviews.

4. Procurement & Vendor Management

· Coordinate material procurement, delivery schedules, and installation.

· Evaluate vendor quotations, contractor capabilities, and work quality.

· Monitor material availability and prevent procurement-related delays.

· Ensure compliance with approved specifications.

5. Quality, Safety & Compliance

· Establish quality-check procedures and inspection milestones.

· Ensure work follows approved drawings, specifications, and applicable safety requirements.

· Maintain snag lists and track corrective actions until closure.

· Ensure proper documentation and approvals.

6. Client & Stakeholder Management

· Conduct progress meetings and communicate project status to clients.

· Manage client expectations, changes, and approvals.

· Coordinate between design teams, site teams, consultants, vendors, and management.

7. Project Closure & Handover

· Conduct final inspections and ensure snag rectification.

· Coordinate testing, commissioning, cleaning, and handover documentation.

· Obtain client sign-off and review project performance.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

·        On-time project completion.

·        Actual cost versus approved budget.

·        Quality inspection pass rate and rework costs.

·        Procurement and material delivery adherence.

·        Site productivity and issue-resolution time.

·        Client satisfaction and successful project handover.

Required Skills & Qualifications

· Degree or diploma in interior design, civil engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.

· 6–10 years of experience in interior fit-outs or turnkey interior projects.

· Strong understanding of BOQs, estimates, schedules, contractor billing, and procurement.

· Experience with MS Project, Excel, AutoCAD, or similar project management tools.

· Strong leadership, negotiation, planning, and communication skills.

title: Project Officer Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section
description:
PRINT
  
  
Project Officer Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section
  
  
16.06.2026 Expired
  
  
Teaser
  
  
**We are**
The European Union (EU) is an economic and political partnership between 27 European countries. It plays an
**important**
role in international affairs through diplomacy, trade, development aid and working with global organizations. Abroad, the EU is represented through more than 140 diplomatic representations, known also as EU Delegations, which have a similar function to those of an embassy.
  
  
The EU Delegation to India, New Delhi works in close coordination with the Embassies and Consulates of the 27 EU Member States. We are a fully-fledged diplomatic mission and represent the European Union in dealings with the Indian government in areas that are part of the EU’s remit.
  
  
**We offer**
The post of
**Project Officer**
Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section, under a fixed-term employment contract of 2 years, with a possibility of renewal under reserve of budgetary availabilities and operational considerations. For internal candidates holding an indefinite-term contract, alternative contractual arrangements may apply in accordance with institutional policies. The team consists of 12 people and there are occasional atypical working hours.
  
  
Under this post, the recruited person will be attributed functions depending on the needs of the Delegation, and on the changes of these needs. The successful candidate
**will serve under the supervision and responsibility**
of the Head of Cooperation Section, providing support, expertise and assistance in coordinating, monitoring and reporting the implementation of projects funded under budget lines dedicated to Human Rights and Democracy (HR&D) as well Migration and Mobility and will provide support and back-up to the section as a whole on related matters. The jobholder will participate in ensuring coordination on cross cutting-matters concerning Human Rights -including Business and Human Rights-, Migration and the Sustainable Development Goals. The jobholder will also undertake similar responsibilities as above, for additional thematic areas, as assigned from time to time by Head of Cooperation. Currently these include: Disability, Youth, Employment, Labour & Decent work, Stability, Peace building & Conflict Prevention.
  
  
**Following Main Tasks And Duties Are Currently Required**
**Task 1: Policy development**

* To participate in conceptual reflections and assist in elaborating work programmes, strategic documents and new approaches to cooperation activities.
* To provide economic, statistical and analytical inputs for European Commission drafts, directives or communications concerning cooperation activities within related fields of expertise.

**Task 2: Project/programme-management**

* To assist in management of all phases of the project cycle, from preparation and launch of Call for Proposals Guidelines, to identification and selection of projects, to contracting, to monitoring and evaluation of project implementation.
* Under the authority of the HoC to represent the EU in meetings and events organised by projects and in other official meetings between the EU and programme partners, International Organisations etc.
* To undertake field visits and to monitor and report on progress, both operational and financial.
* To review and approve Annual Work Plans & Budgets, Progress reports, invoices, expenditure statements, requests for advance and reimbursement prior to submission to the Finance & Contracts Section.
* To maintain regular operational and financial-monitoring information on EU assisted projects and programmes through relevant contract management applications).
* To participate in tendering procedures and preparation of contracts, follow up of auditing requirements and other financial agreements with projects and programs.
* To initiate and ensure adherence to procedures of the European Commission in all matters of project implementation.
* To advise and assist the project implementing organisations, monitoring the performance of consultants, where relevant, and preparing terms of reference, contract addendas etc.
* To contribute to, develop and launch Terms of Reference as required, for the organisation of studies, policy briefs and events on thematic areas of competence.
* To follow up on Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) issues and provide support as HRD focal point.

**Task 3: Inter service Coordination and Information**

* To coordinate with EU Headquarters and, where required, with Indian authorities, and other relevant Departments/Organisations on program and policy aspects of EU-India cooperation, in thematic areas of competence identified above.
* To provide briefings and information on projects, within and outside the Delegation as appropriate.
* To liaise with EU Delegations in the region, where relevant matters to do with development cooperation in the fields of Human Rights and Democracy, Migration and Mobility, and SDGs.
* To contribute to the work of other sections, on matters related to human rights, migration, youth, labour and SDGs, particularly in the preparation of briefs for the Political section for human rights dialogue, HR country strategy paper, HRD support, visits etc.
* To contribute to preparation of terms of reference for launching studies, policy briefs.

**Task 4: Other tasks**

* To contribute to strategic communication within the section and the EU Delegation as a whole
* To ensure EU Visibility is appropriately done by partners
* To support to HQ or Head of Delegation visits/missions
* To represent the EU at relevant workshops/conferences/meetings

The starting salary step for this position is INR 231,790, however the final salary will be determined based on candidate's relevant and verifiable professional experience and is subject to approval by Headquarters. There is a competitive benefits package, subject to certain conditions, including personal leave days and public holidays, health insurances and a retirement savings plan.
  
  
The expected start date will be 01/10/2026.
  
  
**Minimum requirements / eligibility criteria (necessary for the application to be considered)**

* Minimum of Master’s level in International Law, Human Rights, Economic and Social Sciences, Political economy, Political science or equivalent;
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. The professional experience must be acquired after the date on which the qualification allowing access to the post was obtained. Work experience in India or Asia is an asset;
* Excellent knowledge (C2) of English. Knowledge of Indian languages is considered an asset.
* Digital literacy, good knowledge of Microsoft Office;
* Right to residence and work in India;
* Judicial Extract for good conduct;
* Pre-recruitment medical fitness certificate to carry out the tasks assigned.

**Assets/selection criteria (basis for awarding points to select the best applicant)**

* Asset relevant to Task 2 and 3: level of skills of time management, and interpersonal skills; capacity of organizing and coordinating meetings and agendas;
* Asset relevant to Tasks 2 and 3:, e.g] team work fluency, high flexibility, and capacity to work under pressure;
* Asset relevant to Task 2:, e.g] work history ) in the area of relations with external stakeholders, events and public relations;
* Asset relevant to Task 1: knowledge/experience of EU policies, of international relations and of India’s social policies, media environment and economy.

**How To Apply**
The applicant must apply by sending
  
  

* a cover letter, signed
* a Curriculum Vitæ (to include, at the minimum, exact job titles, employers’ names and detailed tasks descriptions) using one of the Europass templates available at:

https://europass.europa.eu/en
  
  
**All Documents To The Following Email Address**
eeasjobs-058@eeas.europa,eu
  
  
**And Mention In The Email’ Subject**
“Ref: 144191 –: Project Officer: Cooperation Section ”
  
  
**no later than 17:00 hrs. (IST) on 03/07/2026.**
**Caution:**
The applicant must verify that he/she fulfils all the conditions. For easy verification, the applicant must mark all the squares r relating to each document or application condition. The absence of one of these conditions or documents is a reason for the rejection of the application
  
  
**The process**
After the deadline for applications, the
**eligible**
applications will be admitted to the Selection by the Committee set up for this purpose.
  
  
Depending on the number of applications received, successive phases of Selection may include shortlisting of candidates-based assessment of the information provided in the cover letter, CV; practical testing and interviews. 5 best candidates will be invited to the final interview
  
  
Only candidates admitted to each successive selection phase will be contacted individually. The Delegation will not supply additional information or discuss the selection procedure. During the selection process, please do not contact the members of the Selection Committee, but address your questions and comments to the Delegation’s Administration.
  
  
[The successful candidate will be subject to a [medical check, background check, etc. whatever is relevant].
  
  
Candidates who wish to lodge a complaint regarding the recruitment process may submit a written communication to the functional mailbox to which they sent the initial application. Upon receipt, the Delegation will review the matter and, where appropriate, consult Headquarters before providing a response.
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
The European Union is committed to an equal opportunities policy for all its employees and applicants for employment. As an employer, the EU is committed to promoting gender equality, preventing discrimination on any grounds and ensuring a zero tolerance approach to any form of harassment. It actively welcomes applications from all qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds. We aim at a service which is truly representative of society, where each staff member feels respected, is able to give their best and can develop their full potential.
  
  
If pre-selected, candidates with disabilities are invited to contact the Delegation (functional mailbox to which the applications shall be sent) in order to accommodate any special needs and provide assistance to ensure equality of opportunities with other candidates.
  
  
If a candidate with a disability is selected and recruited, the EEAS is committed to appropriate measures in order to accommodate his or her special needs to the working place or working conditions in accordance with Art 4 of the Decision ADMIN(2025)13 of the Director-General for Resource Management of the European External Action Service on providing reasonable accommodation for local staff with disabilities working in Union Delegations.

title: Project Leader- ENR
description:
**ABOUT US:**

  

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s Energy and Natural Resources (ENR CoE) team, based out of Gurugram office, and specifically support BAIN ENR practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The ENR CoE consists of 45+ team members, organized into ~10 teams, working across various sectors such as oil and gas, power and utilities, chemicals, mining, fertilizers and agri-business

As the ENR sector personnel, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for our clients in Oil and gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Wastewater Recycling, etc. The primarily objective of the sector professionals is to collaborate with practice/ case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products and topic expertise to answer strategic questions of Bain’s ENR clients.

An Associate works as a team member/contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. 

In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback. The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.

 

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

 

* Candidate should be currently working in strategy consulting/research-oriented set-up and possess acumen to  solve open-ended problems
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different ENR sub-sectors (Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Petrochemicals, etc.)
* Proficient in research and analysis, as well as able to provide solid business judgment to derive answers in situations where  data is not easily available or explicitly published
* Able to interface with primary client contact (Bain case teams from ME offices)
* May have first-level team management responsibility, which involves allocating and reviewing work to a small team of  analysts and conducting performance / feedback discussions
* Provide content thought leadership & may manage simple cases independently

 

**ABOUT YOU:**

* Candidate should be an MBA from top-tier College with strong academic records with 3-6 years of experience in consulting for ENR clients.
* Candidates should possess excellent analytical, communication, problem solving and team player skills; ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
* Should possess strong Excel Modeling and PowerPoint skills.
* Good understanding of any of the ENR subsectors is an added advantage

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Manager - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.
  
  
BCG’s PIPE Practice Area works with the world’s largest investment firms, serving six client asset classes: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Infrastructure & Real Estate Funds, Family Offices, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Pension Plans. Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required; 6-10+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
  
  
Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

**Additional Information**
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
***Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)***

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)***

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

***Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)***

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

**education–to-industry partner**
building the workforce powering India’s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry- aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability. At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.

Backed by
**global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan),**
we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare — two of India’s fastest-growing sectors.

**Role Overview:**

As the Point of Contact for the Facilitator Success Team at Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring we hire, train, and support high-quality Trainers/Facilitators across our campuses pan-India. This role combines elements of talent acquisition, capability development, and operational management, with the ultimate goal of building a strong and reliable facilitator workforce that delivers exceptional student outcomes.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Hiring & Requisitions:**

* Identify facilitator needs across campuses in coordination with corporate academics teams.
* Raise timely hiring requisitions to the HR team and track closure progress.
* Conduct interviews to assess facilitator fitment for Virohan’s teaching model.
* Ensure candidate evaluation is consistent and aligned with classroom expectations.

**Training & Capability Building:**

* Plan and execute training for newly joined facilitators, in partnership with the Academic and L&D teams.
* Track training participation and performance metrics to ensure delivery-readiness.

* Proven ability to identify and manage risks and drive mitigation plans with clear ownership.
* Experience in escalation management and governance of large infrastructure programs/projects.
* Excellent communication skills with experience managing senior stakeholders.
* Manufacturing experience will be an added advantage.

description:

**About Us**
Nutrition International (NI) is a global organization dedicated to delivering proven nutrition interventions to those who need them most. Working in partnership with countries, donors, and implementers, our experts conduct cutting-edge nutrition research, support critical policy formulation, and integrate nutrition into a broader development agenda. For more than 30 years now, we have focused on delivering low-cost, high-impact, nutrition interventions to people in need, driven by our mission to achieve a world where everyone, everywhere, is free from malnutrition and able to reach their full potential. Our work is guided by a dedicated and talented team of experts working globally, regionally and within countries to end malnutrition worldwide.
  
  
If you are a motivated and passionate individual who shares our conviction that a better world is possible through improved nutrition, wants to leave the world a little better than they found it, and is looking to be part of a team with a clear vision, we want to hear from you. Please consider applying for the position below which is being advertised for an anticipated project.
  
  
**About The Project**
The Preconception Nutrition and Care project is an exciting new initiative in India. It aims to change how families begin: by reaching couples of reproductive ages with nutrition, health interventions and counselling before pregnancy, so that women enter pregnancy healthier and better nourished. Healthier beginnings lead to better maternal and birth outcomes. The project takes a systems-based approach. It brings together service delivery, evidence generation, learning and government partnership, so that preconception care becomes integrated into overall health system delivery. At the heart of the project is a commitment to putting the nutritional needs of women and couples at the center of design and implementation. The project aims to generate evidence and learning from implementation, and to use it to shape national dialogue on preconception nutrition and care.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Project Director will lead this work from New Delhi. You will head a small, focused team, guide a range of implementing partners and engage with state and national government. You will also be the primary voice of the project with the donor, government, research bodies and the private sector. You will work closely with Nutrition International's Maternal Newborn Health and Nutrition and Health Economics and Nutrition Financing portfolios, as well as colleagues in the Asia Regional Office and headquarters in Ottawa.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-visibility project, with full accountability for results, partnerships and resources. You will help set the direction for how India, and the wider region, approaches nutrition and care before pregnancy.
**In this role you**
**will be responsible to:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for donor/s, national government representatives and strategic partners to lead evidence-based negotiations on project priorities, scope, and deliverables
* Facilitate shared understanding of project scope, goals and deliverables and among project staff, partners and stakeholders
* Guide the implementation of project activities and ensure project staff and partners are executing the project according to the approved project plan
* Manage relations with partners, service providers and consultants of the project, according to Nutrition International's policies. This includes the development of terms of reference, service provided and consultant/firm selection, contracting, monitoring and end of contract processes
* Oversee and work closely with government stakeholders and partners to develop detailed annual workplans that clearly define the strategies, activities and resources (time, budget and equipment etc.) required for effective implementation of the project; and update workplans regularly to ensure the timely completion of activities and achievement of the deliverables
* Cultivate and manage strong, collaborative relationships with implementing partners, government authorities, donors and other key stakeholders. Ensure open communication channels and a shared understanding of the project's goals, responsibilities, and timelines
* Identify and engage with potential new partners that align with the project's objectives, ensuring their capacities complement the project's needs and strategies
* Ensure monitoring and learning strategies and systems are applied within the project in collaboration with the Monitoring, Data and Learning sub-unit
* Ensure a monitoring plan is developed and followed by the project team and partners. Ensure monitoring data is analyzed and used for course correction as needed
* Ensure that the project has a comprehensive staffing strategy with the appropriate composition of team members to ensure adequate oversight and quality assurance of all work within the project
* Manage project staff contracts and consultants in a timely manner and according to local legislation and Nutrition International policies
* Provide financial oversight for the full scope of the project. title: Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub
description:
**Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub**

**Engagement Type:**

Consultancy

**Location: New Delhi**

**LEAD’s**
**Gender x Digital (GxD) hub**
**is seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The role combines inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder coordination, with a focus on developing and operationalising frameworks, establishing inclusion metrics and monitoring systems, and building a coherent evidence base on programme inclusion.**
**About LEAD at Krea University**

LEAD
is an action-oriented research centre of IFMR Society (a not-for-profit society registered under the Societies Act), leverages the power of research, innovation and co-creation to solve complex and pressing challenges in development. LEAD specialises in developing in-depth granular understanding of socio-economic contexts and harnessing actionable insights that have a wide range of applications in industry, policy, and academia. LEAD is a collaborative hub that brings experts from diverse disciplines and sectors together to develop innovative solutions by harnessing innovation, technology and analytics.

**About GxD hub**

The
Gender x Digital hub (GxD hub)
is a cross-disciplinary platform dedicated to advancing meaningful digital connectivity among women and girls in India. GxD hub is an initiative of LEAD at Krea University (IFMR). Our mission is to address critical intersections between gender and digital through rigorous research, impactful engagement with stakeholders, and ecosystem development. Our work is rooted in a deep commitment to develop gender intentional and overall inclusive digital platforms in the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The candidate will sit at the intersection of inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder co-ordination, contributing to the development and operationalisation of frameworks that ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with a particular focus on women and underserved groups.

This role combines inclusion expertise with strong data capabilities. The candidate will be responsible for tracking and synthesising progress against inclusion targets, while building the systems and evidence base needed to document and communicate the programme’s equity outcomes across states and implementing partners.

This is a stakeholder-facing role for someone who can navigate government and field contexts while bringing analytical rigour to their work. The ideal candidate is an inclusion practitioner with strong data and research skills, who can synthesise evidence, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and translate programme insights into clear, actionable outputs. The candidate will be placed within the Ministry that GxD hub is closely working with.

**Key Responsibilities**



**Inclusion Strategy and Implementation**

●     Develop and operationalise an inclusion strategy to ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with attention to gender, geography, and socioeconomic status

●     Advise on accessibility standards for training content, digital platforms, and learning delivery mechanisms

●     Conduct periodic reviews and recommend interventions to address participation gaps across regions and demographics

**Monitoring, Data, and Evidence**

●     Establish inclusion metrics, monitoring frameworks, and reporting mechanisms for states and implementing partners

●     Ensure inclusion-related data is systematically collated, structured, and narrated consistently — building a coherent evidence base from the programme's earliest stages

●     Track and monitor progress on women's participation and other inclusion targets, and synthesise findings into regular reports and briefs for internal and external audiences

●     Support secondary data analysis and evidence synthesis to contextualise programme data within the broader landscape of digital inclusion in India

**Government and Stakeholder Coordination**

●     Coordinate with ministries, state governments, NGOs, and community organisations to improve outreach among underserved groups

**Minimum Qualifications**

●     Master's degree in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Policy, Development Studies, Education, or a related field

●     Minimum 8 years of experience in inclusion, gender, accessibility, social development, or large-scale government or development programmes

●     Demonstrated experience working directly with central or state government counterparts in India — including in advisory, coordination, or embedded roles

●     Strong track record in data synthesis, evidence collation, and translating programme data into structured narratives for policy and funder audiences

●     Experience designing or operationalising inclusion monitoring frameworks, with hands-on familiarity with indicator development and reporting systems

**Strongly Desired**

●     Prior experience embedded in or advising large-scale government skilling, digital access.

●     Familiarity with India's digital ecosystem, including digital public infrastructure, and the policy landscape around AI and digital skilling

●     Experience working with government-commissioned research, and multi-stakeholder coordination across central and state bodies

●     Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, including primary data collection, field assessments, and mixed-method approaches

**Application Instructions**

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

**To apply, please email the below documents as a single PDF to**
**hr-lead@ifmr.ac.in**
**:**

●     Curriculum vitae

●     Cover letter (no more than two pages) explaining your interest in the role and writing sample

***Note:***
*Due to the large volume of applications we receive, we are unable to contact each candidate individually regarding the status of their application. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purposes.*

title: Art Director
description:

Fraganote is a VC-backed Indian fragrance house redefining how modern India experiences perfume.

We are deeply obsessed with blends, stories, and the emotional architecture of fragrance. Here, perfume isn't just a product—it's identity, memory, mood, and cultural commentary.

Conversations in our office range from olfactory construction to consumer psychology to whether a vanilla note should feel smoky, creamy, or quietly powerful.

We move fast. We think long-term. And we're building one of India's most iconic fragrance brands.

As the
**Art Director**
at Fraganote, you will define and elevate the creative vision of the brand across every consumer touchpoint. You'll lead the visual language of campaigns, product launches, content, packaging, and digital experiences while ensuring every piece of communication reflects the sophistication and emotional depth of the brand.

This role goes beyond execution—you'll be responsible for conceptual thinking, creative direction, mentoring the design team, and collaborating closely with marketing, content, photography, product, and founders to create work that is culturally relevant, visually distinctive, and commercially impactful.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve Fraganote's creative and visual identity across digital, print, packaging, retail, and social platforms.

* Lead, mentor, and inspire the design team while maintaining exceptional creative standards.
* Collaborate with photographers, videographers, stylists, content creators, and marketing teams during creative planning and production.
* Review and approve all creative assets before publication to ensure consistency, quality, and brand alignment.
* Drive innovation by exploring new design trends, visual styles, AI-assisted creative workflows, and emerging cultural aesthetics.
* Build scalable design systems and creative processes that improve efficiency without compromising quality.
* Balance strong artistic vision with business objectives, ensuring creative work contributes to brand growth and performance.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* **8-10 years**
  of experience in creative design, with at least
  **3–4 years leading creative projects or teams**
  .
* Strong portfolio showcasing expertise in branding, campaign design, packaging, digital marketing creatives, and visual storytelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and creative workflow tools. Motion design experience is a plus.
* Deep understanding of typography, composition, colour theory, luxury aesthetics, and brand systems.
* Experience working in D2C, beauty, fashion, luxury, lifestyle.
* Strong leadership, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional creative taste with an eye for detail and a passion for building iconic brands.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who doesn't just design beautiful assets—they create worlds that people want to be a part of.

You understand how luxury brands communicate, how culture influences design, and how great creative can drive both emotion and business results. If you're excited about building one of India's most loved fragrance brands through bold ideas and exceptional craft, we'd love to meet you

**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) seeks to establish a roster of qualified consultants to provide technical support to Member States in the development, implementation, costing, monitoring, evaluation, review, and strengthening of National Action Plans (NAPs) on Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).
  
  
Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, and the One Health approach.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains a major threat to public health, food security, economic development, and health system resilience. Countries in the WHO South-East Asia Region have developed and are implementing National Action Plans on AMR; however, varying levels of capacity, financing, governance, monitoring systems, and multisectoral coordination continue to challenge effective implementation.
  
  
To support Member States in strengthening AMR national programmes and advancing implementation of the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO requires a roster of technical experts capable of providing specialized support across strategic planning, costing, resource mobilization, monitoring and evaluation, programme review, governance strengthening, and One Health coordination.
  
  
The roster will enable WHO to rapidly mobilize qualified experts to support national and regional priorities as needs arise.

* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and multisectoral engagement.
* Develop or update AMR National Action Plans.
* Prepare implementation frameworks and operational plans.
* Support national validation and endorsement processes.

**Deliverable 2: Costing, Budgeting and Financing**

* Develop costed implementation plans.
* Conduct budget and financing analyses.
* Estimate resource requirements and investment needs.
* Develop financing scenarios and sustainability plans.
* Prepare resource mobilization strategies and investment cases.
* Assess cost-saving potential, cost-effectiveness and return on investment for AMR interventions and implementation options.

**Deliverable 3: Monitoring, Evaluation and Accountability Frameworks**

* Design logical frameworks and performance indicators.
* Establish monitoring and reporting mechanisms.
* Develop accountability and learning frameworks.
* Design data collection and review tools

**Deliverable 4: Mid-Term and End-Term Reviews**

* Develop review methodologies and assessment tools.
* Conduct programme performance reviews.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and review workshops.
* Analyse implementation progress and bottlenecks.
* Produce review reports and recommendations.

**Deliverable 5: Capacity Development**

* Develop training materials and guidance documents.
* Deliver workshops and technical training sessions.
* Provide mentoring and coaching to national teams.
* Strengthen national capacity in planning, costing, monitoring and evaluation.

**Deliverable 6: Reporting and Policy Products**

* Prepare technical reports and progress reports.
* Develop policy briefs and evidence summaries.
* Produce national and regional assessment reports.
* Develop strategic planning and investment documents.

Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the 2024 United Nations General Assembly Political Declaration on AMR, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO AWaRe guidance, Universal Health Coverage goals, national AMR action plans, and relevant WHO guidance, standards and toolkits on antimicrobial use surveillance, antimicrobial stewardship, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, and responsible antimicrobial use across human health and One Health contexts.
  
  
**Background**
AMR continues to threaten public health and health system resilience across the WHO South-East Asia Region. Despite progress in implementing national action plans, countries continue to face challenges in responsible antimicrobial use, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, stewardship capacity, AMU surveillance, regulatory oversight and pharmaceutical governance. Strengthening AWaRe implementation, stewardship programmes, surveillance systems and One Health collaboration remains a regional priority under the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025–2030. A roster of technical experts will help WHO rapidly support Member States with specialized expertise as needs arise.

Establish or strengthen AMU surveillance systems, including methods, protocols, data collection, analysis, reporting, dashboards, multisectoral integration, and technical recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 2: Antimicrobial Stewardship Programme Development and Implementation**
Develop and implement AMS strategies, programmes, tools and quality-improvement measures, including AWaRe implementation and interventions to improve prescribing practices.

**Deliverable 4: Regulatory Systems and Pharmaceutical Governance**
Review antimicrobial regulatory and policy frameworks, assess prescribing, dispensing, sales and marketing practices, and support stronger regulations, quality assurance, licensing, prescription-only policies and implementation recommendations.

Support One Health approaches to optimize antimicrobial use across human, animal, food production and environmental sectors, including multisectoral coordination, integrated monitoring, consultations, and implementation of responsible-use strategies and action plans.
  
  
**Deliverable 6: Capacity Development**
Develop and deliver AMS/AMU training, mentoring, awareness and behaviour-change activities, and strengthen institutional capacity for stewardship, surveillance, regulation and access programmes.
  
  
**Deliverable 7: Monitoring, Evaluation and Programme Performance Assessment**
Monitor and evaluate AMS, AMU, access and governance programmes, including indicators, reporting systems, performance reviews, lessons learned and recommendations for strengthening and sustainability.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s leading Community Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. We have proudly facilitated 5 million+ members. By leveraging AI-based algorithms, we streamline the process of searching and connecting with compatible profiles. Our platform redefines how people perceive and approach marriage, ensuring an easy and efficient experience.

**Build the Team. Own the Architecture. Ship the Product. Solve the Hardest Problems.**

**Experience:**
Proven engineering leadership experience required

**Preferred background:**
Strong product-based technology companies

**Role:**
Hands-on Engineering Manager / Individual Contributor

**Expectation:**
High ownership, high execution velocity, zero dependency on constant supervision

The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader who can do both:
**build a high-performing engineering team and personally solve difficult engineering problems.**

You are not someone who stopped coding after becoming a manager. You can review a system architecture, understand an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a production outage, write a critical service, build an AI agent, and still know how to hire, coach, challenge, and manage engineers effectively.

You can take an ambiguous business objective, translate it into an engineering strategy, break it into executable work, assign ownership, remove bottlenecks, and drive it to production.

When the team is moving fast, you multiply its output. When a critical technical problem is blocking delivery, you can get into the details and help solve it yourself.

You are technology-agnostic, obsessed with execution, comfortable with complexity, and actively exploring how AI and autonomous agents can change the way software is built.

**We are not looking for a manager who needs a team to do the engineering for them but for an engineer who has developed the ability to make an entire team more effective without losing the ability to build themselves.**

**What You Will Own**

1. Engineering execution and delivery

* Take complete ownership of engineering delivery, from understanding business priorities to shipping reliable production systems.
* Convert ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans, milestones, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution across multiple projects without allowing dependencies, indecision, or coordination overhead to become excuses for delays.
* Identify bottlenecks early, make trade-offs decisively, and unblock the team without waiting for escalations.
* Maintain high execution velocity without accumulating reckless technical debt or compromising security and reliability.
* Ensure the team ships working software, not just completed tickets, merged pull requests, or impressive-looking roadmaps.
* Take direct ownership of critical deliverables when timelines or technical complexity demand hands-on intervention.

2. Hands-on engineering and technical leadership

* Remain technically credible through active coding, code reviews, debugging, system design, and production ownership.
* Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automations, and AI-powered systems as required.
* Navigate unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* Make sound architecture decisions based on business needs, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, and time to market.
* Diagnose complex production failures, performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, and difficult integration issues.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to personally take the keyboard.

3. Team leadership and people management

* Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers with clear expectations, accountability, and ownership.
* Hire engineers who demonstrate exceptional problem-solving ability, technical depth, learning speed, and execution.
* Set a high engineering bar and address persistent performance issues directly and fairly.
* Coach engineers through difficult technical decisions instead of becoming the team's permanent debugging service.
* Develop engineers who can independently own systems, make decisions, and deliver outcomes.
* Create a culture where engineers challenge assumptions, surface problems early, take responsibility, and continuously improve.
* Balance delegation with hands-on involvement without becoming either a micromanager or an absent manager.
* Provide clear feedback, manage performance, resolve conflicts, and make difficult people decisions when necessary.

4. AI-native and agentic engineering

We expect you to be an active practitioner of modern AI-assisted engineering, not someone who merely encourages the team to experiment with ChatGPT.

* Use AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
* Build or integrate agentic workflows involving planning, tool calling, multi-step execution, external APIs, and verification.
* Identify engineering and business processes that can be automated using LLMs, agents, and conventional software.
* Establish practical workflows that increase engineering throughput without sacrificing correctness or security.
* Evaluate new AI tools based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and cost.
* Teach the team how to use AI effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and validate agent-driven changes.
* Personally prototype and ship AI-powered solutions rather than limiting your involvement to strategy and vendor selection.

**We want a leader who uses AI to increase the output of the entire engineering organization, including their own.**

5. Cross-domain problem solving

You should be comfortable moving between fundamentally different technical challenges.

Depending on the problem, this may involve:

* Backend architecture, APIs, databases, caching, and distributed systems.
* Mobile, web, and end-to-end product workflows.
* Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, performance, and incident management.
* Payment gateways, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency.
* AI applications, LLM integrations, agentic systems, and automation.
* Security, reliability, cost optimization, and scaling systems under real-world constraints.

6. Business ownership

* Understand the business metrics behind the engineering roadmap.
* Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and engineering effort.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity, low-value projects and choices that don't solve a meaningful problem.
* Make informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Optimize infrastructure and engineering costs without creating fragile systems.
* Communicate technical risks, delivery trade-offs, and progress clearly to business stakeholders.

You are expected to understand not just whether something can be built, but whether it should be built, why it matters, and how quickly it needs to deliver value.

The Non-Negotiable Bar

**Technical credibility:**
You have personally built and shipped production software and can still reason deeply about code and architecture.

**Independent execution:**
You do not need your manager to tell you what to prioritize, how to solve a problem, or how to unblock your team.

**Leadership without hiding behind delegation:**
You can manage through others while remaining capable of direct technical contribution.

**Breadth of experience:**
You have dealt with different classes of engineering problems and can adapt beyond your primary specialization.

**AI-native thinking:**
You actively use AI and agentic workflows to improve individual and team productivity.

**Accountability:**
When a project fails, you investigate the causes, own your part, correct the course, and prevent avoidable recurrence.

**People leadership:**
You can attract, develop, challenge, and retain strong engineers while addressing underperformance directly.

What We Do Not Want

* A people manager who has lost the ability to understand or contribute to the code.
* A project manager whose primary output is meetings, status reports, and Jira updates.
* An architect who produces diagrams but cannot validate implementation details.
* A hands-off manager who delegates every difficult technical problem.
* A micromanager who becomes the approval bottleneck for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

* The team consistently ships high-quality software with predictable execution.
* Engineers operate with greater independence and take meaningful ownership.
* Architectural and technical decisions improve the product rather than create unnecessary complexity.
* Critical production issues are diagnosed and resolved systematically.
* AI and automation measurably improve engineering throughput.
* Engineering resources are allocated to the highest-impact problems.
* You can step into the hardest technical problems without becoming a permanent bottleneck.

Interview Process

* **Technical deep dive:**
  Walk us through complex systems you have personally designed, built, shipped, or operated.
* **Live problem solving:**
  Debug an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a failure, or solve a practical engineering problem.
* **System design:**
  Design a production system and defend your choices around reliability, scale, security, cost, and delivery speed.
* **AI-agent exercise:**
  Use an AI coding agent to solve a bounded engineering task and demonstrate how you verify its work.
* **Engineering management scenarios:**
  Handle missed commitments, underperformance, technical disagreements, competing priorities, and team bottlenecks.
* **Execution review:**
  Explain a difficult project you owned, the decisions you made, what went wrong, and the measurable result.
* **Ownership verification:**
  Distinguish what you personally contributed from what the team delivered.

We will evaluate the reasoning behind your decisions, not just the final answers.

**The expectation is simple: lead the team, own the outcome, understand the technology, and be ready to build when it matters.**

title: Head - Policy, Systems & Program Architecture
description:
**Competency**
: Policy analysis, systems thinking, program architecture, government process literacy, documentation.

**Job Mode:**
Onsite

**Reports To:**
Founder & CEO / Board of Directors

**Location:**
New Delhi (HQ) · Multi-state travel

**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk's core identity is as a policy-to-outcomes institution builder. This role is the intellectual and architectural engine of that identity. The Head – Policy, Systems & Program Architecture owns the 'R' and 'I' of the RIGHT model: Redesign (policy co-shaping) and Institutionalize (systems design). Everything that becomes RightWalk standard must pass through this function. This role ensures that what works in one state becomes codified, transferable, and replicable — not tribal knowledge locked in people's heads.

This role owns the institutional architecture of RightWalk’s work: policy reform logic, system design, program models, SOPs, quality thresholds, PMU blueprints, exit criteria and codification of what works across states. It protects the organisation’s identity as a systems-change institution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Policy reform logic and standards**

* Own the policy reform logic across RightWalk's domains — Education (RTE), Livelihood (Apprenticeship), and Health — including policy interpretation, rights-based reasoning, and advocacy positioning.
* Define non-negotiable standards for program design and implementation fidelity.
* Support government-facing policy/process improvements through evidence and design.
* Set non-negotiable program standards: define quality thresholds, entry/exit criteria, and program fidelity benchmarks across all states.
* Lead policy domain heads (Education, Livelihood, Health) and guide specialist analysts.
* Engage with government counterparts, NITI Aayog, and central ministries on policy refinement.

**2. Systems and process architecture**

* Design institutional systems: SOPs, process flows, governance structures, government-technology interface specifications, and central-state system alignment.
* Translate policy intent into implementable system designs.
* Develop templates for process mapping, bottleneck analysis and system redesign.
* Work with technology and data teams to ensure digital tools reflect real administrative workflows.

**3. Program architecture and playbooks**

* Own the codification of 'what works' — convert state-level learning into replicable playbooks, training curricula, and toolkits.
* Translate policy intent into executable program architecture — the bridge between reform logic and PMU operations.
* Define what must be standardised centrally and what can be adapted by states.
* Develop exit and transition criteria for government ownership.
* Ensure each program has clear logic from policy intent to beneficiary outcome.

**4. Codification and replication**

* Capture state innovations and convert them into RightWalk standards.
* Sign off on any new program design or modification before state rollout — the 'fidelity gate' for all RightWalk programs.
* Build knowledge products that support scale, training, donor communication and government adoption.

**5. Cross-functional alignment**

* Partner with the Data/M&E function on KPI definitions, indicator frameworks, and learning loops.
* Work with Programs to test architecture in real state contexts.
* Work with Tech/Product to translate workflows into digital requirements.
* Work with Communications to ensure public narrative reflects real systems work.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* RightWalk has a clear, documented policy and program architecture for each of its three domains — living documents that are used, not just filed.
* Every PMU in every state is working from a consistent playbook — not inventing their own approach.
* SOP and playbook structure created for major programs.
* The 'RightWalk Standard' exists — a codified set of quality thresholds and fidelity benchmarks that any state PMU can be assessed against.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Running state execution or managing PMU field teams.
* Owning donor relationships or fundraising proposals.
* Communications and media strategy.
* Data collection or field M&E.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  12–18 years. Prior experience at the intersection of policy and systems — could be government, a policy think-tank, a development consulting firm, or a senior implementation NGO role.
* **Domain:**
  Deep familiarity with at least one of RightWalk's domains: education (RTE), labour/apprenticeship, or public health systems.
* **Government literacy:**
  Ability to work with government drafting — GOs, policy circulars, SOP design — not just analysis.
* **Writing:**
  Exceptional writing and documentation discipline — can produce policy briefs, system blueprints, and playbooks independently.
* **Mindset:**
  Architecture mindset: thinks in systems, process flows, and standards — not just programmes.
* **Backbone:**
  Comfortable holding the line on quality and fidelity even under pressure from execution teams.



**Success traits**
: Architecture mindset, clarity, strong writing, humility to learn from the field, courage to define standards, ability to hold complexity without drowning everyone in it.
