* Strong understanding of integrated media channels including digital, social, search, commerce, video, programmatic, impact buys and other non biddable emerging media.
* Proven experience managing teams in a fast-paced offshore/onshore delivery setup.
* Experience handling multi-market campaigns and collaborating with global stakeholders.
* Strong operational mindset with experience managing workflows, quality standards, and process governance.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking capabilities with a data-driven approach to planning and optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Experience with media planning tools, reporting dashboards, and planning frameworks.
* Strong presentation and storytelling capabilities.
* Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and drive operational efficiencies.
* Strong coaching and people management skills with experience developing high-performing teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic environment.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. title: Business Technology Analyst - Global Trade Service - Hyderabad / Gurgaon
description:

Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever-changing global environment with fast-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.
  
  
We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.
  
  
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”)**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought-after career option.
  
  
**Deloitte**
Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact**
to their clients by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you will do.**
Our team specializes in effective technology-enabled methodologies and providing leading practices for global trade programs that address both international and local requirements, as well as embed international trade controls into day-to-day business operations.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* You will participate in the implementation of SAP GTS solutions at the client. More specifically you will be responsible for delivering compliance and customs solutions. Tasks include project management, change management, solution design, solution implementation and end-user support & training.
* In your role, you will lead and/or facilitate business process definition and modeling, check the feasibility of this business model regarding the SAP products and the legal requirements. You will guide a team to implement and configure the software to replicate the required business processes and analytical/reporting needs.
* You will contribute to the development and growth of the SAP GTS practice globally.

**The Team**
The GTA practice is composed of operations specialists, Global Trade Management technology specialists, customs brokers, auditors, and trade management professionals who help importers and exporters achieve worldwide compliance and realize efficiencies and advantages in their global supply chain. You will be based in India and support Deloitte Tax to serve clients with international operations and supports their global trade compliance requirements.

* Compliance Management
* Customs Management
* Trade Preference
* You have a good understanding of the supply chain management processes.
* Experience in other SAP modules than SAP GTS is an asset.
* Technical knowledge (e.g. ABAP, SAP PI…) is an asset
* You have good analytical and modeling skills.
* You are a team player with strong communication skills.
* You are open to work in an international multicultural environment and to work abroad if needed.
* You have a university degree or the equivalent by experience.
* You are fluent in English, any other language, especially Chinese and German, is an asset.

**Work Location:**
Gurgaon & Hyderabad
  
  
**Shift Time**
– 11am – 8pm IST
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and in our communities. We are creating trust and confidence in a more equitable society. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte’s purpose, commitments, and impact.

At Deloitte, we value our people and work to build an inclusive culture, where our people are encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work. Our commitment has led to outstanding results in terms of attracting, retaining, and advancing a diverse workforce. We drive multiple efforts focused on intentional hiring, increasing awareness and sensitization, and ensuring a safe work environment for all professionals. We are regularly recognized as an employer of choice across a range of aspects, including inclusion, well-being, innovation, leadership, and a place to start your career. To learn more, check out our latest accolades .

At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state-of-the-art, world-class learning center in the Hyderabad office, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Title: Project Manager – Client Coordination**

**Job Overview**

Looking for an experienced and highly responsible
**Project Manager – Client Coordination**
to manage retail fixture and furniture projects from order confirmation to final installation and client handover.

The candidate will act as the single point of contact between clients and internal departments, ensuring that projects are completed on time and according to approved designs, specifications, quality standards and commercial commitments.

This is a high-responsibility execution role requiring independent follow-up, proactive problem-solving, cross-functional coordination and end-to-end project ownership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Understand client requirements, expectations, specifications and deadlines.
* Maintain regular communication through calls, WhatsApp and email.
* Share project status, timelines, approvals and important updates.
* Handle client queries and coordinate timely issue resolution.
* Maintain strong and professional client relationships.

**2. Project Planning & Coordination**

* Take complete ownership of projects from order confirmation to completion.
* Prepare and maintain project schedules, milestones and deadlines.
* Coordinate with Design, Purchase, Production, Electrical, Finishing, Packaging, Dispatch and Installation teams.
* Ensure every department completes its responsibilities within the required timelines.
* Identify delays and bottlenecks before they affect project delivery.
* Escalate critical issues to management along with possible solutions.

**3. Design Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Design team for drawings, 3D designs, production drawings and revisions.
* Obtain necessary client approvals before production.
* Ensure production proceeds only against approved drawings and specifications.
* Maintain records of drawing revisions and client approvals.

**4. Production Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Production Manager and factory teams.
* Track production progress on a daily basis.
* Ensure materials, drawings and production requirements are available on time.
* Follow up on pending work and maintain project deadlines.
* Conduct regular project status reviews with concerned departments.

**5. Purchase & Material Coordination**

* Coordinate with Purchase regarding material requirements and availability.
* Track critical materials required for each project.
* Prevent material shortages from disrupting production.
* Follow up on pending purchases and vendor deliveries.

**6. Quality Control & Dispatch**

* Coordinate quality checks before dispatch.
* Ensure project deliverables meet approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate packaging, loading and dispatch.
* Prepare dispatch and installation requirements.

**7. Installation & Site Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Installation team and client/site representatives.
* Ensure materials reach the site as planned.
* Monitor installation progress and resolve site-related coordination issues.
* Ensure final project completion and client handover.

**8. Project Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain records of client requirements, approved drawings and BOQ/specifications.
* Track project timelines, design revisions and client approvals.
* Maintain purchase, material availability and production status records.
* Track dispatch and installation progress.
* Maintain records of pending issues and final handover.
* Update project tracking sheets and provide clear status reports to management.

**9. Daily Project Management**

* Review all active projects every morning.
* Identify daily priorities and pending activities.
* Follow up with concerned departments.
* Update project status and tracking sheets.
* Communicate important updates to clients.
* Identify potential delays in advance and take corrective action.
* Ensure client commitments are followed internally.
* Provide management with a clear daily project status.

**Candidate Profile**

* Highly organized, responsible and detail-oriented.
* Excellent follow-up and coordination skills.
* Strong client communication and relationship management abilities.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Comfortable handling multiple projects simultaneously.
* Able to work independently and take ownership of project outcomes.
* Proactive in resolving issues without waiting for instructions.
* Strong in Excel/Google Sheets and project tracking.
* Comfortable communicating through WhatsApp, email and phone.
* Able to coordinate effectively with factory and site teams.
* Focused on deadlines, quality and customer satisfaction.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* A Diploma/Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Furniture/Production Management or a related field will be an advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

**4–7 years of relevant experience**
, preferably in:

* Retail interior projects
* Retail fixtures and furniture
* Modular furniture
* Interior execution
* Furniture manufacturing
* Shop fitting
* Exhibition/stall fabrication
* Project coordination

Candidates with experience in
**retail showroom fixtures and furniture manufacturing**
will be strongly preferred.

**Software Skills**

* MS Excel / Google Sheets
* MS Office
* WhatsApp Business
* Email communication
* Basic project management software / CRM
* AutoCAD or the ability to read production drawings will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time project completion
* Client satisfaction
* Reduction in delayed projects
* Reduction in project-related complaints
* Accuracy of project information and status reporting
* Effective internal department coordination
* Timely client approvals
* Reduction in rework
* Installation completion within committed timelines
* Timely collection/payment follow-up coordination

**Introduction**
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
Global Client Reporting produces high-quality financial and investment reports that provide clients with clear insight into fund performance, composition, and strategy. Our ambition is to deliver a reporting experience that is Client-centric, Efficient & Scalable and Insight-driven; enabled by centralised reporting SMEs.
  
  
We operate as a single global team with a diverse talent base, united by our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
**About Your Role**
We are looking for a proactive and techno-functional
**Manager – Client Reporting Solutions**
to balance Business-as-Usual (BAU) delivery with end-to-end business, change and delivery process optimization. Working across business, operations, and technology teams, you will identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and transform processes by leveraging data, AI, automation, and process reengineering.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines an agile mindset with strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills to translate business needs into practical solutions. You will lead change initiatives from solution design through implementation and UAT while strengthening governance, reporting, risk management, and operational capability to deliver sustainable business outcomes and continuous improvement.
  
  
**About You**
The successful candidate will be expected to perform the primary duties associated with this role. The responsibilities outlined below are provided as a high-level guide and may evolve over time to meet business and operational requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Process Transformation**

* Drive end-to-end business and delivery process optimization through simplification, standardization, process reengineering, and automation.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and client outcomes by leveraging AI, digital solutions, and data-driven insights.
* Partner with business and technology teams to design and implement sustainable process improvements and operating models.

* Develop dashboards, KPIs, and performance insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Monitor operational performance and drive timely resolution of issues.

**Governance, Risk & Data Management**

* Support governance through business reviews, performance reporting, and action tracking.
* Ensure robust data quality, reporting integrity, and compliance with governance standards.
* Identify operational risks, issues, and dependencies, driving mitigation plans and control improvements.

**Project Delivery & Change**

* Lead or support cross-functional business transformation initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, execution, defect management, and business sign-off.
* Apply Agile/SAFe principles to deliver change effectively and support successful business adoption.

**Capability Building & Stakeholder Management**

* Develop process documentation, standards, and knowledge assets to support operational excellence.
* Build team capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and adoption of new tools, technologies, and ways of working.
* Build effective relationships with business, technology, operations, and client stakeholders through clear communication, governance, and executive reporting.

**Skills & Competencies**
**Technical Expertise**

* AI-enabled productivity tools and technology adoption.
* Business process improvement, optimisation, and digital transformation.
* Financial instruments, Mutual funds, Fund Accounting and Reporting domain expertise
* Techno-functional solution design and delivery.
* Change management, operations excellence and continuous improvement frameworks.
* Agile/SAFe methodologies and User Acceptance Testing (UAT); JIRA use expertise.

* Issue and quality management.

**Professional Attributes**

* Experience working within global, cross-functional environments.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proactive, results-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities with attention to detail.
* High degree of ownership, accountability, and execution discipline.
* Capable of driving alignment and managing change across stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Degree in Engineering, Technology, Finance or a related discipline. MBA with Engineering background preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in Business Operations, Service Delivery or Business Transformation in Fund Administration / Asset Management / Investment Banking domain .
* Certification in NCFM, Agile, SAFe, PMP, PRINCE2, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt preferred.

**Feel rewarded**

title: Project Coordinator – Digital Literacy (Urban)
description:

Location : Delhi-NCR

HelpAge India is a secular, not-for-profit organisation in India, registered under the Societies’ Registration Act of 1860. Set up in 1978, the organisation works for
*‘the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life’*
. It runs healthcare, agecare, livelihood, disaster response and awareness initiatives throughout the country & advocates strongly for the elder cause. It became the first and only Indian organization to be honoured with the ‘UN Population Award 2020’ for its exemplary work in the field of ageing and population issues, and earlier in 2014, has been the recipient of
*‘Vayoshreshtha Samman’*
by Government of India, as an institution working for senior citizens. We have been awarded highest CRISIL VO 1A grading for excellence in operations and high credibility. We have been recognized as a Great Place to Work.

**Role Overview**

The Project Coordinator will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing the Digital & Financial Empowerment Programme for senior citizens across the state. The position requires close engagement with senior citizen associations, community volunteers, community stakeholders, and project teams to ensure effective program delivery, achievement of targets, and timely reporting.

**Programme Implementation & Coordination**

* **Coordinate and oversee programme implementation across designated districts and**
  urban locations.
* Develop and maintain a database of Senior Citizen Associations (SCAs), Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), clubs, elder groups, and urban slum communities.
* Ensure adherence to project timelines, guidelines, and quality standards.
* Monitor programme activities and provide regular updates to the State Program Manager, State Head, and Programme Lead.

**Training & Capacity Building**

* Organize and facilitate monthly digital, financial, and legal literacy workshops for senior citizens.
* Conduct awareness sessions on digital safety, cyber fraud prevention, online services, financial inclusion, and legal rights.
* Train and mentor youth volunteers to support programme implementation.
* Build local resource networks to strengthen outreach and programme impact.

**Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation**

* Ensure achievement of monthly and quarterly programme targets.
* Collect, verify, and maintain programme data for monitoring and evaluation.
* Prepare and submit progress reports, MIS reports, success stories, photographs, videos, and case studies.
* Track participant feedback and recommend improvements to enhance programme effectiveness.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with SCAs, RWAs, elder groups, banks, financial institutions, legal authorities, and community stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder consultations, programme reviews, and planning meetings.
* Represent the programme at local events, networking forums, and observances such as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day (WEAAD) and International Day of Older Persons (IDOP).

**Administrative Support**

* Coordinate logistics for workshops, training programmes, and outreach activities.
* Maintain records of programme activities, attendance, and volunteer engagement.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and project requirements.

Requirements
  
  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Sociology, Development Studies, Education, Management, or a related field.

* 1 to 3 years of experience in programme coordination, community development, outreach, training, or related social sector projects.
* Experience working with senior citizens, digital literacy, financial inclusion, or community-based programmes will be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Programme planning and project management
* Training and facilitation skills
* Stakeholder engagement and partnership building
* Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting
* Strong communication and presentation skills, proficency in local language is a must
* MIS and data management
* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Volunteer and team management
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and digital tools

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: PMO Senior Consultant
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Project Management Office (PMO) Senior Analyst**
, you will support ERM's global consulting delivery by enabling effective project governance, financial oversight, resource planning, and operational excellence across complex consulting projects. Working closely with Project Managers, Partners in Charge, and cross-functional teams, you will help ensure projects are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with client expectations. This role is critical in driving project performance, supporting informed decision-making through data and reporting, and enhancing the scalability and consistency of project delivery across ERM's global business.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Drive successful project execution by tracking project performance, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables across multiple engagements.
* Provide timely project insights, reports, and dashboards that enable project leadership to make informed business and delivery decisions.
* Strengthen project governance and compliance through effective management of approvals, risk registers, change controls, and project setup processes.
* Improve commercial and financial performance by supporting project scoping, resource planning, budgeting, invoicing, and contract administration activities.
* Enhance collaboration across global teams by facilitating project communications, stakeholder engagement, and delivery coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
* Contribute to consistent, high-quality project delivery by supporting best practices, mentoring junior team members, and promoting continuous improvement in project management processes.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from an accredited university.
* 5-8 years of project management experience.
* Strong understanding of contracts and project management processes.
* Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Applications and MS Project.
* Effective and professional communication with employees and clients.
* Ability to work with minimal direction in a highly collaborative manner.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Prior experience in environmental, sustainability, or infrastructure projects is a plus.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies**

* Experience working within environmental, sustainability, infrastructure, or engineering consulting projects.
* Exposure to global delivery, shared services, or matrixed organizational environments.
* Familiarity with project financial management systems, reporting tools, and contract management processes.
* Knowledge of project risk assessment, change management, and governance frameworks.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Health & Safety, Well-being, and Belonging Management**

* Monitor health and safety performance and meeting requirements while supporting field staff.
* Develop and distribute team briefing notes to support others in navigating ambiguity.
* Model ERM values, act with integrity, and contribute to a positive, inclusive team environment.
* Mentor junior colleagues, share knowledge, and actively participate in team and community activities.

**Commercial Leadership**

* Support proposal development including scoping and resourcing plan development.
* Lead in preparing comprehensive cost estimates using ERM’s Value Pricing Platform.
* Review contract details and maintain requirements register.
* Engage with marketing team in proposal development.
* Determine staffing availability and support project set up documentation.
* Curate required contract documentation and initiate project set up upon client authorization.

**Project Management**

* Support multiple projects through tracking project status, financials, resources, deliverables, and invoicing.
* Lead project tracking meetings, budget reviews, and risk management review activities.
* Prepare clear project reports and dashboards and use data insights to inform the Project Leadership in decision making.
* Partner with Project Managers to support project reporting and delivery Key Performance Indicators (KPI).
* Develop scopes and budgets for repeat work.
* Build strong delivery relationships with resources across the company.

**Project Delivery**

* Draft a Project Management Plan/Project Execution Plan and review with Partner in Charge (PIC) and Project Manager (PM).
* Support the development of project schedule.
* Conduct project status check-ins, weekly finance reviews, and share insights with PM for monthly PIC/PM reviews.
* Identify and record out-of-scope work in a Management of Change register.
* Collaborate with PIC and PM to identify and create change orders for additional scope.
* Support engagement of subcontractors and bill contractors ahead of time to reduce project cash flow restrictions.
* Facilitate technical reviews, project updates, and final delivery to meet client expectations.
* Lead the preparation of invoicing per schedule and track payments, following up on payment issues if required.
* Confirm client receipt and approval of invoices and escalate issues to the PIC and PM as needed.
* Build trust through accurate, timely support and transparent communication.
* Facilitate internal and/or client kick-off meetings, distribute team briefs, and maintain channels of communication between Project Leadership and team.
* Ensure all governance approvals and accurate project system set up.
* Support Risk Management processes and execution through preparation, review, and maintenance of a risk register.
* Complete change management and support risk assessments (Project Risk Reviews [PRR]).

title: Program Coordinator/Research Associate
description:
**Number of Position:**
One (1)
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi
  
  
**Organization Name:**
Centre for Chronic Disease Control (CCDC)
  
  
**Organization Profile:**
Centre for Chronic Disease Control (CCDC) is a not-for-profit research organization engaged in knowledge generation and knowledge translation for the prevention and control of non- communicable (chronic) diseases in varied settings of developing countries. CCDC has been recognized as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organization (SIRO) by Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. CCDC also holds recognition as a WHO Collaborating Centre for Surveillance, Capacity Building and Translational Research in Cardio-metabolic diseases and is an ICMR Collaborating Centre of Excellence.
  
  
**Project Brief:**
The project aims to improve early detection, referral, management, and follow-up of common chronic health conditions, including hypertension, diabetes and other common chronic conditions, through household-based care, community health camps, digital health technologies, and telemedicine-enabled primary healthcare services.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Program Coordinator/Research Associate will lead the implementation of this project at the site level and serve as the primary liaison between the community, PHC, and central project team. The role involves supervising frontline health workers, coordinating community health camps, supporting teleconsultations, overseeing participant screening and referral processes, and ensuring effective use of DigiSetu, eCDSS, and point-of-care diagnostic technologies. The Program Coordinator/Research Associate will also be responsible for maintaining service quality, monitoring project activities, ensuring protocol compliance, and facilitating continuity of care for study participants.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Site Coordination and Team Supervision
* Lead and coordinate day-to-day implementation of project activities at the site.
* Supervise frontline health workers and ensure timely completion of screening, referral, follow-up, and data collection activities.
* Act as the primary point of communication between the study site, healthcare providers, and the central project team.
* Community Health Camps and Service Delivery
* Plan, organize, and oversee community health camps and outreach activities.
* Ensure quality screening, participant registration, counselling, and referral services during camps.
* Support community mobilization and facilitate participant engagement across intervention activities.
* Digital Health and Clinical Coordination
* Coordinate assisted teleconsultations and ensure smooth patient flow through DigiSetu-enabled services.
* Oversee implementation of eCDSS, electronic health records, and digital referral pathways.
* Ensure readiness and appropriate use of point-of-care diagnostic devices and telemedicine equipment.
* Referral Management and Continuity of Care
* Monitor referral completion, teleconsultation uptake, and follow-up care of moderate- and high-risk participants.
* Coordinate with Medical Officers and specialists to facilitate timely clinical evaluation and management.
* Support continuity of care through tracking, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms.
* Quality Assurance, Monitoring, and Reporting
* Monitor adherence to study protocols, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.
* Review and validate screening, referral, teleconsultation, and data records for completeness and accuracy.
* Prepare site reports, participate in review meetings, and provide regular progress updates to the project team.
* Any Other Duties as assigned, based on emerging needs.

**Essential**
Responsibilities and Requirements
  
  

* Master’s degree in public health or an equivalent relevant discipline from recognised institution.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in community health, primary healthcare, public health programmes, outreach activities, or clinical service delivery.
* Experience in coordinating field teams, health camps, community-based screening programmes, or implementation of health projects.
* Familiarity with telemedicine platforms, electronic health records, digital health applications, and point-of- care diagnostic devices.
* Strong communication, leadership, interpersonal, and team management skills.
* Ability to coordinate with healthcare providers, community stakeholders, and project teams.
* Proficiency in the local language (Hindi as applicable) and basic English.
* Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Zoom, PowerPoint, and digital reporting systems.

**Desirable**

* Experience with government health systems, Primary health centres
* Ability to work independently and manage field responsibilities with minimal supervision
* Join immediately

**Reporting**
The Program Coordinator/Research Associate will report to the Site Investigator and designated central project team member.

title: Head of Operations - Scaffolding & Painting
description:
**Company Description**
Indian Trade Links is a rapidly growing provider of mechanical and industrial services, specializing in industrial scaffolding, piping, civil, mechanical, and painting solutions. With thousands of completed projects across India, the company is recognized as a trusted construction partner delivering safe and cost-effective services. Its diverse, high-quality product range and strong network of reliable vendors support stringent quality standards and competitive pricing. A focus on expertise, ethical business practices, and continuous improvement has positioned Indian Trade Links as a market leader. Candidates can learn more about the company at www.indiantradelinks.in or by contacting info@indiantradelinks.in.

Head of Operations – Scaffolding & Industrial Services

**Company:**
Indian Trade Links

**Position:**
Head of Operations

**Department:**
Operations

**Industry:**
Scaffolding / Industrial Services / Projects

**Location:**
India, with travel to project sites as required

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Level:**
Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and commercially aware
**Head of Operations**
to lead and control our scaffolding and industrial project operations across multiple sites.

The ideal candidate must possess
**strong practical knowledge of scaffolding operations**
, including planning, erection, modification, dismantling, material management, manpower productivity, safety compliance, measurement and billing coordination.

The position will be responsible for ensuring that projects are executed
**safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets**
, while maintaining strong client relationships.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Scaffolding Operations

* Lead and monitor scaffolding activities across all project sites.
* Have sound knowledge of
  **scaffolding erection, alteration/modification and dismantling**
  .
* Understand different scaffolding systems such as:
* Tube and coupler scaffolding
* Cup-lock/system scaffolding
* Ring-lock/system scaffolding
* Mobile scaffolds
* Birdcage scaffolds
* Suspended and cantilever arrangements, where applicable
* Review scaffolding requirements based on site conditions, work fronts, access requirements and project schedules.
* Ensure proper planning for scaffolding material, manpower and equipment.
* Monitor erected quantity versus dismantled quantity and material utilization.
* Control excessive material consumption, unnecessary scaffolding retention and material losses.

B. Project & Site Management

* Take overall responsibility for operational performance of all active projects.
* Prepare and monitor project mobilization and execution plans.
* Conduct regular reviews with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, Safety personnel and commercial teams.
* Monitor:
* Daily progress
* Planned vs. actual work
* Productivity
* Manpower deployment
* Material availability
* Site constraints
* Client priorities
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action before they affect project commitments.
* Coordinate shutdown, maintenance and high-priority activities with site teams and clients.

C. Manpower & Productivity Management

* Plan manpower requirements project-wise.
* Ensure optimum deployment of scaffolders, helpers, supervisors, engineers and other operational personnel.
* Closely monitor
  **manpower productivity against actual work output**
  .
* Prevent unnecessary overtime and idle manpower.
* Coordinate mobilization and demobilization according to workload.
* Develop capable site supervisors and project leadership teams.

D. Safety & Quality

The Head of Operations must establish a strong safety culture, particularly because scaffolding is a safety-critical activity.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure scaffolding work is executed according to approved procedures, drawings and applicable client/site requirements.
* Ensure inspection and tagging systems are properly followed.
* Ensure use of appropriate fall-protection and personal protective equipment.
* Work closely with the safety team on risk assessments, job safety analysis, toolbox talks and corrective actions.
* Review accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and serious safety observations.
* Ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Participate in client safety audits and operational reviews.
* Ensure defective scaffolding material is identified, segregated and prevented from use.

E. Material & Inventory Control

* Monitor scaffolding inventory across stores and project locations.
* Review material requirements before approving additional movement or procurement.
* Control:
* Material shortages
* Excess stock
* Damage
* Loss/theft
* Inter-site transfers
* Return of dismantled material
* Ensure proper reconciliation of scaffolding material at project completion.
* Improve material utilization and reduce unnecessary rental or procurement costs.

F. Commercial & Cost Control

The role should have strong commercial awareness, not only technical knowledge.

* Monitor project budget versus actual expenditure.
* Review manpower, material, equipment and subcontracting costs.
* Support measurement and certification of completed work.
* Coordinate with Accounts/Commercial teams for timely client billing.
* Monitor unbilled work and operational issues delaying certification.
* Understand the commercial implications of additional work and scope changes.
* Support variation/change-order documentation before additional work becomes a commercial dispute.
* Drive improvement in project profitability through productivity and cost control.

G. Client Management

* Act as a senior operational contact for key clients.
* Attend project review meetings with clients.
* Handle operational escalations professionally and promptly.
* Ensure client complaints are closed with proper corrective action.
* Maintain good relationships with client Operations, Projects, Safety, Maintenance and Commercial teams.
* Protect the company's reputation through disciplined and professional site execution.

H. Reporting & Management Review

Prepare/review weekly and monthly operational dashboards covering:

* Project-wise progress
* Scaffolding quantities
* Manpower deployment
* Productivity
* Safety performance
* Material utilization
* Billing status
* Cost performance
* Major site constraints
* Client issues
* Pending decisions
* Recovery/action plans

Escalate critical issues to management with
**clear facts, financial/operational impact and recommended action**
.

3. Required Experience

* Preferably
  **10+ years of experience**
  in industrial/project operations, with substantial experience in scaffolding operations.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of scaffolding erection and dismantling activities.
* Experience managing
  **multiple industrial project sites**
  is highly desirable.
* Experience dealing with large industrial clients, EPC contractors, steel plants, power plants, refineries or similar facilities is preferred.
* Experience managing large site manpower and supervisory teams.
* Good understanding of project costing, productivity and commercial controls.

4. Educational Qualification

Preferred:

* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in
  **Mechanical, Civil, Industrial or a related engineering discipline**
  .

Relevant scaffolding, safety or project-management certifications will be an advantage.

For an exceptionally experienced scaffolding operations professional,
**strong practical project experience may be considered alongside formal qualifications**
.

5. Essential Scaffolding Knowledge

The candidate should be able to confidently discuss and review:

* Scaffold types and their applications
* Erection and dismantling sequence
* Working platforms and access
* Guardrails and toe boards
* Bracing, ties and stability
* Base arrangements and foundations
* Loading considerations
* Inspection and tagging
* Work-at-height controls
* Material identification
* Scaffolding quantity measurement
* Material reconciliation
* Manpower productivity
* Safe modification of existing scaffolds
* Planning for shutdown and maintenance scaffolding

6. Key Skills

* Strong leadership and decision-making
* Excellent scaffolding operational knowledge
* Multi-site project management
* Manpower planning
* Cost and budget control
* Client management
* Safety leadership
* Material management
* Problem solving
* Negotiation
* Commercial awareness
* Strong communication and reporting skills
* Ability to work under pressure and manage urgent site requirements

7. Key Performance Indicators

Performance of the Head of Operations should be measured using objective business and project metrics such as:

* Safety compliance
* Project schedule adherence
* Scaffolding productivity
* Manpower utilization
* Material utilization and recovery
* Reduction in material loss/damage
* Project cost versus budget
* Billing and measurement readiness
* Client issue closure
* Rework reduction
* Timely mobilization/demobilization
* Project close-out performance

8. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a
**strong operations leader who understands scaffolding from the ground level and can also manage the commercial side of projects**
.

* The candidate should be comfortable moving between a project site, a client review meeting and a management profitability review. This is
  **not purely an office-based managerial position**
  . Regular involvement with project sites and operational teams will be essential.

title: Associate-Delivery Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed, by supporting the delivery and operations of technology capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, the team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for external customers and internal colleagues. It also encompasses product management for core enterprise platforms, as well as technology risk and information security; enterprise data governance and platforms; digital product and design; and enterprise AI platforms across American Express.
  
  
We provide technology delivery leadership that turns complex enterprise priorities into execution, connecting strategy, teams, dependencies and governance to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
The Associate, Delivery Management supports the execution of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives across Project Diamond and Customer Trust. Reporting to the Director of Technology Delivery, this role works across Technology, Product, and Business teams to help move delivery forward—maintaining clear plans, surfacing risks and dependencies early, driving follow-through on commitments, and ensuring leaders have an accurate view of progress and areas requiring attention.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is highly organized, curious, and comfortable working through ambiguity. The successful candidate will be able to get into the details of an issue, understand what is preventing progress, connect dependencies across teams, and translate complex technical discussions into clear actions and delivery implications.
  
  
The Associate will also use AI-enabled tools and automation to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of delivery management, reporting, documentation, and follow-through
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Execution:**

* Support day-to-day execution of technology initiatives across Project Diamond and Customer Trust, from planning through implementation.
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones, commitments, dependencies, and critical dates across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Track work through key delivery stages and maintain a clear view of what is complete, what remains, and what is required to reach the next milestone.
* Identify deviations from plan early, understand the underlying cause and delivery impact, and drive appropriate follow-up with accountable owners.
* Coordinate cross-team activities required to resolve blockers, close dependencies, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Support implementation readiness, including tracking required testing, approvals, sign-offs, deployment dependencies, contingency plans, and other exit criteria.
* Support change management when scope, timing, dependencies, or delivery assumptions change.

**Risk, Dependency & Decision Management**

* Maintain clear visibility into risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions across assigned initiatives.
* Go beyond documenting blockers by helping establish the path to resolution: what needs to happen, who owns it, by when, and when escalation is required.
* Identify upstream and downstream dependencies across applications, platforms, teams, and initiatives and assess their impact on delivery plans.
* Track open decisions and ensure unresolved items are surfaced to the appropriate decision-makers with the context needed to act.
* Escalate material risks and issues early, with a clear articulation of impact, actions underway, and leadership support required.
* Drive actions and commitments through closure and ensure outcomes are reflected in the overall delivery plan.

**Governance & Executive Communication**

* Facilitate working sessions, checkpoints, and governance forums focused on execution, decisions, risks, dependencies, and next steps.
* Prepare concise, fact-based status updates that clearly communicate what changed, what is at risk, the path forward, and where leadership intervention is required.
* Maintain accurate program-level reporting across milestones, delivery health, risks, dependencies, and commitments.
* Support Program Increment (PI) planning and PI closeout, including scope, commitments, carryover, dependencies, delivery forecasts, and outcomes.
* Help ensure governance forums are decision- and action-oriented rather than primarily status-reporting exercises.

**Technical & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Technology, Product, Business, and other delivery teams to understand execution plans and cross-functional dependencies.
* Participate in technical discussions involving APIs, application integrations, data flows, environments, testing, deployment, and system dependencies.
* Develop sufficient technical understanding to ask effective questions, identify delivery implications, and recognize when additional technical expertise or escalation is needed.
* Translate technical discussions into clear business and delivery terms, including decisions, actions, risks, dependencies, owners, and timing.
* Connect related issues across teams and workstreams to help identify potential downstream impacts before they affect delivery.

**AI-Enabled Delivery**

* Use AI-enabled tools to improve project tracking, meeting synthesis, status reporting, risk and action management, documentation, and follow-through.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, appropriate context, and alignment with source information before use.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive delivery-management activities and improve the timeliness and consistency of program information.
* Help establish practical, responsible ways to incorporate AI into day-to-day delivery-management workflows.

**Qualifications**

* 5 Years of experience.
* Experience in technology delivery, program/project management, technology operations, or a related discipline.
* Strong organizational and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies, and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to track complex work, identify gaps or risks, and drive actions through completion.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to move from a reported issue to an understanding of root cause, impact, and path to resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise updates for different audiences, including senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of technology delivery concepts such as APIs, system integrations, data flows, testing environments, application dependencies, release management, and production implementation.
* Ability to work effectively across Technology, Product, and Business teams without relying solely on formal authority.
* High attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of broader program objectives and critical priorities.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans may change.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, business processes, and AI-enabled tools.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: MICE Manager - INTERNATIONAL & DOMESTIC
description:
**Company Description**
Chillax Holiday Pvt Ltd is a specialist in business travel solutions and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) management, serving corporate clients across international and domestic markets. The company focuses on designing tailored travel experiences and impactful events that align with business objectives and brand expectations. A dedicated team manages end-to-end logistics, including accommodations, venue selection, and on-site coordination to ensure smooth execution. Chillax Holiday Pvt Ltd supports a wide range of events, from high-stakes conferences and incentive trips to team-building retreats, all delivered with a commitment to exceptional service and memorable experiences.
  
**Role Description**
The MICE Manager – INTERNATIONAL & DOMESTIC will manage corporate events and travel programs, overseeing both inbound and outbound MICE projects from concept to completion. This full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram involves designing proposals, planning itineraries, coordinating venues and suppliers, and negotiating rates with hotels, airlines, and event vendors. The role includes managing budgets, timelines, and operational plans, ensuring compliance with client requirements and company standards. The MICE Manager will supervise event execution on the ground, handle client communication, address contingencies, and prepare post-event reports and analyses. Collaboration with sales, operations, and finance teams is key to achieving revenue targets and maintaining strong client relationships.
  
**Qualifications**

title: AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
description:
**Position Title:**
AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43595
  
  
**Overview**
Our Digital Technology team's goal is to leverage technology and data to drive profitable growth, enhance customer experience, and further our purpose of celebrating real connections through delicious, planet-friendly food.
  
  
McCain has embarked on an ambitious digital transformation across our business, from Agriculture and Manufacturing to Commercial and Corporate Functions. As part of this transformation, we are making significant investments in digital capabilities, data, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  
  
The AI Deployment & Enablement Lead plays a critical role in helping McCain realize value from AI investments by driving successful deployment, adoption, and business enablement of AI solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as the bridge between AI product teams, technology teams, business stakeholders, and end users to ensure AI capabilities are effectively implemented, embraced, and sustained.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project execution, stakeholder management, change leadership, and business acumen to accelerate adoption of AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, decision making, employee experience, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Reporting to the AI Deployment & Enablement Manager, the AI Deployment & Enablement Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the deployment and adoption of AI solutions across McCain.
  
  
This role partners closely with product owners, AI engineers, business teams, functional leaders, and change management partners to ensure AI capabilities are successfully launched, effectively utilized, and continuously improved. The role focuses on driving business readiness, user adoption, training, communications, stakeholder engagement, value realization, and operational enablement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**AI Deployment & Implementation**

* Lead deployment planning and execution for AI products, tools, and capabilities.
* Coordinate implementation activities across business, technology, and external partners.
* Ensure deployment plans are aligned to business priorities, timelines, and operational readiness requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation activities.
* Support pilot programs, proof-of-concepts, and scaled enterprise rollouts.

**Adoption & Enablement**

* Develop strategies to drive successful adoption of AI solutions across functions and regions.

* Identify capability and skill development needs associated with AI adoption.
* Develop and coordinate training materials, learning resources, workshops, and enablement sessions.
* Support the creation of role-based learning pathways for employees and leaders.
* Foster a culture of responsible AI usage and continuous learning.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Adoption targets achieved for deployed AI solutions.

title: Manager – ERP Implementation/Transformation Readiness, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
  
  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

**How You Will Contribute**
We are seeking an experienced Manager – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation. The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Expertise across one or more of the following areas
  
  

* FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment
* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
* Finance Process Readiness
* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
* Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness
* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data. Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
* Functional Readiness
* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
* Data Migration Readiness
* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
* Integration & Technology Readiness
* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with: MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
* Reporting & Management Information Readiness
* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
* Controls & Compliance Readiness
* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
* Stakeholder & Program Leadership
* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
* Team Leadership
* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

**Qualifications**

* 6–11 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enablement.
* Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts, financial master data, organizational structures, reporting, controls, and data migration.
* Experience working with Finance leadership and senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and complex transformation workstreams.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Training Delivery Manager
description:
**Role Summary**

The Manager – Training Delivery owns execution of assigned training programs end-to-end — converting delivery plans into consistent, high-quality learner and client outcomes across trainer teams, cohorts, and client engagements. The role is the operational layer that translates delivery governance standards set at the account and leadership level into daily execution discipline: trainer readiness, session quality, learner engagement, and client-facing delivery confidence.

This is an execution and team-leadership role, not a reporting role. Success is measured by whether programs run predictably, trainers perform and grow, risks surface early rather than at the client review, and delivery data feeds upward into account-level performance intelligence rather than sitting in a spreadsheet.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Delivery Execution & Governance**

* Own end-to-end delivery for assigned programs, cohorts, and client engagements, ensuring adherence to quality standards, delivery frameworks, and contractual SLAs.
* Plan and govern trainer scheduling, workforce allocation, and resource utilization against delivery commitments and business requirements.
* Maintain the operating cadence for each program — session tracking, milestone checkpoints, and delivery-readiness reviews — so deviations are caught before they become client-visible.

**2. Team Leadership & Trainer Capability**

* Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of trainers and lead trainers, with structured feedback and capability-building interventions tied to observed session quality, not just tenure.
* Run trainer calibration cycles to keep delivery quality consistent across cohorts and geographies.
* Build a bench-readiness view of trainer capability so staffing decisions are proactive rather than reactive to attrition or scale-up requests.

**3. Quality Assurance & Risk Management**

* Establish and govern quality assurance mechanisms — session audits, learner feedback analysis, and corrective action planning — as a continuous loop, not a periodic exercise.
* Identify delivery risks (trainer gaps, engagement drop-off, SLA slippage) early and drive resolution through a defined escalation path, ensuring minimal impact on learner experience or client commitments.
* Escalate risks that exceed program-level authority — client-facing exposure, repeated SLA breach, or resourcing shortfalls — to the Senior Director with a clear recommendation, not just a status update.

**4. Performance Intelligence & Reporting**

* Track and interpret delivery metrics across two tiers: leading indicators (trainer readiness, early engagement signals, session quality scores) that predict outcomes, and lagging indicators (CSAT/NPS, completion, certification) that confirm them.
* Translate program-level data into a structured performance narrative for account and leadership reviews — what happened, why, and what changes as a result — rather than a metrics dump.
* Feed program-level delivery data into the broader account performance intelligence system on a defined reporting cadence, in the format required for client and leadership consumption.

**5. Stakeholder & Client Engagement**

* Support client reviews and business discussions by presenting delivery performance, learner outcomes, risks, and improvement plans with delivery-level credibility.
* Act as the day-to-day delivery point of contact for assigned client stakeholders, maintaining delivery confidence between formal review cycles.

**6. Continuous Improvement & Strategic Contribution**

* Identify process gaps and implement best practices that improve trainer productivity, program consistency, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute delivery-ground-truth into scaling decisions — new program design, trainer onboarding models, and capacity planning — as programs grow in size or complexity.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Training Delivery & Learning Operations Management
* Team Leadership, Coaching & Performance Management
* Trainer Capability Development & Calibration
* Quality Assurance & Delivery Governance
* Data-Driven Delivery Intelligence — distinguishing leading signals from lagging results
* Risk Management & Escalation Discipline
* Resource & Workforce Planning
* Stakeholder & Client Management
* Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
* Communication, Presentation & Executive-Level Reporting
* Working familiarity with digital and AI-enabled delivery tools (scheduling, analytics dashboards, learner engagement platforms)

**Experience:**

* 8–12 years of experience in Training Delivery, Learning Operations, L&D, EdTech, Workforce Development, or Learning Services.
* 3+ years of people management experience leading trainer or delivery teams.
* Proven experience managing large-scale training programs, delivery operations, quality governance, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience working with enterprise clients, digital learning environments, or blended learning programs is preferred; exposure to global or multi-geography delivery is a plus.

**Position Within the Delivery Organization:**

This role sits within the Customer Success & Delivery function, reporting to the Senior Director – Customer Success & Delivery. It carries program- and cohort-level ownership; it does not carry account-level commercial or client-strategy ownership, which remains with the Senior Director and account leadership. The Manager – Training Delivery is the layer that converts governance standards into execution reality and surfaces ground-truth delivery data upward.

**Essential**
About you

* Strong understanding of cost control, forecasting, Earned Value Management (EVM), risk management, and change control.

The Project & Programme Services (PPS) team is a critical component of the Global Project & Programme Management Office (GPMO). The team delivers predictable and efficient project performance management, reporting, and business intelligence across global portfolios. Operating from the Global Technology Centre (GTC) in India, PPS provides cost-effective, agile, and scalable programme services using an onshore-offshore delivery model. Our ambition is to become the global leader in Programme Management Services by building a future-ready, digitally enabled, high-performing team.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Planning & Project Controls professional to support the successful delivery of complex projects across Process, Manufacturing & Production, Energy, Pharma, Infrastructure, Transportation (Rail, Highways, and Aviation) sectors. The role combines expertise in planning, scheduling, cost management, project controls, reporting and performance monitoring to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget while meeting client and business objectives.
  
  
Your role
  
  
*Planning & Scheduling*

* Develop, maintain, and control integrated project schedules using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and other planning tools.
* Establish and manage Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), activity sequencing, logic links, resource loading, and schedule baselines.
* Prepare detailed look-ahead schedules and monitor progress against approved baselines.
* Conduct Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis, schedule performance analysis, and delay analysis.
* Identify schedule risks and opportunities and develop mitigation and recovery plans.
* Support change management processes and update Performance Measurement Baselines (PMB) for approved scope and schedule changes.
* Develop and maintain EPC project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.

*Project Controls & Cost Management*

* Establish and maintain Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS) aligned with project WBS.
* Prepare project control procedures, governance frameworks, and reporting structures.
* Track and analyse project budgets, commitments, actual costs, accruals, forecasts, contingencies, and cash flows.
* Perform Earned Value Management (EVM) analysis and provide performance insights.
* Monitor project cost and schedule variances, identify trends, and recommend corrective actions.
* Produce periodic cost reports, forecasts, dashboards, and project performance reports.
* Support pricing estimates and cost planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Assist project managers with early warnings, change orders, claims support, and project controls documentation.

*Risk, Change & Performance Management*

* Support qualitative and quantitative risk analysis activities.
* Monitor project KPIs and performance indicators.
* Conduct change impact assessments and schedule/cost impact analyses.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements and project governance processes.
* Support supply chain management activities and contract administration requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and standardization of project controls processes.

*Reporting & Data Analytics*

* Develop Power BI dashboards and interactive reports to support project decision-making.
* Analyse project data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* Monitor and report KPIs, trends, forecasts, and project performance metrics.
* Utilize data analytics, Power BI, DAX, SQL, and business intelligence tools to improve project visibility and reporting effectiveness.
* Support automation and digital transformation initiatives within project controls functions.

*Stakeholder & Client Engagement*

* Collaborate with project managers, engineering teams, contractors, clients, and other stakeholders.
* Serve as a key point of contact for planning and project controls activities.
* Facilitate alignment on schedule, cost, risk, and performance objectives.
* Participate in client meetings, steering committees, project reviews, and governance forums.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support successful project delivery.

*Leadership & Team Development*

* Mentor and guide junior planners and project controls professionals.
* Promote best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across projects and portfolios.
* Demonstrate leadership, accountability, and commitment to high-quality project delivery.

**About You**
*Technical Competencies*

* Strong experience in Planning, Scheduling, Cost Management, and Project Controls.
* Expert understanding of CPM scheduling techniques and Earned Value Management.
* Hands-on experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and related planning tools.
* Experience with cost management systems such as EcoSys or equivalent.
* Proficiency in cost management tools such as EcoSys and report preparation skills
* Practiced - Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS), Cash Flow, Contingency Management
* Proficient in Financial System Interface, Budget/Cost Control, Cost Change Control
* Knowledge of NEC3, NEC4, and FIDIC contracts and their impact on project controls, claims, and scheduling.
* Strong understanding of engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning processes.
* Experience in EPC and infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in Power BI, data analytics, reporting, and dashboard development.
* Knowledge of automation tools, VBA, and digital solutions is an advantage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Building Technology, or a related discipline.
* 6-12 years of relevant experience in Planning and/or Project Controls roles on large-scale projects.
* Experience supporting UK, Middle East, or US projects is preferred.
* Master's degree in Project Management or related field is an advantage.
* Preferred Certifications
* PMP (Project Management Professional), APM / MAPM, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MRICS
* Certified Cost Professional (CCP), Certified Schedule Professional (CSP)
* Certified Estimating Professional (CEP) or equivalent professional certifications.

*Competencies*

* Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and report-writing abilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent organizational skills and adaptability in a dynamic project environment.
* Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.

Rewards & benefits
  
  
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
