title: Engineer/ Surveyor
description:
**Engineer/ Surveyor India Sub-Continent**

**Location:**
Delhi, India

**Contract Type:**
Permanent

**Hours:**
Full time, 44 hours per week, Monday to Friday

**Salary:**
171,240 (INR) Gross Pay per month, depending upon experience

**About the CWGC**

The Commonwealth War Graves Commission honours and cares for the people of the Commonwealth forces who died in the First and Second World Wars, ensuring they will never be forgotten. Funded by six Member Governments, our work began with building, and now maintaining, cemeteries at 23,000 locations all over the world.

Today, over a century after we first began, our work continues through our staff, supporters and volunteers who preserve our unique cultural, horticultural and architectural heritage and ensure that the stories of those who died are told.

**What you'll be doing**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Technical/Project Manager (Works) to lead a varied portfolio of estates, infrastructure and maintenance projects across the indian Sub-continent. This is a key role supporting the planning, development and delivery of works that help maintain our sites to the highest standards.

Working closely with operational teams and regional managers, you will oversee projects from survey and planning through to delivery. You will also play an important role in preventative maintenance programmes and construction-related cases across the area.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Undertake structural and property condition surveys and accurately input findings into the CWGC Condition Survey Software.
* Develop a programme of fully costed and internally approved projects, ranging from building refurbishment to heritage structure maintenance, for inclusion in the area’s five-year plan.
* Manage a small team consisting of a Technical Supervisor and manual operatives. Identifying development opportunities, providing clear guidance and supportive leadership.
* Work in partnership with Regional Managers and Contractors to deliver projects in line with the Area Business Plan and Estates Department guidelines.
* Manage all projects using the CWGC Project Management Office System, ensuring effective governance and delivery.
* Prepare and develop works contracts, including FIDIC and small works contracts, in collaboration with the legal team.
* Oversee the Area’s amendments and addenda process, identifying suitable solutions and preparing business cases for proposed works.
* Deliver the area’s planned preventative maintenance programme for all base sites and accommodation, ensuring continued compliance with Commission standards.
* Act as Project Manager for a range of property-related projects, ensuring outcomes meet organisational and stakeholder needs.
* Manage accommodation repairs across ISC, liaising directly with occupants to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and effectively.
* Manage delegated budgets, prepare cost estimates and submit monthly and quarterly expenditure reports as required.
* Work in collaboration with the Health and Safety Advisor to implement health and safety policies, with particular focus on contractor management and the promotion of safe working practices.
* Record and report project-related accidents and near misses, taking appropriate action to manage risk and support Area-wide health and safety compliance.
* Maintain accurate records of all building changes made during projects and provide as-built technical drawings, incorporating any new maintenance requirements into planned preventative maintenance schedules.
* Manage the procurement and installation of headstones and bronze plaques within your area.

**What you need to have**

* A recognised and relevant technical qualification (degree or equivalent).
* Experience (minimum 5 years) of working in a Managerial position.
* High computer literacy including AutoCad, Excel, Word, Outlook
* A qualification or proven training record in building surveying and/or architecture and conservation.
* Experience of working in different cultures, with understanding of cultural and political sensitivities and operations in complex environments.
* A recognised H&S qualification at the level of IOSH Managing Safely standard.
* Practical experience of direct project management (end to end – all phases).
* Experience of managing tendering processes for £50k to 300k range projects.
* Change and performance management at operational level.
* Experience in researching and compiling business case documents in support of project approval and bids for approved funding.
* Thorough knowledge of organisational policies, surveying practices, and a conservation-based approach to management of the Commission’s estate.
* Experience of travelling to remote locations including lone working.

**How to Apply**

If your skills and experience align with this opportunity, we would welcome your application.

Apply via our Career Portal (Engineer/Surveyor ISC at CWGC) by clicking the ‘Apply Now’ button.

As this is an active role, we will be interviewing as we go along, and the role will close when we have an offer accepted by a preferred candidate.

*We believe creating a diverse environment enriches our organisation and strengthens our mission, therefore, we welcome applications from everybody. Join our inclusive environment where every individual is valued.*

Information Security

Gurgaon
  
  
**Job Purpose**

* Lead practical information security, cloud security and GRC activities across business units, client accounts and corporate functions, with a strong focus on AI governance, cloud security, third-party risk, audit readiness and automation of repetitive compliance controls.
* Translate ISO 27001, SOC 2, applicable regulatory requirements, client security expectations and internal policies into business processes that are effective, auditable and operationally sustainable.

**Area**
**Technical Security Expectations - 60%**
**GRC / Process Compliance Expectations - 40%**

Hands-on control assessment across Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365, IAM, endpoint, network, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, conditional access, DLP, encryption and configuration governance.
  
  
Ensure cloud and infrastructure controls are mapped to ISO 27001, SOC 2, client contracts, internal policies and audit evidence expectations.
  
  
**AI Governance & Automation**
Assess AI-related security, data protection and operational risks; support governance of AI tools, AI agents and GenAI use cases; identify opportunities for control automation.
  
  
Embed AI governance, human oversight, policy adherence, evidence retention and exception workflows into practical SOPs and business processes.
  
  
**Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk**
Evaluate vendor security posture, cloud hosting, data handling, access management, resilience and subcontractor risk.
  
  
Run third-party risk assessments, track remediation, manage exceptions, maintain GRC records and align vendor risk decisions with policy and client requirements.
  
  
**Audit & Risk Management**
Test technical control effectiveness and validate remediation for security findings across on-premise, cloud and SaaS environments.
  
  
Lead internal audits, client audits, ISO 27001 audits, SOC 2 audits, risk registers, audit responses, corrective actions and management reporting.

* Maintain privacy governance artefacts and evidence, including records of processing activities, data inventories and data-flow inputs, privacy notices, consent or lawful-processing records, retention requirements and cross-border transfer documentation, in coordination with Legal, Privacy and business owners.
* Coordinate privacy impact assessments and data protection risk assessments for new or changed processes, applications, AI use cases, vendors and client engagements, and track identified actions to closure.
* Support data subject and data principal rights processes, including request intake, identity verification, internal coordination, response tracking, evidence retention and escalation within applicable timelines.
* Work with technology and business teams to implement privacy-by-design controls covering data minimisation, purpose limitation, access control, encryption, masking, retention and deletion, DLP, logging and secure handling of personal data.
* Support personal data breach governance by assessing privacy impact, coordinating evidence and stakeholder inputs, maintaining incident records and enabling timely escalation to Legal, Privacy and management for notification decisions.
* Assess privacy and data-protection controls of third parties and subprocessors, including data location, onward transfers, retention, deletion, incident notification and contractual control requirements.
* Plan, coordinate and lead internal audits, client audits, external certification audits, SOC 2 audits and ISO 27001 audits, including evidence readiness, stakeholder coordination and closure of observations.
* Operate risk exception management by assessing business justification, compensating controls, risk exposure, expiry dates, approvals, evidence and periodic review requirements.
* Perform third-party risk assessments for vendors, subcontractors and critical service providers, covering information security, privacy, cloud hosting, resilience, incident management and contractual control requirements.
* Conduct ISMS risk assessment and maintain risk registers, corrective action plans, control evidence, audit trackers, third-party risk records, exceptions and Statement of Applicability updates in the GRC tool or approved system of record.
* Work with HR, Compliance, IT, Facilities, Procurement, Delivery Business Units and Client Account teams to embed security requirements into business processes without creating unnecessary operational overhead.
* Develop, review and maintain security policies, standards, procedures, guidelines and security awareness content relevant to cloud, AI governance, data protection, third-party risk and audit compliance.

**Key competencies**
**Required Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience.
* 8-10 years of relevant experience in information security, cloud security, cybersecurity governance, technology risk management, third-party risk, audits or compliance assurance.
* Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer, ISO 42001 awareness or implementation exposure, SOC 2 audit readiness experience, or equivalent credentials.
* Practical experience in a professional services, financial services, technology services, KPO/BPO, IT outsourcing or client delivery environment is preferred.

Functional Competencies
  
  

* Strong practical understanding of ISO 27001, SSAE 18 or ISAE 3000 SOC 2, ISO 31000 and 42001, NIST CSF / security best practices, CIS controls, cloud security benchmarks, data protection expectations and client security assurance requirements.
* Sound knowledge of GDPR, DPDPA and similar evolving global privacy laws, strong understanding of privacy technologist principles.
* Hands-on experience of operationalizing GRC platforms to monitor compliance for SOC2, ISO 27001. Sound knowledge of GRC and Privacy Management tools like Archer, TrustArc, OneTrust, ServiceNow
* Hands-on working knowledge of Azure, AWS and Microsoft 365 security controls, including IAM, MFA, SSO, conditional access, DLP, endpoint security, device compliance, vulnerability management, SIEM, encryption, firewall and monitoring controls.
* Ability to assess AI governance and GenAI risks covering data leakage, model output usage, human oversight, approved knowledge sources, third-party AI platforms, prompt hygiene and evidence of review.
* Strong third-party risk assessment skills, including review of vendor security questionnaires, certifications, SOC reports, penetration test summaries, incident management, subcontractor use and remediation commitments.
* Ability to design control automation and AI-agent-assisted workflows for evidence collection, control monitoring, audit follow-ups, risk exception tracking and compliance reporting.
* Strong audit management capability across internal audits, client audits, SOC 2 and ISO 27001, including evidence collection, walkthroughs, stakeholder management, responses and corrective action management.
* Excellent documentation ability for policies, procedures, risk assessments, audit responses, management reports, control narratives and client-facing security responses.

Behavioral and Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Demonstrates ownership, sound judgement and the ability to make risk-based decisions in fast-moving business environments.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence decisions and constructively convince technology, delivery, procurement, legal, compliance, HR, facilities and client-facing stakeholders to adopt required security, privacy, audit and compliance actions.
* Drive audit and compliance initiatives through active collaboration with control owners and stakeholders, including regular in-person meetings, working sessions and evidence walkthroughs where appropriate.
* Confidently facilitate discussions to resolve control gaps, clarify ownership, agree pragmatic remediation plans and secure timely commitment to closure dates.
* Adapt communication style to technical and non-technical audiences, presenting legal, policy, risk and control requirements clearly while maintaining constructive working relationships.
* Leadership ability to drive closure across cross-functional teams without relying only on escalation.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and audit expectations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities and delivering under tight timelines.
* Curious about emerging technologies, AI governance, cloud security and automation, with a continuous improvement mindset.

Success Measures for the Role
  
  

* Cloud and technical security risks, ISMS Risk assessments, privacy risk assessments are assessed, documented and remediated with clear ownership and timelines.
* AI governance and emerging technology risks are translated into practical controls, review evidence and operational SOPs.
* Third-party risk assessments and exception reviews are completed with defensible risk rationale and compensating controls.
* Client audits, ISO 27001 audits, SOC 2 audits and internal audits are managed with timely evidence, clear responses and effective closure of findings.
* Repetitive compliance activities are progressively automated using workflow tools or AI agents, with appropriate governance and human review.
* Business teams experience security and compliance as practical, risk-based and enabling rather than as unnecessary process overhead.
* Sound personality to liaise with senior stakeholders in the business to drive security compliances.

title: Planning Engineer
description:
**Position**

Planning Engineer

**Department**

Projects / Planning

**Location**

NCR – Site Based

**Experience**

5–10 years of relevant experience in construction planning and project controls, preferably with experience in large-scale building projects.

**Qualification**

B.E./B.Tech/diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.

**Job Purpose**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Planning Engineer to be responsible for planning, scheduling, monitoring and reporting the progress of a construction project. The candidate will work closely with the Project Manager, Site Engineers, subcontractors, procurement team and client/PMC to ensure that project activities are properly planned and executed as per the approved programme.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of construction sequencing and should be capable of identifying delays, analysing their impact and driving corrective actions.

**1. Project Planning & Scheduling**

·        Prepare and maintain the detailed project baseline programme in line with contractual requirements.

·        Develop detailed construction schedules covering civil, structural, finishing and other project activities.

·        Break down the master programme into weekly and monthly execution plans.

·        Prepare look-ahead programmes and coordinate with site teams for timely execution.

·        Ensure proper sequencing and coordination of various construction activities.

**2. Progress Monitoring**

·        Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline programme.

·        Collect daily and weekly progress information from various site teams.

·        Identify delays, slippages and activities falling behind schedule.

·        Prepare progress curves, productivity reports and other project control reports.

·        Analyse planned vs. actual progress and highlight critical areas requiring immediate attention.

**3. Delay Analysis & Recovery Planning**

·        Identify reasons for delays and assess their impact on project timelines.

·        Maintain proper records of delays attributable to client, consultants, vendors, subcontractors or other external factors.

·        Prepare recovery programmes wherever required.

·        Monitor implementation of recovery measures and report progress to management.

·        Maintain proper documentation to support contractual extension-of-time and delay claims.

**4. Client / PMC Coordination**

·        Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports for submission to the client/PMC.

·        Participate in progress review meetings with the client and consultants.

·        Prepare presentations and reports for management and client meetings.

·        Track commitments made during progress meetings and ensure timely follow-up.

·        Coordinate with the client/PMC regarding programme changes, priorities and project milestones.

**5. Site Coordination**

·        Work closely with the Project Manager and site execution teams to develop realistic execution plans.

·        Coordinate planning requirements with procurement, stores, subcontractors and other departments.

·        Identify constraints affecting planned activities, including manpower, materials, drawings, approvals, fronts and equipment.

·        Maintain a constraint log and follow up for timely resolution.

·        Ensure that upcoming activities have the required resources and approvals before commencement.

**6. Resource & Productivity Monitoring**

·        Monitor manpower deployment against planned requirements.

·        Track productivity of major construction activities.

·        Assist project management in manpower and resource planning.

·        Highlight resource shortages that may affect project milestones.

·        Monitor subcontractor performance against agreed programmes.

**7. Reporting & Documentation**

·        Prepare daily, weekly and monthly progress reports.

·        Maintain updated project schedules and dashboards.

·        Prepare S-curves, progress charts, milestone trackers and other planning reports.

·        Maintain records of approved programmes, revised programmes and recovery schedules.

·        Ensure all planning and progress documentation is properly maintained.

**Desired Skills**

·        Strong knowledge of construction planning and project scheduling.

·        Good understanding of building construction methodology and sequencing.

·        Strong command of Primavera P6 is preferred.

·        Good knowledge of MS Excel and MS Project.

·        Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

·        Ability to identify the critical path and activities affecting project completion.

·        Good communication and coordination skills.

·        Ability to work under pressure and meet tight project deadlines.

·        Should be proactive and capable of independently following up with multiple departments and stakeholders.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be someone who is hands-on and site-oriented, rather than someone who only prepares reports from information provided by others.

He should have a strong understanding of actual construction activities and be able to translate site requirements into a practical and achievable project programme.

The candidate should also have the ability to challenge unrealistic schedules, identify potential delays in advance and proactively drive the site team towards achieving project milestones.

**Key Performance Indicators**

·        Adherence to project milestones.

·        Accuracy and timely updating of project programmes.

·        Timely identification and escalation of delays.

·        Effectiveness of recovery programmes.

·        Accuracy of progress reporting.

·        Improvement in site productivity and schedule adherence.

·        Timely identification and resolution of project constraints.

title: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript

Our mission is to become a one-stop cyber solutions partner — architecting and delivering secure infrastructure, cybersecurity platforms, and advanced technology solutions while prioritizing open-source, sovereignty, and operational resilience.

Internally, we maintain a sophisticated infrastructure stack combining on-premise virtualization, secure networking, GPU compute, and developer platforms, enabling both product development and cybersecurity operations.

We are looking for a hands-on Infrastructure & Platform Lead who can take ownership of our internal IT and infrastructure, bring operational maturity, and build systems that scale with the company.

## Role Overview

The Infrastructure & Platform Lead will be responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving SecNinjaz's internal infrastructure and IT environment.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of managing virtualization, secure networking, identity systems, developer platforms, and security infrastructure while leading a small team of IT engineers. The candidate will also mentor junior infrastructure engineers and help establish professional operational standards.

You will ensure that our internal systems are secure, resilient, well-documented, professionally operated and compliant, forming the backbone of our cybersecurity and product engineering teams.

Candidates should demonstrate strong understanding of secure infrastructure design and operational security practices.

## Key Responsibilities

- Manage and maintain virtualization infrastructure

- Operate internal technology platforms and services

- Maintain secure networking and remote access infrastructure

- Implement monitoring, alerting, and backup systems

- Improve infrastructure documentation and operational processes

- Lead and mentor junior IT / infrastructure engineers

### Compliance & Governance

- Support and maintain organizational compliance requirements related to IT and cybersecurity

- Ensure infrastructure and systems align with defined security and compliance standards

- Assist in audits by providing required technical evidence and documentation

- Maintain proper access controls, logging, and system configurations as per compliance needs

- Continuously improve infrastructure practices to align with evolving compliance requirements

## Required Skills

Candidates should have experience with:

- Linux system administration

- virtualization platforms (Proxmox / VMware / KVM)

- networking fundamentals

- VPN technologies

- infrastructure monitoring

- backup systems

- infrastructure documentation

## Preferred Experience

Exposure to any of the following is beneficial:

- developer platforms (GitLab Premium/Ultimate)

- identity and access management systems

- containerization technologies

- infrastructure automation

- storage systems

## Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate:

- is hands-on with infrastructure technologies

- has experience managing production environments

- values documentation and structured operations

- is comfortable working in a fast-growing technical organization

Experience working with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, ISO 9001, STQC, SOC2, etc.) is a plus.

## Important Note

title: Category Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented
**Category Manager – Mobility, Transit & Tourism t**
o own the end-to-end performance of this unified vertical on DigiHaat. You will build and scale a comprehensive mobility and tourism marketplace covering daily/regional transit options, stays, local experiences, guided tours, and travel-linked products such as handicrafts, local produce, and curated travel kits. You will onboard and manage supply, ensure listing quality, track bookings and fulfillment, and work with product and tech teams to deliver a seamless buyer journey across transit and travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Category Strategy and Growth
* Define and execute the category strategy for mobility, transit, and tourism with clear goals, priorities, and KPIs in collaboration with product, marketing, and business teams.
* Identify high-potential segments across transit & mobility (first-mile/last-mile connectivity, intercity bus/rail integrators, local transit options) alongside tourism segments (homestays, rural & heritage tourism, craft and culinary experiences, pilgrimage and wellness travel).
* Build the category roadmap around seasonality, commuting patterns, regional demand, festivals, and travel trends.
* Align category operations with broader business objectives of growth, network adoption, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Supply Onboarding and Partner Management
* Onboard and nurture a diverse supply base: transit operators, mobility service providers, homestay owners, tour operators, local guides, experience hosts, artisans, and tourism-linked sellers.
* Build strong relationships with mobility aggregators, transport operators, travel suppliers, and logistics partners to ensure service reliability, availability, and cost efficiency.
* Set and monitor service standards, cancellation/refund policies, and compliance requirements, including transport permits, local licenses, and safety norms.
* Handhold small transit operators, experience hosts, and first-time digital sellers through onboarding, catalogue creation, and platform best practices.
* Booking, Transit & Order Lifecycle Operations
* Monitor the full lifecycle from route search, booking, ticket issuance, and service delivery to post-trip feedback to ensure a smooth end-to-end customer experience.
* Track and resolve operational issues such as schedule disruptions, cancellations, no-shows, overbooking, service quality complaints, refunds, and physical product deliveries.
* Work with operations teams to streamline fulfillment for mobility bookings and tourism-linked retail products.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce operational costs and maximize booking efficiency.
* Pricing, Inventory and Demand Management
* Use demand forecasting to manage inventory, seat/stay availability, and peak/off-peak capacity across daily transit and travel seasons.
* Develop dynamic pricing strategies, bundled offers, and multi-modal travel packages (e.g., Transit Pass + Stay + Experience + Local Products) to improve conversion and basket value.
* Work with marketing on customer acquisition campaigns, transit usage incentives, destination-led promotions, and seasonal travel offers.
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Use data and analytics to track category performance: GMV, total bookings, route throughput, conversion rate, repeat rate, cancellation rate, customer ratings, and partner reliability.
* Identify commuting and travel trends, regional transit bottlenecks, and category expansion opportunities.
* Deliver regular performance reports and actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders for continuous platform optimization.
* Listing Quality and User Experience
* Ensure listings, routes, and travel options are accurate, current, and compelling - covering departure/arrival schedules, stay descriptions, itineraries, amenities, pricing, availability, and policies.
* Analyze customer reviews, ratings, and ride/trip feedback to identify pain points and collaborate with tech/product teams to address them.
* Drive product enhancements for multi-modal travel discovery, transit routing, category search filters, and trust signals for mobility and travel services.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Total Experience: 8–12 years in category management, marketplace operations, or business leadership roles.
* Mandatory Industry Experience: Direct, proven experience across Mobility / Transit, the Travel Industry, and Tourism Management.
* Track Record: Proven success in building, scaling, and monetizing digital platforms in mobility, travel, or multi-service marketplaces.

**Must-Have Attributes**

* Hands-on experience with buyer-facing apps in mobility, transit, travel, hospitality, or experience marketplaces (e.g., transit/cab apps, OTAs, activity platforms).
* Deep understanding of the Indian mobility and tourism ecosystem, including urban/rural transit networks, regional travel dynamics, and localized tourism.
* Expertise in yield management, dynamic pricing, route/inventory capacity planning, and user acquisition strategies.
* Solid grasp of agile methodologies and demonstrated skill in working with cross-functional product and tech teams.
* Exceptional negotiation, partner management, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Principal Manager, New Program Development (EAII Advisors)
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families. For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
Our Accelerator is the engine for new programs. It is a venture-style, stage-gated pipeline that finds the most promising health interventions and develops the strongest into programs ready to scale. Only about 2% of the interventions we evaluate make it through, and those that do have gone on to raise over $100 million. The New Program Development (NPD) team drives this work. We source and vet new ideas, dig into the evidence and cost-effectiveness, build partnerships with researchers, governments, and implementers, and test concepts in the field to turn the best ideas into real programs.
  
  
We are hiring a Principal Manager to lead the development of our next generation of health programs. You will own a set of early-stage interventions and drive each one from a research insight to a program that is proven, fundable, and ready to scale, or to a clear and well-reasoned decision to stop. You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Drive several promising candidate programs through the Accelerator's stage-gate process, and decide what advances, what gets reshaped, and what exits our pipeline
* Interrogate the evidence with honesty. Assess each intervention's evidence base on the merits, including effect sizes and their quality, external validity, variability, negative and contradictory findings, and gaps.
* Model impact and cost-effectiveness under uncertainty. Partner with the Cost-Effectiveness team to build and pressure-test CEAs, reasoning explicitly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty, and translating them into clear go/no-go implications
* Design and run decision-relevant learning in close collaboration with our MLE team. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisions
* Build the case and align stakeholders. Craft compelling, evidence-grounded investment cases. Bring researchers, implementers, governments, and donors along, anticipate objections, unblock barriers, and create momentum
* Collaborate across Evidence Action. Work hand in hand with our Growth team to build necessary resourcing and funding, relevant Program teams who bring the implementation muscle, and the Country Teams who cultivate and manage the policy and government partnerships in the places we work
* Be Evidence Action's face with partners. Independently lead conversations with study authors, implementing organizations, government officials, and funders, and use those relationships to source new ideas and partnerships
* Strengthen the Accelerator's methods, AI-enabled workflows, and quality bar, and mentor analysts and interns on the workstreams you lead

**Requirements**
**Essential**

* You have a bachelors degree and 6 - 10 years of experience in quant social science, program management, international development, or global health in a cross-country setting
* You read primary research and study design critically, synthesize large and conflicting evidence bases, and form an honest view of what the evidence does and does not support
* You build or rigorously interpret cost-effectiveness, epidemiological, or statistical models, and reason clearly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty
* You design lean learning activities that target the uncertainty actually blocking a decision, and you deliver them on a timeline
* You move things forward amid uncertainty, building, prototyping, and unblocking rather than waiting for perfect information
* You build trust and align both internal teams and external partners (researchers, implementers, government, and donors) across cultures and sectors toward a shared path
* You make complex technical findings clear and decision-useful for non-technical audiences, in writing and live
* You manage several workstreams at once, sequence sharply, and make defensible calls about where to spend scarce time
* You have experience working in an international setting and working with diverse teams
* You look for the reasons your favorite idea might be wrong, and welcome the same scrutiny of your own work

**Disclaimer:**
The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.
  
  
**Position Location**
The role is based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Mental and physical well-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

**Compensation:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
***All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.***

title: Associate, Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead poisoning is one of India's most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the world's highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 µg/dL; the national average is 6.2 µg/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.
  
  
National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for India's lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCF's track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCF's embedded TSU. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.
  
  
The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the TSU Lead and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.
  
  
**Location**
New Delhi (embedded at NCDC / MoHFW)
  
  
**Travel**
Domestic travel to programme states as required
  
  
TSU Secretariat and Programme Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day secretariat support to NCDC for the NBPCT, including preparation of meeting agendas, data-backed workplans, activity plans, and meeting charters across surveillance, capacity building, and enforcement priorities.
* Support NCDC's National Lead Technical Working Group through data synthesis, expert inputs, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms that convert deliberations into actionable outcomes.
* Support integration of state and laboratory surveillance data into the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) and contribute to dashboard and visualisation design for NCDC decision-making.
* Strengthen NCDC's capacity for data-backed decision-making in hotspot identification, laboratory and referral infrastructure mapping, and partner coordination.
* Consolidate and disseminate learnings from state-level engagement through regional and national workshops.
* Support the Programme in convening and facilitating inter-ministerial consultations on lead and chemical toxicants across environment, industry, labour, food safety, water, and mines ministries.
* Prepare technical inputs, briefing materials, and correspondence for senior decision-making within the ministry.

Programme Planning and Monitoring
  
  

* Develop and maintain workplan trackers and milestone dashboards to monitor progress against grant commitments and government-agreed deliverables.
* Support development of costed annual workplans and embed these into the programme's operational budgeting cycle.
* Prepare high-quality progress reports, briefing notes, and strategy documents for donors and government counterparts.

State-Level Engagement
  
  

* Lead WJCF's engagement in focal states in coordination with NCDC and state health departments, tailoring activities to each state's readiness and existing ecosystem.
* Support state-level surveillance system strengthening and feed learnings back into the national platform for wider uptake.
* Facilitate alignment between state health and environment departments on lead-related priorities.

Stakeholder and Partner Management
  
  

* Build and maintain relationships with NCDC, MoHFW senior officials, state health departments, CPCB, FSSAI, and development partners including WHO, UNICEF, Pure Earth, Vital Strategies, and others active in the lead ecosystem.
* Support advocacy efforts in collaboration with strategic partners, ensuring technical assistance and policy advocacy are complementary

**Required**

* Postgraduate degree in public health, public policy, environmental science, health management, development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 4-6 years of relevant experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative modeling skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationship with internal and external stakeholders, including more senior-level individuals
* Ability to drive forward assigned workstreams effectively (e.g., through thoughtful work planning, priority setting, stakeholder engagement, etc.)
* Entrepreneurial mindset, ability to work independently in ambiguous, semi-structured environments.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

**Preferred**

* Experience in environmental health, chemical toxicants, or occupational health programme areas.
* Prior experience in a secretariat or TSU role supporting a government technical programme in public health
* Professional proficiency in Hindi.

To Apply
  
  
Please send your CV and a cover note of not more than one page. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
  
  
***Last date to Apply 14 November, 2026***

title: Strategy & Operations Director
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India.
  
  
Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. Earlyfit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP-1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioural support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also...) means there is a unique opportunity to category- create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 brining monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**Strategy & Operations - Role Overview**
The S&O (Strategy & operations) role offers an opportunity to join the founding team of Voy India (formerly Earlyfit) in building 1-10. We’re scaling aggressively with the full backing of a tech, clinical and patient ops powerhouse that has 7+ years’ experience serving 2mn+ customers globally across not just weight loss but also hair loss, TRT, HRT, dermatology and more.
  
  
This role is a generalist that will be thrown at many business problems over their time here – some big, some small, some that will take a few weeks and IC laser focus and some that will take months and a team of 50. The role needs a high-ownership executor with a strategic mind and a builder mindset. Somebody not afraid to take risks, test and fail fast and then pivot quickly. We throw you at any business problem whether that’s in Acquisitions/Growth, Partnerships or Patient Experience/Retention - you take the problem head on, lead discovery, run 2-3 quick pilots, tell us what you want to bet on and then take all the resources you need to execute and scale. Hire, train, standardize/set SOPs, use product teams, and work cross functionally. And finally, work yourself out of the project so it continues to thrive and grow while you move to your next business problem.
  
  
**If this sounds like you, and you have**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles.
* Proven ability to execute and lead cross-functional initiatives and teams
* A burning desire to come to Delhi and build from scratch and get your hands dirty and point to something super impactful and say ‘Hey, I made that happen'

Then let’s chat!

title: Supplier Administrator IV
description:
Indian Ministry of Defence (IMoD) has an enduring requirement for airborne ISR platforms using MQ-9B aircraft, purchased from GA-ASI. The IMoD will rely on General Atomics Global India Pvt Ltd., (GAGIPL) to develop the infrastructure for Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) required to operate and sustain the Indian MQ-9B aircraft. To fulfill this requirement GAGIPL is hiring additional Indian-national support personnel.
  
  
Under general direction, this position is responsible for developing and managing the local supply base and supply chain infrastructure in India for GAGIPL ensuring compliance with both local Indian regulations and GA corporate policies. This individual will report to Director (India Ops) through the Head of Technical Operations.
  
  
Areas of responsibility include supplier identification, evaluation, localization, qualification, on boarding, and performance management. Contract and purchase order execution will be performed primarily by US-based counterparts. This role will collaborate closely with those teams to ensure alignment of sourcing strategies and supplier readiness. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.

Supply Chain & Supplier Development
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, and develop potential suppliers and subcontractors in the Indian market ensuring alignment with GAGIPL and GA corporate policies
* Conduct supplier capability assessments, including quality systems, capacity, financial stability, and compliance with applicable regulations
* Support source selection decisions by providing supplier assessments, risk analyses, and total cost of ownership evaluations to US-based procurement teams
* Work with suppliers to improve performance in quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness, including development of corrective and preventive action plans
* Support localization and indigenization initiatives in line with program and regulatory requirements
* Support US-based procurement teams with local market intelligence, supplier data, and cost inputs in support of purchase order and subcontract awards
* Support the administration of subcontracts from a performance and supplier management perspective, including monitoring delivery, quality, and adherence to program requirements

title: Senior Learning and Development Specialist
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Learning & Development Specialist
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon (supporting L.E.K.'s Australia practice)
  
  
**Reports to:**
HR Manager, Australia
  
  
**Working model:**
Hybrid
  
  
**Company Profile**
L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.
  
  
How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior Learning and Development Specialist will support talent operations in addition to the design, coordination and delivery of professional development programs and learning initiatives for L.E.K.'s Australia practice, based in our Gurgaon office.
  
  
This role combines learning strategy and content design, program facilitation support, and operational coordination, working closely with the HR Manager, Australia leadership, global counterparts and external partners to deliver high-quality training and development across the practice.
  
  
The role requires an experienced Learning & Development practitioner who can work independently across time zones, manage multiple priorities, and operate confidently in a fast-paced professional services environment. The role also requires working experience in people operations and HR business Partnering support.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**
**Australia Learning & Development**
Learning Strategy & Program Design
  
  

* Contribute to the design and support implementation of the Australia multi-year learning strategy
* Re-design course content in conjunction with subject matter experts across the business
* Conduct training needs analysis during half-yearly performance reviews, identifying development gaps
* Coordinate the monthly Australia learning curriculum
* Support facilitation of learning programs across the Australia practice
* Develop on-demand content for orientation and key learning modules
* Continuously improve the Australia approach to learning and participant experience

Annual Professional Development (PD)
  
  

* Coordinate and manage the Australia Annual PD calendar and training roadmap
* Support planning and execution of Manager PD programs
* Coordinate Core Services Annual PD programs across offices
* Track Australia PD program participation, attendance and feedback
* Support promotion and visibility of quarterly training initiatives and learning campaigns

PD Administration & Logistics
  
  

* Manage monthly Consulting PD operations and logistics
* Coordinate training schedules, invitations and calendar management
* Track monthly training attendance and reporting
* Manage training feedback processes including communications, tracking and reminders
* Prepare quarterly reporting for Australia leadership, Office Heads and Sector Heads

Training Coordination & Content Management
  
  

* Prepare training invitations, communication materials and flyers
* Partner with trainers and facilitators to update learning materials and presentation decks
* Maintain and update decks on the Global PD repository
* Attend Global PD community of practice calls and support follow-up actions where required
* Ensure learning materials and communications are accurate, updated and aligned globally

**Australia People & Talent Operations**
Performance Review Cycles
  
  

* Coordinate the end-to-end half-yearly performance review process requirements for the Australia practice
* Support calibration sessions and consolidate review outcomes for leadership
* Track completion rates and follow up with managers and employees on outstanding reviews
* Maintain performance review documentation and ensure data accuracy in HR systems
* Partner with the Learning and Inclusion Manager to translate review outcomes into development priorities

Talent Projects & Operations
  
  

* Support execution of Australia talent projects, including recruitment funnel tracking and reporting
* Support delivery of promotion and career progression processes
* Assist with ad-hoc talent initiatives such as engagement surveys and retention analysis

**Other Strategic Projects**

* Drive key strategic initiatives in support of the Australia practice's growth strategy
* Coordinate and support execution of regional PD projects and new learning program launches
* Contribute to continuous improvement of learning processes and participant experience
* Support the broader Talent team on other initiatives and business-as-usual activity

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Liaise with internal stakeholders including HRBPs, consulting leadership and program facilitators
* Support smooth delivery of learning sessions across multiple offices and time zones
* Build strong working relationships across the Australia leadership team
* Support ad-hoc people initiatives and special projects as required

**Candidate Requirements**

* Strong facilitation and content design skills, with the ability to lead learning sessions independently
* Excellent organisational and co-ordination skills with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across regions
* Proactive, collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced consulting environment
* Strong operational discipline and execution capability
* Genuine interest in learning and development, and people strategy
* Experience supporting performance review cycles, talent operations or broader people operations processes
* Sound understanding of HR and talent operations practices, including data management and reporting

**Candidate Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organisational Development or a related field
* 5-7 years of experience in Learning & Development, HR Operations or people coordination roles, including content design and facilitation
* Prior experience designing and delivering learning programs, training operations or employee engagement initiatives
* Experience within professional services, consulting or a fast-paced corporate environment preferred
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook
* Experience managing training logistics, communications and stakeholder coordination
* Familiarity with learning platforms, survey tools or HR systems is an advantage
* Experience working across regional or multicultural teams, ideally supporting Australia or APAC, preferred
* 4+ years of experience in People or Talent Operations, performance management or HR operations, in addition to L&D experience
* Prior experience supporting performance review cycles, talent projects or workforce reporting in a professional services or corporate environment

**Benefits And Perks Offered**

* L.E.K. offers the opportunity to work in a hybrid setup
* We are among the best paying firms globally
* Generous time away
* Monthly training programmes for personal and professional development
* Parental leave (maternity and paternity) and flexible work options for new parents
* Wellness benefits: health insurance, wellness apps, gym reimbursement

title: Co-Founder - Academy Division
description:
**Company Description**
  
HackHalt Cyber Intelligence Council (CIN: U94990DL2025NPL459178) is a Section 8 organization committed to strengthening global defenses against cybercrime and enabling secure digital participation for individuals, enterprises, and public institutions. The council focuses on AI-driven cyber intelligence and advanced research, using a four-pillar strategy that includes Prevention, Education, Detection, and Rapid Response. Through this approach, HackHalt moves beyond reactive models to anticipate and mitigate emerging threats. Supported by 40+ global partners and having trained over 10,000 individuals by 2026, the organization is actively building a resilient, future-ready cyber workforce and reinforcing digital ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Co-Founder – Academy Division will lead the strategic development and growth of HackHalt’s cyber education and training initiatives in a full-time, remote capacity. This role involves designing and refining curricula, programs, and learning pathways that align with industry standards and HackHalt’s mission of building a robust cyber workforce. The Co-Founder will oversee day-to-day operations of the Academy Division, including program management, stakeholder coordination, and performance tracking. Responsibilities include collaborating with global partners, identifying market and skill gaps, driving learner enrollment, and ensuring high-quality delivery through instructors, mentors, and digital platforms. The role also requires active involvement in brand positioning for the Academy, contributing to thought leadership, and continuously evolving offerings based on research and emerging cyber trends.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to interpret market trends, learner data, and cyber education needs, and to drive evidence-based decision-making.
* Excellent communication abilities, including written, verbal, and presentation skills, to engage learners, partners, and internal teams.
* Sales capabilities to build and manage pipelines for academy programs, foster relationships, and convert leads into enrollments.
* Marketing skills to position the Academy brand, develop outreach campaigns, and promote programs across digital and offline channels.
* Research skills to track developments in cybersecurity, education methodologies, and AI-driven learning tools for continuous program improvement.
* Demonstrated experience in education, training, or technology-based ventures, preferably in cybersecurity or related fields.
* Proven leadership in building or scaling initiatives, including strategic planning, team management, and partnership development.
* Comfort working in a remote, collaborative environment with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Relevant academic background or professional certifications in cybersecurity, technology, business, or education are beneficial.
