title: Head of Operations
description:
**Note : Please apply only if you have worked in a quick\-commerce or top e\-commerce company** 




  





**Location:** 
 South Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 3–12 years
 



**Preferred Background:** 
 Quick Commerce / E\-commerce / Last\-Mile Logistics / Dark Store Operations
 



**Preferred companies:** 
 Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket, Amazon, Flipkart, Shadowfax, Porter or similar high\-speed operations businesses.
 



  





**About TapStock** 




**TapStock is building a technology\-led procurement and fulfilment platform for the interior, architecture and construction ecosystem.** 




**We are looking for our first Operations hire** 
 to build TapStock’s operating system from scratch across warehouse, inventory, fulfilment, dispatch, delivery and customer experience.
 



 You’ll work directly with the
 **founding and technology teams** 
 .
 



**Mission:** 
 Build operations that can handle
 **10X volume without adding 10X people.** 




  





**What you'll own :** 




**1\. Order Fulfilment** 



* Own Order → Stock → Picking → QC → Packing → Dispatch → Delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks and continuously improve fulfilment speed and accuracy.



**2\. Warehouse \& Inventory** 



* Build processes for receiving, inwarding, storage, picking, QC, packing, dispatch and returns.
* Establish SKU/bin discipline, cycle counting, reconciliation and inventory accuracy.
* Create simple SOPs that teams can execute consistently.



**3\. Last\-Mile Delivery** 



* Design TapStock’s initial delivery model across riders, third\-party partners and mini\-trucks.
* Own route planning, batching, SLAs and delivery costs.
* Optimise for
 **fast delivery at the lowest sustainable cost.**



**4\. Technology \+ Operations** 



* Work closely with the technology team to turn operational problems into scalable product solutions. Example: Wrong item picked → Poor SKU identification → Barcode/QR\-based picking.



 The constant question should be:
 **“Can technology eliminate this manual activity?”** 




**5\. Build the Operating Playbook** 




 Create SOPs covering fulfilment, inventory, delivery, returns, damages, failed deliveries, escalations and emergency orders.
 



  





**Metrics you will Own :** 




**Fulfilment:** 
 Processing time, pick/pack/dispatch time, fulfilment SLA
 



**Inventory:** 
 Accuracy, stock\-outs, picking accuracy, shrinkage, damages
 



**Delivery:** 
 On\-time %, delivery time, failures, cost/delivery, orders/rider
 



**Productivity:** 
 Orders/day, orders/employee, orders/hour, warehouse utilisation
 



  





**What we are looking for :** 



* 3–10 years in Quick Commerce, E\-commerce, Last\-Mile or Dark Store operations.
* Hands\-on experience in high\-speed fulfilment environments.
* Strong understanding of warehouse and last\-mile operations.
* Excellent Excel/Google Sheets and analytical skills.
* Strong execution, ownership and problem\-solving ability.
* Comfortable working directly with technology/product teams.
* Comfortable building processes from scratch in a startup.



  





**Most importantly:** 
 We want someone who has
 **personally solved operational problems on the ground** 
 , not someone who only prepares MIS reports.
 



  





 You should be
 **fast, analytical, hands\-on, process\-driven and technology\-friendly.** 




**You could be in the warehouse at 8 AM, analysing 200 orders at 11 AM and redesigning the workflow with the technology team at 4 PM.** 




  





**Reporting** 




**Reports directly to the Founder / CEO** 
 during the MVP stage and works closely with
 



 Product/Technology, Procurement, Warehouse, Customer Success and Delivery Partners.
 



  





**Compensation** 




**Fixed compensation \+ meaningful performance\-linked component. Final compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability to build scalable operations.** 




  





**Selection Process** 



* Founder Interview
* Operations Case Study
* Ground Operations Assessment
* Final Founder Discussion

title: Junior Live Music & Comedy Event Producer
description:
**Junior Event Producer — Booking \& Live Events** 




 Full\-time \| Louder Studio, Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi
 



  





**About Louder** 




 Louder is a live events and entertainment company promoting art, music, and culture. We work with artists, agents, venues, and brands to create memorable live experiences and build audiences for creative talent — with events, tours, and nightclub nights spanning India, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and other international markets. Our mission is to promote multicultural art and cultural exchange for audiences everywhere.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 You'll identify, develop, and secure talent, and manage the relationships and logistics that turn a booking into a sold\-out show — from first pitch through to post\-event settlement. You'll maintain existing client relationships and act as the link between artists, agents, managers, venues, vendors, and our internal team throughout a show's lifecycle. Much of the role is research, budgeting, negotiation, selling, and building the systems and data that make each show better than the last — while contributing to Louder's programming across Australia, NZ, Singapore, India, and beyond, including our nightclub events. Comfort with AI tools across every function of the role is expected.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Research \& Talent* 



* Research markets, cities, and venues; map artists to the right audiences and evaluate profitability and market potential
* Track emerging talent, indie artists, and pop\-culture trends worth booking
* Analyse international markets, audience presence, and other metrics to gauge opportunity



  





*Booking \& Deal\-Making* 



* Pitch concepts and opportunities to artists, agents, and creative teams
* Support and follow up on artist negotiations — reviewing contract notes carefully and capturing negotiation details
* Secure venue availability and backup holds; negotiate booking terms with venues
* Coordinate and maintain key sales points and rider requirements for artists
* Book diverse, credible lineups aimed at maximising ticket sales



  





*Touring \& Show Planning* 



* Draft event business plans and marketing plans
* Build itineraries, routing plans, and touring strategies; develop and manage event calendars and capacities
* Build comprehensive event budgets, capacity plans, and financial projections



  





*Financials \& Admin* 



* Manage financial arrangements — deposits, settlements, expenditure tracking, and event P\&Ls
* Follow up on third\-party quotes and invoices; manage expense reports and contracts
* Build and maintain systems and templates that make booking, budgeting, and reporting repeatable across shows; run post\-event evaluations to improve future events



  





*Marketing, Ticketing \& Sellouts* 



* Own the marketing for your shows end\-to\-end — announcements, campaigns, and promotion — to ensure every show sells out
* Sell TixMojo, our in\-house ticketing platform, to event organisers
* Pitch tickets and sponsorship via call, email, and SMS/WhatsApp
* Identify and collaborate with influencers, promoters, and industry partners to help sell out shows
* Manage the full grant lifecycle — identifying and pitching for grants, writing proposals, winning them, and carrying them through execution, implementation, and reporting/feedback



  





*Platform \& Data* 



* Lead development of our AI\-powered event management platform, working to automate event management work end\-to\-end
* Maintain and update our talent and market database city by city — tracking which shows, genres, and languages are performing well across all the markets we operate in, not just India



  





  





*On\-Site \& Logistics* 



* Project\-manage end\-to\-end logistics for your portfolio of events — staffing, technical/logistic suppliers, production, and venue operations
* Source quotes from vendors and suppliers, and provide on\-site support during execution



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Minimum 2 years' experience in live music/comedy booking, event production, venue booking, promoting, artist management, or client servicing (as a venue booker, agent, promoter, or promoter/agent assistant — gained professionally, independently, or through grassroots/DIY work)
* Experience across all aspects of producing a show — booking/buying, marketing, production, and settlement



  




* Ability to run a tour end\-to\-end: finding venues, routing, scheduling, and executing across a city or country
* Strong Excel skills and confidence building and tracking event budgets
* Working knowledge of lighting, sound, and AV as used in live events
* Wide knowledge of Indian and international artists, DJs, comedians, and entertainers, with genuine engagement in pop culture and emerging talent
* Comfortable selling and pitching a product or service to clients/organisers
* Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills
* Strong organisational and time\-management skills; able to multitask and manage multiple projects and deadlines at once
* Comfortable working with data — understanding, building, and capturing data to track and improve outcomes
* Genuine interest in music, comedy, pop culture, and live entertainment


- 


 Some travel and work across international time zones may be required.
 



  





 One More Thing
 



 "It's not my job" isn't part of our vocabulary. We stuff envelopes; for a fake shaadi, we sourced every costume and element an Indian baraat needs, then found musicians in another country and briefed them on the songs and instruments so it went off seamlessly. We make mistakes, and learn from them.

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Event Manager
description:
**About us:** 




  






 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.
 
**We do over INR 1000 crore\+ GMV (sales) and are growing rapidly.** 




  






 Our strong business model and focus on delivering excellent customer experience has facilitated our sustainable growth funded by internal cashflows.
 
**To fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors! fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors!** 




  





**Growth Prospects:** 




  





**Annual CTC** 

 \- ₹ 10 to 18 LPA (80% Fixed \+ 20% Variable)
 




  





**Growth Path** 




  






 GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
 





 Head \- 18\-35 LPA
 





 Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
 





 Associate \- 5\-10 LPA
 




  





**What's on Offer:** 




  




* High ownership from the beginning, with the opportunity to see your work translate into measurable business outcomes.
* Direct exposure to cross\-functional teams and senior leaders in a fast\-growing travel technology business.
* A steep learning curve, transparent performance expectations and merit\-led growth opportunities
* A high\-energy, in\-office environment in the heart of Connaught Place, New Delhi.



  





**Our founding team:** 




  






 The founding team has aced their respective leadership roles at successful internet startups in India, which are as follows:
 




  




* **Ashish** 

 \- Cofounder, leads technology, Ex CTO Cars24, CTO FabFurnish, Gaadi.
* **Arun** 

 \- Cofounder, leads product, Ex Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory, IIM Bangalore.
* **Chirag** 

 \- Cofounder, leads business, Ex Oyo, TravelTriangle, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee.



  





**What do we value?** 




  




* **We are a team of believers.** 

 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.
* **We dream big** 

 , yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.
* **We are a team of differentiated and ambitious individuals** 

 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.
* **We believe flexibility in** 

 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 

 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



  





**Your Mission** 




  






 Own the end\-to\-end delivery of TravClan's events and BTL activations — from concept, planning and budgeting to on\-ground execution and post\-event evaluation. The role requires someone who has personally delivered large, complex events and can remain accountable for timelines, quality, budgets and participant experience. 
 




  





**What we are looking for:** 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 

 :
 




  




* Build and own an events and activations calendar linked to business priorities, then deliver large\-scale events, conferences, partner meets, exhibitions and BTL activations end to end.
* Translate event objectives into detailed plans covering format, audience, venue, production, logistics, staffing, travel and communication; close statutory permissions, safety, compliance and contingency requirements before execution.
* Create and manage event budgets; negotiate with venues, production partners and other vendors while protecting quality and commercial outcomes.
* Personally lead on\-ground execution, solve real\-time issues and ensure every stakeholder understands deliverables, dependencies and timelines.
* Coordinate across Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance and leadership teams to obtain decisions early and drive all pre\-event and post\-event actions to closure.
* Track registrations, attendance, engagement, leads, cost per participant/lead and other agreed success metrics; prepare clear post\-event ROI reviews with learnings and next actions.
* Build repeatable event checklists, vendor standards and operating processes that improve speed, reliability and cost efficiency across future events.



  





**Check if you fit in the role\-** 




  





**You Must** 




  




* Have 3\+ years of hands\-on event/BTL experience with direct ownership of large\-scale events.
* Have strong project management, commercial judgement and vendor negotiation skills.
* Understand permissions, venue compliance, safety protocols and contingency planning.
* Be calm under pressure, detail\-oriented and comfortable with travel and non\-standard hours



  





**You Can** 




  




* Deliver large events on time, within budget and at expected quality.
* Anticipate risks and resolve on\-ground issues without avoidable escalation.
* Coordinate multiple stakeholders and hold vendors accountable through closure.
* Measure event outcomes and use learnings to improve future events.



  





**You Want to** 




  




* Own events end\-to\-end, from planning through on\-ground execution.
* Work in a high\-ownership environment where execution quality is visible and measurable.
* Make quick decisions and solve problems on the ground.



  





**This role is not ideal for someone who is** 




  




* Your experience is limited to small internal activities, weddings/social events, or supporting someone else who owned the overall event.
* You prefer strategy or creative ideation without direct accountability for budgets, logistics and on\-ground delivery.
* You are uncomfortable with travel, intensive event timelines or resolving last\-minute operational issues.



  





**The Recruitment Process:** 




  






 1\.
 
**Aptitude Test:** 

 The first step of the recruitment process is a basic 50\-minute aptitude test.
 





 2\.
 
**Group Discussion:** 

 If you clear the Aptitude Test, the second step of the recruitment process would be a 20\-30\-minute group discussion round.
 





 3\.
 
**Personal Interviews:** 

 2\-3 video interviews. Detailed discussions about the job profile, company \& candidature are discussed in these rounds.
 





 4\.
 
**Extending an offer:** 

 On successfully clearing the interview rounds, the job offer is extended to the candidate. This includes financial benefits and many other benefits.
 




  





**Important Points:** 




  




* Office Location\- Connaught Place, Delhi
* Work Timings \-
 
**You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time.**

title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring
 



  





 \- Support monitoring of project implementation across 90 police stations in three states, including field visits to selected police stations on quarterly basis.
 



  





 7\. Coordination
 



  





 Ensuring smooth communication, information exchange and prompt follow up with:
 



  





 \- All state project monitoring units (State Supervisor \& Research Associates in 3 states)
 



 \- External agencies engaged in data analysis (CESS, Hyderabad \& CGG, Hyderabad)
 



 \- Evaluation Agencies for Baseline \& Endline Evaluation in 3 states
 



 \- Donor Agency
 



  





 8\. Documentation and Reporting
 



  





 \- Documentation of Best Practice Visit reports submitted by the Project Coordinator, State Supervisors \& Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher (himself).
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to the Donor Agency as and when required.
 



 \- Preparation of the Final Project Report, based on Public consultation meetings, Change Manual, baseline and endline evaluation reports from the respective states and monthly reports from respective State Supervisors.
 



  





 9\. Miscellaneous
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher will report to the Project Director and Project Coordinator.
 



 \- In\-addition to the above\-mentioned job chart, the Project Director \& Project Coordinator may assign any other project related tasks from time to time.
 



  





 SALARY AND OTHER SERVICE CONDITIONS
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research): Rs. 75,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- Senior Researcher: Rs. 60,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- The selected candidate will have to give the undertaking in the form of the bond to serve for minimum period of one year.
 



 \- Economy\-class airfare for visits to various States and UTs
 



 \- Accommodation in police guest houses (or will be reimbursed as per IPF policy).
 



 \- Other service conditions will be governed by IPF HR and other policies
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Selection will be based on a written examination and an interview (if you clear the written exam) to be held on 15th \& 16th October 2026 at IPF HQ New Delhi.

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**About the role**




 We are looking for a highly detail\-oriented, execution\-focused, and analytically strong Project Manager to join our online market research operations team. This role is central to the successful delivery of quantitative research studies across global markets, predominantly the US, UK, and international B2B/B2C ecosystems.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong end\-to\-end ownership capabilities across project execution, client servicing, scripting coordination, sample management, data quality validation, and reporting workflows. This is not a coordination\-only role — we are looking for someone who understands the operational, logical, and analytical nuances of online research and can proactively drive projects with speed, accountability, and precision.
 



 The role demands high agility, strong multi\-tasking ability, operational maturity, and comfort working in a fast\-paced environment handling multiple concurrent studies with strict timelines.
 



  





**Role\- Senior Project Manager (Online Market Research Operations)** 




**Location\- Gurugram (Work from Office)** 




  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**End\-to End Project Ownership** 



* Independently manage the complete lifecycle of quantitative online research projects from kickoff to final delivery.
* Ensure projects are launched, monitored, validated, and delivered within timelines while adhering to client requirements and internal quality standards.
* Maintain complete ownership of project execution including timelines, feasibility alignment, scripting coordination, field management, quotas, data checks, tabulation planning, and reporting coordination.
* Drive proactive communication internally and externally throughout all project phases.



**Client Servicing \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for clients during active project execution.
* Interpret client objectives, research intent, questionnaire requirements, and reporting expectations accurately.
* Ensure timely acknowledgement and resolution of client requests, revisions, and escalations.
* Build confidence with clients through responsiveness, attention to detail, consultative thinking, and execution reliability.



**Questionnaire Review \& Research Logic Understanding** 



* Review questionnaires thoroughly for logic consistency, research flow, respondent experience, and data quality implications before scripting.
* Possess strong understanding of:
* Complex skip logic
* Piping and randomization
* Rotations and masking
* Quota structures
* Validation conditions
* Multi\-level logic dependencies
* Mobile optimization
* Grid optimization
* Conjoint and MaxDiff structures
* Brand lists and segmentation frameworks
* Identify gaps, contradictions, or potential respondent biases proactively before launch.



**Scripting Coordination \& Survey Validation** 



* Work closely with Survey Programming teams and possess operational exposure to platforms such as Decipher and related survey ecosystems.
* Coordinate testing and validation for:
* Survey logic
* Quota controls
* Redirects
* URL parameters
* API variables
* Security checks
* Device compatibility
* Open\-end validations
* Conduct multiple rounds of pre\-launch QA across logic, aesthetics, respondent flow, language handling, and overall user experience before exposing links to clients or sample partners.
* Ensure all client comments and revisions are implemented accurately and validated thoroughly.



**Sample \& Vendor Management** 



* Coordinate with internal panel assets and external sample/vendor partners for feasibility, pricing, quota distribution, and field monitoring.
* Monitor incidence rates, conversion trends, dropout points, and supply quality during fieldwork.
* Optimize sample allocation and vendor mix to balance quality, timelines, and project profitability.
* Handle vendor communication professionally while maintaining accountability on deliverables and quality expectations.



**Data Quality \& Validation** 



* Take ownership of overall data integrity and respondent quality throughout project execution.
* Identify and remove:
* Speeders
* Straight\-liners
* Duplicate respondents
* AI/fraudulent responses
* Gibberish or poor\-quality open ends
* Contextually inconsistent responses
* Apply contextual and logical validations beyond automated checks to ensure reliable and research\-ready datasets.
* Work closely with Data Processing teams on data cleaning logic, variable mapping, coding structures, weighting requirements, and final outputs.



**Operational Excellence \& Automation Mindset** 



* Be highly proficient in Excel and operational data handling including:
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
* Pivot tables
* Advanced formulas
* Data cleaning
* Validation techniques
* Large dataset handling
* Leverage automation tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and operational efficiencies to improve turnaround time and reduce manual dependency.
* Maintain strong process discipline, documentation standards, and execution accuracy while handling multiple live studies simultaneously.



**Budget \& Commercial Awareness** 



* Track project costs, sample spends, vendor allocation, and operational profitability throughout execution.
* Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure projects remain commercially viable while maintaining quality standards.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications**




**Experience** 



* 4–7 years of experience in online quantitative market research project management.
* Prior experience handling international research studies across US, UK, APAC, or Middle East markets preferred.
* Experience in agency\-side or full\-service research environments strongly preferred.



**Technical \& Research Understanding** 




 Strong operational understanding of:
 


* Online survey methodologies
* Questionnaire structures
* Survey logic and routing
* Quota management
* Conjoint and MaxDiff studies
* Tabulation planning
* Data validation workflows
* Online panel ecosystems and sampling methodologies



 Exposure to:
 


* Decipher
* Sawtooth
* SPSS/tabulation workflows
* Automation and AI\-assisted operational tools is highly preferred.



**Core Competencies** 



* Exceptional attention to detail
* Strong ownership mindset
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Fast learner with high adaptability
* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills
* Calm under pressure with strong prioritization ability
* High responsiveness and communication discipline
* Strong operational accountability



  





**Why Join BioBrain?**



* Work with a global client base across diverse industries and research methodologies.
* Be part of a highly agile, technology\-driven research organization focused on automation, operational excellence, and innovation.
* Gain exposure to advanced research operations, AI\-integrated workflows, and international market research ecosystems.
* Opportunity to grow into strategic operations, client leadership, automation, and research consulting roles.



  





 Please apply directly to Nikita@biobrain.io and apply only if you can join within 30 days or have a notice period of 30 days or less.

In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end\-to\-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value\-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13\.4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew’s solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150\+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1\.9 % of India’s power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0\.5% of India’s total carbon emissions and 1\.1% India’s total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1\.3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India’s policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew’s current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India’s growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India.

title: Supply Chain Digital Transformation Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 The Supply Chain Digital Transformation Lead is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end digital transformation of the supply chain function through the application of technology, data and artificial intelligence, spanning demand planning, supply planning, procurement, distribution and cost. It is accountable for identifying, evaluating and implementing the digital tools and applications that transform each process, and for leading the associated change through to adoption.
 



 Working across the planning, procurement, distribution, finance and technology teams, the role sets the digital transformation agenda, develops the business case for technology and artificial intelligence investment, and leads the selection, implementation and adoption of supply chain applications. The function leaders retain ownership of their processes and outcomes; the role partners with them to ideate, evaluate and deploy the right solutions and to strengthen the overall capability, efficiency and effectiveness of the supply chain.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Digital Strategy \& Technology Roadmap
 


* Define the multi\-year technology and AI roadmap for the supply chain, prioritizing the tools and applications to be introduced across planning, sourcing, distribution and cost.
* Evaluate and select supply chain solutions through build\-versus\-buy assessment, vendor and platform evaluation, and proof\-of\-concept against clearly defined use cases.
* Build the business case for each technology investment, covering value at stake, cost and sequencing, and secure leadership alignment behind it.



 B. Planning Systems — Demand \& Supply
 


* Identify, evaluate and implement Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and AI\-based demand forecasting to replace spreadsheet\-based, brand\-wise planning, with the S\&OP leader owning the planning process.
* Deploy the Auto\-Replenishment System (ARS) and inventory\-optimization tools for supply planning, working with the supply planning leader who owns norms and service levels.
* Configure the planning applications, integrations and data flows, and transition operational ownership to the planning leaders.



 C. Sourcing \& Procurement Systems
 


* Evaluate and implement e\-sourcing and e\-auction platforms, contract lifecycle management (CLM) and supplier relationship management (SRM), with the category leaders owning sourcing strategy and negotiations.
* Introduce spend analytics, should\-cost and commodity\-index tools to support category and cost decisions.
* Digitize supplier onboarding, performance scorecards and share\-of\-business tracking on a common platform.



 D. Warehouse, Logistics \& Network Systems
 


* Warehouse Management (WMS) and Transport Management (TMS) systems
* Deploy network\-optimization and route\-optimisation tools to inform network design and secondary distribution.
* Implement a supply chain control tower for network\-wide visibility, exception management and early\-warning alerts.



 E. Cost, Analytics \& Decision Systems
 


* Implement cost\-to\-serve and costing\-and\-allocation tools that provide a clear, system\-based view of where cost sits across the value chain, with SC Finance owning the numbers.



 F. Data, AI \& Automation Platforms
 


* Identify and implement workflow automation and process automation to remove manual, repetitive tasks across supply chain processes.
* Establish the data foundation, master data and integration layer required for reliable analytics and AI across the applications landscape.
* Ideate, pilot and scale artificial intelligence and machine\-learning use cases — such as forecasting, anomaly detection and prescriptive recommendations — in partnership with IT and solution providers.



 Key Projects \& Initiatives
 


* The role will lead a portfolio of digital initiatives that convert core supply chain processes from manual to system\-run. Indicative programmers include:
* Advanced demand planning and AI\-based forecasting — a statistical and machine\-learning forecasting engine integrated with auto\-replenishment.
* MRP automation in SAP (SAP\-VC) — automated material requirement planning, purchase scheduling and vendor call\-off.
* Auto\-replenishment and auto\-indent (ARS) — system\-driven store and distribution\-Centre replenishment based on demand signals.
* Supply chain control tower — a single, real\-time view for exception management and early\-warning alerts.
* Analytics and management dashboards (e.g., Tableau) — automated MIS, self\-service reporting and Capex and new\-store (NSO) pipeline tracking.



 Key Relationships
 



 Internal
 


* Head of Supply Chain Management \& Logistics — reporting line and transformation sponsor.
* Demand Planning \& S\&OP, Supply Planning, Category Management \& Procurement, Capex \& NSO, and Warehouse, Logistics \& Distribution, SC Finance — cost, costing analysis and value realization.
* IT, Digital and Business teams — joint partners in delivering supply chain technology and AI solutions and adopting the new ways of working.



 External
 


* Management consultants and transformation advisors.
* Supply chain benchmarking and best\-practice networks.
* Key suppliers, 3PL and logistics partners.
* Technology, AI and solution providers.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* 7–12 years in supply chain, with a strong track record of leading technology\- and AI\-enabled transformation across planning, procurement and distribution.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Technology, Supply Chain or Operations; a postgraduate qualification (MBA / SCM) is preferred.
* Deep expertise in supply chain technology \& tools including advanced planning, automation, analytics and AI/ML applications.
* Demonstrated success leading digital transformation programmers end to end, from strategy and business case through to implementation and adoption.
* Strong grounding in cost and costing analysis, value realization and business\-case development.
* Exposure to QSR, food, FMCG or multi\-site retail distribution, or a management\-consulting background, is an advantage.



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end supply chain and its digital and AI enablement — demand and supply planning, procurement, distribution and cost.
* Strong command of supply chain technology and artificial intelligence, including advanced planning, automation, data and analytics.
* Strategic, structured problem\-solving; able to design a target operating model and a roadmap to reach it.
* Programmer leadership across multiple concurrent workstreams and senior stakeholders.
* Change leadership — able to influence, challenge and land new ways of working without direct authority.
* Strong commercial and cost acumen; comfortable with costing analysis and value cases.
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management.



 A structured, outside\-in mindset focused on continuous improvement and best practice

**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India

**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.
